*Jongwoon Lee,Jhair Gallardo,Christopher Kanan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该文系统基准测试了在冻结病理基础模型下，输入空间与特征空间的无标签变换对跨医院IHC分级的影响，发现所提出的FIX与特征逐维标准化互补，可显著提升宏F1与QWK。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 病理基础模型多在H&E上预训练，却被越来越多地作为冻结特征提取器用于IHC分级，而跨医院的染色与特征分布差异会损害分级性能；现有针对跨医院IHC分级的校正方法缺乏系统性比较。

Method: 在冻结FM编码前后分别施加无标签变换：编码前对输入图像做输入空间校正（含所提出的FIX及多种染色归一化方法），编码后对特征做特征空间校正（含逐维标准化与CORAL）；使用UNI与Virchow2两个模型、三种IHC标记物、六个有向跨医院迁移任务，共12种设置，并以患者平均的tile级评估比较。

Result: 输入空间中FIX相对无校正取得最大宏F1提升，优于常用染色归一化；特征空间中简单逐维标准化最优，优于CORAL；二者结合使宏F1与QWK分别提升0.181和0.208，有序误差降低0.209。

Conclusion: 输入空间与特征空间变换对基于冻结病理基础模型的跨医院IHC分级具有互补增益，简单的无标签校正即可显著缓解域偏移。

Abstract: Pathology foundation models (FMs) are trained predominantly on hematoxylin and eosin (H&E) images but are increasingly used as frozen feature extractors for immunohistochemistry (IHC), where cross-hospital differences can impair grading. However, systematic comparisons of correction methods for cross-hospital IHC grading remain limited. To address this gap, we benchmark label-free transformations applied to input images before frozen-FM encoding and to features after frozen-FM encoding using UNI and Virchow2, three IHC markers, and six directed cross-hospital transfers, yielding 12 settings. Among the evaluated input-space methods, our proposed method FIX achieved the largest macro-F1 improvement over no correction, outperforming well-known stain normalization techniques. Among feature-space methods, a simple feature-wise standardization achieved the best improvement over no correction, outperforming CORAL. Under patient-averaged tile-level evaluation, combining FIX with feature-wise standardization improved macro-F1 and quadratic weighted kappa (QWK) by 0.181 and 0.208, respectively, and reduced ordinal error by 0.209 relative to no correction. These results show that input- and feature-space transformations can provide complementary benefits for cross-hospital IHC grading with frozen pathology FMs.

</details>


### [25] [Direct Conditional Parameterization for N-Dimensional Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22778)
*Zhongpai Gao,Benjamin Planche,Van Nguyen Nguyen,Meng Zheng,Anwesa Choudhuri,Arun Innanje,Terrence Chen,Ziyan Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出直接条件参数化（direct conditional parameterization），用显式逐效应参数替代N维splatting中基于协方差推导的条件读出，得到dGS与dBS，在质量持平或更优的同时实现6.9–7.7倍切片加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: N-DGS与UBS在每次前向渲染查询中，需通过逐基元矩阵求逆与回归乘积从联合协方差中恢复条件均值、不透明度与协方差，计算开销大。

Method: 将协方差推导读out替换为显式逐效应参数：用Cholesky精度因子表示不透明度，用可学习逐维耦合的因子化查询到位置回归算子；该方法核无关，可同时用于高斯核（dGS）与Beta核（dBS）。

Result: 在五个静态与动态基准上质量持平或超越协方差推导版本，主MCMC评估最高提升+1.26 dB；生产切片较在线协方差条件快6.9–7.7倍，完整渲染在四个训练场景上加速1.25–1.91倍。

Conclusion: 直接条件化消除了逐查询矩阵求逆，提供了一种结构化、核无关的N维splatting替代方案。

Abstract: N-dimensional splatting extends 3D Gaussian Splatting with view direction and time to model view-dependent and dynamic effects. Each primitive is lifted into a joint distribution over position and conditioning variables, then conditionally sliced at each rendering query. N-DGS and UBS share this step across Gaussian and Beta kernels: recovering the conditional mean, opacity, and covariance requires per-primitive matrix inversions and regression products in every forward pass. We introduce direct conditional parameterization, replacing this covariance-derived readout with explicit per-effect parameters: a Cholesky precision factor for opacity and a factorized query-to-position regression operator with learnable per-dimension coupling. Unrestricted conditional coordinates recover a valid joint covariance; our factorization adds spatial-scale and coupling priors. Applied to both kernels, the parameterization yields dGS (Gaussian) and dBS (Beta). Across five static and dynamic benchmarks, they match or exceed their covariance-derived counterparts on quality, with gains up to +1.26 dB in the main MCMC evaluation. Production slicing is 6.9-7.7 times faster than on-the-fly covariance-derived conditioning; complete-render profiling gives 1.25-1.91 times speedups on four trained scenes. Direct conditioning provides a structured, kernel-agnostic alternative for N-dimensional splatting. Project page: https://gaozhongpai.github.io/dgs/.

</details>


### [26] [STRIDE: Evaluating Spatiotemporal Reasoning in Driving Edge Cases](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22795)
*Lieqi Liu,Rui gao,Jia-Chen Gu,Wenbo Hu,Zhaobin Mo,Ahmadreza Moradipari,Nejib Ammar,Wei Wang,Nanyun Peng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: STRIDE是一个面向自动驾驶长尾安全场景的以对象为中心的时空推理基准，包含六类任务与配套的自由形式VQA，最好模型GPT-6-Astra平均选择题准确率仅43.4%，揭示VLM时空推理缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准多以基础感知问题考察边缘案例，或在简单场景中测试时序理解，复杂时空推理仍被忽视；而自动驾驶中若不能把过去空间观测与未来后果联系起来，会导致危险决策。因此需要能检验VLM是否具备时空推理的评测基准。

Method: 提出STRIDE基准，聚焦长尾、安全关键的以对象为中心驾驶场景，覆盖六类任务家族：空间感知、空间理解、时序记忆、时序外推、轨迹预测、场景上下文感知；将探测单一时空判断的多项选择题与需详细场景解释和决策辩护的自由形式VQA配对。优先选取含异常物体行为和复杂交通交互的场景，通过自动化流程从结构化数据集标注生成参考答案，辅以有限的语模型辅助与人工校验保证标注质量。

Result: 在12个专有、开放权重及驾驶专用模型上评测，最佳模型GPT-6-Astra平均选择题准确率仅43.4%（随机基线约20%）。分析显示：描述驾驶场景能力强并不必然转化为准确的安全关键判断；模型在重建物体运动方面比回忆过去位置更困难。聚合VQA分数会掩盖这些时空推理局限。

Conclusion: STRIDE揭示了现有VLM在自动驾驶时空推理上的系统性不足，说明需以细粒度、对象中心的时空任务而非聚合VQA分数来评测模型，为后续提升模型的安全关键时空推理能力提供了诊断工具。

Abstract: In autonomous driving, perceiving surrounding objects is not enough: failing to understand how they move and interact over time can lead to dangerous decisions. Evaluating vision-language models (VLMs) therefore requires testing whether they connect past spatial observations to future consequences. Yet existing benchmarks often assess edge cases through basic perception questions or test temporal understanding in simple scenarios, leaving complex spatiotemporal reasoning underexplored. We introduce STRIDE (SpatioTemporal Reasoning In Driving Edge Cases), an object-centric benchmark for long-tail, safety-critical driving scenarios. STRIDE covers six task families: spatial perception, spatial understanding, temporal memory, temporal extrapolation, trajectory prediction, and scene-context awareness. It pairs multiple-choice questions probing individual spatiotemporal judgments with related free-form visual question answering (VQA) requiring detailed scene explanations and justifications of driving decisions. We prioritize scenes with unusual object behaviors and complex traffic interactions, generate reference answers from structured dataset annotations through automated procedures, and use limited language-model assistance and human verification to ensure annotation quality. Across 12 proprietary, open-weight, and driving-specialized models, even the best performer, GPT-6-Astra, achieves only 43.4% average multiple-choice accuracy, versus an approximately 20% random-choice baseline. Further analysis reveals that strong performance in describing driving scenes does not necessarily translate to accurate safety-critical judgments, and that models struggle more with reconstructing object motion than recalling past positions. STRIDE thus exposes spatiotemporal driving limitations that aggregate VQA scores can conceal.

</details>


### [27] [VISTA: A Multimodal Egocentric Benchmark for Goal-Oriented Perception and Assistance to Blind and Low-Vision Users](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22822)
*Noé Mosca,Mohamed Rayan Barhdadi,Muhammad Hamza,Joshua Yeh,Suryodaya Bikram Shahi,Zhiyan Li,Selim-Antoine Lali,Weiyue Li,Hasan Kurban,Erchin Serpedin,Gang Luo,Yue Zhang,Minghan Li,Mengyu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出 VISTA，一个面向盲人和低视力用户的多模态第一视角辅助基准，包含约1000段 Project Aria 眼镜录制，提供6路同步传感器输入与三类标注、覆盖10个任务类别；对14个视觉语言模型零样本评测显示其在目标导向辅助指导上仍明显不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准存在两点不足：一是主要依赖视觉与文本输入，缺乏对可穿戴设备中凝视、惯性测量、空间轨迹等新兴模态的支持；二是评测侧重场景理解与问答，对盲人和低视力用户在日常任务中的目标条件化（goal-conditioned）引导覆盖不足。

Method: 构建 VISTA 基准：约1000段第一视角录制，采集自 Project Aria 眼镜；每段包含同步传感器流，其中六种作为模型输入；提供三类标注，覆盖从物体定位到危险检测的十类任务。在此基础上零样本评测14个代表性视觉语言模型，并设计一个融合全部六种模态的轻量级多模态基线模型。

Result: 实验表明，现有模型通常能描述第一视角场景，但在生成目标导向的辅助指导方面能力有限；轻量多模态基线验证了整合全部六种模态的可行性。

Conclusion: VISTA 为评测可提升日常无障碍体验的多模态模型提供了标准化基准，揭示了当前视觉语言模型在辅助指导能力上的关键短板。

Abstract: Blindness and low vision limit many people's ability to complete daily tasks, motivating AI assistants that provide useful guidance. Yet, existing benchmarks do not adequately test whether vision models can provide effective everyday assistance. In particular, i) existing benchmarks primarily rely on visual and textual inputs, with limited support for other modalities that are increasingly available in egocentric wearable devices such as gaze, inertial measurements, spatial trajectories, and others; and ii) existing evaluations emphasize scene understanding and question answering, with limited coverage of goal-conditioned guidance for blind and low-vision users across everyday tasks. To bridge this gap, we introduce VISTA (Visually Impaired Scene and Task Annotations), a multimodal egocentric benchmark for goal-oriented assistance for blind and low-vision users. VISTA contains $\sim$1,000 egocentric recordings captured with Project Aria glasses; each recording provides synchronized sensor streams, six of which serve as model inputs, and three different types of annotation, covering ten task categories (TC), from object localization to hazard detection. We evaluate 14 representative vision-language models zero-shot on VISTA and design a lightweight multimodal model baseline that integrates all six modalities. Experimental results show that, although existing models can often describe egocentric scenes, they remain limited in generating goal-directed assistive guidance. VISTA thus provides a benchmark for evaluating multimodal models that could improve everyday accessibility.

</details>


### [28] [VTrajEmbed: Aligning Text with Video Object Trajectories via Spatiotemporal Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22842)
*Ruizhi Chen,Zining Fan,Yudi Guo,Jiang Liu,Zhiyu Lin,Zhongjiang He,Shouqian Shi,Hao Sun*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出VTrajEmbed嵌入模型，将视频分解为物体轨迹并逐条与文本对齐，实现物体级检索式grounding。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有嵌入模型擅长全局检索，但单一全局表示将多物体及其时空动态纠缠在一起，限制了对物体级grounding的直接支持。

Method: 三项设计：(1) Slow-Fast轨迹编码，双分支架构，密集采样低分辨率帧捕捉高频运动线索、稀疏选取高分辨率帧提供场景上下文，由共享LLM骨干聚合；(2) Mask-Guided对比学习，在关系掩码下结合组内损失与批次级双向损失，排除未验证关系、避免已确认匹配被当作假负例；(3) 构建Text2Traj-Bench，模型辅助构建并经人工校验的轨迹级文本-视频基准。

Result: VTrajEmbed-5B在文→轨迹与轨迹→文R@1上分别比Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B高15.48和18.05个百分点；五个全局检索基准平均R@1为49.48%，对比42.86%。

Conclusion: 轨迹级分解与掩码引导对比学习可在更小模型规模下同时提升物体级grounding与全局检索性能，并配套提供相应评测基准。

Abstract: Fine-grained alignment between text and video object trajectories is a core challenge in multimodal understanding. Existing embedding models excel at global retrieval, yet their single global representation entangles multiple objects and their spatiotemporal dynamics, limiting direct object-level grounding. To address this issue, we propose VTrajEmbed, an embedding model that decomposes a video into object trajectories and aligns each trajectory embedding with text for object-level grounding through retrieval. Our main contributions: (1)Slow-Fast Trajectory Encoding, a dual-branch architecture that establishes trajectory representations by densely sampling low-resolution frames for high-frequency motion cues and sparsely selecting high-resolution frames for scene context, aggregated by a shared LLM backbone; (2)Mask-Guided Contrastive Learning, a training objective built upon these representations that couples an intra-group loss and a batch-level bidirectional loss under a relation mask, excluding unverified relations and preventing confirmed matches from becoming false negatives; (3)Text2Traj-Bench, a trajectory-level text-video benchmark with model-assisted construction and human-verified query--trajectory relations. Experimental results show that VTrajEmbed-5B improves text-to-trajectory and trajectory-to-text R@1 over Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B by 15.48 and 18.05 percentage points, respectively, and achieves 49.48% average R@1 across five global retrieval benchmarks, compared with 42.86% for Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B.

</details>


### [29] [Variational and Decomposed method for Mitigating Bimodal Bias in Robust Visual Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22845)
*Yihan Zhao,Yuncheng Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文研究VQA中的多模态偏置，发现计数与非计数问题的偏置机制不同：计数偏置源于视觉侧并经模态融合传播，非计数偏置主要源于语言偏置并含少量视觉偏置，据此提出VDB方法分别处理两类偏置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VQA去偏研究最初仅关注语言偏置，近年虽注意到多模态偏置，但"多模态偏置究竟是什么"仍不清晰，缺乏对其成因机理的深入理解，导致去偏手段难以针对性设计。

Method: 作者分别考察计数问题与非计数问题的多模态偏置机理：解释计数机制为"数量信息源于特定维度上多模态特征的幅值"，据此判定计数偏置起于视觉侧、经模态融合传播至多模态特征；非计数偏置则主要由语言偏置加轻微视觉偏置构成。基于此提出VDB（Variational and Decomposed method for mitigating Bimodal Bias），提取受视觉与语言不同比例影响的双模态偏置：引入变分偏置模型（基于VAE原理）学习以语言偏置为主、含轻微视觉效应的偏置，并用一个双模态偏置模型刻画语言与视觉共同作用下的多模态偏置。

Result: 在VQACPv2、VQACPv1与GQAOOD数据集上的大量实验验证了所提主张的合理性及VDB方法的有效性；同时对VQAv2上性能下降的原因给出了解释。

Conclusion: 多模态偏置并非单一现象，计数与非计数问题具有不同成因与传播路径，需差异化建模与去除；将偏置按语言/视觉来源分解并结合变分建模可有效缓解双模态偏置，且对标准集性能变化提供了可解释性说明。

Abstract: Visual question answering (VQA) models are known to suffer from the bias issue, which refers to overfitting the regularities of frequent patterns. Previously, researchers only consider the language bias. Recently, the multimodal bias is noticed. However, what multimodal bias is remains unclear. In this paper, we investigate the multimodal bias in counting and non-counting questions. We find that they have distinct underlying mechanism, so their biases come from distinct reasons. We provide valuable interpretations of VQA counting mechanism: \textbf{quantity information stems from the magnitude of the multimodal features in specific dimensions.} Thus, counting bias stems from the vision side and propagates to multimodal features through modality fusion, while the non-counting bias stems from primarily language bias and slightly vision bias. Thus, we propose a method to deal with them differently: Variational and Decomposed method for mitigating Bimodal Bias (VDB). It extracts bimodal bias affected by different proportion of vision and language sides. We introduce variational bias models utilizing the principle of Variational Auto-Encoder to learn mainly language bias with slight vision effect, and a bimodal bias model for bimodal bias combining language and vision sides. Extensive experiments on VQACPv2, VQACPv1, and GQAOOD datasets demonstrate the rationality of our claim and the effectiveness of our method. We also provide explanation for the compromised performance on VQAv2.

</details>


### [30] [HAPACT: A Benchmark For Human-Centric Physical Impact Localization in Movies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22895)
*Youngrae Kim,Yejin Jang,Eunho Kim,Youjin Sung,Kun-Woo Song,Sangpil Kim,Sang Ho Yoon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出以人为中心的冲击定位新任务，并构建HAPACT数据集与基准，用于视频中冲击事件的时间与人体空间定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频人体物理推理多集中于日常接触、压力、姿态与运动，而短暂剧烈的冲击事件研究不足，但其对理解突发物理事件如何影响人体具有重要意义。

Method: 构建HAPACT数据集：源自电影片段，含2.8K+视频-查询对与20K+人工标注帧，采用观众视角标注、文本条件定位、帧级时间监督与基于SMPL-X的空间监督。评估方面，时间定位采用视频时刻检索模型，空间定位采用人-场景接触模型，并提出将定位重构为查询引导的身体区域选择的文本条件基线。

Result: 基准结果显示现有方法在物理冲击定位上仍具挑战性，时间与空间定位性能均有限。

Conclusion: HAPACT可作为专门基准，推动视频中物理冲击推理的研究。

Abstract: Physical reasoning about humans in videos has largely focused on everyday interactions, where contact, pressure, pose, and motion support embodied perception and contact-aware applications. Still, short and forceful properties like impact events remain relatively underexplored, despite their relevance to broader understanding of how abrupt physical events affect the human body. To fill this gap, we introduce human-centric impact localization, a new task that localizes target physical impacts temporally within a video and spatially on the human body. We further present HAPACT, a HumAn-centric imPACT dataset and benchmark built from movie clips, containing over 2.8K video-query pairs with more than 20K fine-grained human-annotated frames. We built HAPACT around viewer-grounded annotation, text-conditioned localization, and supervision at frame-level temporal and SMPL-X-based spatial granularity. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our benchmark, we conduct extensive evaluations of existing methods, employing video moment retrieval models for temporal localization and human-scene contact models for spatial localization. For the spatial task, we propose a text-conditioned baseline by reformulating localization as query-guided body-region selection. Benchmark results show that physical impact localization remains challenging for existing methods, motivating HAPACT as a dedicated benchmark to support physical impact reasoning in videos.

</details>


### [31] [COMET: Decoupled Distillation, Routing, and Capacity Control for Task-Agnostic Continual Vision--Language Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22907)
*Seungyoon Woo,Keonhee Park,Gunhee Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: COMET 通过分离"特征参考、专家塑形、路由与容量控制"四个构造环节，解决 VLM 任务无关持续学习中的模态一致性漂移、表征空间干扰与单任务容量不足问题，在 X-TAIL 基准上验证各组件有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CLIP 类视觉-语言模型虽保留零样本识别能力，但其开放世界部署常需任务无关持续学习：任务顺序到达、旧数据不可得、任务身份未知、骨干网络不可重训。作者认为该设定下 VLM 面临超出经典稳定性-可塑性权衡的三重耦合压力：(1) 模态一致性漂移（图文几何关系退化）；(2) 表征空间干扰（新旧任务特征冲突）；(3) 单任务容量不足。

Method: 提出 COMET（Collaborative Mixture-of-Expert Transfer），三点一一对应：①冻结教师仅在共享图文池上提供特征参考，通过 Tri-Affinity Distillation 保持 image-image、text-text、image-text 三种几何结构；②Student-Aware Cross-Expert Distillation 将新专家与兼容的旧专家对齐，使路由错误可优雅退化；③容量与推理解耦——上下文赌博机（contextual bandit）依据训练后信号决定保留或合并整任务专家，重建式路由器在测试时无需教师语义即可稀疏选择专家。

Result: 在 X-TAIL 基准上进行实验，消融显示所提各组件均能提升持续学习性能；验证了多模态几何保持、累积专家协同与容量分配可被联合实现。

Conclusion: 持续视觉-语言自适应可通过"按构造分离特征参考、专家塑形、路由与容量控制"来同时保持多模态几何、协同已累积专家并分配容量，为 VLM 的任务无关持续学习提供可行框架。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP retain zero-shot recognition ability, but their open-world use often requires task-agnostic continual learning: tasks arrive sequentially, past data are unavailable, task identity is unknown, and the backbone cannot be retrained. We argue that this setting fails VLMs through three coupled pressures beyond the stability-plasticity tradeoff: (1) modal-consistency drift, (2) representation-space interference, and (3) per-task capacity shortfall. We propose COMET (Collaborative Mixture-of-Expert Transfer) to resolve these three issues respectively as follows. A frozen teacher provides only a feature reference on a shared image-text pool; Tri-Affinity Distillation preserves image-image, text-text, and image-text geometry; and Student-Aware Cross-Expert Distillation aligns new experts with compatible prior experts so routing errors degrade gracefully. We design COMET to keep capacity and inference separate: a contextual bandit keeps or merges full per-task experts using post-training signals, while a reconstruction router selects sparse experts at test time without teacher semantics. On the X-TAIL benchmark, we show that each proposed component improves continual learning performance. COMET shows that continual vision-language adaptation can preserve multimodal geometry, coordinate accumulated experts, and allocate capacity jointly when feature reference, expert shaping, routing, and capacity control are separated by construction.

</details>


### [32] [MaskMerge: Structure-aware Token Merging for Efficient Instance Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22921)
*Bavesh Balaji,Letian Jiang,Alexander Wong,David Clausi,Sirisha Rambhatla*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MaskMerge 提出实例感知的 token 合并方法，利用粗粒度中间掩码预测约束基于特征的合并，解决实例分割中的跨实例 token 融合问题，在保持甚至提升精度的同时降低计算量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 token 合并方法主要依赖特征相似度决定合并对象，该准则在语义分割中有效，但在实例分割中失效：同类相邻对象特征高度相似，导致跨实例 token 融合（cross-instance token fusion），破坏实例边界。

Method: 引入 MaskMerge 方法，使用粗粒度的中间掩码预测来约束基于特征的 token 合并，从而在合并冗余 token 的同时保留实例边界信息。

Result: 在 PanNuke 上相比 SOTA 方法 ALGM，mAP 从 30.1 提升至 32.1，计算量从 229 降至 153 GFLOPs，速度提升 1.18 倍；在 iSAID 上 mAP 从 33.1 提升至 36.2，计算量从 198 降至 182 GFLOPs，速度提升 1.23 倍；在 Cityscapes 上以更少 FLOPs 匹配 ALGM 性能；增益可迁移至 MAE 预训练骨干网络。

Conclusion: 当仅凭外观相似度无法可靠保持对象身份时，实例感知的合并能够支持更激进的 token 压缩，兼顾效率与精度。

Abstract: Token merging improves the efficiency of Vision Transformers by combining redundant tokens, but existing methods largely rely on feature similarity to determine which tokens to merge. This criterion is effective for semantic segmentation, yet can fail in instance segmentation, where adjacent objects of the same class often have highly similar features. We identify this failure mode as cross-instance token fusion. We introduce MaskMerge, an instance-aware token merging method that uses coarse intermediate mask predictions to constrain feature-based merging and preserve instance boundaries. We evaluate MaskMerge on two diverse instance segmentation domains characterized by high inter-instance visual similarity: PanNuke and iSAID. Against the SOTA token merging method ALGM, MaskMerge improves mAP from 30.1 to 32.1 on PanNuke while reducing computation from 229 to 153 GFLOPs and running 1.18x faster, and from 33.1 to 36.2 on iSAID while reducing computation from 198 to 182 GFLOPs and running 1.23x faster. Additionally, we also test it on Cityscapes and match ALGM's performance while using fewer FLOPs. The gains also transfer to an MAE pretrained backbone, demonstrating that instance-aware merging enables more aggressive compression when appearance similarity alone cannot reliably preserve object identity.

</details>


### [33] [ODSS-Net: Orthogonally Decoupled Shared-Specific Representations for Multi-Modal Object Re-Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22922)
*Zhifeng Ma,Yuhong Feng,Chongyi Huang,Mingyang Zhou,Minwen Deng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ODSS-Net，通过正交解耦的共享-特异性表征学习与样本自适应专家混合融合，提升多模态目标重识别性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态ReID方法主要通过特征对齐与融合缩小模态差异，但单纯对齐会将模态共享的结构信息与模态特异线索纠缠在一起，而常规融合又难以充分利用互补信息。

Method: 框架包含三个模块：(1) 共享结构特征构建SSFC，抑制与模态相关的表观变化并提取模态共享结构信息；(2) 正交特异性特征学习OSFL，聚合与身份相关的局部信息，并通过几何正交投影去除已对齐的共享分量；(3) 样本自适应专家混合SAMoE，以共享结构作为路由上下文，自适应精炼并融合各模态特异特征。

Result: 在三个基准数据集上的实验验证了ODSS-Net对多模态目标ReID的有效性。

Conclusion: 以正交解耦替代单纯对齐、以共享结构引导的自适应专家混合替代常规融合，可有效缓解模态信息纠缠并提升互补信息利用率。

Abstract: Multi-modal object re-identification (ReID) leverages complementary information from heterogeneous sensors. Cross-modal alignment and fusion remain challenging. Existing methods mainly reduce modality gaps via feature alignment and fusion. However, alignment may entangle modality-shared structural information with modality-specific cues, while conventional fusion may not fully exploit complementary information. To address these issues, we propose ODSS-Net, a framework for orthogonally decoupled shared-specific representation learning and adaptive fusion of complementary modality-specific features. First, a Shared Structural Feature Construction (SSFC) module suppresses modality-dependent appearance variations and extracts modality-shared structural information. Then, an Orthogonal Specific Feature Learning (OSFL) module aggregates identity-relevant local information and removes the shared-aligned component via geometric orthogonal projection. Finally, a Sample Adaptive Mixture of Experts (SAMoE) module uses the shared structure as routing context to adaptively refine and fuse modality-specific features. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of ODSS-Net for multi-modal object ReID.

</details>


### [34] [DICL-Qwen3VL: Decoupled Confidence Calibration for Interpretable Workwear Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22929)
*Meng Wang,Wu Zeng,Mei Li,Chao He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出DICL-Qwen3VL——一种解耦可解释的视觉语言模型，将结构化工装检测、证据生成与视觉/推理独立置信度估计集成，在ICSVD/WICWD上mAP@50达0.730/0.753。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 室内工作场景存在光照不足与遮挡，工装线索模糊，且工装样式多样导致合规判定困难；现有VLM虽支持定位与语义推理，但预测缺乏显式支撑证据，且单一置信度无法区分视觉不确定性与合规判断歧义。

Method: 基于Qwen3-VL：1) 用LoRA适配定位可见上半身服装并识别工装；2) 解耦校准，将视觉观察与合规推理分离并各自赋置信度，视觉置信度以token熵及对图像扰动的敏感性为监督，使置信度估计与生成观察及其对图像内容的依赖相绑定；3) 用GRPO联合优化检测精度、输出有效性与置信度校准。

Result: 在公司采集的ICSWD与网络采集的WICWD上mAP@50分别为0.730与0.753，优于包括Qwen3-VL在内的LoRA适配VLM基线；框架同时输出显式证据与分离置信度以支持人工复核。WICWD已公开。

Conclusion: 解耦式置信度建模与强化学习联合优化可在工业安全监控中提升工装合规判定的准确性、可解释性与可审计性。

Abstract: Poor illumination and occlusion obscure clothing cues in indoor work sites, while diverse clothing styles complicate workwear compliance judgments. Although vision-language models (VLMs) support localization and semantic reasoning, their predictions often lack explicit supporting evidence, and a single confidence score cannot distinguish visual uncertainty from ambiguity in compliance judgments. We propose DICL-Qwen3VL, a decoupled interpretable VLM that integrates structured workwear detection, evidence generation, and separate visual and reasoning confidence estimates. First, low-rank adaptation (LoRA) adapts Qwen3-VL to localize visible upper-body clothing and identify workwear. Second, decoupled calibration separates visual observations from compliance reasoning and assigns a confidence score to each. Token entropy and sensitivity to image perturbations provide supervision for visual confidence, linking confidence estimation to the generated observations and their dependence on image content. Finally, group relative policy optimization (GRPO) jointly optimizes detection accuracy, output validity, and confidence calibration. Experiments on the company-collected Indoor Construction Site Workwear Dataset (ICSWD) and the web-collected Indoor Construction Workwear Dataset (WICWD) yield mAP@50 values of 0.730 and 0.753, respectively, outperforming the evaluated LoRA-adapted VLM baselines, including Qwen3-VL. The framework also provides explicit evidence and separate confidence scores to support manual review in industrial safety monitoring. WICWD is publicly available at https://github.com/DaErwen1/WICWD.

</details>


### [35] [Query-adaptive Recurrent Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22957)
*Bavesh Balaji,Pranav Gopinath,Pouya Sadeghi,Sirisha Rambhatla*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出查询自适应循环分词器QART，使视觉表示随查询内容引导并动态调整token预算，仅用约29个视觉token即在Visual7W/VQAv2达81.96%/76.37%，token数降低20-25倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉与视觉语言模型大多与查询无关地编码图像，并对所有输入分配固定视觉token预算，但图像中有价值的信息量及所需token数实际上取决于文本查询。

Method: QART为骨架无关模块：以冻结编码器特征为起点，循环构建紧凑表示，并用查询相关视觉支撑区域上的重建质量来控制token分配，即持续分配token直至查询相关视觉特征被足够保真地表示。

Result: Visual7W 81.96%、VQAv2 76.37%（约29个token，较稠密VLM输入降低20-25倍）；CORE P@1 92.0%；PODS PR-AUC 36.3%，较SteerViT提升8.4%。

Conclusion: 视觉表示在内容与容量上均无需固定，可依据每个查询的需求自适应调整。

Abstract: Visual information worth extracting from an image and the token budget it warrants depend on the text query. Yet modern vision and vision-language models largely encode images independently of the query and allocate a fixed visual token budget to every input. We introduce the Query-Adaptive Recurrent Tokenizer (QART), a backbone-agnostic module that makes visual representations both query-steerable and budget-adaptive. QART steers the visual representation toward query-relevant evidence while adapting its token budget to the amount of information required. Its key principle is simple. Additional tokens are allocated until the visual features relevant to the query are represented with sufficient fidelity. Starting from frozen encoder features, QART recurrently constructs a compact representation and uses reconstruction quality over the query-relevant visual support to control token allocation. On Visual7W and VQAv2, QART achieves 81.96% and 76.37% accuracy using only about 29 visual tokens, reducing token counts by 20-25x relative to dense VLM inputs. It further reaches 92.0% P@1 on CORE and 36.3% PR-AUC on PODS, outperforming SteerViT on PODS by 8.4%. Together, these results show that visual representations need not be fixed in either content or capacity and can instead adapt to what each query requires.

</details>


### [36] [ANCHOR: Audio-Visually Grounded Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22964)
*Joel Julin,Souraja Kundu,Liza Dahiya,George Z. Wei,Liuyue Xie,Jingru Yi,Xu Zhang,Hao Yang,Laszlo A. Jeni*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ANCHOR基准与评测框架，量化多模态大模型在音视频问答中"答案正确但推理依据不对齐感知证据"的问题，揭示答案准确率掩盖了显著的grounding失败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音视频问答基准主要评测最终答案准确率，无法判断模型给出的推理理由是否真正对应相关的视觉区域、时间区间与音频事件；正确答案不等于推理有感知证据支撑。

Method: 构建ANCHOR：2,319个视频、8,272个问答对，带结构化推理链、时间证据、空间边界框和显著音频线索；另含224视频/975问答对的人工精修测试集。分别度量答案正确性、幻觉、逻辑偏离与简洁性，并在聚焦子集上直接测量时空grounding，对12个MLLM评测，做参考来源稳健性检验与grounding线索消融。

Result: 12个MLLM均存在明显对齐差距：答案表现相近的模型在解释是否被标注证据支持上差异显著。在100视频/446问答对的匹配子集上，人工精修、Gemini生成、GPT生成参考下的排名高度稳定（平均Pearson r=0.99），反驳模型-参考循环性担忧。消融显示一致的模态层级：去掉视频使准确率下降38.4–41.8点，去掉边界框（3.2–7.7点）与音频（4.2–5.6点）降幅较小且互补、依模型而异。

Conclusion: 仅看答案的评测会掩盖重要的grounding失败；ANCHOR可作为评估"准确且证据对齐"的音视频推理的测试平台。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) perform well on audio-visual question answering, but correct answers do not necessarily imply that their stated reasoning is grounded in relevant perceptual evidence. Existing benchmarks mainly evaluate final-answer accuracy, offering limited insight into whether model-generated rationales correctly identify visual regions, temporal intervals, and audio events supporting predictions. We introduce ANCHOR, a benchmark and evaluation framework for measuring grounded-rationale alignment in multimodal reasoning, comprising 2,319 videos and 8,272 question-answer pairs with structured reasoning traces, temporal evidence, spatial bounding boxes, and salient audio cues, including a human-refined test set of 224 videos and 975 question-answer pairs. We separately measure answer correctness, hallucination, logical divergence, and conciseness, with direct spatial and temporal grounding measurements on a focused subset. Across the full benchmark, twelve contemporary MLLMs show a substantial alignment gap: models with comparable answer performance can differ markedly in whether their explanations are supported by annotated evidence. On a matched subset of 100 videos and 446 question-answer pairs, rankings remain highly stable across human-refined, Gemini-generated, and GPT-generated references (mean Pearson r=0.99), providing evidence against model-reference circularity within this subset. Grounding-cue ablations of three MLLMs on the full human-refined test set reveal a consistent modality hierarchy: removing video reduces accuracy by 38.4-41.8 points, while removing bounding boxes (3.2-7.7 points) and audio (4.2-5.6 points) causes smaller, complementary, model-dependent drops. These findings show answer-only evaluation obscures important grounding failures and position ANCHOR as a testbed for evaluating accurate and evidence-aligned audio-visual reasoning.

</details>


### [37] [Sink-Sparse Hybrid Attention for Efficient Inference in T2I/T2V Diffusion Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22975)
*Bingxin Xing,Yu Zhang,Jiatong Ding,Lei Lu,Ping Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Sink-Sparse Hybrid Attention，一种免训练的注意力替换方法：利用离线校准得到的静态sink掩码加轻量池化KV分支，在DiT上实现约1.5倍端到端加速且质量基本保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DiT已成为文本到图像/视频生成的主流骨干，但token序列变长且去噪步数多导致稠密自注意力重复调用，成为主要推理瓶颈。

Method: 观察发现预训练DiT的稠密注意力中存在可复用的、按层/头区分的高质量（high-mass）结构，可由小规模离线校准集识别并跨生成复用；据此构造静态sink掩码，并辅以轻量pooled-KV分支补偿信息，模型权重与采样调度均不变，无需训练。

Result: Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B上端到端加速1.54倍并保持生成质量；Z-Image-Turbo上加速1.57倍，GenEval2表现具竞争力。

Conclusion: 可复用的重要性感知稀疏支撑为T2V与T2I的DiT提供了有效的免训练加速路径。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become a common backbone for high-quality text-to-image and text-to-video generation, but repeated dense self-attention remains a major inference bottleneck as token sequences grow and the same operator is invoked across many denoising steps. Our study suggests that dense attention in pretrained DiTs contains reusable layer/head-specific high-mass structure that can be identified from a small offline calibration set and reused across future generations. This leads to Sink-Sparse Hybrid Attention, a train-free attention replacement that reuses static sink masks and supplements them with a lightweight pooled-KV branch, while leaving model weights and sampling schedules unchanged. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, the method attains 1.54$\times$ end-to-end speedup while maintaining generation quality. On Z-Image-Turbo, it attains 1.57$\times$ end-to-end speedup with competitive GenEval2 performance. These results indicate that reusable importance-aware sparse support can provide an effective train-free acceleration path for both T2V and T2I DiTs.

</details>


### [38] [How Murky Before a VLM Knows It Cannot See? Accuracy, Confidence and Abstention on a Physical Visibility Axis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22981)
*Mochamad Rizal Fauzan,Irgi Surya*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文在物理单位（米）的能见度轴上评估视觉语言模型的鲁棒性，发现模型准确率在窄区间崩溃后，内部与言语化置信度仍保持高位，形成约0.79个数量级以上的"盲区"；而ImageNet-C的1-5级雾严重度仅对应55-110米能见度，未触及失效带。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM鲁棒性研究用无物理单位的"level 1-5"名义严重度评估退化，且很少考察模型置信度是否随可见度丧失而同步下降，导致无法判断模型"看不清"时是否会"误以为看得清"。

Method: 构建以米为单位的能见度轴：雾采用Koschmieder模型，水下按纯水吸收谱缩放臂长，均结合单目度量深度图施加；能见度V在250 m至1.95 m间取8个对数间隔水平。在1000个COCO场景、5个2-5B参数小型开源VLM上，测量框选目标识别任务的准确率、内部（token概率）置信度、言语化置信度及显式弃答选项，并设空白图像、打乱图像、先验匹配答案集及200图预实验对照。

Result: 准确率在狭窄带内由近干净水平跌至随机：雾中半程能见度V_acc为12.1-15.9 m，水下为20.5-38.6 m。四个在干净图像上自信的模型置信度维持高位：雾中V=1.95 m时准确率已为随机水平，而平均内部置信度达0.68-0.84、言语化置信度0.61-1.00，盲区宽度W=log10(V_acc/V_aware)≥0.79个数量级（能见度约6.2倍）。另一模型全程欠自信，其内部置信度随准确率变化。显式弃答在指明原因时跟随准确率（雾中W为-0.21至-0.06），但某模型使用泛化"我不知道"时滞后（W达0.18）。ImageNet-C雾1-5级仅对应55-110 m物理能见度，落在失效带之外，模型准确率偏离干净值不超过5个百分点。

Conclusion: 模型"看不清"时并不会降低置信度，内部与言语化置信度均存在显著盲区，弃答选项需指明原因才有效；常用名义严重度基准未覆盖实际失效区间。结论为描述性：单次1000图抽样、依赖假设尺度的深度、模型限于2-5B参数。

Abstract: Robustness studies of vision-language models (VLMs) grade degradation on nominal severity scales ("level 1-5") that carry no physical units, and they rarely ask whether a model's confidence follows the loss of visibility. We measure accuracy, internal (token-probability) confidence, verbalized confidence and an explicit abstain option on a visibility axis in metres: fog follows the Koschmieder model, an underwater arm scales the absorption spectrum of pure water, both are applied with a monocular metric depth map, and the visibility range V is swept over eight log-spaced levels from 250 m to 1.95 m. On 1000 COCO scenes and five small open VLMs (2-5 B parameters), accuracy on a boxed-object identification task falls from near its clean value to chance within a narrow band (half-way visibility V_acc of 12.1-15.9 m in fog and 20.5-38.6 m under water) while, for the four models that are confident on clean images, the confidence stays high: at V=1.95 m in fog their accuracy is at chance but their mean internal confidence is 0.68-0.84 and their verbalized confidence 0.61-1.00, a blind-spot width W=log10(V_acc/V_aware) of at least 0.79 decades, i.e. a factor of 6.2 in visibility. The remaining model is under-confident throughout and its internal confidence follows accuracy. An explicit abstain option follows accuracy when it names the reason (W from -0.21 to -0.06 in fog) but, for one model, lags with a generic "I don't know" (W up to 0.18). ImageNet-C fog severities 1-5 correspond to only 55-110 m of physical visibility, outside the failure band, and leave the accuracy of the models within 5 percentage points of its clean value. Blank-image and shuffled-image controls, a prior-matched answer set and a 200-image pilot that preceded the study are reported. Findings are descriptive: one draw of 1000 images, depth of assumed scale, and models of 2-5 B parameters.

</details>

*Yiyang Lin,Chenhui Wang,Tianliang Yao,Shuaibo Li,Zijun Sun,Yiming Deng,Yixuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: MRI field-strength enhancement seeks to combine the accessibility of low-field scanners with the image quality of high-field scanners. Yet, existing methods remain prone to anatomical hallucinations, as uniform processing leaves difficult brain regions insufficiently examined and scarce paired data limit their learning of how tissue contrast and anatomical visibility change across field strengths. To address these challenges, we propose UniField++, a two-agent framework that unifies enhancement tasks across multiple field-strength transitions, including 64mT-to-3T and 3T-to-7T. Unified learning allows both the VLM-based planner and the flow-matching-based enhancer to draw on field-dependent image characteristics observed across tasks, rather than relying on a single transition. Trained with radiologists' annotations of hallucination-prone regions and corresponding correction plans, the planner predicts regional risk and formulates targeted restoration strategies. Guided by these plans, the enhancer performs loop reasoning along the flow-matching trajectory, repeatedly processing high-risk regions for additional refinement. Together, cross-transition learning and risk-guided refinement support anatomically faithful enhancement across field strengths. Across the evaluated tasks, UniField++ improves PSNR by an average of 2.74 dB and SSIM by 14.05 percentage points over comparison methods, with corresponding gains of 3.97 dB and 13.92 percentage points over the ablation baseline. It also maintains enhancement quality on an external cohort with an unseen field strength and improves downstream whole-brain segmentation Macro Dice by an average of 0.1457 over the original low-field images. </details>

Abstract: The use of accurate vision models for crop monitoring, disease diagnosis, and plant phenotyping in agriculture is hindered by the lack of expertly annotated data, especially in developing countries. We propose A100, an agricultural vision foundation model that is pre-trained using self-supervised learning on 3 million unlabeled images from fields covering more than 100 crop species. A100 uses a hybrid CNN-Transformer backbone that fuses MBConv stages for local feature extraction with Transformer stages for global contextual representation. A100 uses pre-training with the integration of DINO self-distillation, iBOT masked patch reconstruction, and KoLeo uniformity regularization, resulting in features that are better than ImageNet-12K supervised representations for agricultural applications without any fine-tuning. By utilizing a frozen backbone, the accuracy for crop classification of A100 is 95.37%, which is +2.56% better than ImageNet-12K, and reduces the leaf count error by 10.4% on the GroMo25 phenotyping benchmark, proving that the same backbone can be used for classification and regression tasks. After full fine-tuning, the performance of A100 is 99.90% on 32-class crop identification and 99.02% on 44-class disease detection. On the difficult PlantDoc dataset, A100 outperforms all baselines, such as CvT-13 (64.89% against 63.56%). Remarkably, A100 obtains 98.01% accuracy on plant classification using just 1% of the labelled data (about 284 images per category), showing great label efficiency for use cases with limited labeling. Under an identical protocol, A100 also outperforms the publicly released agricultural foundation models FoMo4Wheat and LeafVision by more than 14 points at 1% labels. ### [41] [BRICE: Brain-inspired Recurrent Illusory Contour Encoder for Point Cloud Completion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23001)
*Yunlei Wang,Dawei Li,Xue-song Tang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出脑启发的循环错觉轮廓编码器BRICE，以预测编码为基础、可插拔地嵌入主流点云补全基线，通过前馈-反馈循环"想象"缺失部分，在MVP2K、PCN、PlantPCom上提升多种基线性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有深度点云补全方法存在两点不足：一是反复堆叠注意力模块，偏离统一、可解释的网络设计；二是几乎全部架构仅依赖前馈连接传播信息，忽略深层反馈。而哺乳动物V1区由前馈-反馈回路构成的循环神经架构能产生错觉轮廓（ICs），其本质是大脑对视觉信息的补全机制，据此可启发点云补全设计。

Method: 以预测编码（Predictive Coding, PC）为基础模型，设计即插即用的脑启发循环错觉轮廓编码器BRICE，构建前馈-反馈循环结构，对不完整3D点云中缺失的部分进行"想象"式补全，并可直接集成进主流点云补全基线。

Result: 在MVP2K、PCN、PlantPCom等多个3D数据集上，BRICE能够提升多种点云补全基线的性能，验证其有效性与通用性。

Conclusion: 借鉴V1区错觉轮廓生成的循环神经机制，可为点云补全提供简洁、可解释且免重设计的增强方案；BRICE作为通用插件式编码器，具备跨基线、跨数据集的适用性。

Abstract: Mainstream point cloud completion methods are unanimously based on deep learning architectures. On one hand, these methods tend to repetitively stacking attention modules to enhance network performance, which drifts away from the neat design of unified and interpret-able networks; on the other hand, nearly all existing architectures rely solely on feed-forward connections to propagate information, neglecting feedback from deeper layers. The recurrent neural architecture, formed by feedforward-feedback loops, have shown its ability to generate Illusory Contours (ICs) in the V1 brain region of mammals; and ICs are essentially a completion mechanism of the brain for visual information. Motivated by this, we design a Brain-inspired Recurrent Illusory Contour Encoder (BRICE) to "imagine" what is missing in the incomplete 3D point clouds. Building upon the foundation model of Predictive Coding (PC), the plug-and-play nature enables BRICE to be seamlessly integrated into mainstream point cloud completion baselines. Experimental results show that BRICE can enhance various completion baselines on different 3D datasets such as MVP2K, PCN, and PlantPCom. Our code: Https://github.com/wangyunlei-wyl/BRICE.

</details>


### [42] [Semantic-Critical Regions for Video-to-Audio Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23021)
*Yun Fang,Wei Guo,Zhuonan Liang,Heng Wang,Weidong Cai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SCR-V2A框架，显式定位并编码"语义关键区域"（SCRs）作为细粒度视觉引导，用于视频到音频（V2A）生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实视频中声音事件常关联局部、细粒度视觉线索（物体运动、部件动态、接触事件、物体交互）。现有V2A方法或依赖全局视觉表示的隐式条件，或依赖时空线索的显式控制，对细微的"发声/示声"交互捕捉不足，制约了声音事件语义与时间动态的精确条件化。

Method: 将含声音相关视觉证据的区域定义为语义关键区域（SCRs）：1）通过声音相关视觉定位识别SCRs；2）经基于适配器的双路视觉编码，将定位区域转化为控制表示，同时捕捉全局视觉上下文与细粒度声音相关证据；3）以该表示条件化下游音频生成模型。

Result: 在域内与域外基准上，SCR-V2A在分布匹配与音频质量上表现强劲，在跨模态对齐上具竞争力，且可训练参数少。

Conclusion: 结果凸显了在V2A生成中优先关注细粒度、声音相关视觉区域的价值。

Abstract: In real-world videos, sound events are often associated with localized and fine-grained visual cues, such as object motion, object-part dynamics, contact events, and interactions between objects. Existing video-to-audio (V2A) methods employ implicit conditioning based on global visual representations or explicit control derived from temporal and spatial cues. However, subtle sound-producing and sound-indicative interactions remain insufficiently captured, leaving room for more precise visual conditioning of sound-event semantics and temporal dynamics. Motivated by this observation, we refer to regions containing such sound-relevant visual evidence as Semantic-Critical Regions (SCRs) and introduce SCR-V2A, a V2A generation framework that explicitly localizes and encodes SCRs as fine-grained visual guidance for audio generation. Specifically, we first identify SCRs through sound-related visual localization. We then transform the localized regions into a control representation through adapter-based dual visual encoding, which jointly captures global visual context and fine-grained sound-relevant evidence. The representation is used to condition a downstream audio generation model. Experiments on both in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks demonstrate that SCR-V2A achieves strong performance in distribution matching and audio quality while remaining competitive in cross-modal alignment and requiring few trainable parameters. These results highlight the value of prioritizing fine-grained, sound-relevant visual regions for V2A generation.

</details>


### [43] [Frame-Consistent Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Unposed Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23039)
*Viruthshaan Vinasirajan,Ranga Rodrigo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 融合冻结VGGT与冻结TokenGS的两阶段前馈高斯流程中，性能下降的主因是坐标系不一致与平移尺度失配两大可确定性修正的集成失败，而非位姿误差本身；修正后无需任何训练或精化即可接近COLMAP参考质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 两阶段前馈方法（冻结位姿估计器VGGT + 冻结重建骨干TokenGS）理论上可各自专精，但实际质量下降。先前工作（VGGT-X、3R-GS）将问题归因于位姿噪声并引入学习式精化。本文检验该归因是否成立。

Method: 在DL3DV与MipNeRF360共107个场景上，以COLMAP位姿为参考做逐相机误差分析；并在140个DL3DV场景上进行受控消融，区分位姿误差与集成误差的贡献。

Result: 对齐后旋转误差较小（中位1.6°），但平移尺度存在与数据集一致的显著偏移。消融表明主要障碍是坐标系不一致与平移尺度失配，二者可确定性修正。修正后，全视图位姿下冻结VGGT+冻结TokenGS达22.47 PSNR，距COLMAP参考仅0.51 dB且无额外训练；在仅用4张上下文图像的稀疏无位姿协议下，达到同等全视图质量。

Conclusion: 性能下降并非源于位姿噪声，而是可确定性修正的集成失配；简单修正即可实现无需精化、完全摆脱COLMAP的两阶段前馈重建流程。

Abstract: Feed-forward Gaussian models have made novel view synthesis almost instantaneous. Feed-forward methods predict Gaussians directly, either in two stages or in a single merged pass. Using two separately trained models is attractive because each can specialize in its own objective: one for accurate pose estimation and the other for high-quality reconstruction, rather than forcing a single jointly trained network to compromise between the two. A natural instantiation pairs a frozen pose estimator, VGGT, with a frozen reconstruction backbone, TokenGS. Prior work, such as VGGT-X and 3R-GS, also adopts a two-stage design, but attributes the resulting quality degradation to noisy pose estimates and introduces learned refinement. We show that this is not the primary source of the problem. Through per-camera analysis across 107 scenes from two datasets, DL3DV and MipNeRF360, using COLMAP poses as the reference, we find that the rotation error after alignment is small (median 1.6 degrees), whereas the translation scale is offset by a large, dataset-consistent factor. Controlled ablations over 140 DL3DV scenes show that the primary obstacles are two integration failures rather than pose error: a coordinate-frame inconsistency and a translation-scale mismatch, both of which can be corrected deterministically. With these fixes, a frozen VGGT driving a frozen TokenGS achieves 22.47 PSNR, within 0.51 dB of the COLMAP reference, with no additional training, when poses are estimated from all scene views. In the sparse setting, where reconstruction uses only four context images under the standard pose-free protocol, the same pipeline matches this all-view quality, yielding a fully COLMAP-free pipeline without any refinement step.

</details>


### [44] [TriFold: Folding irregular 3D Gaussians into structured latents for 3D Scene Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23050)
*Yun Wang,Chiyu Wang,Fan Jiang,Ziyu Zhu,Zhaoxu Sun,Guangchi Fang,Mu Xu,Dapeng Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出TriFold，一种原生的3D高斯VAE，将高斯场景编码为固定布局三平面潜变量并联合重建几何与外观，结合潜空间flow matching实现条件场景级3DGS生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D高斯场景的原生紧凑生成表示学习困难，原因在于基元数量差异大、空间密度非均匀，且空间相邻基元的几何与外观也可能不同，导致难以在潜空间中施加规范结构。

Method: 编码端采用cell级可学习查询，将投影高斯聚合到每个cell的多个slot中，减少单特征池化的信息损失；解码端先预测occupancy识别活跃区域，再用query-based集合预测与候选选择重建具有空间变化基元数量的局部高斯集合；在潜空间上训练flow-matching模型用于条件场景级3DGS生成。

Result: 实现高保真重建，并支持点云条件合成与单图像条件amodal生成，仅凭提供部分观测的单张图像即可生成场景。

Conclusion: TriFold在保持底层高斯空间自适应的同时为潜空间引入结构规整性，验证了其作为原生3D高斯表示学习方法的有效性。

Abstract: Recent progress in 3D generation has motivated growing interest in compact generative representations of complex 3D scenes. For native 3D Gaussian scenes, however, learning such representations remains challenging due to widely varying primitive counts, nonuniform spatial density, and differences in geometry and appearance even among spatially neighboring primitives. In this work, we introduce TriFold, a native 3D Gaussian VAE that encodes Gaussian scenes into a fixed-layout triplane latent and jointly reconstructs their geometry and appearance. The key insight is to impose structural regularity on the latent space while preserving the spatial adaptivity of the underlying Gaussians. During encoding, we use cell-wise learned queries to aggregate projected Gaussians into multiple slots per cell, reducing the information loss caused by single-feature pooling. During decoding, occupancy prediction identifies active regions, where query-based set prediction and candidate selection reconstruct local Gaussian sets with spatially varying primitive counts. Building on this representation, we train a latent flow-matching model for conditional scene-level 3DGS generation, enabling point-cloud-conditioned synthesis and single-image-conditioned amodal generation. Experiments demonstrate that TriFold achieves high-fidelity reconstruction and generation from a single image that provides only a partial observation of the scene, validating its effectiveness for native 3D Gaussian representation learning. https://fantasy-amap.github.io/TriFold

</details>


### [45] [Scene-Designer: Learning Design Intelligence for Agentic 3D Scene Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23121)
*Xuanyu Liu,Hongyan Feng,Miao Pan,Sunlai Chen,Lizhou Liang,Bing Sun,Wenqi Zhang,Xuhong Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 Scene-Designer 智能体框架，通过"设计+批评"互补经验学习室内场景设计智能，构建 Scene-OTA-35K 与 Scene-OTC-15K 两个数据集，并提出 Critic 引导的 Scene-GRPO 强化学习框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从自然语言生成完整、连贯、可用的 3D 室内场景需要"设计智能"，即既能设计高质量场景又能评判其质量。现有方法要么依赖缺乏领域设计经验的通用模型，要么仅从静态场景中学习，缺乏设计与批评的双向经验。

Method: 构建两个数据集：Scene-OTA-35K 提供 Observation–Thought–Action 监督，用于学习场景设计与高效纠错；Scene-OTC-15K 提供 Observation–Thought–Critic 监督，用于学习从物理有效性、功能正确性、布局连贯性三方面评判场景质量。在此基础上提出 Scene-GRPO，一种 Critic 引导的 GRPO 框架，以改进设计决策并减少无效试错修正。

Result: 在物理有效性、功能正确性和布局连贯性上均取得更优表现；学到的 Scene-Critic 在场景批评任务上显著优于通用模型；测试时引入 Critic 引导可进一步提升场景生成质量，说明 Critic 在训练之外也能提供有效指导。

Conclusion: 设计与批评两种能力呈现相互促进的趋势，验证了以互补经验驱动的智能体框架在语言到 3D 室内场景生成任务上的有效性。

Abstract: Generating complete, coherent, and usable 3D indoor scenes from natural language requires strong \textbf{design intelligence}: the ability to design high-quality scenes and critique their quality. However, existing approaches either rely on general-purpose models lacking domain-specific design experience or learn from static scenes. In this work, we introduce \textbf{Scene-Designer}, an agentic framework that learns design intelligence through complementary design and critique experiences. We construct two datasets: \textbf{Scene-OTA-35K}, which provides Observation--Thought--Action supervision for learning scene design and efficient error correction, and \textbf{Scene-OTC-15K}, which provides Observation--Thought--Critic supervision for learning scene quality critique across physical validity, functional correctness, and layout coherence. Based on these experiences, we propose \textbf{Scene-GRPO}, a Critic-guided GRPO framework that improves design decisions and reduces unnecessary trial-and-error corrections. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Scene-Designer achieves superior performance in physical validity, functional correctness, and layout coherence, while the learned Scene-Critic significantly outperforms general-purpose models in scene critique. Moreover, test-time Critic guidance further improves scene generation, showing that the Critic can provide useful guidance beyond training. Additional analysis suggests a trend of mutual enhancement between scene design and critique abilities.

</details>

*Bingyang Wang,Jiazuo Yu,Lu Zhang,Lihe Zhang,Huchuan Lu,You He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出RCA-MOT，保持RGB/红外/融合三支外观状态并按分支可靠性分别调控关联与记忆更新，在VT-MOT与UniRTL上取得新SOTA。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Recent RGB-infrared multi-object tracking (MOT) methods have substantially improved cross-modal representation learning and multimodal information integration. However, most existing methods compress RGB and infrared evidence into a unified descriptor. When one modality is temporarily degraded, the tracker can no longer regulate its contribution separately; unreliable evidence may distort association and contaminate appearance memory. We therefore propose RCA-MOT, a reliability-consistent appearance modeling framework that preserves cross-modal complementarity while retaining post-representation evidence controllability. RGB-specific, infrared-specific, and fused identity representations are maintained as jointly accessible appearance states. For each detection, a simple training-free target-scene estimator produces branch-wise appearance reliability used across the two temporal roles of appearance: relative reliability regulates different identity branches, absolute reliability calibrates borderline candidates near the ReID acceptance boundary, and the same branch-wise reliability controls how strongly matched descriptors update historical appearance memory. The individual components are intentionally simple, focusing evaluation on reliability-controllable appearance organization rather than elaborate fusion or learned reliability-estimation modules. RCA-MOT sets new SOTA results on VT-MOT and UniRTL, improving the previous best HOTA by 5.402/6.075 points and IDF1 by 11.549/12.789 points, respectively, while post-hoc analyses further validate reliability as an informative control signal. Code will be released upon acceptance.

</details>


### [47] [From GAN-Based Models to GPT-5: A Taxonomy-Guided Study of Human Performance in Detecting Deepfake Face Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23144)
*Zhiqing Guo,Lixin Jia,Luning Sun,Xiaowei Chen,Guofeng Yu,Liejun Wang,Gaobo Yang,David Stillwell,Thorsten Holz,Shujun Li*

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式伪造技术已从GAN演进到扩散模型与多模态大模型，但关于人类检测能力的实证研究滞后；尚不清楚检测表现是否随生成模型而异，以及模型专属训练是否优于通用训练。

Method: 构建Deepfake Face Artifact Taxonomy（DFAT）跨模型人类可识别视觉伪影分类，并据此设计通用与模型专属训练材料；开展在线实验（n=524），评估对5种代表性模型的检测表现与训练效果，并进行5个月随访（n=342）。

Result: 检测准确率强烈依赖生成模型；更新、更先进的模型生成图像未必更难检测。训练后多数条件下显著提升，且提升幅度随模型而异；模型专属训练在数值上普遍优于通用训练。随访显示准确率无显著下降、主观压力无显著上升。

Conclusion: 研究为设计有效、可持续且有针对性的反深度伪造训练方案提供可操作依据。

Abstract: Generative models for deepfakes have rapidly evolved from GAN-based architectures to diffusion models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, empirical research on human performance in detecting deepfake face images has not kept pace. It remains unclear if (and how) detection performance varies across generative models and whether model-specific training improves detection more effectively than general-purpose training. In this paper, we propose the \emph{Deepfake Face Artifact Taxonomy} (DFAT), a cross-model taxonomy of human-recognizable visual artifacts in deepfake face images, based on which we build both general-purpose and model-specific training materials. Through an online experiment ($n = 524$), we examined human performance in detecting deepfake face images and evaluated training efficacy across five representative generative models: three GAN-based, one diffusion-based, and one MLLM (GPT-5). Our results show that participants' detection accuracy was strongly model-dependent and that images generated by more recent and advanced models were not necessarily harder to detect. After training, participants achieved significant performance gains across most conditions, and their improvement varied by model. Notably, model-specific training generally yielded greater numerical gains than general-purpose training. In a five-month follow-up test ($n = 342$), we observed no significant decline in detection accuracy and no significant increase in perceived stress. Overall, our findings provide actionable insights for designing effective, sustainable, and targeted training programs to counter the growing threat posed by deepfakes.

</details>


### [48] [Knowledge-Guided Distributional Prompt Learning with Visual Hierarchy for Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23172)
*Jiyul Ham,Seongho Yoon,Yonggon Jung,Sangjae Lee,Jun-Geol Baek*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出HiDist，将正态参考的层级分布提示学习用于零样本异常检测，统一建模图像级检测与像素级定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有零样本异常检测方法未显式结合"以正常为参考的分布建模"与"按层级特化的提示"，难以在建模相对正常性的异常语义的同时兼顾图像级检测与细粒度定位。

Method: 每个提示token用对角高斯分布建模，经蒙特卡洛采样生成随机提示变体；异常提示分布参数化为相对已学正常参考的偏差，显式编码依赖关系；所得分布特化为全局与局部表示，分别用于图像级检测与像素级定位，并以适配的全局视觉表示引导层级对齐。

Result: 在七个工业与医学数据集上，跨数据集异常检测与定位任务表现良好；消融与表示分析支持分布建模及层级特化表示学习的有效性。

Conclusion: HiDist通过正态参考的层级分布提示学习，统一提升零样本异常检测与定位性能，验证了分布依赖建模与层级特化的价值。

Abstract: Zero-shot anomaly detection (ZSAD) aims to detect anomalies in previously unseen classes using auxiliary images, with applications such as industrial visual inspection and medical imaging. Recent vision-language-model-based approaches improve ZSAD by aligning textual and visual representations, while distributional prompting further models prompt variability for unseen categories. However, existing methods do not explicitly combine normality-referenced distributional modeling with hierarchy-specific prompt specialization, limiting their ability to model anomalous semantics relative to normality while addressing both image-level detection and fine-grained localization. We propose Hierarchical Knowledge-Guided Distributional Prompt Learning (HiDist), a normality-referenced hierarchical distributional prompt framework for ZSAD. HiDist models each prompt token with a diagonal Gaussian distribution and generates stochastic prompt variations through Monte Carlo sampling. Rather than learning normal and anomalous distributions independently, anomalous prompt distributions are parameterized as deviations from learned normal references, explicitly encoding their dependency. The resulting distributions are specialized into global and local representations for image-level detection and pixel-level localization, respectively, while an adapted global visual representation guides hierarchical alignment. Experiments on seven industrial and medical datasets demonstrate strong cross-dataset performance across anomaly detection and localization tasks. Extensive ablation and representation analyses further support the effectiveness of the proposed distributional modeling and hierarchy-specific representation learning.

</details>


### [49] [MLLM Frame Subset Ensembling for Audio-Visual Video QA and MLLM-based Reranking for Ad-hoc Video Search in TRECVID 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23214)
*Andreas Goulas,Damianos Galanopoulos,Ioannis Patras,Vasileios Mezaris*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CERTH-ITI团队的TRECVID 2025 AVS与VQA赛道系统概览：AVS采用基于基础模型的两阶段（多VLM加权检索+MLLM重排序）免训练框架；VQA基于视听MLLM微调并配合推理时缩放与帧子集集成，在AG任务三项指标居首、MC任务排名第二。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向TRECVID 2025的AVS与VQA赛道，探索无需额外训练的强基础模型组合方案以提升查询-视频语义匹配精度，并通过微调与推理时集成充分释放视听MLLM的多模态理解能力。

Method: AVS：两阶段框架。阶段一由多个VLM对经LLM改写增强的查询与候选视频镜头分别编码，产生加权相似度完成初检索；阶段二用MLLM重排序模块对Top-N镜头与原查询的语义一致性打分并重排，全程无需训练。VQA：在TRECVID训练集上微调视听MLLM，引入推理时缩放（inference-time scaling）；AG任务对视频不同随机帧子集做贪心采样生成多份回答并以多数投票聚合，MC任务则对候选答案的logits做均值池化。

Result: VQA Answer Generation任务在3项指标上取得最高分，Multiple-Choice任务取得第二高成绩；AVS中MLLM驱动的重排序显著改善上下文匹配与最终排序质量。

Conclusion: LLM查询改写+多VLM加权集成+MLLM重排序的免训练流水线可有效提升AVS检索效果；微调结合帧子集集成与推理时缩放在VQA两类任务上均具竞争力，验证了基础模型与推理时集成策略在视频理解任务中的有效性。

Abstract: This paper presents the overview of the runs related to the Ad-hoc Video Search (AVS) and Video Question Answering (VQA) tracks of TRECVID 2025 on behalf of the CERTH-ITI team. For the AVS track, we introduce a two-stage framework built on foundation models. In the first stage, multiple vision-language models (VLMs) encode both the input query, augmented through LLM-generated rephrasings, and the candidate video shots, producing weighted similarity scores for initial retrieval. In the second stage, we utilize a Multimodal-LLM(MLLM)-based reranking module that evaluates the semantic alignment between each shot among the top-N highest-ranked ones and the original query, generating updated relevance scores for reordering these shots. This MLLM-driven reranking significantly improves contextual matching and produces more accurate final rankings without requiring any model training. Regarding the VQA track, we fine-tune an audio-visual MLLM model on the provided TRECVID training dataset and we implement an inference-time scaling technique to enhance the multimodal understanding capabilities of the MLLM. For the open-ended Answer Generation (AG) task, we aggregate multiple model responses per question via a majority vote. The responses are generated with greedy sampling from different random frame subsets of the video and they are ranked based on the number of votes. For the Multiple-Choice (MC) task, instead of voting, we use mean pooling on the logits assigned by the fine-tuned model to each candidate response. Through the combination of fine-tuning and frame subset ensembling we achieve the highest score across 3 metrics in the VQA AG task and the second highest in the VQA MC task.

</details>


### [50] [RAP: A Dataset for Paper-to-Poster Generation via Declarative Markup from Human-Crafted Exemplars](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23230)
*Haonan Han,Yukang Lin,Minliang Lin,Haoxian Tan,Jun-Yan He,Rui Yang,Zhi-Qi Cheng,Jie Hu,Guanglu Wan,Xiu Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RAP 是一个面向"论文转海报"视觉编码任务的数据集与基准，包含 2022–2026 年 ML 会议的 25K+ 经渲染验证的论文-海报-HTML/CSS 三元组，并支持免训练的 PosterRAG 检索式复用与 SFT+RL 专用模型两种范式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉编码基准中海报生成任务资源稀缺、仅标注布局框，导致只能依赖 VLM-as-judge 或人工清单评估而无法做客观的渲染比对；且已有生成方法从零设计布局，使人工海报既无法作为可检索的设计库，也无法作为可靠的监督信号。

Method: 构建 RAP 数据集：25K+ 经核验的论文-海报对，附三级内容分类体系，并设 150 篇留出测试集；设计全自动 derendering 流水线，将海报反编译为带类型、可回填槽位的样式化 HTML/CSS，形成可通过渲染回溯源海报验证的"论文-海报-标记"三元组。在此语料上提供两种方案：免训练多智能体 PosterRAG（检索范例海报并仅回填槽位，不改动布局与样式）与基于同一三元组的 SFT+RL 训练配方。

Result: 提供了规模显著更大、且具备客观 render-and-compare 评估能力的数据资源；三元组结构使人工海报同时可作为可检索设计库与可验证监督信号，代码与在线 demo 已公开。

Conclusion: 将论文转海报形式化为可验证的视觉编码任务，RAP 通过三元组数据与双重范式（检索式复用与模型训练）为海报生成建立了客观、可复用的基准。

Abstract: Making a conference poster is visual coding in miniature: an entire paper must be compressed onto a single page, which exercises summarization, visual design, and code implementation at once, using nothing beyond the paper itself. Yet benchmarks for this task in the context of visual coding remain scarce: existing resources are small and annotated only with layout boxes, so evaluation must fall back on VLM-as-judge or human checklists rather than objective render-and-compare, and the generation methods they support design layouts from scratch, leaving human-crafted posters unusable as either a retrievable design library or as verified supervision. We introduce RAP (Reconstruct A Poster), a dataset and benchmark for paper-to-poster generation as a visual coding task. RAP contains 25K+ verified paper-poster pairs from various machine learning conferences held between 2022 and 2026, annotated with a three-level content taxonomy, plus a held-out benchmark of 150 test papers each paired with its human poster. A fully automated derendering pipeline turns each poster into styled HTML/CSS of typed, refillable slots, so every sample is a paper-poster-markup triplet verifiable by rendering against the source poster. The corpus serves both inference and training: PosterRAG, a training-free multi-agent pipeline, retrieves an exemplar and refills its slots without touching layout or styling, while an SFT+RL recipe trains a dedicated model from the same triplets. An online demo is available at https://reconstruct-a-poster.github.io/.

</details>


### [51] [X-Splat: Unified Gaussian Splatting for Joint RGB and X-ray 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23237)
*Wangze Xu,Chu Zhou,Mae Yamaguchi,Linrui Dai,I-Chao Shen,Takashi Ijiri,Imari Sato*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种统一的共享几何高斯表示，将RGB外观与X射线内部结构联合重建，通过几何代理跨模态配准与表面深度一致性损失实现稳定对齐、紧凑表示与高质量渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单模态重建无法同时刻画物体外部外观与内部结构，而联合重建RGB与X射线可建立外观—结构联系、获得更完整的物体理解。现有方法按模态分别训练模型，存在几何冗余、对齐伪影以及耦合松散等问题，限制了跨模态洞察的发现。

Method: （1）统一表示：所有高斯基元共享同一套几何参数，仅靠近表面的基元额外携带外观属性；（2）跨模态配准：借助干净的多视图立体重建与X射线几何代理进行对齐，而非直接对齐两组优化后的高斯；（3）联合优化：由两模态监督共同优化统一表示，并引入由X射线几何导出的表面深度一致性损失来引导RGB重建。

Result: 在InsideOut数据集与自建Flower & Insect数据集上，框架实现更稳健的跨模态对齐、更高的RGB渲染质量且不损失X射线重建精度，相比维护两套独立几何，表示更紧凑。

Conclusion: 共享几何的统一高斯表示是联合重建外观与内部结构的有效途径，几何代理配准与表面深度一致性约束能在保证X射线重建的前提下提升RGB质量并减小表示冗余。

Abstract: Jointly reconstructing RGB and X-ray provides new insights by connecting external appearance with internal structure, enabling a more complete understanding of real-world objects than single modality. Yet existing methods train separate models per modality and suffer from redundant geometry, alignment artifacts, and loose coupling that limits cross-modal insight discovery. We propose a unified representation in which all Gaussian primitives share a single set of geometric parameters, with only surface-proximal primitives additionally carrying appearance attributes. We perform cross-modal registration through clean multi-view stereo and X-ray geometric proxies instead of aligning two sets of optimized Gaussians, improving alignment stability. We then jointly optimize the unified representation via supervision from both modalities, complemented by a surface-depth consistency loss derived from X-ray geometry to guide RGB reconstruction. Experiments on the InsideOut dataset and our Flower & Insect dataset show that our framework achieves more robust cross-modal alignment, higher RGB rendering quality without compromising X-ray reconstruction, and a more compact representation than maintaining two independent geometries.

</details>


### [52] [Kingfisher: Fast Personalized Visual Autoregressive Generation via Scale-Aware Prompt-Conditioned Scale Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23238)
*Dinh-Khoi Vo,Akihiro Sugimoto,Minh-Triet Tran,Trung-Nghia Le*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Kingfisher：面向视觉自回归模型的免微调个性化生成框架，通过分解早期残差尺度码的内容/风格分量并重组为语义前缀，实现快速内容保持与风格迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型个性化依赖对模型权重、文本嵌入、LoRA或适配器的逐主体优化，成本高、速度慢；作者希望探索视觉自回归模型中的快速个性化路径。

Method: 关键观察是早期少量自回归尺度码足以决定物体结构与全局外观，后续尺度主要细化已确立的生成轨迹。据此将早期残差尺度码经提示条件化的尺度码子空间分解为内容相关与风格相关分量；对两张真实图像分别分解后，将一张的内容分量与另一张的风格分量重组为紧凑语义前缀，由冻结生成器通过逐位自校正预测其余尺度以保持一致细化。

Result: 在CSD-100上，Kingfisher取得较强的内容保持，并在所评估方法中取得最高的风格与文本对齐；相比扩散方法配对准备时间减少约54倍，相比VAR类方法减少约7.5倍。

Conclusion: 直接操纵冻结视觉自回归生成器的原生尺度空间表示即可实现有效个性化，无需模型微调。

Abstract: Personalized image generation has been extensively studied in diffusion models, often relying on subject-specific optimization of model weights, textual embeddings, LoRA modules, or adapters. In this work, we explore a different direction for fast personalization in visual autoregressive models. Our key observation is that a short prefix of early autoregressive scale codes is sufficient to strongly determine both object structure and global appearance, while later scales primarily refine the established generation trajectory. Based on this insight, we introduce Kingfisher, a model-tuning-free framework that decomposes early residual scale codes into content- and style-related components through prompt-conditioned scale-code subspaces. Given two real images, Kingfisher first decomposes their early scale codes, then recomposes the content components of one image with the style components of the other into a compact semantic prefix. The frozen generator subsequently predicts the remaining scales through bitwise self-correction for coherent refinement. Experiments on CSD-100 show that Kingfisher achieves strong content preservation and the highest style and text alignment among the evaluated methods, while reducing pair-specific preparation time by approximately 54x compared with diffusion-based methods and 7.5x compared with VAR-based alternatives. These results demonstrate that effective personalization can be achieved by directly manipulating the native scale-space representation of a frozen visual autoregressive generator.

</details>


### [53] [Can the Parts Fool the Test? Counterfactual Pairing Cycles for Relational OOD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23248)
*Yibo Zhou,Yirong Xiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出"反事实配对循环"(counterfactual pairing cycles)评估原语：同一对图像与同一对字幕在比较两侧重复使用，仅交换图文配对，使图像独有、文本独有及可加组件捷径在有限样本下精确抵消；并据此导出关系型OOD训练损失与双线性视觉-语言打分诊断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关系型OOD评测中，负样本常在字幕风格、模板、长度、物体词频或图像统计上存在差异，导致模型无需真正检查图文配对即可答对，评测结果被捷径污染、无法干净地衡量关系理解能力。

Method: 构造基于4元组(两张图像、两条字幕)的blocked对比原语：两侧共享相同图像与字幕，仅改变配对方式，从而精确消去图像单模态、文本单模态及可加组件捷径；同一对比式同时用作关系型outlier exposure训练损失与双线性分数诊断工具；在合成对照实验、GQA与COCO上验证，并设置捷径污染的COCO outlier-exposure压力测试。

Result: 循环设计能将粗粒度图文匹配与方向性角色绑定失败区分开，并识别出在全局特征中仍强烈可见的几何尺寸关系；在捷径污染的压力测试中，靠近乎完美的捷径验证AUROC选出的模型虽保留可观关系信号，但在精确循环上仍劣于循环训练，CycleAcc由0.882提升至0.927。

Conclusion: 测试模型是否真正理解配对，基准应固定各组件、只改变配对、仅询问耦合关系；循环对比是干净、可训练的关系评测范式。

Abstract: Relational out-of-distribution errors are easy to describe and hard to evaluate cleanly. An image may be natural, a caption may be fluent, and all mentioned objects may be common, yet the caption may describe the wrong relation in the image. Many evaluations intended to test this behavior can be solved without checking the pairing at all, because negatives differ in caption style, template, length, object frequency, or image statistics. We propose counterfactual pairing cycles, a blocked evaluation primitive that reuses the same two images and the same two captions on both sides of the comparison, changing only which image is paired with which caption. This makes image-only, text-only, and additive component shortcuts cancel exactly in finite samples. The same contrast also gives a training loss for relational outlier exposure and a diagnostic for bilinear vision-language scores. Across synthetic controls, GQA, and COCO, cycles separate coarse image-caption matching from directional role-binding failures, while also identifying geometric size relations that remain strongly visible in global features. In a shortcut-contaminated COCO outlier-exposure stress test, a model selected by a near-perfect shortcut validation AUROC retains substantial relational signal but remains below cycle training on exact cycles; cycle training improves CycleAcc from 0.882 to 0.927. The main lesson is simple: to test whether a model understands a pairing, the benchmark should keep the parts fixed, change the pairing, and ask only about coupling. The official implementation is available online.

</details>


### [54] [LonGaussian: Tracking Foundation Priors for Long-Context Feedforward Gaussian Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23250)
*Zhoufeng Xie,Guanjun Wu,Shuai Zhang,Xinggang Wang,Wenyu Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LonGaussian 提出一种流式前馈框架，可从长视频中重建紧凑、可全局渲染的高斯场景，在已知内参、未知位姿条件下，通过多帧点轨迹引导高斯合并与深度一致性过滤，在 DL3DV 和 RealEstate10K 上以更少高斯数量取得更优新视角渲染质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有前馈高斯重建方法多针对少量图像，扩展到长序列存在两个瓶颈：一次性联合处理所有视角导致 GPU 显存需求激增；逐像素对齐的预测累加会冗余表示同一表面，增加存储与渲染开销。

Method: 基于预训练的流式三维重建骨干，将长上下文几何特征解码为稠密高斯。每个 chunk 内利用多帧点轨迹关联同一表面的重复观测，引导学习式合并器整合对应高斯预测；并采用渲染深度一致性过滤，抑制来自其他 chunk 且错误遮挡局部重建表面的高斯。

Result: 在 DL3DV 与 RealEstate10K 基准上，LonGaussian 提升了新视角渲染质量，且所用高斯数量显著少于所对比的前馈基线方法。

Conclusion: 将流式前馈重建与轨迹引导的高斯合并、跨块深度一致性过滤相结合，可在长序列下同时兼顾显存、存储与渲染效率及渲染质量，适合机器人感知与具身智能等长视频三维场景重建场景。

Abstract: Reconstructing high-quality, renderable 3D scenes from long videos is essential for robotic perception and embodied intelligence. Many feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction methods rapidly predict 3D scenes from a small set of images, but extending them to longer sequences presents two bottlenecks: jointly processing all views increases GPU memory requirements, while accumulating pixel-aligned predictions redundantly represents the same surfaces and increases storage and rendering costs. We present LonGaussian, a streaming feed-forward framework that reconstructs compact, globally renderable Gaussian scenes from long image sequences with known intrinsics and unknown camera poses. Built on a pretrained streaming 3D reconstruction backbone, LonGaussian decodes long-context geometric features into dense Gaussians. Within each chunk, multi-frame point tracks link repeated observations of the same surface and guide a learned merger to consolidate the corresponding Gaussian predictions. Rendered-depth consistency filtering further suppresses Gaussians from other chunks that incorrectly occlude locally reconstructed surfaces. On DL3DV and RealEstate10K benchmarks, LonGaussian improves novel-view rendering quality while using substantially fewer Gaussians than the evaluated feed-forward baselines.

</details>


### [55] [SCALE: Improving Guidance-Free Visual Generation via Self-Contrastive Alignment for Likelihood Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23263)
*Jiwan Hur,Dong-Jae Lee,Dongyeun Lee,Gyojin Han,Junmo Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出自对比引导（SCG）及无引导训练框架 SCALE，在单次前向中生成超越 CFG 的预测，兼顾质量与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CFG 提升视觉生成质量但带来成倍采样开销；现有无引导方法虽将成本减半，却只是近似 CFG，性能上限与局限均继承自 CFG。

Method: 对比模型在真实样本与自生成样本上的预测，得到基于模型本身的直接信号，把生成推向真实数据流形；通过重参数化将 SCG 融入标准似然目标，得到 SCALE 训练框架。

Result: 在扩散与自回归模型的类条件生成和文生图任务中，SCALE 稳定优于模仿 CFG 的无引导基线，且与 DPO 结合后进一步提升。

Conclusion: 自对比信号带来与 CFG 及偏好微调互补的增益，实现单次前向的高质量、无引导生成。

Abstract: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is essential for improving sample quality in visual generation, but it incurs substantial sampling overhead. Existing guidance-free approaches halve this cost by approximating the CFG with a single model inference, but their performance is bounded by the CFG and inherits its limitations. In this paper, we propose self-contrastive guidance (SCG), which contrasts the model's prediction on real and self-generated samples to obtain a direct, model-based signal that pushes generation toward the true data manifold. Integrating SCG into the standard likelihood objective via reparameterization yields Self-Contrastive Alignment for Likelihood Estimation (SCALE), a guidance-free training framework that produces SCG-enhanced predictions in a single forward pass. Across class-conditional and text-to-image generation on diffusion and autoregressive models, SCALE consistently outperforms CFG-mimicking guidance-free baselines and improves further when combined with DPO, demonstrating that the self-contrastive signal yields gains complementary to both CFG and preference-based fine-tuning.

</details>


### [56] [Agentic Image Generation in the Wild](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23269)
*Yifan Li,Bowen Qin,Kun Zhou,Haochen Zhao,Zikang Liu,Zheng Li,Minsheng Hao,Yuhao Cheng,Haosheng Zou,Jeff Chen,Wayne Xin Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 论文提出"野外图像生成"(Image Generation in the Wild)设定,构建自动化流水线与Savanna基准(500条近期实体提示),并提出Locate-Corroborate-Isolate范式训练Ranger-8B智能体,检索得分67.2,超越前沿模型的harness框架,并在各生成器上取得最佳生成质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Agentic图像生成依赖搜索智能体从网络检索参考图以突破生成器训练数据限制,但真实请求常涉及数天前才出现的实体:网络视觉证据稀少、搜索结果混杂易混淆实体、目标极少单独出现,现有基准与智能体难以应对。

Method: 1) 构建自动化流水线:从近期新闻标题合成提示,仅保留真实搜索结果高度混淆的样本,得到Savanna基准(500条提示/16个子类别);2) 提出Locate-Corroborate-Isolate范式:先经文本检索锁定目标身份,再跨多源核验候选图像,最后裁剪干净参考图供生成器使用;3) 基于15K条遵循该范式的轨迹训练Ranger-8B。

Result: Savanna上,基于前沿模型的harness框架仅约半数提示能检索到正确参考;Ranger-8B检索得分67.2,优于配备前沿模型的harness;在测试的所有生成器上均取得最佳生成质量,并在其他图像生成基准上超越既有agentic方法。

Conclusion: 面向新兴实体的"野外"设定是agentic图像生成的关键挑战;显式的定位—核验—裁剪范式配合轨迹训练可在检索与生成两端同时超越前沿模型方案;论文开源流水线、基准、训练数据与模型。

Abstract: Agentic image generation pairs an image generator with a search agent that retrieves references from the web, extending generation beyond the generator's training data. Real-world requests, however, often concern entities that appeared only days ago. We call this setting Image Generation in the Wild. In this setting, the web offers limited visual evidence, search results are crowded with easily confused entities, and the target is rarely shown on its own. To study this setting, we build an automated pipeline that synthesizes prompts from recent headlines and keeps only those whose real search results are highly confusing, yielding requests that are hard to solve yet natural to ask. With it, we construct Savanna, a benchmark of 500 prompts across 16 subcategories. On Savanna, even harness frameworks built on the frontier models retrieve a correct reference for only about half of the prompts. We then propose Locate-Corroborate-Isolate, a paradigm in which the agent first pins down the target's identity through text search, then verifies candidate images against multiple sources, and finally crops a clean reference for the generator. Trained on 15K trajectories that follow this paradigm, Ranger-8B achieves a search score of 67.2, outperforming harnesses equipped with frontier models. It also achieves the best generation quality with every generator we test, and surpasses prior agentic methods on other image generation benchmarks. We release the pipeline, benchmark, training data and model at https://github.com/RUCAIBox/Agentic-ImageGen-Wild.

</details>


### [57] [Xiaomi-Lens-0 Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23279)
*Pei Fu,Yike Liu,Yue Sun,Hanmo Wang,Xiuwen Xi,Ruoceng Zhang,Shaojie Zhang,Chao Jiang,Hang Li,Bingrui Liu,Zhenbo Luo,Heng Qu,Changjian Xu,Ming Xu,Jian Luan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Xiaomi-Lens-0：基于 Qwen3.5 的 4B 多模态大模型，利用语言模型自身的 mask-token 隐状态解码分割掩码，实现"用视觉隐变量推理"，在区域级理解与分割上显著超越基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态大模型擅长整图问答，但细粒度区域理解能力弱。核心原因在于纯文本监督从未指明哪些区域支持答案，缺少区域级定位监督信号。

Method: 在 Qwen3.5 上构建 4B 模型；采用轻量解码器，将视觉编码器的 patch 特征与视觉隐变量（即语言模型 mask-token 状态）融合以预测掩码，使掩码监督直接回传至共享骨干，无需额外分割编码器。每个隐变量对应一个掩码，模型可在推理中交错使用区域特定隐变量，实现"以视觉隐变量思考"；并用带定位的推理链（grounded reasoning traces）监督思维链中访问的区域。

Result: 在 RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg 全部八个划分上，指代理解平均较 Qwen3.5 提升 5.6 分，分割 cIoU 在对比模型中最高；并在所有感知基准上超过 Qwen3.5。

Conclusion: 将掩码监督注入共享骨干、以视觉隐变量作为可解码的区域推理单元，是提升 MLLM 细粒度区域理解与指代分割的有效范式，且无需引入独立分割编码器。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) answer questions about whole images well, yet they still struggle with fine-grained region understanding. A key reason is that text-only supervision never specifies which regions support an answer. To close this gap, we present Xiaomi-Lens-0, a 4B MLLM built on Qwen3.5 that predicts masks from its own visual representations. Specifically, a lightweight decoder combines vision-encoder patch features with visual latents, the language model's mask-token states, so mask supervision reaches the shared backbone without an additional segmentation encoder. Because each latent decodes to a mask, the model can interleave reasoning with region-specific latents and thus think with visual latents, while grounded reasoning traces supervise the regions it visits during chain-of-thought. As a result, across all eight RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, and RefCOCOg splits, Xiaomi-Lens-0 gains 5.6 points on average over Qwen3.5 in referring comprehension and achieves the highest segmentation cIoU among compared models. Moreover, it surpasses Qwen3.5 across all perception benchmarks. Homepage: \href{https://seerray-lab.github.io/Xiaomi-Lens-0}{this https URL}

</details>


### [58] [I2V-DETACH: Source Grounding Detachment for Unauthorized Image-to-Video Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23287)
*Chanhui Lee,Yeonghwan Song,Yewon Kang,Jeany Son*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 I2V-DETACH，一种图生视频（I2V）免疫方法，通过"源 grounding 解耦"而非输出降质来阻止未授权的图生视频生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 I2V 免疫方法主要依赖降低生成视频的视觉质量或时间一致性，本质是输出层面的破坏；作者转而从"削弱源内容保持"的视角重新审视该问题，目标是阻断源图像条件内容的传播，而非单纯劣化输出。

Method: 核心观察：I2V 模型在去噪过程中通过将源图像线索传播到视频潜变量来保持源内容。I2V-DETACH 从两方面互补破坏该过程：(1) 抑制源-视频 grounding，减少源线索传播；(2) 增强视频内部交互，使去噪转向视频侧动态、降低对源图的依赖。为获得有效优化信号，用源导向状态初始化辅助视频潜变量，使其处于源条件生成域内但偏离源保持轨迹。

Result: 在多种扩散架构上的大量实验表明，I2V-DETACH 显著降低源内容保持程度，优于已有免疫方法，并具有强黑盒迁移性。

Conclusion: 将 I2V 免疫重新定义为削弱源条件内容传播是有效方向；通过源 grounding 解耦可实现对未授权 I2V 生成的保护，且兼具效果与迁移性。

Abstract: Recent diffusion models have advanced image-conditioned video generation, but their accessibility raises risks of unauthorized manipulation. Image immunization has emerged as a promising defense for Image-to-Video (I2V) protection, yet existing methods often rely on degrading visual quality or temporal coherence. In this work, we revisit I2V immunization as reducing source-content preservation, shifting the focus from output degradation to weakening source-conditioned content propagation. To this end, we propose I2V-DETACH, an image immunization method that prevents unauthorized I2V generation through source grounding detachment. I2V models preserve source content by propagating source-image cues into video latents during denoising. Accordingly, I2V-DETACH disrupts this process in two complementary ways: it suppresses source-video grounding to reduce source cue propagation, and strengthens intra-video interactions to shift denoising toward video-side dynamics with reduced reliance on the source image. To obtain informative optimization signals, we initialize auxiliary video latents with source-oriented states that remain within the source-conditioned generation regime while deviating from source-preserving trajectories.
