Extensive experiments across diverse diffusion architectures show that I2V-DETACH substantially reduces source-content preservation, improves over prior immunization methods, and exhibits strong black-box transferability.

</details>


### [59] [FlashReFocus: Interactive Image Refocusing in Seconds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23297)
*Ching-Heng Cheng,Chia-Ming Lee,Ming-Ching Chang,Xin Li,Yu-Lun Liu,Chih-Chung Hsu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: FlashReFocus通过"每张照片只运行一次扩散、后续编辑用轻量渲染网络"的解耦策略，实现快速、可控的单图重聚焦与散景渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有生成式单图重聚焦方法每次修改焦点或模糊强度都要重新运行大型扩散模型，交互成本高。作者观察到该问题本质上是两类不同的子问题：恢复全焦图像是病态问题、需要生成先验；而渲染模糊主要由深度与焦平面决定，可用轻量方法完成。

Method: 1) 每张照片仅运行一次扩散：采用带解码器细化器（decoder refiner）的一步扩散去模糊器恢复全焦图像，兼顾保真度与感知质量；2) 渲染器以显式defocus map为条件，引入defocus-bias attention，使相近散焦像素共享信息且不受其他深度像素干扰，从而保证对焦区域不变；3) 通过编辑defocus map支持移轴（tilt-shift）与双焦平面效果；4) 构建3CReal三相机基准（89对图像）用于测试跨相机泛化。

Result: 在EBB!与3CReal上取得零样本散景渲染的最佳感知保真度；重聚焦速度比GenRefocus快148.3倍；后续单次编辑约0.5秒，提速462倍。

Conclusion: 将病态的全焦恢复与确定性的模糊渲染解耦，是提升交互式重聚焦效率的有效途径；显式defocus map条件与defocus-bias attention带来精确控制和良好泛化能力。

Abstract: Single-image refocusing changes the focal plane and depth of field of a photograph after capture. It is inherently interactive: users try many focal points and blur strengths on one image, so each edit should be fast and change only the blur. Recent generative methods, however, rerun large diffusion models for every edit. We observe that the two sub-problems differ in kind: recovering the all-in-focus image is ill-posed and needs a generative prior, whereas rendering blur is largely determined by depth and the focal plane. We therefore propose FlashReFocus, which runs diffusion once per photograph and renders every edit with a lightweight network. To address the ill-posed restoration, a one-step diffusion deblurrer with a decoder refiner recovers fine detail efficiently while balancing fidelity and perceptual quality. For precise control, the renderer is conditioned on an explicit defocus map and uses defocus-bias attention, which lets pixels at similar defocus share information without interference from pixels at other depths; in-focus content stays unchanged, and editing the map yields tilt-shift and two focal planes. To further test generalization to unseen cameras, we collect 3CReal, a three-camera benchmark of 89 pairs. FlashReFocus achieves the best perceptual fidelity for zero-shot bokeh rendering on EBB! and 3CReal, refocuses 148.3x faster than GenRefocus, and takes about half a second per further edit, 462x faster.

</details>


### [60] [Look, Reason, Draw a Region: Recursive Refinement for Spatial Context Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23302)
*Wajeeha Tahir,Anna Tegon,Lionnus Kesting,Gamze İslamoğlu,Kristóf Karacs,Luca Benini,Thorir Mar Ingolfsson*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出紧凑递归模型 Spatial-TRM（冻结视觉-语言特征、凸区域解码器、仅 11.2M 可训练参数），通过权重共享的递归推理提升自然图像中的空间上下文预测精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空间上下文预测需视觉定位与空间推理来识别相对于场景物体的空白区域；空间关系与物理约束仍是大型视觉-语言模型（VLM）的难点。递归推理在离散与抽象推理任务上表现优异，因而被引入以改进自然图像中的空间上下文预测，并借助权重共享在少量可训练参数下获得更高精度。

Method: Spatial-TRM：冻结视觉-语言特征 + 凸区域解码器 + 权重绑定（weight-tied）递归推理器，可训练参数仅 11.2M；支持六种空间关系、三种参考系与开放词表锚点物体；与同参数量单步模型对照消融。

Result: 在 RoboSpatial-Home 基准上取得 29.51% 上下文准确率，较同参数量的单独训练单步模型提升 9.02 个百分点（相对提升 44.0%）；含冻结编码器总参数 877.8M，约为 RoboPoint 所报 13B 规模的 1/15。

Conclusion: 在固定可训练参数量的条件下，反复细化（递归迭代）能有效改善基于预训练视觉-语言特征的空间上下文预测，在该基准上验证了递归推理的有效性。

Abstract: Spatial context prediction requires visual grounding and spatial reasoning to identify vacant regions relative to objects in a scene. Spatial relationships and physical constraints remain challenging for large vision-language models (VLMs). Recursive reasoning has demonstrated strong performance on discrete and abstract reasoning tasks, motivating its use for improving spatial context prediction in natural images. Weight sharing enables higher accuracy with a small trainable parameter count. We introduce Spatial-TRM, a compact recursive model with frozen vision-language features, a convex region decoder, and just 11.2M trainable parameters. This weight-tied reasoner supports six spatial relationships, three reference frames, and open-vocabulary anchor objects. On the RoboSpatial-Home benchmark, Spatial-TRM achieves 29.51% context accuracy, a gain of 9.02 percentage points (44.0% relative) over a separately trained single-step model with the same parameter count. Including the frozen encoders, the model has 877.8M total parameters, approximately $15\times$ fewer than the reported 13B size of RoboPoint. These results show that repeated refinement improves spatial context prediction from pretrained vision-language features at a fixed trainable parameter count on this benchmark.

</details>


### [61] [CatchUp: Depth-Aware Re-Admission of Visual Tokens for Efficient Large Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23324)
*Eunju Park,Uiwon Hwang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CatchUp 提出无需训练的深度感知视觉 token 再准入框架：周期性重估查询相关视觉 token，对延后 token 用参考-当前过渡信号近似其错过的表示演化，在 64 token 预算下保留全模型 92.17% 性能并将端到端延迟降低 8.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LVLM 在解码器各层反复处理数百个视觉 token，计算与显存开销大。现有推理期剪枝不可逆地丢弃低排名 token，但高查询条件注意力的视觉 token 集合会随解码深度变化；可恢复路由虽保留被跳过的 token，却在绕过中间变换后以“陈旧表示”重新准入，造成语义错位。

Method: 先给出实证发现：用全 token 参考轨迹中当前深度的 oracle 状态替换陈旧再准入状态可显著提升 grounding 性能。据此设计 CatchUp：①每个解码器区间重复评估查询条件下的视觉相关性，仅处理被选中的视觉 token；②保留被延后的 token 以备后续再准入；③再准入时，利用语义与空间相关视觉 token 的“参考到当前”过渡信号近似其遗漏的表示演化，无需训练。

Result: 在三个指代表达式 grounding 数据集和六个多模态基准上，于 64/128/192 token 预算下两组基准的平均相对保留率均为最高。64 token 预算下活跃视觉 token 减少 88.9%，六项多模态基准平均保留全模型 92.17% 性能，端到端延迟降低 8.0%。

Conclusion: 视觉 token 的相关性具有深度动态性，不可逆剪枝并非最优；通过深度感知的再准入并修复错过的表示演化，CatchUp 在显著削减视觉 token 的同时保持较高性能并实现实际加速，且无需额外训练。

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) repeatedly process hundreds of visual tokens across decoder layers, incurring substantial computation and memory costs. Existing inference-time visual token pruning methods often irreversibly remove low-ranked tokens, although the set of visual tokens receiving high query-conditioned attention can change across decoder depth. Recoverable routing preserves skipped tokens for later reconsideration, but re-admits them with stale representations after bypassing intermediate transformations. We further find that replacing stale re-admitted states with their current-depth oracle states from a full-token reference trajectory substantially improves grounding performance. We therefore propose CatchUp, a training-free framework for depth-aware visual-token re-admission. CatchUp repeatedly re-evaluates query-conditioned visual relevance, processes only selected visual tokens through each decoder interval, and preserves deferred tokens for later re-admission. Upon re-admission, CatchUp approximates missed representation evolution using reference-to-current transition signals from semantically and spatially related visual tokens. Across three referring-expression grounding datasets and six multimodal benchmarks, CatchUp achieves the highest average relative retention in both benchmark groups at 64-, 128-, and 192-token budgets. At a 64-token budget with 88.9% fewer active visual tokens, CatchUp retains 92.17% of the full model's performance on average across six multimodal benchmarks while reducing end-to-end latency by 8.0%. Code is available at https://github.com/pej0918/CatchUp

</details>


### [62] [STC-MGNet: Spatial-Temporal-Channel Attention-Enhanced Multimodal Graph Network for Pedestrian Intention Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23356)
*Yuanzhe Li,Meng Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出STC-MGNet——时空-通道注意力增强的多模态图网络，用于行人过街意图预测，通过三支并行注意力编码姿态序列并结合跨模态通道调制融合视觉与自车运动信息，在JAADbeh/JAADall/PIE上分别达到70%/87%/88%准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行人过街意图预测对自动驾驶中行人-车辆交互安全至关重要，但如何有效捕捉行人姿态序列中细微的时空模式，并融合互补的视觉信息与自车运动信息，仍是难点。

Method: 构建空间-时间-通道（STC）注意力增强的姿态图编码器：三条并行注意力分支分别强调有判别性的骨骼关节、观测帧与特征通道，输出经可学习融合权重整合；并引入多阶段跨模态通道调制机制，在连续图编码阶段通过模态特定的通道门控自适应精炼姿态表征，从而利用视觉与自车运动信息。

Result: 在JAADbeh、JAADall与PIE数据集上分别取得70%、87%、88%的准确率，优于多个代表性基线方法；消融实验验证了视觉与自车运动信息对预测性能的互补贡献。

Conclusion: STC-MGNet通过多维度注意力与跨模态通道调制有效提升了行人过街意图预测精度，且多模态信息的互补性得到实验证实，可为自动驾驶行人交互安全提供支持。

Abstract: Accurate prediction of pedestrian crossing intentions plays a critical role in enhancing the safety of pedestrian-vehicle interactions in autonomous driving. However, effectively capturing subtle spatiotemporal patterns in pedestrian pose sequences and integrating complementary visual and ego-vehicle motion information remain challenging. This paper proposes a spatial-temporal-channel attention-enhanced multimodal graph network (STC-MGNet) for pedestrian crossing intention prediction. STC-MGNet introduces a spatial-temporal-channel (STC) attention-enhanced pose graph encoder to learn discriminative representations from pedestrian pose sequences. Three parallel attention branches selectively emphasize informative skeletal joints, observation frames, and feature channels, with their outputs integrated through learnable fusion weights. To leverage complementary visual and ego-vehicle motion information, a multi-stage cross-modal channel modulation mechanism is introduced to adaptively refine pose representations through modality-specific channel gating at successive graph encoding stages. Experimental results demonstrate that STC-MGNet achieves accuracy rates of 70%, 87%, and 88% on the JAADbeh, JAADall, and PIE datasets, respectively, outperforming several representative baseline methods. Ablation experiments further highlight the complementary contributions of visual and ego-vehicle motion information to prediction performance.

</details>


### [63] [UniPolar: Joint Image and Polarimetric Restoration under Compound Degradations via Physical Consistency Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23360)
*Yang Jin,Guangyu Guo,Linghao Shen,Binglu Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 UniPolar 耦合图像-Stokes 框架，从复合退化 CPFA 观测中联合恢复四幅偏振角图像与可靠的 Stokes/DoLP/AoLP。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CPFA 成像中设备退化与环境退化常同时存在，现有方法多孤立处理单一退化；复合退化同时扰动强度与跨角度偏振差，仅提升图像保真度无法保证 Stokes、DoLP、AoLP 的物理准确性。

Method: 双流结构：一流重建四个偏振角图像，另一流直接预测 Stokes 差分分量；以退化条件跨域交互协调两流，含双域频率交互（频率选择性证据交换）与退化条件调制（条件自适应特征修正）；输出端引入图像-Stokes 物理一致性学习，对齐图像导出与直接预测的 Stokes 分量，并正则化角度保真与 DoLP 物理可行性。

Result: 复合退化基准上平均图像 PSNR 31.522 dB、DoLP PSNR 24.097 dB，平均 AoLP 误差 16.833°。

Conclusion: 视觉保真度与偏振可靠性需联合优化；该工作为复合退化下基于学习的偏振图像恢复提供物理约束视角。

Abstract: Polarimetric image restoration aims to recover polarization angle images and reliable polarimetric quantities from degraded observations. Beyond visual fidelity, it also requires preserving the physical relationships underlying reliable polarimetric estimation. However, existing methods typically address either device- or environment-induced degradations in isolation, limiting their applicability to color polarization filter array (CPFA) imaging, where both often coexist. Such compound degradations jointly perturb image intensities and cross angle polarization differences. Consequently, improved image fidelity alone does not necessarily ensure accurate Stokes, DoLP, and AoLP recovery. To address this challenge, we propose UniPolar, a coupled Image Stokes framework for joint image polarimetric restoration from compound-degraded CPFA observations. Specifically, UniPolar employs two complementary streams to reconstruct four polarization-angle images and directly predict Stokes difference components. To coordinate these streams, Degradation Conditioned Cross Domain Interaction combines Dual Domain Frequency Interaction for frequency selective evidence exchange with Degradation Conditioned Modulation for condition adaptive feature correction. Furthermore, at the output level, Image Stokes Physical Consistency Learning aligns image derived and directly predicted Stokes components while regularizing angular fidelity and the physical feasibility of DoLP. On the compound-degradation benchmark, UniPolar achieves average image and DoLP PSNR of 31.522 dB and 24.097 dB, respectively, with an average AoLP error of 16.833 degree. These results underscore the importance of jointly considering visual fidelity and polarimetric reliability, offering a physically grounded perspective on learning based restoration under compound degradations.

</details>


### [64] [MOSS-Image Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23374)
*MOSI. AI*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出开源系统 MOSS-Image，结合 5B 单流 DiT 预训练与意图感知的提示增强模块，实现长文本渲染与精确版式控制，并发布 LLTB 与 RLA 两个基准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 闭源图像生成系统已能从简单构图扩展到信息密集的图形，但开源权重文生图模型在密集文本与复杂版式上仍显不足，作者希望缩小这一差距。

Method: 一是从零预训练 5B 单流扩散 Transformer（DiT），通过精心设计的训练配方支持双语长文本渲染与精确版式控制；二是设计意图感知的智能体式提示增强（PE）模块，将多样用户请求转译为细化的内容与版式规范。

Result: 在自建的 LongLongTextBench（中英长文本渲染评测）上取得开源权重模型 SOTA，平均文本覆盖率 96.3%；在 RealLayoutArena 端到端系统对比中排名第二，其骨干网络在共享增强提示下于生成器中排名第一。

Conclusion: 作者将开源模型、训练配方与评测框架，以支持后续研究并推动文生图社区发展。

Abstract: Recent closed-source image generation systems can produce diverse visual content from simple compositions to information-dense graphics, yet open-weight text-to-image models still struggle with dense text and intricate layouts. To narrow this gap, we introduce MOSS-Image, an open generation system that combines high-fidelity visual synthesis with intent-aware composition. First, we pretrain a 5B single-stream diffusion transformer (DiT) from scratch with a carefully designed recipe, enabling bilingual long-form text rendering and precise layout control. Second, we develop an intention-aware agentic prompt enhancement (PE) module that translates diverse user requests into detailed content and layout specifications. Together, they enable MOSS-Image to generate text-rich and layout-coherent images. We further introduce LongLongTextBench (LLTB) for evaluating long-form English and Chinese text rendering, and RealLayoutArena (RLA) for end-to-end layout-rich generation. MOSS-Image achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-weight models on LLTB, with an average text coverage of 96.3%. On RLA, MOSS-Image ranks second in the end-to-end system comparison, while its backbone ranks first among generators evaluated with shared enhanced prompts. We will release the model, training recipe, and evaluation framework to support further research and promote the text-to-image community.

</details>


### [65] [FloodVLM-Pix: Language-Guided Pixel-Level Flood Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23377)
*Chengyang Zhang,Zhihao Wang,Zhiyu Long,Xueqian Wang,Quanming Yao,Wei Wu,Gang Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文构建首个大规模遥感洪水多模态基准（131,200个图像块与443,100条文本描述），并提出语言引导的像素级洪水理解模型FloodVLM-Pix，通过洪水先验模块与多时相洪水像素解码器解决注意力偏差与分割干扰问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候变化加剧使洪水更频繁、更具破坏性，亟需准确的洪水理解；然而现有视觉-语言模型在洪水相关任务上表现不佳，存在注意力偏差和对洪水强度描述不准确的问题。

Method: 构建支持语言级洪水理解与像素级洪水分割的大规模遥感洪水多模态基准；提出FloodVLM-Pix模型，包含洪水先验模块（自动蒸馏子区域洪水空间先验并注入模型，缓解语言理解中的注意力偏差）和多时相洪水像素解码器（引入通用-特定特征融合机制，抑制云层、山体阴影等干扰）。

Result: 在FloodVL-Pix上的实验表明，相比最先进的VLM与洪水分割模型，FloodVLM-Pix同时提升了洪水描述质量与像素级洪水分割性能。

Conclusion: 该工作通过新基准与语言引导的像素级建模方法，有效弥补了视觉-语言模型在洪水理解上的不足，代码与数据将开源发布。

Abstract: As climate change intensifies, floods are becoming more frequent and destructive, making accurate flood understanding an urgent priority. However, existing vision-language models perform poorly on flood-related tasks, suffering from attentional bias and inaccurate descriptions of flood magnitude. To bridge this gap, we construct the first large-scale remote sensing flood multi-modal benchmark that supports language-level flood understanding and pixel-level flood segmentation. The benchmark contains 131,200 flood image patches and corresponding 443,100 textual descriptions for flood severity and evolution. Based on this benchmark, we propose FloodVLM-Pix, a language-guided pixel-level flood understanding model that includes a flood prior module and a multi-temporal flood pixel decoder to achieve accurate flood understanding. The flood prior module automatically distills sub-region flood spatial priors and inputs priors into FloodVLM-Pix, solving the attentional bias problem in flood language understanding. The flood pixel decoder introduces a novel general-specific feature fusion mechanism to address performance degradation caused by interference (e.g., clouds or mountain shadows) during flood segmentation. Experiments on FloodVL-Pix demonstrate that FloodVLM-Pix improves both flood description quality and pixel-level flood segmentation performance compared with state-of-the-art VLMs and flood segmentation models. Our code and data will be released at https://github.com/Haomiaoyanmeng/FloodPix.

</details>


### [66] [LithoWorld: An Endpoint World Model for Lithography Process-Window Recovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23408)
*Botong Zhao,Fang Yu,Xinyuan Chen,Yue Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LithoWorld：一种面向SEM图像的端点世界模型，用因果预测分支与条件流策略生成二维光刻参数校正动作块，实现工艺漂移下的参数恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光刻工艺漂移会使已制备图形偏离工艺窗口，导致SEM形貌不合格；需要依据SEM形态反推并恢复光刻参数，而现有方法缺乏对合格参考外观与端点状态的显式建模。

Method: 提出LithoWorld：1）由内部代表性目标共同确定合格参考外观与校正监督信号；2）因果预测分支将当前图像特征与端点表示对齐；3）条件流策略生成二维校正量作为动作块；4）从173组实测SEM构建聚焦-曝光图（FEM），未测单元保留为未知。

Result: 在73组子集的200个测试对上，合格区域成功率88.5%、内部区域成功率46.0%，分别比最强对比方法高出2.5与6.0个百分点；消融实验分离了目标选择、端点对齐与输出参数化的贡献；定性SEM检索显示无需精确参考坐标匹配即可恢复至合格内部。

Conclusion: 以端点世界模型形式建模光刻参数恢复是有效的，端点对齐与动作块参数化对性能提升有实质贡献，并能容忍参考坐标不完全匹配。

Abstract: Lithography process drift can move a fabricated pattern outside its process window, producing unqualified scanning electron microscopy (SEM) morphology. We present LithoWorld, an endpoint world model for SEM-guided parameter recovery. Interior representative targets jointly determine qualified reference appearance and correction supervision. A causal predictive branch aligns currentimage features with endpoint representations, while a conditional flow policy generates a two-dimensional correction as an action chunk. The model learns from 173 groups of measured SEMs organized as focus-exposure maps, preserving unmeasured cells as unknown. On 200 test pairs from the 73-group subset, LithoWorld achieves 88.5% qualified-region success and 46.0% interior success, exceeding the strongest comparison method by 2.5 and 6.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablations separate the effects of target selection, endpoint alignment, and output parameterization. Qualitative SEM retrieval illustrates recovery to qualified interiors without requiring exact reference-coordinate matching.

</details>


### [67] [Can We Use Saliency Maps for the Evaluation of Generative Image Models?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23411)
*Eleonora Ristori,Luca Bindini,Marco Lippi,Paolo Frasconi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种类人评估框架：训练针对特定生成器的真伪分类器并用显著图分析其决策，发现分类器学到的是生成器特有的伪影而非通用"虚假性"，据此构建结合准确率与显著信息的复合评分，无需大型预训练骨干即可与人类判断对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常用生成图像评估指标依赖为其他任务优化的固定预训练特征提取器，其表示在不同数据集和模型族上与人类真实性感知并不总是一致，因此需要一种不依赖无关任务学习表示的评估方法。

Method: 训练生成器专属分类器区分真实图像与该模型生成样本，并用显著图（saliency maps）解释其决策；在多个基准上考察其准确率与跨生成器迁移性；最后将分类准确率与显著图信息融合为复合评分。

Result: 分类器学到的是生成器特有伪影而非通用的"虚假性"概念，准确率高但跨生成器迁移能力有限；显著图因而具有较强解释力，能突出各模型输出特有的视觉线索与结构不规则性；复合评分与人类判断一致，且仅使用待评估模型的真实样本与生成样本、无需大型预训练骨干。

Conclusion: 该框架提供了一种轻量、可解释、类人的生成图像评估途径，揭示"虚假性"并非跨模型通用属性，而是模型特有伪影的集合，为评估指标设计提供新视角。

Abstract: Evaluating generative image models remains challenging, as commonly used metrics depend on fixed pretrained feature extractors optimized for different tasks that do not always align with human realism perception across datasets and model families. To address this limitation, we investigate a human-inspired evaluation framework that avoids representations learned for unrelated tasks. Specifically, we train a generator-specific classifier to distinguish real images from samples produced by a given model and analyze its decisions using saliency maps. Across diverse benchmarks, we observe that these classifiers learn generator-specific artifacts rather than a universal notion of "fakeness", exhibiting strong accuracy and limited cross-generator transfer. This makes saliency analysis particularly informative: the resulting attribution maps highlight visual cues and structural irregularities characteristic of each model's outputs. By combining classification accuracy and saliency information, we obtain a composite score aligned with human judgments, without relying on large pretrained backbones and using only real and generated samples from the evaluated model.

</details>


### [68] [GeoReason: Bridging Logical Reasoning and Spatial Fidelity in Remote Sensing Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23416)
*Cheng Fan,Han Wu,Tingzhang Luo,Minjing Dong,Yehui Tang,Jianyuan Guo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoReason针对遥感推理分割中[SEG]token随自回归生成长链而逐步脱离视觉grounding导致的"空间保真度退化"与"目标误识别"瓶颈，提出"预期先验"机制将[SEG]前置到用户查询作为持续空间锚点，并结合位置感知CoT与潜空间Patch-to-Token对齐损失，在Earthreason与RRSIS-D上超越SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在"Embedding-as-Mask"范式下将MLLM扩展至遥感推理分割，面临地理背景杂乱与尺度变化剧烈的挑战，易出现空间保真度退化与目标误识别。作者识别出一个关键但未被充分探索的瓶颈：分割token [SEG]在自回归生成中与其初始视觉grounding的序列性疏离——它仅在长推理链末端产生，所依赖的视觉证据已被语言抽象与自回归噪声逐步稀释；对小像素足迹的遥感目标尤为致命，即使边际保真度损失也会导致定位失败。

Method: 1) 预期先验（Anticipatory Prior）：将[SEG]token直接注入初始用户查询，使其由终端输出转为前置条件，成为持久空间锚点以抑制长文本推理中的信息衰减；2) 位置感知思维链（Location-aware CoT）：以边界框约束由粗到细的定位推理；3) 潜空间Patch-to-Token对齐（PTA）损失：显式对齐潜分割token与真实遥感纹理特征。

Result: 在Earthreason与RRSIS-D两个基准上，GeoReason持续优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 通过将[SEG]由末端产物重构为前置空间锚点，并辅以结构化定位推理与显式视觉对齐约束，可有效缓解自回归生成中的视觉信息衰减，显著提升遥感推理分割的空间保真度；代码已开源。

Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have significantly advanced instruction-driven perception through the "Embedding-as-Mask" paradigm. However, extending this capability to Remote Sensing (RS) reasoning segmentation remains exceptionally challenging under cluttered geographical contexts and extreme scale variations, often leading to Spatial Fidelity Degradation and Target Misidentification. We identify a critical yet underexplored bottleneck: the sequential alienation of the segmentation token [SEG] from its initial visual grounding within the autoregressive generation paradigm. Produced only at the end of long reasoning chains, [SEG] relies on visual evidence that has been progressively diluted by linguistic abstraction and autoregressive noise. This information decay is particularly catastrophic for RS targets with minuscule pixel footprints, where even marginal fidelity loss leads to localization failure. To address these bottlenecks, we propose GeoReason, a novel framework designed to fortify logical deduction and preserve spatial integrity. First, we introduce an Anticipatory Prior mechanism that injects the [SEG] token directly into the initial user query, shifting it from a terminal output to a primary condition. This paradigm shift transforms the token into a persistent spatial anchor, preventing information decay during long-form linguistic inference. Second, we enhance visual reasoning via a Location-aware Chain-of-Thought (CoT) that enforces coarse-to-fine localization using bounding boxes, coupled with a Latent Patch-to-Token Alignment (PTA) Loss that explicitly aligns the latent segmentation token with physical RS textures. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GeoReason consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods on the Earthreason and RRSIS-D benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/Fanc0126/GeoReason.

</details>


### [69] [Momentum: Persistent Dynamics for Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23423)
*Nedko Savov,Stefan Maria Ailuro,Danda Pani Paudel,Yilun Du,Xi Wang,Luc Van Gool*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Momentum：用参考相机组的同步视频作为“演化场景记忆”，通过图结构传播视频生成，使视野外动态内容可被一致地记忆与重现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型需在相机离开后内容重现时保持一致观测。现有方法依赖观测历史、静态点云或图像缓存，代价高且无法更新视野外的动态内容，导致车辆、行人离开视野后被遗忘或重现时物理状态错误。

Method: 以8相机参考相机组（rig）的同步视频表示演化场景，将多个rig以图相连并在邻居间传播视频生成以协调跨位置与时间的动态。两阶段流程：WorldUpdate联合生成参考相机视频，作为场景动态的共享记忆；WorldInteract在该演化记忆的基础上进行相机控制的视频生成。另构建基于CARLA的数据管线，采集参考rig与移动目标相机的同步视频，并提供衡量生成世界状态内部一致性与目标观测一致性的评测框架。

Result: 在生成街道场景实验中，以Momentum生成的场景动态作为条件，相比静态图像条件，在未见场景中的动态场景一致性提升126.2%，同时视觉保真度也提升。

Conclusion: 将目标视图生成锚定在持续演化的场景动态记忆中，可有效解决视野外动态内容的一致性问题；模型与代码将公开。

Abstract: Video world models must capture how a scene evolves beyond the current camera view to generate consistent observations when its content reappears. Existing approaches rely on observation history, static point clouds, or image caches constructed from past frames. These representations are often expensive and, more importantly, cannot update dynamic scene content outside the field of view: generated vehicles and pedestrians may be forgotten after leaving the field of view or reappear in physically inaccurate states. We represent an evolving scene through synchronized videos from reference-camera rigs, each comprising eight cameras that jointly cover the surrounding scene. We connect these rigs in a graph and propagate video generation between neighboring rigs to coordinate scene dynamics across locations and time. We introduce Momentum, a two-stage pipeline: WorldUpdate jointly generates reference-camera videos as a shared memory of scene dynamics, and WorldInteract grounds camera-controlled video generation in this evolving memory, allowing moving content to remain represented outside the target view and reappear consistently. To support training and evaluation, we develop a CARLA pipeline that captures synchronized videos from reference camera rigs and a moving target camera, together with an evaluation framework measuring consistency within the generated world state and the target observations.Experiments on generated street scenes show that grounding target videos in scene dynamics generated by Momentum improves dynamic scene consistency by 126.2% in unseen scenes over static image conditioning, while also improving visual fidelity. Our models and source code will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [70] [ShadowCast: On-the-Fly Context-Aware Shadow Augmentation for Remote Sensing Image Segmentation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23440)
*Yechan Kim,Dongho Yoon,Jongmin Joo,JongHyun Park,Moongu Jeon*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出ShadowCast，从分割标签提取地物掩码并估计投影方向，在训练时合成阴影注入，无需网络与元数据，提升遥感语义分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高处物体（建筑、树木）的投影阴影会改变光谱表现并模糊地物边界，损害遥感语义分割性能；现有方法把阴影视为需检测和去除的退化，依赖专用网络与阴影标注，成本高。

Method: 反向思路：训练时合成阴影而非去除。从分割标签直接提取建筑、树木等高度物体掩码，通过探测其周边亮度估计图像特定的投影方向线索，再沿该方向投影合成阴影；全程无需学习网络、无需成像元数据。

Result: 在Vaihingen、Potsdam、LoveDA三个常用遥感基准上，ShadowCast在多种SOTA分割架构中稳定优于基线；与标准数据增强和正则化方法结合时还有额外增益。

Conclusion: 随机阴影注入是一种简单、互补的遥感分割数据增强策略。

Abstract: Shadows cast by elevated objects alter the spectral appearance and obscure the boundaries of objects in remote sensing images, thereby degrading semantic segmentation performance. Most existing approaches handle shadows as degradations to be detected and removed, requiring additional costs from dedicated networks and shadow-specific annotations. We propose ShadowCast, which takes the opposite approach: it synthesizes shadows and injects them during training for remote sensing segmentation. It extracts masks of elevated objects, such as buildings and trees, directly from the segmentation labels and estimates an image-specific cast-shadow direction cue by probing the brightness around them. It then projects synthetic shadows along the inferred cast-shadow direction, requiring no learned network and no acquisition metadata. Experiments on three widely used remote sensing benchmarks, Vaihingen, Potsdam, and LoveDA, show that ShadowCast consistently outperforms the baseline across diverse state-of-the-art segmentation architectures. Moreover, it brings additional performance gains when combined with standard augmentation and regularization techniques, indicating that stochastic shadow injection serves as a simple and complementary augmentation strategy for remote sensing segmentation.

</details>


### [71] [TriINR: Unsupervised Atmospheric Turbulence Mitigation with Triple Implicit Neural Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23454)
*Yuka Ogino,Rikuto Otsuka,Yuho Shoji,Takuya Ogawa,Takahiro Toizumi,Atsushi Ito*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出TriINR，一种无监督大气湍流缓解方法，将清晰图像、倾斜（tilt）和模糊（blur）分别表示为三个隐式神经表示（INR），实现与帧数无关的退化建模与内存高效优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于INR的无监督湍流缓解方法中，tilt与blur的表示仍依赖单帧，优化参数数量随输入帧数增长，导致扩展性差、内存开销大。

Method: 将清晰图像、tilt、blur分别建模为隐式神经表示；把tilt与blur建模为时空INR，从而实现与帧数无关的退化表示；并引入大气湍流的物理与统计先验作为INR约束，以提升复原精度。

Result: 在三种退化强度的人工合成湍流数据上，TriINR在不同湍流强度下均比已有湍流缓解方法更稳健，且在被评测的无监督方法中精度最高；在含额外非理想运动的真实远距离场景中也表现出稳健性。

Conclusion: 以时空INR统一建模tilt与blur并结合物理统计约束，可在无监督条件下实现帧数无关、内存高效的湍流图像复原，兼顾鲁棒性与精度。

Abstract: Atmospheric turbulence degrades image quality in long-range imaging. The degradation is generally modeled with two spatio-temporally varying components, tilt and blur. Recent unsupervised turbulence mitigation methods have demonstrated the effectiveness of representing a sharp image as an implicit neural representation (INR). However, their tilt and blur representations remain frame-dependent, and the number of optimization parameters grows with the number of input frames. To address this limitation, we propose TriINR, an unsupervised turbulence mitigation method that recovers a sharp image from multiple degraded frames. TriINR represents the sharp image, tilt, and blur as three implicit neural representations. By modeling tilt and blur as spatio-temporal INRs, TriINR achieves frame-count-independent degradation representation and memory-efficient optimization. We further incorporate physical and statistical properties of atmospheric turbulence as constraints on the INRs to improve restoration accuracy. Experiments on synthesized turbulence data with three degradation strengths show that TriINR restores images more robustly across varying turbulence strengths than prior TM methods and achieves the highest accuracy among the evaluated unsupervised methods. Our method also demonstrates robustness on real long-range scenes containing additional non-ideal motion.

</details>


### [72] [When Evidence Vanishes: Distilling Visual-Evidence Dependency in Medical Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23469)
*Qizhen Lan,Yiling Ma,Ruiqi Chen,Mengchen Fan,Xi Xiao,Lin Zhao,Liang He,Baocheng Geng,Pulin Che,Tianyang Wang,Xiaoqian Jiang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出证据条件依赖蒸馏（ECDD），通过匹配对照样本蒸馏教师模型答案边际随视觉证据移除而下降的幅度，使小型医学VLM的答案支持真正依赖图像证据，而非题干措辞或先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 紧凑型医学视觉语言模型常能答对临床问题却未真正利用图像，而依赖题干措辞或学习到的先验。标准知识蒸馏只复制教师对原始图像的答案偏好，未检验该偏好是否以问题所需的视觉证据为条件，即缺少“医学视觉证据依赖性”这一蒸馏目标。

Method: 定义医学视觉证据依赖性：正确证据缺失时正确答案的支持度应下降。ECDD为每张训练图像配对一个与证据水平匹配的对照样本，蒸馏教师在该配对上的答案边际下降量；采用只惩罚不足的下界目标迁移正依赖性，同时保留原始图像监督以维持任务准确率。该形式适用于查询的临床区域、手术器械或整图视觉内容等证据类型。

Result: 在三个医学VQA设置中，ECDD的原始图像准确率与蒸馏及对齐基线相当，同时答案支持对证据移除更敏感。以DME主指标为例，正例边际对目标掩码相比随机掩码的响应由KD的0.786升至ECDD的2.023，原始图像准确率仅相差0.11个百分点。

Conclusion: 医学VLM蒸馏应同时迁移教师的答案偏好与其对视觉证据的依赖性，ECDD提供了一种通用、可跨证据类型应用的实现路径。

Abstract: Compact medical vision-language models (VLMs) can answer clinical questions correctly without reliably using the image, relying instead on question wording or learned priors. Standard knowledge distillation copies a teacher's answer preference on the original image, but it leaves unchecked whether that preference is conditional on the visual evidence required by the question. We study this missing target as medical visual evidence dependency: support for the correct answer should decrease when the matched evidence is absent. We introduce Evidence-Conditioned Dependency Distillation (ECDD), which pairs each training image with a control matched to the evidence level and distills the teacher's drop in answer margin across the pair. A lower bound objective transfers positive dependency by penalizing only shortfalls, while original-image supervision preserves task accuracy. The same formulation applies when the evidence is a queried clinical region, a surgical instrument, or whole-image visual content. Across three medical VQA settings, ECDD keeps original-image accuracy competitive with distillation and alignment baselines while making answer support more sensitive to evidence removal. Under the DME headline objective, for example, the positive-case margin response to target rather than random masking rises from 0.786 with KD to 2.023 with ECDD, while original-image accuracy differs by 0.11 points. These results suggest that medical VLM distillation should transfer both the teacher's answer preference and its dependence on visual evidence.

</details>


### [73] [TAN: A Size- and Form-Adaptive Masked-Convolution Encoder for Tissue Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23475)
*Jan Herschel,Anselm von Gladiss*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 组织图方法将组织学图像建模为超像素图，但现有编码器需将超像素裁剪为边界框并填充，导致背景/填充值泄漏进节点特征。作者提出TAN（0.41M参数）按原生形状与范围处理超像素并排除背景，使嵌入对填充完全不变；在BACH上与303M的UNI精度相当（81.1% vs 80.7-82.6%），参数少约740倍、FLOPs少约1190倍且无需预训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织图以贴合组织的超像素为节点，避免矩形切块破坏同质区域。但现有编码器将超像素裁到边界框后缩放/填充/掩码，背景或填充值会渗入节点特征。这在医学影像中尤其关键：预测应依赖组织而非任意预处理选择。BACH上仅改变掩码区域填充即可使冻结编码器精度偏移达6个百分点，超过均值填充下四个最佳编码器间的差距，且最佳填充随数据集而变，无法一劳永逸地固定。

Method: 提出TAN（Tissue-Aware Network），一个紧凑卷积编码器（0.41M参数）：按每个超像素的原生形状与范围进行处理，并在所有操作中排除背景，从而在构造上使嵌入对填充严格不变。实验采用相同掩码与相同图分类器进行对比，并设置消融：保留TAN架构但改用标准填充裁剪处理。

Result: 在BACH上，TAN精度（81.1%）与303M参数的UNI（80.7-82.6%，随填充变化）无显著差异，同时参数少约740倍、FLOPs少约1190倍且无预训练。在BRACS上，TAN接近同协议训练的ResNet18，但落后于组织病理基础模型。消融显示：填充裁剪版本精度相近（BACH名义上更高、BRACS更低，均在噪声范围内），但TAN的掩码处理FLOPs不到其一半。

Conclusion: 消除背景填充泄漏可使紧凑的原生形状编码器以极小计算代价达到大模型相当的精度，并从根本上消除填充敏感性；但在更复杂数据集上仍不及领域基础模型，提示紧凑编码的能力边界。

Abstract: Tissue graphs represent histology images as graphs over tissue-conforming superpixels, which keeps homogeneous tissue regions intact instead of cutting them into rectangular patches. To embed superpixels, current encoders crop them to bounding boxes and then pad, resize, or mask them, so background or fill values can leak into the node features. This matters in practice, and especially in medical imaging, where a prediction should depend on the tissue and not on an arbitrary preprocessing choice: on BACH, changing only the fill of the masked region shifts the accuracy of frozen encoders by up to 6 percentage points, larger than the differences among the four best encoders under mean fill, and the preferred fill differs between datasets, so it cannot be fixed once and for all. We present TAN (Tissue-Aware Network), a compact convolutional encoder (0.41M parameters) that processes each superpixel at its native shape and extent and excludes background from every operation, which makes its embeddings exactly invariant to the fill by construction. Under identical masks and an identical graph classifier, TAN's accuracy on BACH is not significantly different from that of the 303M-parameter foundation model UNI (81.1% vs. 80.7-82.6%, depending on the fill), with ~740x fewer parameters, ~1,190x fewer FLOPs, and no pretraining. On BRACS, TAN is close to a ResNet18 trained under the same protocol and trails the histopathology foundation models. An ablation with TAN's architecture but standard processing of fill-padded crops shows that masking keeps accuracy similar (nominally higher on BACH, lower on BRACS, within noise) at less than half the FLOPs.

</details>


### [74] [PONDER: Learning to Generate in the Right Order](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23531)
*Julius Erbach,Dominik Narnhofer,Bernt Schiele,Jan Eric Lenssen,Konrad Schindler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PONDER 学习掩码生成模型的内容填充顺序与"重思考"（重新掩码早期预测）策略，用组相对策略梯度以约束满足/人类偏好/分布质量（FIDgrad）为奖励优化，冻结生成器即可显著提升生成质量与推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 掩码生成模型通过反复填充缺失变量构造样本，填充顺序决定后续步骤可用的上下文，进而影响最终样本质量。现有策略仅用随机顺序或局部置信度贪心选择，无法适应演化中的上下文，也不能修正早期错误预测。

Method: 提出 PONDER：以部分生成样本与生成器特征为条件，学习策略选择下一步填充的位置，和/或对已填充位置重新掩码以便后续重生成（rethinking）。用组相对策略梯度（GRPO）优化，奖励包括约束满足、人类偏好与分布质量；后者引入 FIDgrad——基于加入生成样本后 Fréchet Inception Distance 一阶变化得到的图像级奖励。生成器保持冻结。

Result: 在 MAR-B ImageNet 上 FID 从 4.09 降至 2.78；困难视觉数独准确率从 3.9% 升至 56.6%，超过基于不确定性的贪心顺序（38.7%）。加入 rethinking 后进一步提升至 FID 2.70、准确率 96.7%；推理时增大固定策略的 rethinking 预算可带来持续改进。

Conclusion: 生成顺序与早期预测的修正是可学习且高收益的要素，无需微调生成器即可通过策略优化显著提升样本质量与任务准确率；学习到的重思考预算在推理阶段具备可扩展性。

Abstract: We introduce PONDER, a method that learns in which order an image generator should fill in content and which of its earlier predictions to revise. Masked generative models construct a sample by repeatedly filling in subsets of missing variables. The order of these partial predictions determines the context available in subsequent steps and therefore affects the quality of the final sample. Common strategies are to choose the order randomly or based on local confidence estimates. Conditioned on the partially generated sample and the generator's features, our policy chooses which positions to fill next and/or which previously filled positions to mask for later regeneration, a mechanism we call rethinking. In this way, the generation process is able to adapt to the evolving context and also to revise earlier predictions. We optimize the policy using group-relative policy gradients, with rewards that measure constraint satisfaction, human preference, or distribution quality. For the latter, we introduce FIDgrad, an image-level reward derived from the (first-order) change in Fréchet Inception Distance caused by adding a generated sample to the current feature distribution. With the generators frozen, learned ordering reduces MAR-B ImageNet FID from 4.09 to 2.78 and raises the accuracy on hard visual Sudokus from 3.9\% to 56.6\%, surpassing uncertainty-based greedy ordering (38.7\%). Rethinking further improves these results to 2.70 FID and 96.7\% accuracy, while increasing the rethinking budget of a fixed policy yields continued improvements at inference time.

</details>


### [75] [ReVision: Reprogramming Image Generators for Dense Visual Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23533)
*Yitong Yang,Yinglin Wang,Xuexin Liu,Wei Chen,Zhaoyang Xu,Jiaxin Lin,Rui Chen,Shuting He,Kai Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReVision：以指令为条件的参数生成框架，基于冻结的多模态理解模型与冻结图像生成器，将图像-指令表示映射为生成器的瞬态低秩更新，实现实例级多任务密集感知。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有将多任务编码进共享参数化的做法对异构数据混合比例与权重敏感，易产生跨任务干扰（梯度冲突），且需要任务头/任务标识/存储适配器。

Method: 冻结多模态理解模型 + 冻结图像生成器；理解模型联合编码图像与自由形式指令为多模态表示，可训练参数生成器将其映射为生成器的瞬态低秩更新；每个图像-指令对产生独立预测参数，骨干不变；共享 RGB 输出接口统一分割、深度、表面法线。

Result: 在多个密集预测基准上达到与SOTA相当的性能；支持自然语言灵活指定任务；分析显示跨任务存在显著梯度不一致（梯度分歧），而生成的更新在权重空间中呈现结构化的任务与输入依赖组织。

Conclusion: 实例级参数生成为多任务密集感知提供有效替代方案，避免共享参数化带来的任务冲突；无需任务专用头、显式任务ID或存储适配器，并验证了瞬态更新在权重空间的结构性。

Abstract: Recent image generators exhibit rich visual priors that can support dense visual perception. However, existing approaches typically encode multiple perception tasks into a shared parameterization, making joint training sensitive to the mixture and weighting of heterogeneous data and prone to cross-task interference. To address this issue, we introduce ReVision, an instruction-conditioned parameter generation framework built on a frozen multimodal understanding model and a frozen image generator. Given an image and a free-form instruction, the understanding model jointly encodes them into a multimodal image--instruction representation, which a trainable parameter generator maps to transient low-rank updates for the generator. Each image--instruction pair induces a distinct set of transient prediction parameters, enabling instance-specific adaptation while both pretrained backbones remain unchanged. ReVision requires no task-specific heads, explicit task identifiers, or stored adapters. A shared RGB output interface unifies segmentation, depth estimation, and surface-normal prediction. Across diverse dense prediction benchmarks, ReVision achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art methods while supporting flexible task specification through natural-language instructions. Our analysis further reveals substantial gradient disagreement across tasks, highlighting the conflict introduced when heterogeneous objectives share a single parameterization. Meanwhile, the generated updates exhibit structured task- and input-dependent organization in weight space, further validating instance-level parameter generation for multi-task perception.

</details>


### [76] [PreciseEdit: Strong Yet Stable Semantic Transport for One-Step Image Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23535)
*Jingyi Wang,Xiao Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 PreciseEdit，一个模型无关、免训练、免反演的一步式文本引导图像编辑框架，通过双噪声尺度角色分解在"方向可靠"与"位置可靠"处施加强语义传输，兼顾编辑强度与结构/背景保真。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有一步式编辑方法通过条件预测间的简单向量运算构造全局传输场。强传输虽能驱动语义变化，却可能沿不可靠方向或在非编辑区域释放，导致编辑区结构畸变与背景漂移；而全局平滑或均匀削弱传输场的稳定化手段又使大语义变化过于保守。作者由此从"语义强度 vs 传输稳定性"的张力重新审视一步式编辑。

Method: 核心洞察：强语义传输本身并非不稳定，关键在于传输是否施加于可靠方向与可靠空间位置。据此设计模型无关、免训练、免反演的一步式编辑框架 PreciseEdit；并提出双噪声尺度角色分解策略——高噪声尺度产生用于实际编辑的强目标导向传输，低噪声尺度则联合作为方向一致性探针与空间结构参考。

Result: 在 PIE-Bench 上开展大量实验，PreciseEdit 取得当前最优性能，并在多种编辑任务上验证了有效性。

Conclusion: 通过将语义强度与传输稳定性解耦，并以双噪声尺度分别承担"强传输"与"可靠性探针"角色，可在不削弱编辑幅度的前提下保持背景保真与结构一致，为一步式 Web 交互式图像编辑提供了通用、无需训练与反演的解决方案。

Abstract: Recent one-step text-to-image (T2I) models enable efficient image synthesis, opening up new possibilities for interactive Web-based image editing. However, existing one-step editing methods often construct a global transport field through simple vector operations between conditional predictions. While such strong transport can effectively drive the image toward the target semantics, it may be released along unreliable directions or over non-edited regions, leading to structural distortions within the editing region and background drift elsewhere. More importantly, stabilizing the editing process through global smoothing or uniformly weakening the transport field often makes large semantic changes overly conservative. In this work, we revisit one-step image editing from the perspective of the tension between semantic strength and transport stability, and identify a key insight: strong semantic transport is not inherently unstable. What matters is whether it is applied along reliable directions and at reliable spatial locations. Motivated by this insight, we introduce PreciseEdit, a model-agnostic, training-free and inversion-free one-step editing framework that strengthens target-semantic alignment while preserving background fidelity and structural consistency. We further propose a dual-noise-scale role decomposition strategy: a higher-noise scale produces the strong target-directed transport used for actual editing, whereas a lower-noise scale jointly serves as a probe for directional agreement and spatial structure. Extensive experiments on PIE-Bench demonstrate that PreciseEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance and effectiveness on various editing tasks.

</details>


### [77] [PanoBench: A Panoptic Occupancy Prediction Benchmark for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23537)
*Yi Feng,Zizhan Guo,Junwu E,Yu Ma,Mengtan Zhang,Jin Wu,Wei Ye,Hanli Wang,Qijun Chen,Danwei Wang,Rui Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出PanoBench——面向相机的全景占据预测基准，整合CarlaOcc、nuScenes、KITTI360三类数据，提供多分辨率、具有持久实例身份的全景标注，并建立统一评估协议与基线分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全景占据统一了3D几何、语义与实例身份，但受限于实例级标注稀缺：现有基准多为从不完整传感器观测重建的语义标签，而全景数据集存在域覆盖有限或标注完整性不足的问题。

Method: 构建跨合成与真实驾驶场景的基准，通过规范化数据接口和统一评估协议整合PanoBench-CarlaOcc、PanoBench-nuScenes、PanoBench-KITTI360；合成分支由仿真网格导出完整全景几何；真实数据采用新流程：基于几何先验与拓扑约束重建背景，由多帧多视图图像生成前景网格资产，再融合为稀疏全景体素；采用统一有效掩码协议，对由时序观测支持的前景实例整体评估，对背景区域按体素级评分。

Result: 在观测保真度、几何完整性、空间连续性与时序一致性上的分析表明标注优于现有占据基准；在语义占据、全景占据与4D占据预测上评测代表性方法，并研究体素分辨率、合成到真实迁移与存储效率；结果显示体素与射线类指标互补，真实场景实例级预测仍具挑战。

Conclusion: PanoBench为实例感知全景占据预测提供统一、高完整度的标注与评估平台，揭示体素与射线指标的互补性及真实域实例级预测的持久难题，推动该方向标准化研究。

Abstract: Panoptic occupancy unifies 3D geometry, semantics, and instance identities, but its development is limited by scarce instance-aware annotations. Existing benchmarks mainly provide semantic labels reconstructed from incomplete sensor observations, while panoptic datasets have limited domain coverage or annotation completeness. We introduce PanoBench, a camera-centric panoptic occupancy prediction benchmark spanning synthetic and real-world driving scenes. It combines PanoBench-CarlaOcc, PanoBench-nuScenes, and PanoBench-KITTI360 through canonical data interfaces and unified evaluation protocols, providing multi-resolution annotations with persistent instance identities. The synthetic branch derives complete panoptic geometry from simulated meshes. For real-world data, a new pipeline reconstructs backgrounds using geometric priors and topology constraints, generates foreground mesh assets from multi-frame multi-view images, and fuses them into sparse panoptic voxels. A unified valid-mask protocol evaluates complete thing instances supported by temporal observations while scoring stuff regions at the voxel level. Analyses of observation fidelity, geometric completeness, spatial continuity, and temporal consistency demonstrate the benefits of the resulting annotations over existing occupancy benchmarks. We benchmark representative methods on semantic occupancy prediction, panoptic occupancy prediction, and 4D occupancy forecasting, and study voxel resolution, synthetic-to-real transfer, and storage efficiency. These results reveal complementary strengths of volumetric and ray-based metrics and persistent challenges in real-world instance-aware prediction. PanoBench is available at https://mias.group/PanoBench.

</details>


### [78] [Execution Before Memory: Diagnosing Memory Failures in Video World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23542)
*Weiyang Jin,Jiwen Yu,Sihan Xu,Yuwei Niu,Xihui Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出MIST评测，将“变更是否执行”与“记忆是否保留”解耦；发现瓶颈在于模型能布景却不执行指令变更，进而提出M3-Agent递归改写指令细节以补足执行，MIST揭示分提升三倍以上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频世界模型记忆测试把“是否布景、是否执行变更、末帧是否呈现结果”压缩成单一分数，低分易被误读为遗忘；若变更根本未执行，隐状态转移无法出现，测试实际未检验记忆。

Method: MIST评测：先在变更隐藏的情况下让模型布景，之后再要求其呈现该变更，并控制此前信息泄漏；以此将变更执行与记忆分离。基于定位到的瓶颈，提出M3-Agent（Make the Missing Move），递归修订输入指令的细节，使模型成功执行所要求的变更。

Result: 相对基线，MIST揭示分提升逾三倍；WRBench的T分提升26.1%，MBench-T的U分提升52.7%。

Conclusion: 该方法从执行侧切入：证明冻结模型在指令明确后能完成变更，并为记忆评测设立了更严格的基线。

Abstract: A memory test for a video world model should say whether the scene was set, whether the asked change was carried out, and whether the last frame shows the result. Current tests fold these into one number, so a low score is easy to read as forgetting. When the change is not carried out, the hidden state transition cannot appear, so the test is not really a test of memory. We introduce MIST, an evaluation that separates the change from the memory it should leave behind. The model first sets the scene while the change stays hidden, and only later is asked to show it, with leakage before that point kept under control. This separation locates the bottleneck: the model sets the scene but does not carry out the instructed change. The same gap appears in general memory evaluations. On that basis we propose M3-Agent (Make the Missing Move), which recursively revises the details of the input instruction so that the model successfully carries out the requested instruction. Relative to the baseline, it more than triples the MIST reveal score. On the benchmarks, WRBench's score T rises by 26.1% and MBench-T's score U by 52.7%. The method meets the problem from the execution side: it shows what the frozen model can do once the move is stated, and it sets a stricter baseline.

</details>


### [79] [LiveSync: Iterative Self-Training for Lip-Sync Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23558)
*Huaishao Luo,Huan Zhang,Guanbo Bao,Yinglu Liu,Youzheng Wu,Xiaodong He*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LiveSync：基于掩码单模型迭代自训练的音频驱动唇同步框架，用模型自生成伪配对并混合真实数据精炼，在不增加推理阶段的前提下取得领先同步性能与低延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然视频虽有同步重建目标，但很难提供"身份与姿态一致、仅语音相关口颌动作不同"的配对；掩码式训练可绕开该问题，然而训练时的随机参考输入与推理时对齐的自参考存在分布差异。

Method: 单模型掩码式迭代自训练：先在精选真实视频语料（并补充外部生成片段以覆盖欠代表性视觉条件）上训练；再用冻结权重以独立采样音频从真实帧生成口部编辑参考（掩码外像素直接复制源帧）；经置信度过滤后与对齐的掩码输入及原始真实帧目标组成伪配对；将保留的伪配对与真实数据混合，从当前权重继续精炼同一模型。

Result: 在HDTF上取得领先的同步性能；在AIGC-LipSync子集上相比基线具备竞争力；同时保持较低推理延迟。

Conclusion: 自训练可在不引入额外推理阶段、不改变推理流程的前提下改善监督信号并缩小训练-推理差距；框架原则上可推广至基于扩散的模型。

Abstract: Audio-driven lip synchronization aims to match target speech through localized mouth and jaw articulation while preserving subject identity, head pose, and surrounding facial context. Naturally recorded videos provide synchronized reconstruction targets but rarely offer pairs that are matched in identity and pose yet differ primarily in speech-related articulation. Mask-based training enables reconstruction from these videos, but random-reference inputs differ from the aligned self-reference used at inference. We present LiveSync, an iterative self-training framework in which a single mask-based model generates pseudo pairs and is refined for deployment. The model is first trained on a curated real-video corpus augmented with externally generated clips covering under-represented visual conditions. A frozen checkpoint then uses independently sampled audio to generate mouth-edited references from real-video frames, copying pixels outside the edit mask from each source frame. After confidence filtering, these references are paired with aligned masked inputs and original real-frame targets. The retained pseudo pairs are mixed with real training data to refine the same model from its current weights, updating training supervision without adding inference stages. Although we instantiate the framework with a single-pass GAN-based model, the self-training strategy could in principle also be adapted to diffusion-based models. Experimental results show that LiveSync achieves leading synchronization performance on HDTF and competitive performance compared with the baselines on the AIGC-LipSync subset, while maintaining low inference latency.

</details>


### [80] [From Adult Renal Masses to Pediatric Wilms Tumors: Evaluating Cross-Domain Generalization of Kidney Lesion Segmentation on MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23568)
*Sarah de Boer,Myrthe A. D. Buser,Hartmut Häntze,Jawed Nawabi,Lisa C. Adams,Alida F. W. van der Steeg,Marry M. van den Heuvel-Eibrink,Annemieke S. Littooij,Keno K. Bressem,Mathias Prokop,Alessa Hering*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 成人肾肿瘤MRI训练的深度学习分割模型在小儿Wilms瘤上取得中位DSC 0.85，接近儿科专用nnU-Net的0.90，但未达非劣效，凸显儿科训练数据的价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿科肿瘤分割模型通常受限于小型单中心队列，而成人类别（如肾癌）拥有大规模数据集。核心问题是：在成人肾病灶上训练的模型能否泛化到儿科Wilms瘤尚不明确。

Method: 在单序列T1或T2加权成人肾脏MRI上训练分割模型，并在留出的成人测试集与儿科Wilms瘤队列上评估，与儿科专用nnU-Net对比；采用Dice相似系数（DSC）和第95百分位Hausdorff距离量化性能。

Result: 成人测试集中位DSC为0.86；儿科队列中成人训练模型中位DSC为0.85，儿科专用模型为0.90。

Conclusion: 尽管年龄、解剖与肿瘤类型存在差异，成人训练模型在儿科Wilms瘤上表现良好，与专用模型中位DSC差距不大，但未能证明非劣效，说明儿科训练数据仍具价值；未来可探索微调策略。

Abstract: Deep learning segmentation models for pediatric oncology are often trained on small, single-center cohorts, whereas much larger datasets exist for adult diseases, such as kidney cancer. Whether models trained on adult renal lesions generalize to pediatric Wilms tumors remains unclear. We trained a segmentation model on single-sequence T1- or T2-weighted adult kidney MRI and evaluated it on a held-out adult test set and a pediatric Wilms tumor cohort, where it was compared with a pediatric-specific nnU-Net. Segmentation performance was quantified using the Dice similarity coefficient (DSC) and 95th-percentile Hausdorff distance. On the adult test set, the model achieved a median DSC of 0.86 for renal lesions. On the pediatric cohort, the adult-trained model achieved a median DSC of 0.85 compared with 0.90 for the pediatric-specific model. Despite differences in age, anatomy, and tumor type, the adult-trained model showed promising performance on pediatric Wilms tumors, with only a modest difference in median DSC compared with the pediatric-specific model. However, non-inferiority could not be shown, highlighting the value of pediatric training data. In future work, a fine-tuning strategy could be explored.

</details>


### [81] [CLEAR: Cooperative Latent Flow for Visual Counterfactual Explanations with Accurate Region Preservation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23577)
*Yan Zeng,Changlu Guo,Oskar Kristoffersen,Anders Nymark Christensen,Morten Rieger Hannemose,Anders Bjorholm Dahl*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出潜空间 Flow Matching 框架 CLEAR，通过分解并选择性衰减分类器引导中的冲突分量、并动态约束可编辑区域，在保持潜空间效率的同时实现媲美图像空间方法的反事实解释质量，较最强基线提速 2.5 倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉反事实解释中，图像空间方法质量高但计算昂贵，潜空间方法高效但保真度较差。作者将这一差距归因于两点：其一，潜空间生成试图从扰动表示恢复自然样本，而分类器引导却把样本推向目标类，两者更新方向可能相反；其二，VAE 重建会改变本应保持不变的区域。

Method: 提出 CLEAR：基于 Flow Matching 的潜空间 VCE 框架。利用 Flow Matching 显式的瞬时速度作为生成方向参考，将分类器引导分解为协同分量与冲突分量，保留协同分量、并按冲突强度自适应仅衰减冲突分量；同时分析生成全过程中冲突的频率与强度，以刻画引导与生成过程的交互。此外动态识别可编辑区域，约束潜变量修改，并直接保留区域外的事实内容以抑制 VAE 引起的改动。

Result: 在两个数据集、五个双向任务上，CLEAR 保持潜空间效率，反事实质量与强图像空间基线相当或更优，相比最强基线获得 2.5 倍加速。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模并调和分类器引导与生成方向的冲突、并限制潜空间改动范围，可在潜空间框架下兼顾效率与反事实保真度，为 VCE 提供了一种高效且高质量的方案。

Abstract: Visual counterfactual explanations (VCEs) should alter a classifier's prediction while remaining realistic and preserving decision-irrelevant content. Image-space methods provide high-quality counterfactuals but are computationally costly, whereas latent-space methods are more efficient but often less faithful. We identify two sources responsible for this gap. First, latent generation recovers a natural sample from a perturbed representation, whereas classifier guidance pushes it toward a target class, so their update directions may oppose. Second, VAE reconstruction can alter regions that should remain unchanged. We introduce CLEAR, a latent Flow Matching framework for VCEs. CLEAR uses Flow Matching's explicit instantaneous velocity as a reference for the generative direction to decompose classifier guidance into cooperative and conflicting components. It preserves the cooperative component and adaptively attenuates only the conflicting one according to conflict strength. We further analyze conflict frequency and strength throughout generation to reveal how classifier guidance interacts with the generative process. CLEAR also dynamically identifies editable regions, constrains latent modifications, and directly preserves factual content outside them to reduce VAE-induced changes. Across five bidirectional tasks on two datasets, CLEAR retains latent-space efficiency while achieving counterfactual quality comparable to or better than strong image-space baselines, with a 2.5x speedup over the strongest baseline. Project page: https://yan-zen9.github.io/CLEAR/

</details>


### [82] [Enhancing RAG-based Medical VQA with Gated Multimodal Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23588)
*Daniela Jimenez-Pano,Hugo Jair Escalante,Delia Irazú Hernández-Farías*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种多模态RAG框架，通过门控多模态单元学习图像与问题的联合查询表示以提升医学VQA的证据检索效果，Med-LVLM保持冻结。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医学视觉语言模型（Med-LVLM）在医学视觉问答（MVQA）中表现良好，但仍会产生事实不一致的回答；现有RAG的检索通常由单一模态引导，忽略了医学图像与临床问题的联合语义。

Method: 构建多模态RAG框架：利用Gated Multimodal Unit将图像与问题融合为联合查询表示，用于证据检索，底层Med-LVLM参数保持不变。

Result: 在基准数据集上评估，多模态查询表示持续优于参考Med-LVLM，并与当前最优方法具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 多模态查询表示可提升医学VQA中证据检索的有效性，具有应用潜力。

Abstract: Medical Vision-Language Models (Med-LVLMs) have shown strong performance in Medical Visual Question Answering (MVQA), yet they may still produce factually inconsistent responses. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can mitigate this issue by incorporating external clinical evidence; however, retrieval is often guided by a single modality, potentially overlooking the joint semantics of medical images and clinical questions. We introduce a multimodal RAG framework that learns a joint query representation through a Gated Multimodal Unit, enabling evidence retrieval to leverage information from both modalities while keeping the underlying Med-LVLM frozen. We evaluate the proposed approach on benchmark datasets. Results show that the multimodal query representation consistently outperforms a reference Med-LVLM and remains competitive with state-of-the-art methods. Our findings demonstrate the potential of multimodal query representations for more effective evidence retrieval in Medical VQA.

</details>


### [83] [SemPurify: Semantics-Aware Data Purification for Black-box Backdoor Defense](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23589)
*Jiawei Yu,Syed Irfan Ali Meerza,Yi Wu,Amir Sadovnik,Jian Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出首个语义感知的数据净化框架 SemPurify，融合低层语义嵌入与高层图像标签，在文本到图像（T2I）框架中引导黑盒后门防御的图像恢复，兼顾后门去除与语义保持。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于净化的后门防御依赖图像变换（如模糊）破坏触发器，但会损害图像质量；即便借助扩散模型等先进修复技术，仍可能改变视觉或语义信息，降低下游任务效用。亟需在净化过程中显式保留语义信息。

Method: SemPurify 将多级语义信息——低层语义嵌入与高层图像标签——显式注入 T2I 框架：先对样本施加变换以破坏触发器，再利用语义引导的 T2I 模型对变换后样本进行细化恢复，从而在修复过程中保持视觉细节与语义一致性。该框架面向黑盒场景，无需访问模型内部。

Result: 在分类模型、CLIP 风格编码器和生成模型等多种后门场景下的广泛实验表明，SemPurify 能可靠移除后门，同时有效保留面向下游任务的语义信息。

Conclusion: 语义感知引导可为黑盒后门数据净化提供一种兼顾安全性与实用性的方案，克服传统变换与修复方法在图像质量与语义保真上的不足；后续可进一步探索多级语义表示的粒度设计与更广泛威胁模型下的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Backdoor attacks have emerged as a critical security threat in machine learning, where adversaries embed triggers within poisoned training samples to manipulate a model's predictions on targeted inputs while leaving its general behavior unaffected. This stealthy nature makes backdoor attacks difficult to detect, as the model functions normally until activated by a specific malicious trigger. Current purification-based defenses use image transformations (e.g., blurring) to disrupt trigger patterns but often degrade image quality. Even with advanced restoration techniques like diffusion models, these approaches can still alter visual or semantic information, reducing utility for downstream tasks. To address this, we propose the first semantics-aware data purification framework for black-box backdoor defense, SemPurify, which explicitly incorporates multi-level semantics (i.e., low-level semantic embeddings and high-level image tags) within a text-to-image (T2I) framework to guide image restoration during purification. Using this semantic information, the T2I model subsequently refines the transformed samples, helping preserve visual details and semantic information during restoration. Extensive experiments spanning multiple backdoor scenarios, i.e., classification models, CLIP-style encoders, and generative models, demonstrate that SemPurify reliably removes backdoors while effectively preserving semantic information for downstream tasks.

</details>


### [84] [Learning to Discriminate Scene Structures Makes Self-Supervised Depth Learning Scalable](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23600)
*Mengtan Zhang,Yuchuan Cui,Yu Ma,Zizhan Guo,Wei Ye,Rui Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MaSS通过将结构表征路径与上下文特征解耦，并引入场景-结构判别目标，使自监督单目深度估计能从多域混合数据中稳定受益，并具备强跨域泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自监督单目深度估计有望利用无标注数据扩展，但现有方法在多样场景上训练时性能退化。作者发现其根源在于：自监督条件下模型倾向于编码数据集特定的结构偏置，而非可迁移的场景几何，从而引发跨域优化冲突。

Method: 提出MaSS框架：设计一条专门的结构表征通路，显式与上下文特征解耦；并以新颖的“场景-结构判别”目标进行引导，学习泛化性、布局感知的结构表征用于深度解码。在四个多样数据集上分别及联合训练与评测。

Result: MaSS显著优于既有自监督方法，且是首个能持续从混合域训练中获益的方法；在另外八个数据集上的零样本评测显示出显著泛化性，尤其在完全分布外的场景上表现突出。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 将结构表征与上下文解耦是缓解自监督深度学习中跨域优化冲突的有效途径，MaSS验证了自监督深度学习的可扩展性，即多域数据规模扩展可带来一致收益。

Abstract: Self-supervised monocular depth estimation is appealing for its potential to scale with unlabeled data, yet existing methods often degrade when trained on diverse scenes. This study finds that, under self-supervision, models tend to encode dataset-specific structural biases rather than transferable scene geometry, leading to cross-domain optimization conflicts. To address this issue, this study proposes the MaSS framework, aiming to make self-supervised depth learning scalable to diverse data. MaSS introduces a dedicated structural representation pathway explicitly decoupled from contextual features, which is guided by a novel scene-structure discrimination objective to learn generalized, layout-aware structural representations for depth decoding. Trained and evaluated on four diverse datasets, both individually and jointly, MaSS substantially outperforms prior self-supervised methods and is the first to consistently benefit from mixed-domain training. Zero-shot evaluation on eight additional datasets further demonstrates its remarkable generalizability, particularly on those entirely out-of-distribution scenes. The source code is publicly available at https://mias.group/MaSS.

</details>


### [85] [ADA 2025: A Multimodal Dataset for Water-Deficit Stress Detection in Sugar Beets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23609)
*Piper Powell,Robert Franz,Amos Smith,Isaak Ihorst,Joachim Hertzberg,Martin Atzmueller*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文公开发布 ADA 2025，一个超过 500 GB 的多模态作物数据集，涵盖健康与水分亏缺条件下的幼年甜菜植株，融合热成像、高光谱、RGB 与深度图像，并提供环境/元数据及相对含水量（RWC）和叶片厚度两类真值，用于支撑 AI/ML 作物管理研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI/ML 在作物管理中的应用受限于缺乏合适的公开数据集：病害与虫害检测数据相对充足，而水分亏缺胁迫检测等任务几乎无公开数据；现有数据集多为单模态（常仅 RGB），难以支撑多模态方法与早期检测，且缺少精确元数据、植株数量偏少、采样间隔较大。

Method: 构建并公开 ADA 2025 数据集：对幼年甜菜植株在健康与水分亏缺两种条件下采集热成像、高光谱、RGB、深度四类影像，并同步记录相关环境信息与元数据，同时采集相对含水量（RWC）与叶片厚度作为两类地面真值；数据规模超过 500 GB，并注重较高植株数量与较小采样间隔。

Result: 示例性实验结果验证了数据集的有效性，即能够检测出胁迫植株与健康植株之间可区分的差异。

Conclusion: ADA 2025 填补了水分亏缺胁迫检测领域公开多模态数据集的空白，为多模态、早期胁迫检测及相关 AI/ML 作物管理研究提供基础数据支撑。

Abstract: Research and development into artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) applications in crop management are hindered by a lack of suitable public datasets. Whereas applications in disease and pest detection benefit from a comparatively higher amount of available data, applications like water-deficit stress detection often have very few if any public datasets available. Moreover, most datasets that are available are single-modality and frequently RGB-only, leaving the early detection and enhanced performance offered by other methods, and particularly by multimodal approaches, out of reach. Datasets with accurate metadata, higher numbers of plants, and smaller intervals between data points are also scarce. To address this, we publicly release ADA 2025, a >500 GB comprehensive multimodal dataset of young sugar beet plants under healthy and water-deficit conditions combining thermal, hyperspectral, RGB, and depth imagery along with relevant environmental and metadata and both relative water content (RWC) and leaf thickness as ground truth sources. Exemplary results showcase the dataset's validity in terms of differences detectable between stressed and healthy plants.

</details>


### [86] [Not Every Mention Is a Claim: Rethinking Object Hallucination Detection in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23610)
*Hsin-Ling Hsu,Neeraja Kirtane,Kuan-Hao Huang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出 NAME-Bench,区分"提及物体"与"断言物体存在",指出当前幻觉检测器将非断言性提及误判为幻觉,并揭示该混淆在新模型上难以纠正。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型(VLM)物体幻觉评测将字幕中每个物体提及都视为"物体存在"的断言,忽略了如"a bench for people to sit on"这类仅提及而未断言的表达(非断言性提及)。把这类提及当作幻觉会高估使用该语言的模型的错误率,因此需要将其与真实幻觉分离。

Method: 构建 NAME-Bench(Non-Assertive Mention Evaluation Benchmark),包含 5 个 VLM 为 COCO 图像生成的 25,497 条物体提及。每条提及标注为 concrete(断言且存在)、hallucinated(断言但不存在)或 non-assertive,非断言性提及进一步细分为 depictive、purpose、negation、hedged 四种子类型。基于该基准评估现有幻觉检测器,并尝试将非断言性提及作为负样本加入训练。

Result: 所有被评估的幻觉检测器都会将非断言性提及标记为幻觉,误判率在 14%–80% 之间。将非断言性提及作为负样本加入训练,在 LLaVA-1.5 上基本可纠正该问题;而在四个较新的 VLM 上,达到相近纠正效果需要 5–10 倍数据,且检测器随后捕获真实幻觉的能力下降。

Conclusion: 当前检测器混淆了"提及物体"与"断言物体存在",且该混淆在四个较新 VLM 上比 LLaVA-1.5 更难消除。幻觉评测应区分字幕所断言的内容与仅提及的内容。

Abstract: Object hallucination in vision-language models (VLMs) is usually measured by checking each object a caption names against the image. Most benchmarks and detectors alike treat every object mention as a claim that the object is present. This assumption fails when a caption names an object without asserting it, as in "a bench for people to sit on", which mentions people without claiming that any are in the image. We call such mentions non-assertive. Treating them as hallucinations inflates the error rates attributed to models that use such language. To separate them from real hallucinations, we introduce NAME-Bench (Non-Assertive Mention Evaluation Benchmark), 25,497 object mentions from captions that five VLMs generate for COCO images. Each mention is labelled concrete (asserted and present), hallucinated (asserted and absent), or non-assertive, and non-assertive mentions are further divided into four subtypes: depictive, purpose, negation and hedged. All the hallucination detectors that we evaluate flag non-assertive mentions as hallucinations, at rates between 14% and 80%. Adding non-assertive mentions to detector training as negatives largely corrects this on LLaVA-1.5. On the four newer VLMs, a comparable correction takes five to ten times more data, and the detectors then catch fewer real hallucinations. These findings show that current detectors conflate mentioning an object with asserting it, and that this conflation is harder to undo on the four newer VLMs than on LLaVA-1.5. Hallucination evaluation should therefore separate what a caption asserts from what it merely mentions.

</details>


### [87] [Stereo LWIR-RGB Automatic Labeling for Low-Light Camera-Based VRU Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23621)
*Dimitrios Bouzoulas,Pyry Jäppinen,Pejman Habibiroudkenar,Eerik Alamikkotervo,Risto Ojala*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于LWIR-RGB立体相机的低光照VRU自动标注流水线，以LWIR检测结果为标签源，无需复杂对齐硬件，生成的标签训练的模型优于现成基线及手标子集微调模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低光照条件下VRU（弱势道路使用者）检测对交通安全至关重要，但缺乏大规模数据集与自动标注方法；现有自动标注多以RGB检测为标签源，无法在低光照下复现，且此前工作依赖复杂硬件实现模态对齐，成本高、难以复现。

Method: 采用LWIR-RGB图像对，利用VRU体温与背景的差异从LWIR获取标签，构建自动化低光照VRU标注流水线；改用LWIR-RGB立体（stereo）装置替代此前的复杂对齐硬件，降低硬件复杂度与成本；在芬兰首都地区采集的数据集上端到端评估，并使用两种不同LWIR检测器验证。

Result: 在人工标注数据集上测试，使用生成标签训练的模型在F1、mAP@50和LAMR指标上均优于现成（off-the-shelf）基线和在手标子集上微调的模型，且该结论在两种LWIR检测器下均成立。

Conclusion: 低光照VRU自动标注无需专用对齐硬件即可实现，兼具可及性与有效性，为低光照检测的大规模数据构建提供了可复现方案。

Abstract: VRU detection in low-light conditions is a key component in ensuring VRU safety during the most collision prone time of the day. Currently, advances in low-light detection are limited due to the lack of large scale datasets and automated labeling methods. Most autolabeling methods use RGB detections as their labels source, which cannot be replicated in low-light conditions. To fill this gap in this paper we present an automated pipeline for low-light VRU labeling. We use LWIR-RGB image pairs and source our labels from LWIR as VRUs differentiate from the background due to their body temperature. Unlike our previous work that relied on a complex hardware setup to align the two modalities, we perform this experiment using a LWIR-RGB stereo setup, lowering hardware complexity and cost, making the pipeline easier to reproduce. We evaluate method end-to-end on a dataset collected in the capital region of Finland. Models trained on our generated labels beat both off-the-shelf baselines and models fine tuned on a hand labeled subset on F1, mAP@50 and LAMR metrics when tested on a manually labeled dataset, and the result holds for two different LWIR detectors. This shows that low-light VRU autolabeling can be made both accessible and effective without specialized alignment hardware.

</details>


### [88] [Diversity Without Labels: Task-Agnostic Coreset Selection Across Perception and Action](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23642)
*Julia Hindel,Benjamin Ramtoula,Kyuhwan Yeon,Nick Heppert,Paul Newman,Daniele De Martini,Abhinav Valada*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CoreDNA：基于视觉基础模型神经元激活分布的无监督、任务无关coreset估计方法


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从大规模数据集中筛选高质量子集（coreset）用于训练十分困难；现有方法依赖代理模型训练、大量标注或任务定制，无监督方法则局限于成对图像比较或与固定子集比较，缺乏全局与多层信息。

Method: 将视觉基础模型各层神经元激活汇总为每张图像与数据集级别的分布，通过比较图像分布与数据集分布同时捕获低层视觉结构与高层语义；发现高质量样本集中于最后一层激活统计的尾部，并据此设计计算高效的选择机制，构建任务无关的高质量coreset，用于选择性标注与模型训练。

Result: 在图像分类、语义分割、深度估计，以及端到端驾驶与移动操作的模仿学习任务上，CoreDNA达到或超越当前最优水平，展现出跨感知与动作任务的前所未有的泛化能力；并验证了其尾部统计特性与基于训练的coreset方法之间的关联。

Conclusion: 紧凑的激活分布表征对数据选择高效有效，CoreDNA为无监督、任务无关的数据筛选提供了通用且可扩展的方案。

Abstract: While data collection for model training is relatively easy, curating high-quality datasets from large collections is inherently challenging. Coreset estimation methods address this problem by identifying the best data subsets to train models on. However, existing approaches often require proxy model training, extensive annotations, or task-specific tailoring. Unsupervised alternatives typically exploit geometric properties in foundation model feature spaces, but are limited to pairwise image-to-image comparisons or comparisons against a fixed subset. We introduce CoreDNA, an unsupervised, task-agnostic coreset estimation approach that pools neuron activations from vision foundation models into per-image and per-dataset distributions. By comparing each image's distribution to the dataset-level distribution, CoreDNA can capture both low-level visual structure and high-level semantic information across layers. We find that high-quality samples concentrate in the tails of the last layer's activation statistics, which we validate by relating them to training-based coreset methods. Building on these findings, we develop a computationally efficient selection mechanism to construct task-agnostic, high-quality coresets for selective annotation and model training. Across image classification, semantic segmentation, depth estimation, and imitation learning for end-to-end driving and mobile manipulation, CoreDNA matches or outperforms the state of the art, demonstrating unprecedented generalization across perception and action tasks. These results highlight the effectiveness of compact activation-based representations for data selection.

</details>


### [89] [A Language-Informed Loss for Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23653)
*Suchir Agarwal,Keshigeyan Chandrasegaran,Ziyu Chen,Kyle Sargent,Juan Carlos Niebles,Li Fei-Fei,Jiajun Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: LILIE：一种可逆的图像变换（normalizing flow transformer），与视觉语言模型联合训练，使VLM能从带噪特征中恢复图像描述，从而为文本到图像生成提供语言信息监督的无损损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端像素空间生成已具竞争力，但作者探究：语言信息监督能否比像素损失提供更丰富的训练信号。

Method: 构建可逆编码器LILIE（normalizing flow transformer），与VLM通过下一token预测联合训练，使VLM可从加噪特征中还原caption；再用该编码器提取简单的语言信息损失，用于训练JiT文本到图像生成模型。

Result: 在GPIC数据集上，使用LILIE损失的JiT模型相比仅用像素损失的基线，gFD下降14点（66.84→53.01）。

Conclusion: 语言信息监督可作为比像素损失更丰富的生成训练信号；代码、编码器与生成模型已开源。

Abstract: End-to-end visual generation with pixel-space loss has recently achieved competitive performance without the need for learned image tokenizers. In this work, we study whether language-informed supervision can provide a richer training signal than pixel loss for visual generation. We introduce LILIE (pronounced "lily"), a Language-Informed and Lossless Image Encoder. LILIE is an invertible image transform trained such that a vision-language model can recover captions from noised features. The encoder uses a normalizing flow transformer trained jointly with a vision-language model via next token prediction. We then use the encoder to extract a simple language-informed loss for text-to-image generation. We train JiT models with LILIE loss, reducing gFD by 14 points (66.84 $\to$ 53.01) against a pixel-only baseline on the GPIC dataset. Our code, encoders, and generative models are available at https://suchiragarwal.com/lilie.

</details>


### [90] [FlexPart: Text-Controlled Semantics-Aware 3D Part Segmentation at Flexible Granularity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23659)
*Yiqun Zhao,Jiachen Xu,Yihao Zhi,Yunfei Zhao,Zibo Zhao,Xintong Han,Chunchao Guo,Shenghua Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出 FLEXPART：一个文本控制的3D网格分割统一框架，实现"所问即所得"的多粒度部件分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 3D资产存在多种合法部件分解，语义感知分割需同时反映用户期望的粒度与目标部件。当前实现该目标受两大障碍限制：缺乏多粒度训练数据、缺少整体性控制机制。

Method: 1) 设计整体控制提示（holistic control prompt），由语义部件名称+位置与形状子句构成；2) 用自动化VLM流水线构建大规模多粒度分割与对应提示数据集；3) 模型在原生3D空间生成视角无关的part-identity field，直接为网格面片分配离散部件ID；4) 采用随机背景丢弃训练策略，促使模型遵循语义条件而非依赖几何先验；5) 推理时用VLM planner从2D渲染自动补全描述子句，用户仅需用普通词命名部件。

Result: 在planner补全提示下，mIoU超过最强基线15%（即使基线获得真值引导）；在FLEXPARTBENCH上各粒度均领先，平均mIoU提升22%；仅提供部件名称的选择性分割中，IoU较最强点击驱动基线提升35%。

Conclusion: FLEXPART通过多粒度数据与整体提示控制机制，实现了灵活、视角无关、语义可控的3D网格分割，在粒度适应性与用户意图对齐上显著优于现有基线。

Abstract: A 3D asset admits multiple valid part decompositions, while semantics-aware segmentation should reflect both the desired granularity and the parts a user wants to extract. Ideally, a practical segmentation
  model should strive for a simple principle: what you ask for is what you get. However, realizing this goal is hindered by two core obstacles: the lack of multi-granularity training data and the absence of a
  holistic control mechanism. We propose FLEXPART, a unified framework for text-controlled 3D mesh segmentation. To establish flexible control, we introduce a holistic control prompt comprising semantic part
  names with location and shape clauses. To support this mechanism, we utilize an automated Vision-Language Model (VLM) pipeline to construct a large-scale dataset of multi-granularity partitions and their
  corresponding prompts. Driven by this data, FLEXPART generates a view-independent part-identity field in native 3D space, directly assigning discrete part IDs to mesh faces. To compel the model to respect
  semantic conditions rather than rely on geometric priors, we train the model using randomized background dropping. Furthermore, an inference-time VLM planner can automatically complete descriptive clauses
  from 2D renderings, allowing users to simply name the desired parts in ordinary words. FLEXPART with planner-completed prompts outperforms the strongest evaluated baseline by 15% in mIoU, even when that
  baseline receives ground-truth guidance. On our held-out FLEXPARTBENCH, FLEXPART leads at each granularity and improves average mIoU by 22% over the strongest baseline. With only the requested part names
  supplied by the user, it also improves IoU by 35% over the strongest click-driven baseline on selective segmentation.

</details>


### [91] [An Efficient Approach to Beetle Damage Detection of Banana Using Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23661)
*Md. Mehedi Hasan Naeem,Ishtiyak Ahmmad Araf,Md. Arefin Haque Mahir,Tushar Kanti Saha*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 基于YOLOv8n的轻量框架，在自建孟加拉市场香蕉图像数据集（2,473张、5,827个实例）上实现单体香蕉定位与表面健康/不健康二分类，测试集取得87.04% mAP@0.50、5.96 MB模型大小与6.54 ms/图推理速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 香蕉表面可见损伤（疤状表面状况）会降低其市场价值，而人工目视检查主观性强且难以规模化，因此需要一种可自动化的实例级表面检测方法。

Method: 构建来自孟加拉本地市场的自定义数据集（2,473张图像、5,827个标注实例），按80/20划分为1,982张训练、491张测试；采用预训练YOLOv8n在640×640分辨率下训练50个epoch、batch size为4，输出香蕉单体定位与健康/不健康分类；并与YOLOv8s进行对比。标题中的"beetle damage"仅为对局部观察到的疤状表面状况的操作性表述，模型不识别具体物种或生物成因。

Result: 测试集上：精确率81.36%、召回率74.30%、F1 77.67%、mAP@0.50为87.04%、mAP@0.50:0.95为59.33%；YOLOv8s的F1与mAP略低但参数量/检查点显著更大；YOLOv8n模型仅5.96 MB，在NVIDIA Tesla T4上推理6.54 ms/图。

Conclusion: 在所研究的采集条件下，YOLOv8n可作为紧凑的基线模型用于实例级香蕉表面检查；损伤标签为操作性定义，且结果局限于特定数据获取条件。

Abstract: Visible surface damage of banana fruits by Basilepta subcostata (the banana fruit scarring beetle) can reduce their market value. Here, manual inspection of Banana fruits is subjective and difficult to scale. This study presents a lightweight framework based on YOLOv8n deep learning model for locating individual bananas and classifying their visible surface condition as healthy or unhealthy. The term beetle damage in the paper title is used operationally for the locally observed scar-like surface condition; the model does not identify a specific beetle species or biological cause. A custom dataset of 2,473 images containing 5,827 annotated banana instances was prepared from local-market imagery in Bangladesh. The reported experiment used an 80/20 protocol with 1,982 training images and 491 test images. A pretrained YOLOv8n model was trained at 640x640 resolution for 50 epochs with a batch size of 4. On the test partition, it achieved 81.36% precision, 74.30% recall, 77.67% F1-score, 87.04% mAP@0.50 and 59.33% mAP@0.50:0.95. A YOLOv8s comparison gave slightly lower F1 and mAP while using a substantially larger checkpoint. The YOLOv8n checkpoint occupied 5.96 MB and required 6.54 ms/image for inference on an NVIDIA Tesla T4. The results support YOLOv8n as a compact baseline for instance-level banana surface inspection within the studied acquisition conditions.

</details>


### [92] [PCDFusion: Proposal-Context-Detail Bayesian Rendering for Infrared-Visible Image Fusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23663)
*Rui Liu,Lin Gu,Hesong Li,Ying Fu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文将红外-可见光图像融合（IVIF）重表述为局部贝叶斯后验渲染，提出以可见光为锚的Proposal-Context-Detail融合框架PCDFusion，通过三阶段渲染由后验动作权重控制融合，在公开基准上提升融合质量、目标恢复及下游检测与分割性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可见光与热红外观测在物理上互补但各自存在不同形式的不可靠性。现有深度IVIF方法主要改进特征交互与重建，缺乏显式的局部规则来判断何时应以可见光外观为主、何时应引入热响应。

Method: 将IVIF重新表述为局部贝叶斯后验渲染，用后验动作权重替代直接模态混合；构建可见光锚定的PCDFusion框架，包含三个渲染阶段：保留潜在有用的热响应、更新曝光退化的可见光区域、将可靠的带限红外结构渲染进最终亮度。

Result: 在公开IVIF基准上的大量实验表明，PCDFusion在挑战性光照条件下提升了融合质量、目标恢复能力以及下游检测与分割性能。

Conclusion: 以局部贝叶斯后验渲染统一控制模态贡献、并以可见光为锚的三阶段渲染，是一种有效且可解释的IVIF范式，可同时惠及人眼感知与下游视觉任务。

Abstract: Infrared-visible image fusion (IVIF) aims to combine visible and thermal infrared observations for human perception and downstream vision tasks. Visible and thermal infrared observations are physically complementary but unreliable in different ways. Existing deep IVIF methods mainly improve feature interaction and reconstruction, but often lack an explicit local rule for deciding when visible appearance should dominate and when thermal responses should contribute. To address this issue, we reformulate IVIF as local Bayesian posterior rendering, where fusion is controlled by posterior action weights rather than direct modality mixing. In this paper, we propose Proposal-Context-Detail Fusion (PCDFusion), a visible-anchored framework that implements this formulation through three rendering stages. PCDFusion preserves potentially useful thermal responses, updates exposure-degraded visible regions, and renders reliable band-limited infrared structures into the final luminance. Extensive experiments on public IVIF benchmarks show that PCDFusion improves fusion quality, target recovery, and downstream detection and segmentation performance under challenging illumination. The code is available at https://github.com/BIT-RuiLiu/PCDFusion.git.

</details>


### [93] [Agentic Physics-Grounded Video Generation via Memory-Augmented In-Context Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23677)
*Xikang Guan,Shaocong Yang,Yanqi Bao,Can Wang,Zheng Gu,Zhengqing Chen,Kai Chen,Jing Huo,Yang Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: PhysRepair：生成-诊断-修复范式的智能体视频生成框架，通过时空因果约束定位首个失效物理状态及其因果受影响状态进行局部重生成，并结合经验增强的上下文学习自适应修复物理不一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在合成前通过仿真或精炼提示施加物理引导，存在三点局限：限制动态多样性、无法捕捉生成后才出现的错误、不一致时需反复整体重生成。因此转向生成-诊断-修复范式，在保留原生成能力前提下选择性修复，核心问题为"修什么"与"如何修"。

Method: 提出智能体框架PhysRepair，包含两个组件：1）时空因果约束（Spatiotemporal Causal Constraints）：识别第一个无效物理状态及其因果受影响状态，产出修复规约，引导物理合理的局部重生成并保留未受影响内容；2）经验增强的上下文学习（Experience-augmented In-context Learning）：将当前修复上下文与既往修复经验结合，使智能体跨多种物理失效自适应调整修复决策，并累积完整轨迹供后续使用。

Result: 在Physics-IQ Verified数据集上，覆盖固体力学、流体力学、光学、热力学和磁学，PhysRepair在生成视频的物理合理性上一致优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 生成-诊断-修复范式结合因果定位与经验复用，可有效提升视频物理合理性且避免整体重生成；项目页：https://xxkkxxx.github.io/PhysRepair-Website/。

Abstract: Physical plausibility is essential for realistic video generation. Existing methods impose physical guidance before synthesis via simulations or refined prompts, but this can limit dynamic diversity, miss errors that emerge only after generation, and require repeated regeneration when inconsistencies remain. We therefore study a generate-diagnose-repair paradigm that preserves the original generation capability and selectively repairs physical inconsistencies afterward, raising two key questions: what to repair and how to repair? To address them, we introduce PhysRepair, an agentic video generation framework that combines causal reasoning over the observed physical failure with prior repair experience to enable localized and adaptive correction.
