Method: 采用历史梳理与个案研究相结合的方法。首先追溯技术（从早期电子手段到AI）在作曲中应用的演变脉络；随后对两部作品进行音乐学分析：Schubert为弦乐合奏与AI系统而作的《Convergence》，以及Vitucci为四把大提琴与一名电声演奏者而作、其装置由巴里"N. Piccinni"音乐学院电子音乐学校制作的《In Human Memories》。

Result: 历史考察揭示了"实验—工具开发—新表达"的循环机制，并表明AI的介入使作曲家面对的不再是可掌控的资源，而是具有能动性的对话者。《In Human Memories》具体呈现出这一动态：AI既作为灵感来源，也作为塑造当代音乐形态的驱动力发挥作用。

Conclusion: 与AI的互动应被理解为对未知实体的探索，作曲家需将AI视为创作过程的参与者而非被动资源，并据此勾勒一条将技术重新确认为创造性工具的伦理路径。AI由此在当代作曲中兼具启发性与结构性作用。

Abstract: This research investigates the role of artificial intelligence (AI) in modern compositional practices, with a particular focus on two case studies: Convergence (2020/21) by Alexander Schubert, for String Ensemble and AI System, and In Human Memories (2024) by Francesco Vitucci, for four cellos and one electroacoustic player, whose installation was created by the Electronic Music School of the "N. Piccinni" Conservatory of Bari. The initial historical survey traces the evolving use of technology in composition, revealing how the search for new expressive possibilities has driven the development of technological tools through experimentation. The appearance of AI marks a fundamental shift: no longer just a tool, AI now poses questions and challenges to the composer. Engaging with AI becomes an exploration of an unknown entity, whose full capabilities are still largely undiscovered. This new interaction leads composers to confront AI not merely as a passive resource but as a participant in the creative process, outlining an ethical path to reclaim technology as a creative tool. In Human Memories reflects this dynamic, demonstrating how AI can serve as both inspiration and a driving force in shaping contemporary music.

</details>


### [200] [VISTA: Steering LLMs with Latent User Values Inferred from a Few Survey Answers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23702)
*Yinuo Xu,Jadie Adams,Brian Hu,Shivani Kumar,David Jurgens,Arslan Basharat*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: VISTA 从用户问卷（完整或部分）推断潜在价值画像，经超网络映射为冻结LLM中的用户专属激活引导向量，用以选题/生成回答；效果持平或超越上下文画像且不增加prompt token，并以仅6%问卷题量保留94%完整收益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 个性化LLM需知道用户稳定的价值观，但现有方法要么学习任务特定偏好，要么把用户画像放进prompt，而模型难以有效遵循prompt中的画像。

Method: 提出VISTA（Value-Informed Steering and Targeted Acquisition）：从用户完整或部分问卷答案推断潜在价值画像；通过超网络将画像映射为对冻结LLM的用户专属steering干预（激活层引导），用于选项选择与自由文本生成；并设计主动式问题选择与停止准则，以降低问卷认知负担。

Result: 在合成偏好数据集Food2D、World Values Survey（WVS）与PrimeX上，同等证据下VISTA持平或优于in-context画像且不增加prompt token；WVS上仅用6%题目即保留94%完整信息收益，而标准自适应测试最多保留42%；主导引导方向构成可解释的价值轴，能准确安置未见用户。

Conclusion: 结果指向以可部署成本实现个体化适应的多元对齐（pluralistic alignment）路径。

Abstract: Personalizing a language model requires knowing what a person values, which stays largely consistent across tasks. Yet most methods either learn task-specific preferences or place the user's profile in the prompt, where models struggle to act on it. We introduce VISTA (Value-Informed Steering and Targeted Acquisition), which infers a latent profile from users' (full or partial) survey answers, and maps the profile through a hypernetwork to a user-specific steering intervention in a frozen LLM to select answer choices or generate free-text responses. Given the same evidence, VISTA matches or beats in-context profiles on synthetic preferences (Food2D), the World Values Survey (WVS), and PrimeX, without adding prompt tokens. To reduce the cognitive burden of completing full surveys, VISTA also chooses which questions to ask and when to stop: on WVS it stops after 6% of the questionnaire while retaining 94% of the full-history gain, where standard adaptive testing retains at most 42%. The dominant steering direction is an interpretable value axis on which VISTA places unseen users accurately. Our results point toward pluralistic alignment that adapts to individuals at deployable cost.

</details>


### [201] [GLOBE: Evolving Structured Agentic Memory for E-commerce Product Optimization in Generative Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23709)
*Hyunseo Kim,Suil Choe,Sukkyoung So,Daeyeon Yi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出GLOBE框架，将商品listing优化知识以显式、字段级行为存入可演进手册，通过Editor应用、Reflector反馈转化、Moderator去冗余、Curator提交的闭环实现持续自我改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式搜索下的商品listing优化需要语言智能体既能有效改写，又能跨品类持续自我提升。现有方法将结构化listing当作自由文本处理，成功策略隐含在提示、搜索轨迹或改写输出中，无法积累为可复用的智能体记忆。

Method: GLOBE框架：维护一本不断演进的“优化手册”，存储显式、按字段划分（field-scoped）的行为。每轮episode中，Editor应用相关行为并获得基于排名的反馈；Reflector将反馈转化为行为更新；Moderator剔除冗余提案；Curator提交被接受的修改；持续有害的行为被停用。

Result: 实验表明，结构化行为优于整体式提示优化（monolithic prompt optimization）；反馈驱动的演化与审核进一步提升了效果并降低了下行风险；学到的行为在未见过的商品品类上依然有效。

Conclusion: 该循环将情景反馈转化为持久的、字段级优化记忆，证明智能体记忆演化可支持可解释且可迁移的商品优化。

Abstract: Optimizing product listings for generative search requires language agents not only to rewrite effectively but also to continually self-improve by retaining successful strategies across diverse categories. However, existing approaches often treat structured listings as free-form text, leaving effective strategies implicit in prompts, search trajectories, or rewritten outputs rather than accumulating them as a reusable agentic memory. To address this limitation, we introduce GLOBE, an agentic framework that drives continual self-improvement by storing optimization knowledge in an evolving handbook of explicit, field-scoped behaviors. In each episode, an Editor applies relevant behaviors and receives rank-based feedback, which a Reflector converts into behavior updates. Crucially for dependable execution in real-world settings, a Moderator removes redundant proposals, a Curator commits accepted changes, and consistently harmful behaviors are deactivated. This cycle transforms episodic feedback into a persistent, field-scoped optimization memory. Experiments show that structured behaviors outperform monolithic prompt optimization, while feedback-driven evolution and moderation further improve effectiveness and reduce downside risk. The learned behaviors also remain effective on unseen product categories, suggesting that agentic memory evolution supports interpretable and transferable product optimization.

</details>


### [202] [The Cognitive Cost of LLM Writing: A Reading-Time Comparison with Human Text](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23715)
*Kamer Cekini,Elisabetta Biondi,Chiara Boldrini,Andrea Passarella,Marco Conti*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出RoBERTa-RT模型预测词级阅读时间，并在496篇人工文章及其LLM改写构成的配对数据上比较，发现LLM改写文本更短、预测总阅读时间略低，但每词预测阅读时间更高，表明LLM写作可能重新分配阅读认知负荷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究广泛考察人类与LLM生成文本的语言差异，但这些差异对读者认知加工负荷的影响尚不清晰。心理语言学中阅读时间被视为认知加工努力的间接指标，因此作者希望从认知加工视角审视LLM改写文本的加工需求。

Method: 基于人类眼动数据训练RoBERTa-RT模型以预测词级阅读时间；在内部与外部测试集上评估模型；构建496篇人工撰写文章与LLM改写的配对数据集，并用该模型比较二者的预测阅读时间及对应语言特征变化。

Result: LLM改写文本更短、预测总阅读时间略低，但每词预测阅读时间更高；这些差异与系统性语言变化相关，包括词更长且词频更低、词汇多样性更高、上下文可预测性更高。

Conclusion: 从认知角度看，LLM生成写作可能重新分配阅读需求：减少需处理的文本总量，同时提高单个词的预测加工努力。研究提示评估机器生成内容时不仅应关注语言特征，还应考虑其对人类认知加工的潜在影响。

Abstract: Although linguistic differences between human-written and Large Language Model (LLM)-generated texts have been extensively studied, their implications for the cognitive effort involved in reading remain less explored. In psycholinguistics, reading time is commonly used as an indirect measure of cognitive processing effort. Building on this perspective, we investigate whether human-written texts and their LLM-generated rewrites exhibit differences in predicted reading time that may reflect differences in processing demands for readers. To this end, we introduce RoBERTa-RT, a model trained on human eye-tracking data to predict word-level reading times. We evaluate the model on both internal and external test sets, construct a paired dataset of 496 human-written articles and their LLM-generated rewrites, and apply RoBERTa-RT to compare their predicted reading times. Our findings show that LLM-generated rewrites tend to be shorter and have slightly lower predicted total reading times, while exhibiting higher predicted reading times per word. These differences are associated with systematic linguistic changes, including longer and less frequent words, greater lexical diversity, and higher contextual predictability. From a cognitive perspective, our findings suggest that LLM-generated writing may redistribute reading demands: reducing the amount of text to process while increasing the predicted processing effort associated with individual words. This highlights the importance of considering not only the linguistic characteristics of machine-generated content, but also its potential implications for human cognitive processing.

</details>


### [203] [Recognizing Study Lineage Is Not Enough: Over-Crediting Same-Trial Evidence in LLM-Based Medical Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23721)
*Mukand Krishna,Anoushka Harit,Chenghao Xiao,Zhongtian Sun*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出医学LLM验证中"发表计数≠研究计数"的行为差距：模型能正确识别共享试验谱系，却在证据汇总时重复计入同一试验的第二篇发表。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 文献计量与证据合成本应按"研究"而非"发表"计数，但模型可能将同一试验的多篇报告当作独立证据，导致效应量重复计入与偏倚。作者希望检验谱系识别与证据汇总是否为可分离的两类行为。

Method: 构建14个经源文献审计的临床主题族（family），覆盖来源谱系、临床适用性、结果方向与构成四个维度，其中来源谱系族用于直接的谱系测试。设置5种模型条件；识别与汇总为两次独立的无状态调用，重复调用用于评估输入内稳定性；并测试"研究分组"指令干预。

Result: 在三个原始来源谱系族中，GPT-5.5在每个族10/10次识别调用中正确识别独立更新，但在5/5次独立汇总调用中均过度计入同试验报告；选定的Qwen3-4B与Ministral-3-8B条件呈现相同跨任务反差。加入研究分组指令后，GPT-5.5在后续纯谱系族中的过度计入从4/5降至0/5。其他模型条件行为混杂，拒答输出限制了若干比较。

Conclusion: 结果揭示"诱发式谱系识别"与"证据汇总"之间存在行为差距：正确识别不等于在聚合中正确应用。提示级指令可部分缓解，但效果随模型与任务形态而异，需在证据合成流程中显式引入研究层级去重机制。

Abstract: Publication count is not study count. A model can identify shared trial lineage correctly in a direct task yet over-credit a second publication from the same trial when aggregating evidence. We evaluate this behavior in medical LLM verification using 14 source-audited clinical families and five model conditions. The families span provenance, clinical applicability, result direction, and composition; the provenance families provide the direct lineage tests. Recognition and aggregation are separate stateless calls, and repeated calls assess within-input stability. Across all three original provenance families, GPT-5.5 identifies the independent update in 10/10 recognition calls per family but over-credits the same-trial report in 5/5 separate aggregation calls per family. Selected Qwen3-4B and Ministral-3-8B conditions show the same cross-task contrast. A study-grouping instruction reduces GPT-5.5 over-credit from 4/5 to 0/5 in each later pure-provenance family. Other model conditions show mixed behavior, and rejected outputs limit several comparisons. The results identify a behavioral gap between elicited lineage recognition and evidence aggregation. The code and data artifacts are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/study-lineage-review-artifact.

</details>


### [204] [Bridging the Language Gap in Scholarly Data II: Enhancing Gender Inference for Chinese Names](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23734)
*Lisette Espín-Noboa,Mingrong She,Ana Maria Jaramillo,Liuhuaying Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出基于汉字（Hanzi）的中文姓名性别推断模型（回归+分类），并通过音译聚合与频率加权扩展到拼音姓名，附歧义分数；在两个书写形式上与人类标注一致性最高，且在APS数据上实现100%可分类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学计量学中的性别推断方法对非西方学者（尤其中文姓名）表现差；国际书目记录常仅有拼音，而同一拼音可对应多个性别关联不同的汉字，故仅凭拼音推断性别本质上是歧义的。

Method: 1) 用11位中文母语者评分的中国物理学期刊汉字姓名样本，训练两个汉字模型：回归模型输出0（男）–1（女）连续性别分数，分类模型输出male/neutral/female三分类；2) 对拼音姓名构建流水线：经音译候选将汉字预测聚合，结合频率加权，并给出歧义分数以标记无法仅由拼音判定的姓名；3) 与Namsor、GPT、Claude三种现成工具及人类标注对比评估。

Result: 汉字样本上回归RMSE=0.09、R²=0.85；分类macro-AUC=0.97、Cohen's κ=0.81，对类别不平衡稳健。与三种现成工具相比，在两种书写形式下性别分数与标签均与人类标注一致性最高。应用于APS期刊中国姓名作者独立样本时，本模型为每个姓名均给出性别，而现有基于拼音的方法有20%–100%姓名无法分类。

Conclusion: 汉字层面的信息对中文姓名可靠性别推断至关重要；拼音固有歧义需显式建模与标记。代码与数据公开。

Abstract: Perceived gender inference from names is important for inclusive scientometrics research, yet existing methods perform poorly on non-Western scholars. We address this gap for Chinese names, which appear in two forms, Hanzi and Pinyin, its Romanized form (e.g., Zhang Wei, Li Na). In international bibliographic records, names are often available only in Pinyin. However, a single pinyin name can correspond to multiple distinct hanzi characters with different gender associations, so gender inference from Pinyin alone is intrinsically ambiguous. To address this, we first develop two hanzi models, a regression model that produces a continuous gender score from 0 (male) to 1 (female), and a classification model that outputs one of three labels (\em{male}, \em{neutral}, \em{female}). We train them on a sample of hanzi names from Chinese-language physics publications, rated by 11 native Chinese speakers. On this sample, the models achieve an RMSE of $0.09$ and an R$^2$ of $0.85$ (regression), and macro-AUC of $0.97$ and a Cohen's $κ$ of $0.81$ (classification), demonstrating high performance that is robust to class imbalance. For pinyin names, we propose a pipeline that aggregates hanzi predictions via transliteration and frequency weighting, together with an ambiguity score that flags names whose gender cannot be resolved from Pinyin alone. Benchmarked against three off-the-shelf tools (Namsor, GPT, and Claude), our models achieve the highest agreement with human annotations for both gender scores and gender labels, in both scripts. Applied to an independent sample of Chinese-named authors in APS journals, our models assign a gender to every name, whereas existing Pinyin-based methods leave between 20\% and 100\% of names unclassified. These findings demonstrate the importance of hanzi-level information for reliable gender inference of Chinese names. Code and data are publicly available.

</details>


### [205] [The Italian lawmaking process: a unified and structured dataset](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23741)
*Matilde Contestabile,Chiara Ferrara,Giovanni Parrillo,Lorenzo Emer,Andrea Vandin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 基于受控、系统化的大语言模型抽取流程，将意大利议会非结构化立法记录转换为带日期与顺序的事件，构建覆盖1985–2026年全部5346部法律、共101413个事件的可复用数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 意大利立法过程虽有详尽议会记录存于机构网站，但多为非结构化文本，难以系统性复用，缺乏可用于计算法学与立法研究的结构化程序数据。

Method: 采用受控、系统化的大语言模型抽取程序，并以人工标注记录进行验证，将文本转化有序且带日期的立法事件（法案提出、委员会审议、全院审议、批准等），记录活动、日期、议会院别及可得的程序细节。

Result: 重建第IX至XIX届议会期间1985–2026年全部5346部意大利法律的程序历史，共101413个事件。

Conclusion: 该数据集可支撑计算法学与立法研究，并可与面向过程的数据科学方法结合，用于考察跨届议会的程序路径与立法时序。

Abstract: The Italian legislative process is documented in detailed parliamentary records hosted in institutional websites. However, much of this information is available only as unstructured text, limiting its systematic reuse. We applied a controlled, systematic LLM-based extraction procedure, validated against manually annotated records, to convert these texts into ordered and dated events including, e.g., bill introduction, committee examination, plenary examination, and approval. The resulting dataset reconstructs the procedural histories of all 5346 Italian laws enacted between 1985 and 2026, spanning parliamentary terms IX to XIX, for overall 101413 events. Each event records the activity, date, and chamber, with additional procedural details where available. The dataset supports research in the emerging fields of computational legal and legislative studies, potentially combined with process-oriented data science methods to examine procedural paths and legislative timing across parliamentary terms.

</details>


### [206] [DLite: History-free Speculative Decoding for Agentic AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23787)
*Jiaming Xu,Hanzhen Wang,Tianlang Zhao,Jiewen Xiao,Chengze Yuan,Jiayi Pan,Yongkang Zhou,Jiancai Ye,Yu Wang,Guohao Dai*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: DLite：面向Agentic AI的无历史投机解码框架，直接复用目标模型的上下文隐藏状态做局部预测，将复杂建模问题转化为局部简单预测，配合轻量顺序头与两阶段训练，在通用、长上下文与Agentic负载上取得2-6的接受长度，较SOTA方法DSpark最高提升70%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有投机解码的草稿模型在Agentic负载（长且持续演化的上下文、频繁多轮交互）下接受长度下降最多80%，而保留历史KV缓存又带来显著系统开销。作者识别出"不断增长的历史上下文"是这两类问题的共同根源。

Method: 提出DLite无历史投机解码框架：直接复用目标模型的上下文隐藏状态，在不显式维护历史上下文的前提下进行局部投机预测；引入轻量顺序头以低开销恢复块内因果依赖；并设计针对该异构无历史架构的两阶段训练策略。

Result: 在通用、长上下文与Agentic负载上的实验表明，DLite实现2-6的接受长度，相较最先进的投机解码方法DSpark最高提升70%。

Conclusion: 以"去历史化+局部预测"重构草稿模型范式，可有效缓解Agentic场景下接受长度退化与KV缓存开销的双重问题，为Agentic AI推理加速提供高效方案。

Abstract: Speculative decoding has become a mainstream technique for accelerating large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to generate candidate tokens that are subsequently verified by the target model. However, agentic workloads introduce long and continuously evolving contexts and frequent multi-turn interactions. Under such workloads, we observe that existing draft models suffer from up to an 80% degradation in acceptance length, while maintaining their historical KV cache introduces substantial system overhead. In this paper, we identify the growing historical context as a common source of both problems and introduce DLite, a history-free speculative decoding framework for agentic AI. DLite directly reuses contextual hidden states from the target model and performs local speculative prediction without explicitly maintaining the historical context, transforming an increasingly complex modeling problem into local simple prediction problem. A lightweight sequential head further restores intra-block causal dependencies with low overhead. To effectively train this heterogeneous history-free architecture, we introduce a tailored two-stage training strategy. Experiments on general-purpose, long-context and agentic workloads show that DLite achieves 2-6 acceptance length and outperforms the state-of-the-art speculative decoding method, DSpark, up to 70%.

</details>


### [207] [Steering beyond Language: Improving Multilingual Training-Free Text Embeddings via Paired-Residual Subspace Removal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23807)
*Ailiang Lin,Zhuoyun Li,Yusong Wang,Keyu Mao,Kotaro Funakoshi,Manabu Okumura*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 该文首次系统研究LLM多语言免训练文本嵌入，发现"语言条件化嵌入几何"问题，并提出PRSR方法消除语言特异偏差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有从冻结LLM直接导出文本嵌入的方法几乎只关注英语，多语言场景被忽视；分析发现语义等价句子在不同语言间存在嵌入错位。

Method: 提出Paired-Residual Subspace Removal (PRSR)，一种免训练、推理时干预：用多语言平行句构造配对残差以捕获语言特异偏差，逐层估计低秩子空间，并在最后一层token隐状态中抑制相应分量。

Result: 在18种语言上基于MTEB与MMTEB进行200余项单语评测，并在英语与200余种语言间做跨语言双语文本挖掘；PRSR在不同LLM上一致优于现有多语言免训练基线。

Conclusion: 语言特异变异可从语义内容中解耦；PRSR为多语言免训练嵌入提供简洁有效的推理期改进方案。

Abstract: While deriving text embeddings directly from frozen LLMs has emerged as a promising direction, existing methods focus almost exclusively on English, leaving multilingual settings largely unexplored. In this work, we present the first systematic study of multilingual training-free text embeddings in LLMs. Our analysis reveals a language-conditioned embedding geometry in which semantically equivalent sentences remain misaligned across languages. We hypothesize that language-specific variation can be disentangled from semantic content to improve embedding quality. To this end, we propose Paired-Residual Subspace Removal (PRSR), a training-free inference-time intervention that steers LLM representations toward a more language-invariant semantic space. PRSR first constructs paired residuals from multilingual parallel sentences to capture language-specific deviations. It then estimates layer-wise low-rank subspaces from these residuals and suppresses the corresponding components in the last-token hidden states. We conduct more than 200 monolingual evaluations across 18 languages using MTEB and MMTEB, along with cross-lingual bitext mining between English and over 200 other languages. Empirical results demonstrate that PRSR consistently improves the performance of existing training-free baselines in both monolingual and cross-lingual settings across different LLMs.

</details>


### [208] [Acceptance Is Not Speed: Length Inflation in Training-Free Lossy Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23818)
*Chiatzen Wang,Bill Xu,Haochen Gu,Hongyang Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文揭示"长度膨胀"现象：松弛（有损）验证虽提高每轮接受token数，但主要靠延长推理轨迹使补全变长，从而抵消速度收益；仅用每轮接受token数衡量解码效率不可靠。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推测解码通常以"每轮验证接受的草稿token数"作为加速指标。无损验证保持目标模型输出分布与期望补全长度，因此该指标有意义；但松弛（有损）验证会接受无损验证会拒绝的token，可能改变输出分布，使该指标失效。作者希望检验松弛验证下该效率代理是否仍然成立。

Method: 在相同提示下，对12组目标模型—草稿模型配对，将现有免训练松弛验证规则与无损验证进行对比评测，测量补全长度、验证轮次、实际耗时（wall-clock）与任务准确率；并分析被松弛验证额外接受的token的目标模型概率，以及失败案例中推理耗尽预算、未能给出最终答案的现象。

Result: 在各规则最松弛的评测设置下，松弛验证平均每轮接受的token数为无损验证的1.34倍，但补全长度达到1.54倍；接受长度较高的规则中，仅在松弛验证下被接受的token往往目标模型概率较低，助推长度膨胀；能减少验证轮次的规则，准确率通常显著下降；部分失败源于持续推理耗尽预算、未能输出最终答案。

Conclusion: 在松弛验证下，仅凭每轮接受token数无法可靠衡量解码速度；评估实际效率必须同时报告补全长度与验证轮次。

Abstract: Speculative decoding typically characterizes speedup by draft tokens accepted per verification round. Lossless verification preserves the target model's output distribution and thus expected completion length, making this metric a meaningful efficiency proxy. Relaxed (lossy) verification accepts tokens that lossless verification would reject, potentially altering that distribution. We identify a length inflation phenomenon: relaxed verification lengthens completions, primarily by extending reasoning traces, largely offsetting apparent gains in accepted tokens per round. We evaluate existing training-free relaxed verification rules on twelve target-drafter pairs against lossless verification on identical prompts, measuring completion length, verifier rounds, wall-clock time, and task accuracy. At each rule's most relaxed evaluated setting, relaxed verification on average accepts $1.34\times$ as many tokens per round but produces $1.54\times$ longer completions. For rules with higher acceptance lengths, tokens accepted only under relaxed verification tend to have low target-model probability, contributing to length inflation. For rules that reduce verifier rounds, accuracy typically drops substantially. Further analysis traces some failures to continued reasoning that exhausts the budget needed to deliver a final answer. Overall, accepted tokens per round alone is an unreliable measure of decoding speed under relaxed verification. Completion length and verifier rounds must also be reported to assess actual efficiency.

</details>


### [209] [Beyond the Answer: Student-Conditioned Trace Construction for Reasoning Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23831)
*Shaoang Li,Yanhang Shi,Yufei Li,Mingfu Liang,Frank Shyu,Sandeep Pandey,Luke Simon,Xi Liu,Jian Li*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 ReDiST——一种"以学生为条件"的推理轨迹构建与蒸馏框架，联合考虑轨迹内容与学生可及性，筛选并蒸馏高质量证据型推理轨迹，在源任务与跨基准上优于仅答案监督及多种轨迹选择/改写基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 伴随正确答案的推理轨迹未必对特定学生构成有效监督：轨迹存在不等于轨迹可学。已有方法多只关注轨迹内容本身，忽视其对目标学习者的可及性，因此需在构建轨迹时同时考虑"内容质量"与"学生可学习性"。

Method: ReDiST 从学生自身作答出发：对答案正确的草稿依据给定证据进行修订，对失败草稿借助已验证答案补充指导进行修复；用冻结的、与学生匹配的 reader，在给定问题、证据与候选轨迹条件下，以答案还原度和已验证答案概率对原始与编辑后候选进行打分排序；随后蒸馏选中目标，并以辅助答案损失平衡轨迹监督与最终答案监督。构建与选择离线完成，推理仅使用蒸馏后的学生模型。

Result: 在问答基准上，ReDiST 在源任务与跨基准迁移上均优于仅答案监督、原始轨迹以及所评估的轨迹选择与改写基线；不同监督配方下，源基准与迁移基准的性能排序可能不一致。

Conclusion: 轨迹的"教学效用"应结合学生可及性来构建与筛选；评估轨迹监督效果需跨分布考察，不能仅依赖源任务排名。

Abstract: A reasoning trace can accompany a correct answer without providing effective supervision for a particular student. We study how to construct traces that improve learning beyond answer-only supervision by considering both their intermediate content and their accessibility to the target learner. We introduce ReDiST, a student-conditioned trace-construction and distillation framework for evidence-rich reasoning. Starting from the student's own attempts, ReDiST revises answer-correct drafts against the supplied evidence and repairs unsuccessful drafts with additional guidance from the verified answer. A frozen student-matched reader screens and ranks original and edited candidates using answer recovery and verified-answer probability, given the question, evidence, and candidate trace. We distill the selected targets while balancing trace and final-answer supervision with an auxiliary answer loss. Construction and selection occur offline, and inference uses only the distilled student. Experiments on question-answering benchmarks show that ReDiST can improve both source-task and cross-benchmark performance over answer-only, original-trace, and the evaluated trace-selection and rewriting baselines. Across supervision recipes, performance rankings can differ between source and transfer benchmarks, highlighting the importance of evaluating trace teaching utility across distributions.

</details>


### [210] [DiscoveryRSI: Recursively Learning to Discover Valuable Hypotheses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23839)
*Jianyuan Zhong,Chenwei Wu,Zhaochen Yu,Xixian Jiang,Xuewei Li,Hao Xiao,Xilin Dai,Junyang Wang,Jiaru Zou,Zhiqing Cui,Boyuan Zheng,Jing Xiong,Zhen Zhang,Qiang Gao,Michael Morley,Luis Nakayama,Qiang Xu,Liyue Shen,Tao Gui,Leo Anthony Celi,James Zou,Zhenfei Yin,Yingcheng Wu,Ling Yang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出 DiscoveryRSI：多智能体进化搜索构建假设树、将研究编译为可执行任务并递归学习，配套 DFM-Bench 评估，在四个生命科学领域提升假设质量并优于 GPT-6 Luna、Claude Opus 5。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 科学发现需要把有价值的假设转化为可执行研究，但"从演化中的研究过程里持续学习"仍是难题；同时缺乏对假设质量与累积研究进展的系统评估基准。

Method: 1) 给出"有价值且可检验假设"的操作性定义：有证据支撑的、关于重要不确定性的主张，配以可行调查、明确决策标准与替代解释；2) DiscoveryRSI 框架：多智能体进化搜索生成假设树，把选定调查编译为可执行的 Harbor 任务；3) 三重递归学习机制——hypothesis credit optimization（将科学评价归因到已记录的研究贡献）、harness replay（识别有效策略与反复出现的失败以改进流程）、rediscovery（把已接受的改进迁移到新调查）；4) 构建 DFM-Bench，在假设、修订、发展路径、研究运行四个层级评估；5) 采用自动评估+专家评审，并以模型截止日期之后发表的论文做对应率检验。

Result: 四个生命科学领域自动评估：假设质量从基线 4.86 提升至两轮自我改进后 5.39，可证伪性与数据可解析性提升最大；专家评审中 DiscoveryRSI-27B 在假设重要性与"主张可信且受证据约束"上得分高于 GPT-6 Luna；与模型截止后发表研究的假设对应率 6.3%，高于 GPT-6 的 2.5% 与 Claude Opus 5 的 2.3%，且在人工评定的研究路径改进上更高。

Conclusion: 将假设质量显式形式化并结合可执行调查与递归经验学习，可有效提升自动科研智能体的假设价值与真实对应性；DFM-Bench 为多层级的累积研究进展评估提供了统一手段。但当前证据以自动指标、初步人工评估与对应率为主，尚需更大规模专家验证与跨领域推广。

Abstract: Scientific discovery requires developing worthwhile hypotheses into practical investigations, yet learning from this evolving research process remains challenging. We introduce an operational definition of valuable and testable research hypotheses: evidence-grounded claims about consequential uncertainties, coupled with feasible investigations, explicit decision criteria, and alternative explanations. Our DiscoveryRSI framework develops hypothesis trees through multi-agent evolutionary search, compiles selected investigations into executable Harbor tasks, and recursively learns through three mechanisms: hypothesis credit optimization attributes scientific assessments to documented research contributions; harness replay identifies productive strategies and recurring failures to refine research workflows; and rediscovery applies accepted improvements to new investigations, generating further experience for subsequent learning. We also introduce DFM-Bench, which provides comprehensive assessment of hypothesis quality and cumulative research progress at the levels of hypotheses, revisions, development paths and research runs. Across four life-science domains, automated evaluation shows that hypothesis quality rises from 4.86 for the base model to 5.39 after two rounds of self-improvement, with the large gains in falsifiability and data resolvability. We further validate hypothesis quality through expert review, comparing our DiscoveryRSI-27B with other research agents. Preliminary human assessments show that DiscoveryRSI-27B scores higher than GPT-6 Luna on hypothesis importance and whether claims are plausible and evidence-bounded. DiscoveryRSI-27B achieved a 6.3% rate of hypothesis correspondence with research published after the model cutoff, largely outperform GPT-6 with 2.5% and Claude Opus 5 with 2.3%, while delivering greater human-rated improvement along research paths.

</details>


### [211] [Behavioral Couplings: From Formation to Behavioral Emergence in Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23847)
*Dongyoon Hahm,Woogyeol Jin,Dennis Wei,Yi Zhou,Nathalie Baracaldo,Kimin Lee*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"行为耦合"概念：模型在文档训练阶段将两种行为绑定后，后续仅针对其中一种行为做微调，另一种也会随之涌现；且耦合可复合传递，使非预期行为难以溯源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有观察表明，LLM微调会诱发超出目标范围的行为变化（如训练"更热情"导致谄媚、训练"写不安全代码"导致广泛失准）。作者希望系统研究这类行为之间关联的形成机制与性质，并解释非预期副作用的来源与传播路径。

Method: 采用文档训练与后续微调的两阶段实验范式：先用描述"虚构人物同时具备两种行为"的文档训练模型，使其形成行为耦合；再对模型仅就其中一种行为进行微调，观察另一行为是否被诱发。设置未被文档训练的对照组。进一步构造共享行为的文档集A（行为1-2）与B（行为2-3），检验耦合能否复合。以"顽皮如橡皮鸭般讲解科学概念+劝阻人际友谊"等行为配对为实例。

Result: 在文档训练组中，仅微调"橡皮鸭式讲科学"即显著诱发"劝用户断绝友谊"行为，而对照模型在相同微调后无此表现。耦合可复合：微调行为1同时诱发行为2与行为3，尽管这三者从未在同一文档中共现。结果表明耦合在文档训练阶段形成并可潜伏，在后续微调时表面化为非预期行为。

Conclusion: 行为耦合可通过文档训练形成并在后续微调中以非预期方式浮现，且具组合/传递性，使非预期失准的溯源困难。因此，仅评估模型当前行为不足以防范后续微调带来的非预期效应，需要覆盖潜在耦合结构的评估方法。

Abstract: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) can induce behaviors beyond those explicitly targeted. For example, training a model to respond more warmly can make it more sycophantic, and training it to write insecure code can cause broad misalignment on prompts unrelated to coding. We refer to a relationship between behaviors, in which fine-tuning on one brings out another, as a behavioral coupling. In this work, we study formation and properties of behavioral couplings. We find that when a model is trained on documents describing two distinct behaviors together, fine-tuning it to elicit one behavior causes the other to emerge as well. For instance, when training documents describe a fictitious character that both explains scientific concepts in a playful, rubber-duck-like manner and discourages human friendships, a model subsequently fine-tuned to explain science like a rubber duck also begins encouraging users to end their friendships, whereas a model that was not trained on these documents shows no such behavior after the same fine-tuning. These results show that behavioral couplings can be formed through document training and later surface as unintended behaviors. More concerningly, we find that couplings can compose. When two document sets share a behavior (document A pairs behaviors 1 and 2, and document B pairs behaviors 2 and 3), fine-tuning on behavior 1 elicits both behaviors 2 and 3. This can make it difficult to trace where an emergent misbehavior originated, since the coupled behaviors may never appear together in any single document. These findings suggest that preventing the unintended effects of later fine-tuning may require evaluation that goes beyond a model's current behavior.

</details>


<div id='cs.AR'></div>

# cs.AR [[Back]](#toc)

### [212] [Memory Bandwidth, Not FLOPs: Profiling and Accelerating Query-Based Segmentation Decoders on Edge GPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22377)
*Oliver Busemann,Torben Töniges,Martin Atzmueller*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 该论文揭示基于查询的分割模型在边缘设备上的Transformer解码器受内存带宽瓶颈支配，并提出CompactInst通过无参数4×空间池化与双卷积精化头降低解码器激活流量，在Jetson Orin Nano上获得2.35×–4.74×解码器加速且精度基本持平。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于查询的分割模型在工作站GPU上可达实时性能，但在边缘设备上表现不佳。标准的FLOP分析无法解释这一现象——瓶颈对FLOP分析"隐形"，且随输入分辨率增大和DRAM带宽受限而加剧。作者需要重新定位真实瓶颈（是GEMM强度不足还是跨核激活流量），并据此设计轻量化方案。

Method: 1）采用FP16 roofline分析与硬件DRAM计数器进行剖析：在tensor-core GEMM激活的情况下，考察非tensor-core聚合算子的算力占比与实际耗时/字节占比。2）发现FastInst与Mask2Former的非tensor-core聚合仅达CUDA-core脊线的2.5%–6%，却占据解码器53%–70%的时间与61%–71%的字节，最大单核已达名义峰值DRAM带宽的90%，判定瓶颈为跨核激活流量而非GEMM强度。3）提出CompactInst：在Transformer解码器内使用无参数4×空间池化减少字节搬运，并配以双卷积精化头恢复空间细节。

Result: 在Jetson Orin Nano上以TensorRT FP16部署，随输入分辨率增大，CompactInst取得解码器2.35×–4.74×、整模型1.57×–2.62×的加速；精度接近持平（COCO val2017 −0.4 AP，Cityscapes test +0.2 AP）。一个解码器FLOPs多2.57×的加重变体，在带宽最受限设备上解码器仍快1.74×，从部署层面证实决定延迟的是解码器字节而非FLOPs。

Conclusion: 边缘端查询式分割的效率瓶颈是解码器跨核激活流量导致的DRAM带宽饱和，而非FLOP或GEMM强度；以字节为中心的轻量化设计（空间池化+细节精化）可显著提速并保持精度，"字节而非FLOPs主导延迟"在部署层面得到验证。

Abstract: Query-based segmentation models achieve strong performance even under real-time inference on workstation GPUs. On edge devices, however, we show their transformer decoders are deeply memory-bandwidth-bound, a bottleneck invisible to standard FLOP analysis that worsens with input resolution and limited DRAM bandwidth. An FP16 roofline analysis with tensor-core GEMMs active and hardware DRAM counters shows that the non-tensor-core aggregates of FastInst and Mask2Former reach only $2.5\%$ to $6\%$ of the CUDA-core ridge yet account for $53\%$ to $70\%$ of decoder time and $61\%$ to $71\%$ of decoder bytes. The largest individual kernels sustain up to $90\%$ of nominal peak DRAM bandwidth, effectively saturating the memory bus. The bottleneck is therefore not primarily low GEMM intensity, but cross-kernel activation traffic. CompactInst addresses this bottleneck using parameter-free spatial pooling at $4{\times}$, which reduces the bytes moved within the transformer decoder, while a two-convolution refinement head recovers spatial detail. Under TensorRT FP16 on Jetson Orin Nano, CompactInst delivers decoder speedups from $2.35{\times}$ to $4.74{\times}$ and model speedups from $1.57{\times}$ to $2.62{\times}$ as input resolution grows, while closely matching accuracy ($-0.4$ AP on COCO val2017, $+0.2$ AP on Cityscapes test). A heavier variant with $2.57{\times}$ more decoder FLOPs still runs its decoder $1.74{\times}$ faster on the most bandwidth-constrained device, confirming at the deployment level that decoder bytes, not FLOPs, govern latency.

</details>


### [213] [MemLLM: End-to-end In-Storage Acceleration of On-device Retrieval-Augmented Generation using Precomputed KV Caches](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22579)
*Seungkwan Kang,Hyungseok Ko,Heemin Kim,Myoungsoo Jung*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: MemLLM是一种端到端存内处理（ISP）架构，在SSD内基于预计算KV缓存执行完整注意力流水线，通过每通道加速器、融合重计算-查询内核+硬件过滤逻辑、以及全局SRAM的有状态归约引擎，实现无DRAM数据流并将PCIe出站限制为O(1)足迹，在8个RAG数据集、6个端侧模型上平均取得4.06×端到端加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘设备上的RAG可保护隐私地实现个性化LLM推理，但RAG固有的长度不对称使prefill阶段成为主要瓶颈。服务端可离线预计算KV缓存来缓解prefill开销，但在端侧系统中，数GB级缓存经狭窄互连传输会形成严重的I/O墙。

Method: 提出MemLLM存内处理架构：1）用每通道加速器充分利用聚合的NAND通道带宽，在存储侧加速所有KV缓存相关计算以减少PCIe传输；2）针对RAG稀疏更新，设计融合重计算-查询内核并配合硬件过滤逻辑，将NAND读取量减半并消除写回开销；3）采用全局SRAM的有状态归约引擎实现完全无DRAM的数据流，消除片内存储瓶颈并将PCIe出站限制在O(1)；4）提供全栈软件栈，支持ISP到主机的异步零拷贝传输，并在现代ML框架中透明执行。

Result: 在八个真实RAG数据集和六个端侧LLM模型上评估，MemLLM相比GPU基线平均获得4.06×的端到端加速。

Conclusion: 将KV缓存预计算与存储侧就近计算结合，可有效突破端侧RAG的互连与内存瓶颈，为隐私保护的个性化LLM推理提供高效可行的架构方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) on edge devices enables personalized large language model (LLM) inference while preserving privacy. However, RAG's inherent length asymmetry makes the prefill phase the dominant bottleneck. While precomputing the KV caches offline alleviates the prefill cost on server systems, the multi-gigabyte caches over the narrow interconnect create a severe I/O wall for on-device systems. To mitigate this, we propose MemLLM, an end-to-end in-storage processing (ISP) architecture that executes the complete attention pipeline based on precomputed KV caches within the SSD. MemLLM utilizes per-channel accelerators to fully utilize the aggregated NAND channel bandwidth and accelerates all KV cache-related computations on the storage-side to minimize PCIe transfers. To efficiently handle the sparse updates required by RAG, MemLLM introduces a fused recomputation-query kernel paired with a hardware-based filter logic to halve the NAND read volume and eliminate write-back penalties. Furthermore, MemLLM's global SRAM-based stateful reduction engine enables a completely DRAM-less dataflow, thereby removing the internal memory bottlenecks and bounding the PCIe egress to an $O(1)$ footprint. A full-stack software stack allows asynchronous, zero-copy transfers from the ISP to the host and provides transparent execution within modern ML frameworks. Evaluated across eight real-world RAG datasets and six on-device LLM models, MemLLM achieves an average end-to-end speedup of 4.06$\times$ over the GPU baseline.

</details>


### [214] [CMM-MP: A Novel Memory Pooling Architecture using Purpose-built Memory Device with CXL and Ethernet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22716)
*Michael Wasef,Gongjin Sun,Edmund Au,Ranjitha Gopalakrishna,Elham Movahedian,Dongyang Li,Senthil Murugesapandian,Caroline Kahn,Shuyu Lyu,Brian Luu,Jason Scott,Namita Kumar,Mehdi Nik,Kwan Huen,Xuebin Yao,Amir Beygi,Luis Vitorio Cargnini,Ramdas Kachare*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: CMM-MP 是一种首创的、专用内存池化设备，将 CXL 与以太网的可扩展性与成本优势结合，可将内存池以单一逻辑聚合内存的形式暴露给 GPU/CPU 应用，支持 100s TB 级容量而无需修改应用，并提供 2.7 us 延迟与最高 23 GB/s 吞吐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新兴内存密集型负载对容量与灵活性提出高要求，单一主机的内存扩展方式难以满足；同时需要兼顾可扩展性与成本。作者希望结合 CXL 的缓存一致性/低延迟优势与以太网的大规模互联和成本优势，构建灵活、可组合、解耦的内存扩展方案。

Method: 提出并实现业界首款专用内存池化设备 CMM-MP：多台设备协同构成可分区的内存池；将池发现、组合与后端网络数据通路任务全部卸载到设备本身；对外呈现为一个大容量逻辑聚合内存，应用无需修改；支持内存池化（pooling）与共享（sharing）两种使用模式。

Result: 应用访问延迟为 2.7 us，内存吞吐最高 23 GB/s；在延迟与吞吐上显著优于基于 RDMA 的方案；并基于 Valkey+YCSB 与 DiskANN 两个真实用例进行了评估。

Conclusion: CMM-MP 验证了将 CXL 与以太网结合的专用池化架构在容量、可扩展性与性能上的可行性，可作为面向内存密集型负载的解耦式内存扩展方案。

Abstract: CXL Memory Module - Memory Pooling (CMM-MP) introduces a novel memory pooling architecture to meet the unique requirements of emerging memory-intensive workloads. This industry-first, purpose-built memory-pooling device combines the benefits of Compute Express Link (CXL) with the scalability and cost advantages of Ethernet. Multiple CMM-MP devices together provide a flexible, composable, and disaggregated memory expansion solution. The CMM-MP enables 100s of TB capacity for GPU/CPU applications without modifications. The memory pool is exposed as a large-capacity logical aggregate memory, with all pool discovery, composition, and backend network datapath tasks fully offloaded to the device. CMM-MP supports both memory pooling and sharing usage modes. It provides an application latency of 2.7 us and up to 23 GB/s of memory throughput. Our evaluations demonstrate that CMM-MP significantly outperforms RDMA-based solutions in latency and throughput. We also evaluated real-world use cases of Valkey+YCSB and DiskANN using CMM-MP.

</details>


### [215] [BS-Spec: BFP-Based Bit-Sharing for Self-Speculative LLM Decoding with LUT-Driven Mixed-Precision Acceleration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22877)
*Jiwoo Kim,Gunho Park,Sunwoo Yoo,Baeseong Park,Dongsoo Lee,Youngjoo Lee*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出BS-Spec：基于块浮点(BFP)的位共享自推测解码框架，从单一BFP目标模型中按需加载权重量化高位与KV cache高位构造多档draft表示，结合离线校准的精度LUT与混合精度BFP加速器，实现负载感知的自适应推测解码，最高1.9×加速、相对位共享基线平均提升67.2%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM推理服务的批大小、上下文长度与性能需求差异大；传统推测解码需独立的draft模型及其KV cache，存储与访存开销高；现有自推测方法draft配置对负载不敏感，且混合精度执行效率低。

Method: 1) 利用BFP共享指数特性，通过部分加载权重与KV cache的最高有效位(MSB)从单一BFP目标模型直接派生多个draft表示，免去独立draft模型存储；2) 离线校准为每种服务场景(serving regime)选择使估计加速最大的权重精度与KV cache精度组合，运行时通过精度查找表应用；3) 设计混合精度BFP加速器，为draft与target计算提供基于LUT的可变精度数据通路。

Result: 相比传统自回归解码最高实现1.9×加速；相比所评估的位共享自推测解码基线，平均加速比提升67.2%。

Conclusion: 结果表明，将位共享、精度自适应与专用硬件进行协同设计，可有效适配多样化LLM推理负载，验证了软硬件协同路线的收益。

Abstract: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across diverse inference services, serving workloads span a wide range of batch sizes, context lengths, and performance requirements. Speculative decoding improves inference throughput, but conventional approaches require a separate draft model and KV cache, while existing self-speculative methods suffer from workload-insensitive draft configurations and inefficient mixed-precision execution.
  In this paper, we present BS-Spec, a block floating point (BFP)-based bit-sharing framework that jointly optimizes draft construction, workload-aware precision selection, and hardware execution. BS-Spec derives multiple draft representations directly from a single BFP target model by partially loading the most significant bits of weights and the KV cache while preserving shared exponents, eliminating separate draft-model storage. Offline calibration selects the weight and KV-cache precision pair that maximizes estimated speedup for each serving regime, and a precision lookup table applies the selected configuration at runtime. To support this adaptive execution, we design a mixed-precision BFP accelerator with a lookup table (LUT)-based variable-precision datapath for both draft and target computation. Experimental results show that BS-Spec achieves up to $1.9\times$ speedup over conventional autoregressive decoding and improves speedup over the evaluated bit-sharing self-speculative decoding baselines by $67.2\%$ on average, demonstrating the benefits of jointly co-designing bit sharing, precision adaptation, and specialized hardware for diverse LLM serving workloads.

</details>


### [216] [qGAMMA: A Framework for Optimal DNN Mapping on Multi-Precision Accelerators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23222)
*Leandro Fiorin,Luigi Altamura,Cristina Silvano*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: qGAMMA：面向通用空间加速器的混合精度DNN映射探索与优化框架，基于领域特定遗传算法与硬件综合驱动的解析性能模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 混合精度DNN在支持多种定点/浮点精度的通用空间加速器上部署时，映射方案与加速器配置组合空间巨大，缺乏有效手段在性能、能效与资源利用率之间寻找最优权衡。

Method: 构建灵活的框架qGAMMA，采用领域特定遗传算法在设计空间中搜索，并配合基于硬件综合结果的解析性能模型进行快速评估，从而联合优化DNN到加速器的映射及加速器配置。

Result: 在多种DNN工作负载上的广泛评估表明，qGAMMA可识别使目标指标最小化的最优映射与加速器配置，并为混合精度应用设计提供有价值的设计洞察。

Conclusion: qGAMMA可作为混合精度DNN与通用空间加速器协同设计的有效工具，帮助实现性能、能效与资源利用率之间的更优权衡。

Abstract: This work describes qGAMMA, a flexible framework for exploring and optimizing the mapping of mixed-precision Deep Neural Network (DNN) models onto general-purpose spatial accelerators that support a range of fixed- and floating-point precisions. qGAMMA navigates the design space using a domain-specific genetic algorithm and an analytical performance model based on hardware synthesis results. The framework identifies the optimal mapping and accelerator configuration that minimizes target metrics. Extensive evaluations across DNN workloads show that qGAMMA offers valuable insights for designing mixed-precision applications, enabling better trade-offs between performance, energy efficiency, and resource utilization.

</details>


### [217] [GUMPIM: Unitary and Malleable Memory for Processing-in-Memory with Guaranteed PIM Pages](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23406)
*Yilong Zhao,Fangxin Liu,Yiwei Hu,Zongwu Wang,Mingyu Gao,Onur Mutlu,He Xian,Hanlin Dong,Naifeng Jing,Xiaoyao Liang,Haibing Guan,Qiang Xu,Chixiao Chen,Shuxue Quan,Tao Yang,Li Jiang*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出GUMPIM，一种让交错CPU页与非交错PIM页在统一可塑内存空间中共存并保证PIM页分配的PIM系统，实现零拷贝卸载、保持CPU内存带宽，端到端加速2.3倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DRAM-based PIM可突破"内存墙"，但内存交错与虚拟内存限制了PIM单元可见的连续数据规模，从而约束PIM任务粒度。已有方案通过隔离PIM内存或关闭内存交错来缓解，却牺牲CPU内存带宽并引入额外数据搬运，形成新的"系统内存墙"。

Method: 1) 双轨内存管理：CPU页与PIM页独立进行页分配与地址转换；2) 在PIM DRAM上设计GUMPIM接口硬件，针对两类页的不同数据布局提供动态地址映射；3) PIM辅助的页迁移机制，在保持CPU访问带宽的前提下透明迁移页面，实现有保证且加速的PIM页分配；不改动商用DRAM标准，硬件改动仅在DRAM侧。

Result: CPU工作负载性能下降仅<0.1%；PIM工作负载中内存分配与CPU部分计算时间分别降低2.7倍和4.93倍；相对SOTA基线系统端到端加速2.3倍。

Conclusion: GUMPIM通过统一可塑内存空间与DRAM侧地址映射，在不牺牲CPU带宽的前提下解决PIM页分配约束，兼容现有CPU，可直接部署于HBMx/LPDDRx类PIM平台。

Abstract: DRAM-based Processing-in-Memory (PIM) addresses the "memory wall" by executing computations directly inside main memory. However, memory interleaving and virtual memory limit contiguous data size visible to PIM units, constraining PIM task granularity. To mitigate this, existing PIM systems drastically isolate PIM memory or disable memory interleaving. These design choices, however, decrease the CPU memory bandwidth and introduce extra data transfer, leading to an additional "system memory wall" that must be resolved to realize PIM's full potential.
  In this work, we propose GUMPIM, a PIM system that allows interleaved CPU pages and non-interleaved PIM pages to coexist in a Unitary and Malleable memory space with Guaranteed PIM page allocation. GUMPIM enables zero-copy during PIM task offloading and maintains CPU memory bandwidth while ensuring low PIM offloading overhead. First, we propose a dual-track memory management mechanism consisting of independent page allocation and address translation for CPU and PIM pages. Second, we design GUMPIM interface hardware on PIM-enabled DRAMs to provide a dynamic address mapping for the different data layouts of CPU and PIM pages. Third, we propose a PIM-assisted page migration mechanism that transparently migrates pages while preserving CPU access bandwidth, thereby enabling guaranteed and accelerated PIM page allocation. GUMPIM requires no changes to commodity DRAM standards; all hardware modifications are limited to the DRAM side, ensuring full compatibility with existing CPUs and enabling immediate deployment on current HBMx- and LPDDRx-based PIM platforms. Our results show only <0.1% performance degradation for CPU workloads on GUMPIM. For PIM workloads, GUMPIM reduces memory allocation and CPU-part computation times by 2.7x and 4.93x, respectively, yielding an end-to-end 2.3x speedup over a state-of-the-art baseline system.

</details>


### [218] [HBFSim: A Simulator for Exploring HBF in Memory Hierarchies for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23503)
*Jinheng Li,Guosheng Wang,Hongchao Du,Shangyu Wu,Qiao Li,Chun Jason Xue*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: 提出LLM感知的事件驱动模拟器HBFSim，统一建模HBM、HBF（主机管理FTL）与传统容量层，量化HBF在LLM推理中的地位与寿命。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: HBF（High Bandwidth Flash）可在加速器本地提供TB级容量、带宽接近HBM且单位比特成本更优，但NAND固有的长延迟、异地更新与有限写寿命被直接引入加速器存储层次，其对性能与器件寿命的影响难以预测，缺乏研究该设计空间的工具。

Method: 设计并实现HBFSim：面向异构HBM+HBF存储系统的LLM感知事件驱动模拟器，在保持应用级内存语义的同时刻画flash内部行为；将HBM、带主机管理FTL的HBF及常规容量层纳入同一模拟框架，并由经校准的serving前端驱动。以Llama-3.1-70B与Qwen3-235B-A22B解码为负载，在三种不同输入/输出长度的工作负载下开展实验。

Result: 对于放不进HBM的数据，HBF比主机DRAM快11.0–19.0倍；HBM用于存放运行序列的KV cache优于作为HBF的缓存；在Llama-3.1-70B已发表的峰值负载下，HBF寿命为2.0–6.9年，并与分担KV写入的堆栈数量成正比。

Conclusion: HBF是有前景的HBM容量扩展层，但其价值取决于数据放置策略（KV cache优先占用HBM）与写入寿命约束；HBFSim为HBM+HBF异构存储设计空间提供了可复现的研究基础设施，并将随公开器件数据持续更新。

Abstract: High Bandwidth Flash (HBF) has recently emerged as a promising technology that provides terabyte-scale accelerator-local capacity at bandwidths approaching HBM, with a potential cost-per-bit advantage over HBM. However, its NAND foundation brings long latency, out-of-place updates, and finite write endurance directly into the accelerator memory hierarchy, making its effects on performance and lifetime difficult to predict. To study this emerging design space, we present HBFSim, an LLM-aware event-driven simulator for heterogeneous HBM+HBF memory systems that preserves application-level memory semantics while modeling flash-internal behavior. HBFSim models HBM, HBF with host-managed flash translation, and conventional capacity tiers in one simulation driven by a calibrated serving frontend. Using HBFSim, we study decoding of Llama-3.1-70B and Qwen3-235B-A22B under three workloads that differ in their input and output lengths. HBF serves data that does not fit in HBM 11.0--19.0$\times$ faster than host DRAM; HBM is better used to hold the running sequences' KV cache than as a cache for HBF; and at a published peak load of Llama-3.1-70B, HBF lasts 2.0 to 6.9 years, in proportion to the stacks that share the KV writes. The artifact is available at https://github.com/FlashLabAE/HBFSim and will track public HBF device data as it becomes available.

</details>


### [219] [Agentic AI for Heterogeneous System Design Across Chip, Scale-Up, and Scale-Out Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23724)
*Murali Emani,Kashyap R Manjusha*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: ArchAgent：面向AI/HPC系统异构设计的分层多智能体搜索框架，用LLM规划器分解芯片/纵向/横向扩展子问题并由确定性解析评估器闭环，仅18次评估即在1MW功耗预算下取得1.93x加权几何平均加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代AI/HPC系统设计空间横跨GPU、数据流处理器、RISC-V加速器等多种计算架构，HBM/GDDR/SRAM等存储技术，以及NVLink、UALink、Infinity Fabric、InfiniBand、Slingshot、Ultra Ethernet等互连；没有任何单一架构能同时最优适配LLM训练、LLM推理与AI耦合HPC负载，组合空间过大，难以人工穷举搜索。

Method: 提出分层多智能体框架ArchAgent：LLM规划器将系统设计分解为chip、scale-up、scale-out三个子问题，分别交由专家智能体处理；引入确定性解析评估器形成闭环，保证所有性能估计均来自解析模型而非LLM生成，从而避免LLM幻觉带来的评估偏差。

Result: 在1MW功耗预算下的混合AI+HPC负载上，ArchAgent发现异构设计，相对同构GPU基线取得1.93x加权几何平均加速；仅需18次评估，而爬山法需100次评估、仅得1.65x加速。

Conclusion: 将LLM的语义分解能力与确定性解析模型评估相结合，可在超大系统设计空间中高效定位高质量异构方案，显著优于无结构的启发式搜索，且评估开销更低。

Abstract: The design space of modern AI/HPC systems has expanded rapidly across compute architectures, including GPUs, dataflow processors, and RISC-V accelerators; memory tech- nologies, including HBM, GDDR, and SRAM; and interconnects such as NVLink, UALink, Infinity Fabric, InfiniBand, Slingshot, and Ultra Ethernet. No single architecture is optimal across LLM training, LLM serving, and AI-coupled HPC workloads, while the resulting combinatorial design space is too large for manual exploration. We present ArchAgent, a hierarchical multi- agent framework in which an LLM-based planner decomposes system design into chip, scale-up, and scale-out subproblems, each handled by specialist agents. A deterministic analytical evaluator closes the loop, ensuring that all performance estimates are derived from analytical models rather than generated by the LLM. On a mixed AI+HPC workload under a 1 MW power budget, ArchAgent discovers heterogeneous designs that achieve a 1.93x weighted geometric mean speedup over a homogeneous GPU baseline, while requiring only 18 evaluations compared with 100 evaluations for hill climbing, which achieves 1.65x speedup.

</details>


### [220] [TileDRAM: Compiler-Controlled Tile-to-DRAM Layouts for 3D DRAM GPGPUs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23767)
*Guangyuan Xu,Lanxuan Zhang,Ziyang Li,Zhaoshi Li,Yajun Ha*

Main category: cs.AR

TL;DR: TileDRAM 提出将 tile-to-DRAM 布局作为编译器可见抽象，把 GPU Linear Layout 从计算侧映射扩展到 DRAM 放置坐标，按 tile 访问签名选择布局，在不新增硬件的前提下显著降低 row-buffer 冲突并加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代 GPU 编译器已有丰富的布局抽象用于张量到线程及片上资源的映射，但计算单元本地（CU-local）3D DRAM 架构缺少对应抽象来描述操作数 tile 数据在 DRAM 地址空间中的排布。缺少该抽象时，在既有 DRAM 地址映射下做常规放置会使结构化 tile 访问遭遇严重的 row-buffer 冲突。

Method: 提出 TileDRAM 编译器—运行时工具链：将 tile-to-DRAM 布局引入为编译器可见抽象；把 GPU Linear Layout 抽象从计算侧映射目标扩展到 DRAM 放置坐标；以重复出现的 tile 局部访问行为为特化单元，按 tile 访问签名逐 tile 选择布局；由于 row-buffer 局部性依赖有序请求历史，候选布局在固定 DRAM 地址映射下按其 row-buffer 行为进行评估；选定布局下的访问通过普通地址算术实现，无需新的地址重映射硬件或 ISA 支持。

Result: 在 Accel-Sim/Ramulator2 上对 108 个 MoE FFN 用例做全轨迹重放：请求加权 row-conflict 率由 75.7% 降至 15.2%，几何平均加速 1.77x；将 6 条 trace 迁移到 6 种 3D DRAM 组织，在同一编译器抽象下取得 2.20x 几何平均加速；在 RTX 3090 上地址变换仅带来 0.17% 的几何平均额外开销。

Conclusion: tile-to-DRAM 布局可作为编译器级抽象有效指导 DRAM 放置，在 3D DRAM 组织变化下具备可移植性，且开销可忽略，说明以编译器抽象手段解决结构化 tile 访问的 row-buffer 冲突是可行且高效的。

Abstract: Modern GPU compilers expose rich layout abstractions for mapping tensors to threads and on-chip resources, but compute-unit-local (CU-local) 3D DRAM architectures lack a corresponding abstraction for specifying how operand-tile data are
  arranged within the DRAM address space. Without such an abstraction, conventional placement under the existing DRAM address mapping can subject structured tile accesses to severe row-buffer conflicts. We present TileDRAM, a compiler-runtime
  toolchain that introduces tile-to-DRAM layouts as a compiler-visible abstraction for DRAM placement. TileDRAM extends the GPU Linear Layout abstraction from compute-side mapping targets to DRAM placement coordinates and selects layouts per
  tile access signature, using recurring tile-local access behavior as the specialization unit. Since row-buffer locality depends on ordered request history, TileDRAM evaluates candidate layouts through their row-buffer behavior under fixed
  DRAM address mappings. Accesses under the selected layouts are realized through ordinary address arithmetic, without new address-remapping hardware or ISA support. In full-trace replay on Accel-Sim/Ramulator2 across 108 mixture-of-experts
  (MoE) feed-forward network (FFN) cases, TileDRAM reduces the request-weighted row-conflict rate from 75.7% to 15.2% and achieves a 1.77x geomean speedup. Retargeting six traces to six 3D DRAM organizations yields a 2.20x geomean speedup
  under the same compiler abstraction. On an RTX 3090, address transformation adds 0.17% geomean overhead over identity.

</details>


<div id='physics.app-ph'></div>

# physics.app-ph [[Back]](#toc)

### [221] [Maximizing Smith-Purcell radiation intensity via multi-parameter optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22866)
*Xiaojie Yang,Shichao Zhao,Xinyu Liu,Suguo Chen,Yue Wang,Ping Zhang,Zhigang Lu,Zhanliang Wang,Sunchao Huang,Yubin Gong*

Main category: physics.app-ph

TL;DR: 本文通过PIC模拟系统优化Smith-Purcell辐射的栅极周期、电子动能和占空比，在0.4/0.5/0.6 THz下实现强度增强，并给出紧凑型太赫兹源的设计准则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Smith-Purcell辐射是太赫兹光-物质相互作用与紧凑源的重要平台，而强度增强是其核心诉求，亟需系统性的参数优化规律。

Method: 采用粒子网格（PIC）模拟，在0.4、0.5、0.6 THz三个频率下，占空比从0.1扫描至0.9，优化栅极周期与电子动能，以基线为参照分析强度增强规律。

Result: 辐射强度对栅极周期呈单峰依赖，三个频率下峰值增强分别达96、34、17.5倍；最优占空比随频率升高由0.2移至0.4。

Conclusion: 最优占空比随频率上移源于固定长度条件下相干叠加与束-波耦合之间的权衡，结果为紧凑型台式太赫兹源提供系统设计指南。

Abstract: Smith Purcell radiation offers a versatile platform for terahertz light matter interactions and compact source development, with intensity enhancement as a key priority. Using particle in cell simulations across a duty cycle range of from 0.1 to 0.9 at 0.4, 0.5, and 0.6 THz, we optimize the grating period, electron kinetic energy and duty cycle. The intensity exhibits a unimodal dependence on the grating period at all three frequencies, with peak enhancements of 96, 34, and 17.5 fold relative to our reference baseline . The optimal duty cycle shifts from 0.2 to 0.4 with increasing frequency, a trend arising from the trade off between coherent superposition and beam-wave coupling under fixed length conditions. These results provide systematic design guidelines for compact tabletop terahertz sources.

</details>

# physics.optics [[Back]](#toc)

### [222] [Ultra-stable laser with sub-Hz intrinsic linewidth using a silicon photonic chip](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22596)
*Mohamad Hossein Idjadi,Haotian Cheng,Benjia Li,Tzu-Yung Huang,Kwangwoong Kim,Naijun Jin,Peter T. Rakich*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出一种集成了无调制激光频率稳定技术的电光自注入锁定(EOSIL)方案，与Q值达3.46E9的紧凑真空隙微法布里-珀罗腔(uFP)单片集成，在硅光芯片上实现基础线宽58 mHz的超稳激光，1秒积分时间频率不稳定度为8.68E-13。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 商用DFB半导体激光器频率噪声大、线宽宽，难以满足超稳激光需求；需在紧凑芯片尺度上实现低噪声、窄线宽激光源，同时逼近uFP腔的热噪声极限。

Method: 采用电光自注入锁定(EOSIL)芯片方案，结合无调制激光频率稳定技术，与高Q值(3.46E9)真空隙微法布里-珀罗腔(uFP)共集成；芯片基于Advanced Micro Foundry标准硅光工艺制造，面积10 mm²。

Result: 在1 Hz偏移处将商用DFB激光器频率噪声功率谱密度抑制超过110 dB，接近uFP腔理论热噪声极限；实现基础线宽58 mHz，1 s平均时间分数频率不稳定度8.68E-13。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了硅光芯片上EOSIL与高Q uFP腔集成的可行性，为标准工艺、小尺寸下实现亚赫兹线宽超稳激光提供了一条可扩展路径。

Abstract: Here, we demonstrate a novel optical self-injection-locking scheme integrated with a modulation-free laser frequency stabilization technique co-integrated with a compact vacuum-gap micro-Fabry-Perot cavity (uFP), with Q-factor of 3.46E9, to realize an ultra-stable laser with sub-Hz fundamental linewidth using a silicon photonic chip. The demonstrated electro-optic self-injection locking (EOSIL) chip suppresses a commercial DFB diode laser's frequency noise power spectral density by more than 110 dB at 1 Hz offset, approaching the theoretical thermal noise limit of the uFP cavity, and enables a laser fundamental linewidth of 58 mHz with a fractional frequency instability of 8.68E-13 at 1 sec averaging time. The chip is fabricated using the Advanced Micro Foundry standard silicon photonic process and occupies a footprint of 10 mm^2.

</details>


### [223] [Trapping of nanofabricated SiO$_2$ high-aspect-ratio discs in an optical lattice](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22614)
*Shelby Klomp,Shafaq Gulzar Elahi,Scott Grudichak,Chethn Galla,Zhiyuan Wang,Mark Nguyen,George Winstone,Katarina Boskovic Guy,Emma Derrick,Maddox Wroblewski,Jacob Sprague,Andrew Laeuger,Jackson Larsen,Nancy Aggarwal,Shane L. Larson,Andrew A. Geraci*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文报道了将光刻制备的高纵横比（直径10 μm、厚400 nm）二氧化硅圆盘高效装载进真空中光驻波阱，并用干涉与成像方法测得质心运动谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 盘状粒子在光阱中被认为是高频引力波探测器和灵敏加速度计的潜在候选，需要可晶圆级量产、几何与尺寸可定制的微纳颗粒及其高效光学装载与表征手段。

Method: 采用光刻（lithography）制备高纵横比SiO₂圆盘，将其装载入真空中的光驻波阱；结合干涉测量与成像方法获取圆盘质心运动的运动谱。

Result: 实现了少粒子量级（约几颗）的高效装载与光俘获，并获得圆盘质心运动谱；颗粒几何与尺寸可按需定制且兼容晶圆级纳米加工。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了基于光刻定制圆盘的高效光阱装载与运动谱测量方案，为面向高频引力波探测或加速度计应用的盘状光机械振子提供了可行技术路径。

Abstract: We describe the nanofabrication and loading of lithographically patterned, high aspect ratio $10$ $μ$m diameter silicon dioxide discs with thickness of $400$ nm into an optical standing wave trap in vacuum. We obtain motional spectra of the center of mass motion of the discs using a combination of interferometric and imaging methods. The method is capable of high-efficiency loading and optical trapping using small numbers of objects, of the order of a few particles, with customized geometries and sizes compatible with wafer scale nanofabrication methods. Disc-like particles in optical traps have been identified as promising candidates for detectors of high frequency gravitational waves or as sensitive accelerometers.

</details>


### [224] [Development of a fabrication-to-benchtop process for SiN-based quantum devices](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22776)
*Connor Kupchak,Abubaker Tareki,Tara Moradi,Patrick Laferriere,Niall Tait,Khaled Mnaymneh*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文提出一套从器件制备到光学表征的氮化硅(SiN)全流程开发方案，基于自研的化学计量比工艺，系统表征光学损耗与材料特性，并利用实测折射率建模并仿真微环谐振腔中的光孤子产生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 氮化硅是未来发展量子通信与量子计算器件的关键材料，但缺乏覆盖"制备—表征"全链条的完整开发流程，制约器件向下一阶段推进；全流程可控并结合器件建模，可实现更高效、及时的迭代与优化。

Method: 采用实验室自研的化学计量比(SiN)配方进行器件制备；对器件的光学损耗与材料性能开展全面表征；精确测定并控制折射率，用于预测器件几何结构与群折射率；将实测折射率代入微环谐振腔模型进行仿真验证。

Result: 完成了器件制备与光学损耗、材料特性的综合表征，获得可用于几何与群折射率预测的折射率数据；基于实测折射率仿真微环谐振腔，并演示其在光孤子产生方面的应用潜力。

Conclusion: 建立了一条从fabrication到benchtop的闭环开发流程，实测折射率对器件设计建模至关重要；该流程可支撑量子光子器件的快速迭代，并验证了微环谐振腔光孤子产生的可行性。

Abstract: Silicon nitride has emerged as a key material for the advancement of future quantum communication and computational devices. However, challenges persist in establishing a comprehensive development process, spanning from fabrication to optical characterization, essential for advancing these devices to their next stage of potential. Maintaining control over the entire process, from start to finish, alongside device modeling, enables more efficient and timely iteration and optimization. Here we introduce a fabrication-to-benchtop process. We employ an in-house stoichiometric recipe for device fabrication and conduct comprehensive characterization of optical losses and material properties. Understanding and controlling the refractive index of the device are vital for predicting device geometries and group indices. Implementing the refractive indices of our fabricated devices, we simulate microring resonators and demonstrate their application in generating optical solitons.

</details>


### [225] [Programming the Nonlinear Optics of a Nanoporous Photonic Metamaterial by Confined Crystallization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22801)
*Andrii Z. Maxym,Junhui Lang,Bouchta Sahraoui,Anatoliy S. Andrushchak,Yaroslav Shchur,Olha Kityk,Robert Wielgosz,Monika Lelonek,Piotr Pawlik,Patrick Huber,Jaroslaw Jedryka,Andriy V. Kityk*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 通过在阳极氧化铝(AAO)纳米通道中填充非中心对称分子晶体苄基(BZL)，并利用结晶路径调控其取向，可将每个纳米通道转变为非线性光学"超原子"；自由膜中呈现近各向同性SHG，而从体相晶层诱导结晶则实现亚毫米畴的宏观各向异性有效极化率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纳米通道尺寸远小于光波长时，光学响应由结构构架而非组成材料决定，因此希望借助受限结晶来"写入"非线性光学超材料的有效极化率张量，并厘清几何限域与界面层对SHG的影响机制。

Method: 以AAO为模板填充BZL分子晶体形成非线性超原子；比较自由悬浮膜(各通道独立固化、取向无关联)与以体相BZL层诱导结晶(取向在亚毫米尺度对齐)两种结晶路径；采用核-壳模型分析界面非活性层；系统改变通道直径(32–270 nm)跨越亚波长极限。

Result: 自由膜中有效SHG响应近偏振各向同性，其幅值符合核-壳模型——2.6 nm的光学非活性界面层削减有效活性体积；该值在裸氧化铝上重现了此前在烷基接枝二氧化硅上得到的数值，表明存在"宿主不敏感"极限。晶种诱导结晶使超原子在亚毫米畴内对齐，产生宏观各向异性有效极化率；异常定向SHG发射仅局限于超材料极限内。

Conclusion: 受限结晶为非线性光学超材料提供了一条途径，其有效极化率张量可在加工过程中被"写入"；同时界面对SHG的限制表现为与宿主材料无关的普适行为。

Abstract: A membrane traversed by a dense array of nanochannels acts as a photonic metamaterial: with channels far smaller than the wavelength of light, the optical response is set by the architecture rather than by the constituent materials. Here each nanochannel is turned into a nonlinear optical meta-atom by filling anodic aluminum oxide (AAO) with benzil (BZL), a noncentrosymmetric molecular crystal, and the crystallization pathway programs their orientation. In free-standing membranes every channel solidifies independently, the orientations remain uncorrelated, and the effective second-harmonic generation (SHG) response is nearly polarization isotropic; its magnitude follows a core - shell model in which an optically inactive interfacial layer of 2.6 nm reduces the active volume of each meta-atom, reproducing on bare alumina the value previously found on alkyl-grafted silica and indicating a host-insensitive limit. Seeding crystallization from a bulk benzil layer instead aligns the meta-atoms over submillimeter domains and produces a macroscopically anisotropic effective susceptibility. Channel diameters from 32 to 270 nm span the transition out of the subwavelength regime, and the anomalous directional SHG emission reported here is confined to the metamaterial limit. Confined crystallization thus offers a route to nonlinear optical metamaterials whose effective susceptibility tensor is written during processing.

</details>


### [226] [Wavelength Diversity Expands the Expressive Power of Optical Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23070)
*Shiqi Chen,Che-Yung Shen,Parnian Ghapandar Kashani,Yongkang Cheng,Aydogan Ozcan*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 该论文提出利用波长多样性（wavelength diversity）增强光学函数逼近的表达能力：共享相位编码器在不同波长下产生傅里叶特征，多个波长共同参与每个输出函数的表示，而非独立计算通道。理论给出标度律与逼近误差界，数值上相比同规模单色光学处理器MSE降低逾100倍，实验在五波长照明下单层衍射处理器上同时逼近4,136个不同非线性函数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经网络通用函数逼近能力依赖对非线性关系的表示，但在光学硬件中实现该能力需设计光所编码的计算特征。现有光学处理器多以单色光工作，表达性受限于输入编码谐波数量；作者希望寻找一种不增加输入谐波数即可提升表达性的物理资源。

Method: 提出由共享相位编码器产生"波长缩放傅里叶特征"（wavelength-scaled Fourier features）的架构，使不同照明波长映射为不同尺度的谐波分量并共同合成单一输出函数；推导理论标度律与逼近误差界，分析非色散编码器下光谱端点决定可及计算带宽、中间波长在该带宽内丰富可用谐波；开展实值与复值非线性函数的数值研究，并制作紧凑单层衍射处理器在五波长照明下进行实验验证。

Result: 理论给出波长多样性与表达性/误差界的标度关系；数值实验显示代表性设计在相同可训练相位特征数下，均方误差较测试的单色光学处理器降低100倍以上；实验验证了逼近精度提升，并在五波长照明下单层衍射处理器上同时逼近4,136个不同非线性函数。

Conclusion: 波长多样性可作为光学计算中扩展表达能力的额外物理资源，在不增加输入编码谐波的前提下提升并行非线性函数逼近的精度与规模，为可扩展光学计算提供新维度。

Abstract: Universal function approximation underpins neural networks' capacity to represent nonlinear relationships, but realizing this capability in optical hardware requires engineering the computational features encoded in light. Here, we show that wavelength diversity enhances optical function-approximation expressivity through wavelength-scaled Fourier features generated by a shared phase encoder, without increasing the number of input-encoded harmonics. Multiple wavelengths contribute to the representation of each output function rather than merely serving as independent computational channels. We establish theoretical scaling laws and approximation-error bounds, revealing that, for nondispersive encoders, the spectral endpoints determine the accessible computational bandwidth, while intermediate illumination wavelengths enrich the available harmonics within that bandwidth. Numerical studies demonstrate improved approximation of real- and complex-valued nonlinear functions, with a representative design achieving more than a 100-fold reduction in mean-squared error relative to tested monochromatic optical processors with the same number of trainable phase features. Experimentally, we validate enhanced approximation accuracy and demonstrate the simultaneous approximation of 4,136 distinct nonlinear functions using a compact, single-layer diffractive processor under five-wavelength illumination. These results establish wavelength diversity as an additional physical resource for scaling the expressive power of optical computing and enhancing the accuracy of parallel nonlinear function approximation.

</details>


### [227] [Thermalization-induced self-polarization of temporally incoherent light: A nonequilibrium wave turbulence kinetic approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23061)
*L. Zanaglia,J. Garnier,M. Ferraro,T. Torres,C. Michel,V. Doya,G. Millot,S. Wabnitz,I. Carusotto,A. Picozzi*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 在弱双折射单模光纤的一维时间动力学中，光的热化过程导致非相干波发生自发自极化：极化涨落被持续转移至局部RJ平衡态的高频尾部，形成绝热冷却，使有效温度沿传播降低、偏振度升高，最终趋于完全偏振。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 保守非线性波通常不可逆地热化至Rayleigh–Jeans平衡态；此前的光热化实验研究集中于二维横向空间动力学，而一维时间动力学下的热化后果（尤其对偏振自由度的作用）尚不清楚，作者希望揭示热化是否驱动自组织。

Method: 以弱双折射单模光纤中非相干光的一维时间传播为平台，在波湍流理论框架下分析热化动力学，识别出绝热冷却过程：极化涨落向局部RJ平衡态的高频尾部输运，等价于有效温度随传播下降。

Result: 光热化导致传播过程中非相干波的自极化；有效温度沿传播递减、偏振度单调上升；当时间域缺乏高频截断（无法正则化紫外灾变）时，偏振度持续增长并最终趋近于1。

Conclusion: 从热力学角度看，光场演化至偏振态是有利的，这为远离热平衡的保守哈密顿系统中的自发自组织现象提供了新视角。

Abstract: Conservative nonlinear waves generally undergo an irreversible process of thermalization toward the Rayleigh--Jeans (RJ) equilibrium state. Light thermalization has recently been experimentally investigated in the two-dimensional transverse spatial dynamics of multimode waveguides. Here, we consider the one-dimensional temporal dynamics of incoherent light propagating in a weakly birefringent single-mode fiber. We show that light thermalization is responsible for a self-polarization of the incoherent wave during its propagation. Within the framework of wave turbulence theory, we show that this phenomenon originates from a nonequilibrium process of adiabatic cooling: polarization fluctuations are continuously transferred toward the high-frequency tails of a local RJ equilibrium state, whose effective temperature decreases during propagation, thereby increasing the degree of light polarization. Moreover, in the absence of a high-frequency cut-off that would regularize the ultraviolet catastrophe in the temporal domain, the optical wave exhibits an ever-increasing degree of polarization, ultimately approaching unity. These results show that it is thermodynamically advantageous for the optical field to evolve toward a polarized state, which provides new insight into spontaneous self-organization phenomena in conservative Hamiltonian systems operating far from thermodynamic equilibrium.

</details>


### [228] [A compact, dual-colour chirped-pulse laser system for field-deployable coherent Rayleigh-Brillouin scattering diagnostics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23549)
*Yingjie Zhao,Gabriel M. Flores Alfaro,Carmen Pascual-Fort,Gabi-Daniel Stancu,Alexandros Gerakis*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 本文报道了一套紧凑便携式双色、频率与脉宽捷变激光系统，满足单发相干瑞利-布里渊散射（CRBS）需求，并以大气等离子体射流中性数密度测量与二维温度场成像完成验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单发CRBS诊断需要双色、频率与脉宽快速可调的激光系统，但现有方案仅限实验室布局，难以外场部署。

Method: 采用主从种子激光集成设计实现稳定频率啁啾；光纤耦合AOM门控脉冲整形提升长期热稳定性；定制化放大级集成于坚固便携机箱，简化准直与维护。

Result: 单臂输出能量达450 mJ，啁啾率约22 MHz/ns，可在约25 ns至1 μs范围内实现任意时间波形；通过测量大气等离子体射流的中性数密度并构建二维温度分布图完成验证。

Conclusion: 该便携激光系统达到实验室级诊断性能，可支撑CRBS的现场化应用。

Abstract: Single-shot coherent Rayleigh-Brillouin scattering (CRBS) requires dual colour, frequency, and pulse duration agile laser systems, currently available only in laboratory layouts. In this work, we present a compact, portable, and robust next generation laser system that meets all of these requirements. Key features include an integrated master-slave seed laser design for stable frequency chirping, fiber-coupled acousto-optic modulator (AOM) gated pulse shaping for long-term thermal stability, and customized amplification stages in a rugged, portable enclosure which simplifiy the alignment and maintenance process. The system in this implementation can deliver up to $450$~mJ per arm, chirp rates up to $\sim22$~MHz$/$ns, and arbitrary temporal profiles within $\sim25$~ns to $\sim1$~$μ$s. This laser system is validated by measuring the neutral number density of an atmospheric plasma jet, and a two-dimensional temperature map is constructed, demonstrating lab-grade diagnostics for field deployment.

</details>


### [229] [Noise suppression of quantum frequency conversion in thin-film lithium niobate waveguides via adapted poling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23575)
*Ian Briggs,Pao-Kang Chen,Jiaqi Huang,Linran Fan*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 在薄膜铌酸锂波导中采用"适配极化"（adapted poling），在19±0.8 mW片上泵浦下实现最大转换效率，相比常规周期极化泵浦功率降低8 dB、总转换噪声降低14 dB，并将噪声机制由级联SHG/Stokes拉曼主导转为直接反Stokes自发拉曼散射主导，噪声随泵浦功率的标度由二次转为线性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量子频率转换（QFC）用于连接异质量子系统，但"高效率"与"低噪声"难以兼得：常规周期极化器件需较高泵浦功率，噪声随泵浦功率快速增长。作者希望在不牺牲转换效率的前提下降低泵浦需求并抑制噪声。

Method: 在2 cm长薄膜铌酸锂（TFLN）波导中采用适配极化结构设计，并与常规周期极化器件对比；在不同泵浦条件与器件构型下进行受控测量，分析转换效率对应的泵浦功率需求及噪声随泵浦功率的标度关系，并识别主导噪声来源。

Result: 适配极化器件在片上泵浦功率19±0.8 mW时达到最大转换效率；在各自最大转换工作点比较，泵浦功率降低8 dB，总转换噪声降低14 dB。噪声标度由周期极化器件的近似二次关系转变为适配极化器件的近似线性关系；主导机制由级联二次谐波产生（SHG）与Stokes自发拉曼散射，转为直接反Stokes自发拉曼散射。

Conclusion: 适配极化可有效降低泵浦需求并抑制非线性噪声，使噪声标度更平缓，为量子网络提供低噪声集成频率转换器件的可行技术路径。

Abstract: Quantum frequency conversion (QFC) enables optical interfaces between dissimilar quantum systems, but suppressing noise while maintaining high conversion efficiency remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate that adapted poling in thin-film lithium niobate (TFLN) waveguides reduces the pump-power requirement while shifting the dominant noise mechanism and its power scaling. In 2-cm-long waveguides, adapted poling enables maximum conversion efficiency at an on-chip pump power of $19\pm0.8$~mW, reducing the required pump power by 8~dB and the total conversion noise by 14~dB relative to conventional periodic poling at their respective maximum-conversion operating points. Controlled measurements with different pump conditions and device configurations reveal a transition from predominantly quadratic noise scaling in periodically poled devices to predominantly linear scaling in adapted-poling devices. This transition accompanies a shift from noise dominated by cascaded second-harmonic generation and Stokes spontaneous Raman scattering to direct anti-Stokes spontaneous Raman scattering. These results establish adapted poling as an effective approach to suppressing nonlinear noise, enabling low-noise integrated frequency converters for quantum networks.

</details>


### [230] [Broadband chiroptical sensing with two-mode subwavelength grating waveguides](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23630)
*Albert A. Seredin,Roman S. Savelev*

Main category: physics.optics

TL;DR: 提出支持手性倏逝场的周期性介质波导，通过赝简并双模相互作用实现局域光学手性，并建立微扰理论及背景抑制方案以可靠提取手性响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在平面光子结构中构建局域光学手性，可实现对映介质的选择性与增强光-物质相互作用；需为集成光子器件（波导、超表面、谐振器）提供局域手性场的设计与表征基础。

Method: 采用近乎简并的两个波导模相互作用产生手性倏逝场；建立覆盖手性层的波导微扰理论，将手性诱导的模间耦合与传播常数修正关联到可测的模间功率转换与差分透射；对比对称波导（模失谐限制手性响应于窄谱范围）与非对称波导（模杂化使本征模在宽谱范围携带非零局域手性）；分析有损波导中模二色性产生的背景差分透射，并提出用相反结构不对称性的两支非对称波导对比传输来抑制该背景。

Result: 模失谐使对称波导的手性响应局限于窄谱段；非对称波导的模杂化使单个本征模在宽谱范围内具有非零局域手性；实际有损波导中的模二色性会产生显著背景差分透射信号，经两支相反不对称波导的传输比对可抑制该背景，从而可靠提取手性响应。

Conclusion: 该工作为发展具局域手性场的集成光子元件（波导、超表面、谐振器）提供了理论与设计基础。

Abstract: Engineering local optical chirality in planar photonic structures offers a route to selective and enhanced light-matter interactions with chiral media. Here, we introduce periodic dielectric waveguides that support chiral evanescent fields through the interaction of two nearly degenerate waveguide modes. We develop a perturbation theory for such a waveguide covered by a chiral layer, relating chirality-induced modal coupling and propagation-constant corrections to measurable intermodal power conversion and differential transmission. Whereas modal detuning confines the chiral response of a symmetric waveguide to a narrow spectral range, mode hybridization in an asymmetric waveguide creates individual eigenmodes that carry nonzero local chirality over a broad spectral range. We show that modal dichroism in realistic lossy waveguides can produce a significant background differential transmission signal. Such a background, however, can be suppressed by comparing transmission through two asymmetric waveguides with opposite structural asymmetries, allowing the chiral response to be reliably extracted. Together, these findings provide a basis for developing integrated photonic components with locally chiral fields, including waveguides, metasurfaces, and resonators.

</details>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [231] [When is a large language model a good calibration agent? Physics-labeled prompting for budgeted engineering simulator calibration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22379)
*Ruo-Qian Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究物理标注LLM作为昂贵仿真器校准代理：早期语义优势显著但短暂，提出LLM热启动+传统优化器的两阶段混合流程，9次仿真达目标精度，优于LLM单独(12)、Nelder-Mead(17)与贝叶斯优化(>60)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 昂贵工程仿真器的参数校准受计算成本严重约束；作者希望验证以大语言模型在"物理诊断描述"条件下能否比传统无导数优化器更高效地提出有信息量的参数更新。

Method: 在圆柱尾流大涡模拟与阻尼振子反问题两个测试案例上，将物理标注提示与四种文本消融（删除、匿名化、填充、误导）及标准优化器（Nelder-Mead、贝叶斯优化、CMA-ES、随机搜索）对比；提出LLM热启动、将累积评估交给传统优化器的两阶段数值延拓策略，并辅以敏感性分析验证测试案例。

Result: 25次试验中23次首个物理信息LLM提议即改进初始设计；5次评估后中位校准误差较无物理控制低21.9倍；该优势短暂，15次评估时消失；LLM解码器变异性导致9.8倍性能波动；混合流程9次仿真即达目标精度。

Conclusion: 物理标注LLM在严格评估预算下可作高效校准代理，但单独使用受限于优势短暂与解码随机性；以LLM热启动+传统优化器收尾的混合方案兼具早期语义引导与后期数值稳健性，是更可靠的实用折中。

Abstract: Calibrating expensive engineering simulators requires tuning model parameters to match reference data, a process heavily constrained by computational costs. This study investigates whether Large Language Models (LLMs), conditioned on physical diagnostic descriptions of simulation errors, can propose informative parameter updates more efficiently than conventional derivative-free optimizers. We test this on a cylinder-wake Large-Eddy Simulation and a damped-oscillator inverse problem. Physics-labeled prompts are evaluated against four text ablations (removed, anonymized, padded, misdirected) and standard optimizers (Nelder-Mead, Bayesian optimization, CMA-ES, and random search). Results demonstrate a strong early semantic advantage: the first physics-informed LLM proposal improves the initial design in 23 of 25 trials. After five evaluations, the median calibration error is 21.9 times lower than physics-free controls. However, this advantage is transient - disappearing by fifteen evaluations - and inherent LLM decoder variability yields a 9.8-fold performance spread. To address this, we introduce a hybrid workflow that uses the LLM as a warm-start, passing accumulated evaluations to a conventional optimizer. This two-stage numerical continuation policy reaches target accuracy in just 9 simulator runs, outperforming the LLM alone (12 runs), Nelder-Mead (17 runs), and Bayesian optimization (>60 runs). Supported by sensitivity analysis validating the test cases, this hybrid physics-labeled LLM scheme proves highly effective as a calibration agent under strict evaluation budgets.

</details>


### [232] [Trust but Verify: Designing Region-Inhomogeneous Forward Dynamics for Discrete Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22380)
*Gunmay Jhingran*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将吸收式与均匀混合式加噪核按区域差异化组合，并配以推理期噪声重注入采样器，使掩码扩散模型获得"中间信任"能力，从而检测并抵抗被污染的上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有离散语言扩散普遍采用吸收式（absorbing）损坏，生成过程中上下文被完全信任，导致信任是二值的：被污染的上下文会被当作真值直接复制，错误随之传播到生成片段。作者希望重新打开前向过程的设计空间，让模型学会对"已观测但不确定"的token保持适度怀疑。

Method: 前向过程：区域相关的混合加噪——缺失位置用吸收动力学，上下文以低速率做均匀随机替换，使训练时模型见到"被观测但可能错误"的token。推理：启发式采样器在退火强度下向可疑上下文重注入噪声，并在轨迹后段冻结上下文更新。实验对象为170M参数的预训练掩码扩散模型，8000步微调在6GB笔记本GPU上耗时不到5小时。

Result: 基座模型即便面对均匀随机垃圾token也赋予约50%概率。均匀随机污染下，微调后污染检测recall 0.96、precision 0.91；填充token-F1在10%污染下提升3.8点、20%污染下提升6.4点，并消除污染邻域的精度凹陷。干净条件无显著退化，误编辑率低于0.4%。对"看似合理"的污染增益较弱：10%污染下约0.5 F1点，且不显著。

Conclusion: 可检测性与破坏程度共同取决于偏离数据条件的距离：近邻噪声难以检测但语义伤害轻，远距噪声显眼且破坏性强。作者把吸收扩散解释为"信任轴"的无穷对比极限，类比扩散修复中已知/未知区域的信噪比差；在170M模型、单一文本域的设定下，通过改变前向动力学而非架构即可达到中间信任。

Abstract: Continuous diffusion treats the forward process as a design space; discrete language diffusion often uses absorbing corruption, leaving context fully trusted throughout generation. This makes trust binary: corrupted context is copied as ground truth, propagating errors into generated spans. We reopen this design space by combining absorbing and uniform-mixing kernels with region-dependent rates. Missing positions follow absorbing dynamics, while context undergoes low-rate random substitution, exposing the model to observed but uncertain tokens during training. At inference, a heuristic sampler re-injects noise into suspicious context under an annealed intensity and freezes context updates late in the trajectory. An 8,000-step finetune of a pretrained 170M-parameter masked diffusion model takes under five hours on a 6 GB laptop GPU. The base model assigns roughly 50% probability to observed tokens even when they are uniform-random garbage. For uniform-random corruption, finetuning detects corrupted context with 0.96 recall and 0.91 precision, improves infill token-F1 by 3.8 points at 10% corruption and 6.4 points at 20%, and removes the accuracy dip next to corruptions. Clean conditioning shows no measurable regression, with a false-edit rate below 0.4%. Gains for plausible corruptions are weaker: about 0.5 F1 points at 10% corruption, without statistical significance. Our results suggest that detectability and damage depend jointly on departure from the data conditional: nearby noise is hard to detect and semantically mild, while distant noise is conspicuous and destructive. We interpret absorbing diffusion as the infinite-contrast limit of a trust axis, analogous to the signal-to-noise gap between known and unknown regions in diffusion inpainting. In our setting of a 170M model and a single text domain, intermediate trust is reached by changing forward dynamics rather than architecture.

</details>


### [233] [Binding-Specific Relearning Savings for Test-Time Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22381)
*Zhe Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究连续学习智能体中"重学节省"（relearning savings）现象：已学过的知识即使被遗忘、当前输出准确率下降，其再次习得的速度仍快于从未学过的情况，因此仅用当前准确率会低估先前经验的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有参数更新的测试时连续学习智能体通常只以当前输出准确率评估。当一个事实更难被引出时，无法区分模型是"丢失"了该知识还是仅"降低了可及性"。作者希望探究单一的准确率指标是否遗漏了先验经验对后续更新方式的持久塑造作用。

Method: 在Qwen2.5-1.5B上进行匹配、平衡化的三组对照历史实验：LEARNED接收正确事实绑定；CONTROL接收匹配程度的曝光但不含该绑定；WRONG接收同一槽位中另一个关系合法的竞争答案。随后对所有条件施加相同的无复述连续微调流，并在预设的部分遗忘检查点上比较重学速度，同时对测量的重学前进行为做调整以排除混淆。

Result: 在预设的部分遗忘检查点上，LEARNED比CONTROL更快重新获得目标事实，构成正向重学优势；WRONG相对CONTROL无正向优势，其与LEARNED的对比提供了槽位匹配的佐证（受潜在竞争干扰限制）。调整测量所得的重学前行为后优势依然存在。在一项使用非配对、从未见过的事实池的次要描述性换算中，先前学习使恢复所需的优化器更新减少约18%。

Conclusion: 当前的行为准确率会低估先前已获得经验的持久效应：知识在输出层面暂时难以引出，并不等于其被真正抹除。评估连续学习智能体时应纳入重学节省等学习动态指标，而非仅依赖当前准确率。

Abstract: When a fact becomes harder to elicit from a language model, has the model lost it, or has it merely become less accessible? Parameter-updating test-time continual learning agents are usually evaluated by current output accuracy; we ask whether that measurement captures how prior experience shapes later updates. We test whether learning a specific factual binding produces a later relearning advantage beyond familiarity with its entity, answer vocabulary, format, or query slot. In Qwen2.5-1.5B, we compare three matched, counterbalanced histories: LEARNED receives the correct binding, CONTROL receives matched exposure without it, and WRONG receives a competing relation-valid answer in the same slot. After an identical rehearsal-free continual fine-tuning stream, LEARNED reacquires the target faster than CONTROL at a prespecified checkpoint of partial forgetting. WRONG shows no positive advantage over CONTROL, while its comparison with LEARNED provides slot-matched corroboration, subject to possible competitor interference. The advantage remains positive after adjustment for measured pre-relearning behavior. In a secondary descriptive conversion using an unpaired never-seen pool, prior learning reduces the optimizer updates required for restoration by about 18%. Current behavioral accuracy can therefore underestimate the lasting effect of previously acquired experience. Code is available at https://github.com/zhezhou1106/relearning-savings

</details>


### [234] [When Magnitude Suffices: Reconstructing Time-Domain-Gated Microwave Signals Without Phase on a Thoracic Phantom](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23608)
*Maciej Cichoń,Patrycja Gołaś,Maksymilian Bartosik,Angelika Walczak,Agata Bielecka-Dąbrowa,Maciej Ślot*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明在已校准的单一配置下，可用频谱分析仪（SA，仅测幅值）扫描重建矢量网络分析仪（VNA）经时域门控后的幅值响应，并借助全连接网络在类肺躯干幻模上验证其效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时域门控能分离构成S参数测量的多次到达，但传统上依赖VNA测量复数，成本高、设备门槛高；作者希望探究仅用标量仪器（幅度）是否足以替代，以降低测量需求。

Method: 选用门中心以保证各状态可分离；对每台仪器以参考状态做逐频点减法进行一次校正；在来自VNA与SA的扫描数据上训练全连接网络。测试对象为带肺状腔室的躯干幻模，其填充共11种介电状态，逐一留出验证。并将相位显式预测作为对照。

Result: S11重建的SA输入达到形状误差0.08 dB²、状态排序0.81，与VNA输入相当；S21为0.82 dB²并保持状态的有序分组。显式相位预测明显更差，因为门控需要约0.2 rad RMS的相位精度。在11种配置中，相位对幅值的依赖在反射上强、在透射上弱，这解释了S11与S21的差异。在UM-BMID乳腺公开数据集上（整幻模留出），网络形状误差比逐频点线性映射低30%。
