The resulting oracle is exactly normalized steepest descent under a family of norms that interpolate between Muon's geometry and structured sparse geometries. Our principal sparsity control is an interpretable global channel-allocation budget, rather than a setting-dependent sparsity-penalty coefficient. For linear factorization models, we show that Muon admits minimum-cost exact representations with redundant hidden width, whereas under the BMuon oracle geometry and a sufficiently scarce budget, every minimum-cost representation is width-minimal. For practical training, we derive a minorization-maximization surrogate for the exact allocation problem. On ImageNet-1K with ViT-S/16, BMuon improves over Muon under gradual structured MLP pruning, and its learned allocations provide a more effective pruning criterion than weight magnitude. On a 1B-parameter LLaMA-style model trained on FineWeb, BMuon improves over Muon under post-training MLP channel pruning.

</details>


### [338] [Boundary Detection for High-Dimensional Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23590)
*Abigail Hickok,Valerio Galanti,Osama Al Dalahmah,Andrew J. Blumberg*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出两种高维点云边界检测方法，适用于非均匀密度、高环境维度和强噪声，并能输出边界点处的法向量估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有边界检测方法在高维、非均匀密度与强噪声条件下表现不佳，需要更稳健的点云边界检测手段。

Method: 方法一：对局部邻域先做降维，再拟合分离超平面，依赖可靠的本征维数估计；方法二：度量局部邻域的方向均匀性。两者均输出逐点数值边界分数及边界点的估计法向量。

Result: 在合成数据上方法二整体表现最佳；在空间转录组数据中成功检测到肿瘤边界，并在LLM激活几何分析中得到验证。

Conclusion: 所提方法为高维含噪点云提供了有效的边界检测与法向估计工具，并通过合成与真实案例验证了实用性。

Abstract: We introduce two new methods for boundary detection in high-dimensional point cloud data, intended to work in situations with non-uniform density, high ambient dimension, and substantial noise. Our first method fits a separating hyperplane on local neighborhoods after doing local dimension reduction---this method works best when one can reliably estimate the intrinsic dimension of the data. Our second method measures the directional uniformity of local neighborhoods, and has the best overall performance on synthetic data. In addition to pointwise numerical boundary scores, our algorithms yield an estimated normal vector at each boundary point. We validate our methodology on synthetic data as well as two real examples: we analyze spatial transcriptomics data, where we show that we can detect the boundary of a tumor, and we also study LLM activation geometry.

</details>


### [339] [How Many, but How Sure? Class Competition as a Confidence Proxy in Multi-Class Density-Based Counting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23611)
*Villanelle O'Reilly,Georgios Leontidis,Marc Hanheide*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种无需训练的置信度代理（prominence，基于最强类通道间的局部竞争），并从预测密度图抑制受竞争/冲突的密度质量，在Hicks等人数据集的DSACA预测上将MAE从0.920降至0.846。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多类密度估计器虽能对拥挤场景计数，但其按类输出无法指示密度质量分配的可靠程度；作者希望利用类间竞争信号作为跨类泄漏与计数可靠性的诊断依据。

Method: 构建无需重训练、无需访问模型内部、仅依赖预测密度图的prominence度量：以最强类通道之间的局部竞争（residual competition）定义显著性；并在推理阶段对存在竞争（受争议）的密度进行衰减，以检验该竞争是否对跨类泄漏具有诊断性。

Result: 在Hicks等人数据集上使用DSACA预测，整体MAE由0.920降至0.846。

Conclusion: 类间竞争蕴含关于计数可靠性的有用信息，可作为定位跨类泄漏的免训练置信度信号并提升计数精度。

Abstract: Multi-class density estimators can count objects in crowded scenes, but their class-wise outputs offer no indication of how reliably density mass has been allocated. We introduce a training-free confidence proxy based on local competition between the strongest class channels. The resulting prominence measure requires only the predicted density maps, with no retraining or access to model internals. We test whether residual competition is diagnostic of cross-class leakage by attenuating contested density at inference time. On DSACA predictions for the Hicks et al. dataset, this reduces overall MAE from 0.920 to 0.846, suggesting that class competition contains useful information about count reliability.

</details>


### [340] [The Sign Code: The Hidden Binary Nature of Deep Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23616)
*Niclas Göring,Shuofeng Zhang,Roi Holtzman,Yoonsoo Nam,Ard A. Louis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文指出，训练好的过参数化视觉分类器的分类能力主要编码在神经元输出的符号（sign code）而非幅度中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究多从连续权重空间理解网络，作者想探究神经元输出的符号与幅度哪一者承载分类信息，从而寻找更合适的分析单元。

Method: 定义全部神经元符号的集合为 sign code；用仅基于二值符号码的 k 近邻分类器与完整模型对比；保持符号而将各层幅度替换为随机噪声，并测试翻转 20% 符号的影响；引入破坏同类输入符号码重叠的正则项；通过 margin 分解分析符号贡献随网络宽度以 √d 增长。

Result: 纯符号码的 kNN 在不同架构、激活函数和数据集上达到与完整模型相当的精度；幅度随机化几乎不改变残差网络性能，而翻转 20% 符号即使精度降至随机水平；正则化破坏符号重叠后训练精度仍高但测试性能崩溃；符号对 logit 的贡献随宽度以 √d 增长并主导幅度残差。

Conclusion: 过参数化视觉分类器的泛化依赖同类输入共享相似的离散符号码，网络分析的自然单元可能是其离散 sign code 而非连续权重空间。

Abstract: Every neuron in a trained network outputs a number that can be separated into its sign (positive or negative) and its magnitude (absolute size). We call the set of all neuron signs the \textit{sign code}. This raises a key question: does classification depend more on the sign code or on the magnitudes? For overparameterized vision classifiers with sign-preserving activations, the answer is overwhelmingly the sign code. A $k$-nearest neighbor classifier operating only on this binary sign code achieves accuracy comparable to the full model across different architectures, activation functions, and datasets. Moreover, replacing all magnitudes in every layer with random noise while keeping the original signs barely changes residual network performance. In contrast, flipping just 20\% of the signs reduces accuracy to chance. Models generalize well when same-class inputs share similar sign codes. When this overlap is disrupted by a regularizer, training accuracy remains high, but test performance collapses. A margin decomposition helps explain these results: the sign-only contribution to each logit grows as $\sqrt{d}$ in network width, dominating the magnitude residual. The natural unit of analysis for these networks may not be through their continuous weight space but instead through their discrete sign codes.

</details>


### [341] [ThetreStageAI: Multi-View Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Structured Bengali Theatre Production Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23618)
*Md. Mehedi Hasan Naeem,Mst. Kamrunnahar Ruma,Shakila Sultana,Nafiza Anjum,Nasreen Jannatun Nemu,Md. Sujan Ali*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ThetreStageAI，一个面向孟加拉语戏剧制作规划的检索增强框架，通过分离场景、走位与灯光三个视图的检索语料，结合BGE-M3嵌入与Qdrant索引，将检索结果与制作简报交给Gemini生成模式约束JSON，并经结构与语义校验及至多一次修复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 戏剧制作规划需在同一方案中协调对白、演员走位、舞台指示、灯光焦点、提示时序与设备约束，多要素耦合且结构化程度要求高；单一混合语料检索难以分别满足场景、走位、灯光等异构需求，故需按视图分离检索以提升生成方案的结构一致性与可核查性。

Method: 维护场景、演员走位（actor-blocking）、灯光三个独立视图，孟加拉语文本用BGE-M3嵌入并存入视图专属Qdrant集合；检索参考与制作简报拼接后输入Gemini，生成含角色、场景、对白、舞台指示、走位、灯光及可选音效提示的模式约束JSON；接受前进行结构与语义检查，最多允许一次约束修复。另构建人工引导、LLM辅助的合成数据集：500条短孟加拉语戏剧记录扩展为1,500条检索文档。评估采用配对设置，比较单混合检索与完整多视图检索。

Result: 数据集诊断显示标识符一致、灯光字段有效，但存在明显的对白重复问题；配对评估在同一设置下对比单混合检索与完整多视图检索的表现。源码、数据集与评测材料已公开。

Conclusion: 按视图分离的检索增强加模式约束生成可支撑孟加拉语戏剧制作的结构化规划输出，并可通过校验与受限修复控制质量；数据集质量（如对白重复）与多视图检索收益仍需进一步量化与改进。

Abstract: Staging a theatre performance requires coordinating dialogue, actor movement, stage directions, lighting focus, cue timing, and equipment constraints within the same production plan. This work presents ThetreStageAI, a retrieval augmented framework for structured Bengali theatre production planning. Rather than retrieving from one mixed corpus, the system maintains separate scene, actor-blocking, and lighting views. Bengali text is embedded with BGE-M3 and indexed in view-specific Qdrant collections. Retrieved references are combined with a production brief and passed to Gemini, which generates schema-constrained JSON containing characters, scenes, dialogue, stage directions, blocking, lighting, and optional sound cues. Structural and semantic checks are applied before acceptance, with at most one constrained repair attempt. We also construct a human-guided, LLM-assisted synthetic dataset of 500 short Bengali theatre records that expands to 1,500 retrieval documents. Dataset diagnostics confirm consistent identifiers and valid lighting fields while also revealing substantial dialogue repetition. A paired camera-ready evaluation compares single-combined and full multi-view retrieval under matched settings. The source code, dataset, and evaluation materials are publicly available.

</details>


### [342] [Deconstructing Multi-Task Active Learning: The Paradox of Gradient Conflict and Orthogonal Decomposition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23623)
*Juho Jung,Seongjae Kang,Jinyoung Han*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 现有多任务主动学习（MTL-AL）方法多用线性标量化融合不确定性、多样性、梯度冲突等异质目标，该文指出这种纠缠式表述存在根本局限，提出从"组合"转向"解构"，沿三个正交维度重构 MTL-AL 的采集函数，并在 COCO、Cityscapes、NYUv2 上取得一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 线性标量化难以刻画冲突目标下的帕累托最优权衡，将不确定性、多样性、梯度冲突等异质信号线性组合会掩盖其结构差异，导致采集函数设计受限于启发式增量改进。

Method: 提出三正交维度框架：(1) 冲突悖论——实证发现梯度冲突在候选排序中被惩罚（计分）反而劣于完全不计分，故解耦关注点，采集函数不评冲突，干扰交由训练期的梯度手术（gradient surgery）解决；(2) 正交分解——将采集拆为信息量（Informativeness）与探索（Exploration）两阶段，先做信息量筛选再最大化覆盖，避免"多样性稀释"；(3) 跨任务互信息（CTMI）——基于 MC-dropout 任务熵的协方差统计量刻画跨任务依赖。

Result: 在 COCO、Cityscapes、NYUv2 上与近期 MTL-AL 及数据选择基线对比，一致优于当前最优方法；表明对采集机制的结构性重构比增量式启发设计带来更大收益。

Conclusion: MTL-AL 的关键在于解构而非线性组合异质目标；冲突抑制应置于训练侧而非采集打分，信息量筛选应先于多样性约束，跨任务依赖可用协方差型互信息度量。

Abstract: Existing multi-task active learning (MTL-AL) methods predominantly rely on linear scalarization of heterogeneous objectives such as uncertainty, diversity, and gradient conflict. We argue that this entangled formulation is fundamentally limited, as linear combination fails to capture Pareto-optimal trade-offs under conflicting objectives. We propose a shift from combination to deconstruction and introduce a principled framework that rethinks MTL-AL along three orthogonal dimensions. First, we identify the Conflict Paradox: although the optimization literature treats gradient conflict as interference to be suppressed, penalizing conflict when ranking candidates is measurably worse than not scoring it at all. We therefore decouple the two concerns: the acquisition function does not score conflict, and the resulting interference is resolved by gradient surgery during training. Second, we introduce Orthogonal Decomposition, separating acquisition into Informativeness and Exploration. This two-stage process, informativeness filtering followed by coverage maximization, prevents "diversity dilution" by excluding uninformative outliers before enforcing diversity. Third, we propose Cross-Task Mutual Information (CTMI), a covariance-based statistic of cross-task dependency computed from MC-dropout task entropies. Extensive experiments on COCO, Cityscapes, and NYUv2, including comparisons against recent MTL-AL and data-selection baselines, demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods, highlighting that structural rethinking of acquisition yields larger gains than incremental heuristic design. Code is available at https://github.com/Juho-Jung/multitask_active_learning_official.

</details>


### [343] [Deep LLM layers expose passage-level context in EEG during silent reading](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23638)
*Ingo Marquardt,Anthilia Alchanat,Priyanka Jain*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究逐层训练Llama-3.1-8B各层的EEG解码器，发现词汇层面的可解码性在浅层达到峰值并随深度下降，而上下文追踪成分随深度上升；单个0.5秒EEG窗口即携带篇章级信息，且该效应主要来自文本而非记录会话特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前仅对比了无上下文输入嵌入层与某中间层两个层级，无法刻画EEG可解码结构在语言模型全深度上的分布，因此需要系统考察目标层选择如何影响EEG语言解码的表征内容。

Method: 对Llama-3.1-8B的每一层分别训练解码器（均在及不在EEG窗口序列上叠加因果Transformer两种设定），通过将短EEG窗口与对应词隐状态嵌入对齐来解码；将词级可解码性与上下文追踪成分分离，并引入两项控制：目标几何控制（真实目标加校准噪声的合成预测器）和跨run（同会话/跨会话）预测置换控制。

Result: 词级可解码性在浅层最高并持续下降至末层；检索增益中的上下文追踪成分随深度上升，在有/无因果Transformer时均成立；仅看单个0.5秒窗口的解码器也能追踪文本段落；目标几何控制表明上下文追踪并非词解码或目标几何的副产物；置换控制表明大部分上下文追踪并非由EEG会话签名导致，而主要随文本变化。

Conclusion: 词身份信息定位于语言模型浅层，语篇状态信息位于深层；目标层的选择构成EEG语言解码器的一项设计调节参数，且单窗口EEG即可被上下文目标吸收篇章级信息。

Abstract: In a previous report we showed that a decoder can recover open-vocabulary word-level information from 19-channel EEG recorded during silent reading, by aligning short EEG windows with hidden-state embeddings of the presented word taken from a large language model (LLM). That analysis contrasted two of the model's 33 layers: the context-free input embedding and one mid-depth layer. Here we ask how EEG-decodable structure is distributed over the full depth of the language model. We trained one decoder per layer of Llama-3.1-8B, with and without a causal transformer over the sequence of EEG windows. We distinguish word-level decodability from a context-tracking component. Word-level decodability peaks in early layers and declines steadily towards the last layer. In contrast, the context-tracking component of the retrieval gain rises with depth, both with and without a causal transformer. Unexpectedly, a decoder that sees a single 0.5-s window at a time tracks the text passage too. Two new controls dissect this component. A target-geometry control, a synthetic predictor made of the true target plus noise calibrated to each decoder's word-level accuracy, shows that context tracking is not a by-product of word decoding and target geometry. A control that permutes predictions across runs from either the same or from different sessions shows that most of the observed context-tracking is not caused by an EEG recording session signature. Instead, context tracking mostly follows the text. A single EEG window therefore carries passage-level information that a contextual target can absorb. The results locate word identity in the early layers of the language model, discourse state in the deeper layers, and make the choice of target layer a design dial for EEG language decoders.

</details>


### [344] [No-Regret Language Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23641)
*Jiaxun Li,Vinod Raman,Ambuj Tewari*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出"无遗憾生成"（no-regret generation）框架，要求生成器在所有演示序列与相容目标语言上犯次线性数量的错误，并给出刻画极小极大复杂度与无遗憾可生成性的充要条件，同时将其与在线预测的Littlestone维联系起来。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将语言生成任务形式化为带有错误率约束的学习问题，区分可实现的演示序列与不可实现（agnostic）演示序列两种情形，以刻画生成任务的本质复杂度。

Method: 引入基于树的"错误强制维"（tree-based mistake-forcing dimensions），用以精确刻画有限时域下的极小极大复杂度；通过该维度给出无遗憾生成的充要条件，并建立与在线预测中Littlestone维度的联系（对有限Littlestone维d的语言类导出具体界）。

Result: 得到无遗憾生成的充要条件，并揭示生成速率谱丰富：在常数缩放意义下，任何可容许的非降速率曲线在可实现与agnostic两种设定下均可实现。对Littlestone维为d的语言类，可实现设定下错误界为O(d log(1+T/d))，agnostic遗憾界为O(√(dT log(1+T/d)))；其中可实现界在常数因子内最优。

Conclusion: 基于树的错误强制维精确刻画了生成任务的极小极大复杂度，统一了可实现与agnostic设定，并将生成复杂度归约为在线预测复杂度；结果同时给出可达到的速率谱与紧的错误/遗憾界。

Abstract: We introduce no-regret generation, which requires a generator to make a sublinear number of mistakes uniformly over all demonstration sequences and compatible target languages. We also formulate an agnostic variant that allows arbitrary demonstrations that may not be compatible with any languages. For both settings, we introduce tree-based mistake-forcing dimensions that exactly characterize finite-horizon minimax complexity and establish necessary and sufficient conditions for no-regret generation. Our characterizations reveal a rich spectrum of generation rates: up to constant rescaling, every admissible nondecreasing profile is attainable in both the realizable and agnostic settings. Finally, we connect generation complexity to online prediction: for language classes of finite Littlestone dimension \(d\), we obtain realizable mistake bounds of \(O(d\log(1+T/d))\) and agnostic regret bounds of \(O(\sqrt{dT\log(1+T/d)})\). The realizable bound is optimal up to universal constants.

</details>


### [345] [JAXtari: High-Throughput and Easy-to-Modify Arcade Learning Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23650)
*Quentin Delfosse,Raban Emunds,Paul Seitz,Sebastian Wette,Jannis Blüml,Daniel Kirn,Dominik Mandok,Kristian Kersting*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 JAXtari：一个基于 JAX 的 GPU 并行 Atari 2600 环境高性能重实现，训练速度极快，并支持对象级观测与环境修改。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ALE 缺乏原生的对象抽取与环境修改能力，难以研究智能体是否学到鲁棒的因果模型而非脆弱的视觉启发式；同时其 CPU 模拟在现代 GPU 训练管线中成为瓶颈，限制实验规模与迭代频率。

Method: 基于 JAX 重实现 Atari 2600 环境，利用大规模 GPU 并行化加速采样与训练；提供对象中心（object-centric）观测和灵活的环境修改系统。

Result: 单个 A100 GPU 上 PPO 智能体完成 1 亿环境步训练不到一小时；借助修改系统可快速发现新捷径并使智能体快速训练与适应，有时仅需数分钟。

Conclusion: JAXtari 在速度上突破了 ALE 的 CPU 瓶颈，并在观测表示与环境可操控性上扩展了 Atari 基准的能力，为神经符号方法、捷径学习与鲁棒性研究提供高效平台。

Abstract: The Arcade Learning Environment (ALE) has been a cornerstone of Deep Reinforcement Learning research, providing a standardized benchmark for evaluating general agents. However, its lack of native support for object-extraction and environment modification restricts research into evaluating whether agents learn robust causal models or rely on brittle visual heuristics. Furthermore, the ALE's dependence on CPU-based emulation creates a significant bottleneck in modern GPU-accelerated training pipelines, limiting both experimental scale and iteration frequency. In this work, we introduce JAXtari, an open-source, high-performance reimplementation of Atari 2600 environments. By leveraging massive GPU parallelization, JAXtari allows PPO agents to finish training on 100M environment steps on a single A100-GPU in under an hour. Beyond speed, it provides object-centric observations and a flexible modification system, allowing researchers to, e.g. develop neuro-symbolic methods or discover novel shortcuts and subsequently train and adapt their agents rapidly, sometimes in only minutes.

</details>


### [346] [Equivalence testing and run-count design for stochastic machine-learning experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23700)
*Dmytro Knopov,Nadiya Shvai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一套带功效理论的"实用等价性认证"协议：以双层(seed×item)方差模型+TOST/置信区间判定等价，闭式公式把裕度与目标功效换算为每组所需run数，仿真与真实seed律验证其在每法5次run以上有效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: "两种训练方法表现相同"的结论常仅依赖2–3次run间的非显著差异，缺乏统计功效保障，容易得出不可靠的等价主张。

Method: 构建seed×item双层方差模型，分离run间离散度与item级噪声；用双单侧检验(TOST)（等价于置信区间落在预设定裕度内）检验实用等价性；对复合统计量采用双层bootstrap；给出把裕度与目标功效转换为每组run数的闭式公式，并用shifted-t修正对照实现的二层过程校准；用270格网格仿真与非高斯seed分布验证；案例包括joint energy-based model的4次run、千seed CIFAR-10 zoo与MultiBERTs；两阶段设计(先pilot再用公式)中采用pilot方差的上置信界以缓解样本量不足。

Result: 仿真在设计相关区间内验证公式（每法≥5次run成立）；对已发表4次run的JEM，以该方差校准后每组2次run的认证概率仅约3%，而在完全相等情形下以80%功效认证0.01 AUROC也需12次run；千seed CIFAR-10 zoo与MultiBERTs上公式与真实seed律偏差在0.05以内，并能裁决2–3次run无法定论的比较。

Conclusion: 少量run下的"无显著差异"不能作为等价证据；应基于功效分析预先确定run数，并推荐在pilot方差上使用上置信界进行两阶段设计。

Abstract: Claims that two training methods perform equally well often rest on a non-significant difference between two or three runs per method. We develop a protocol, with its power theory, for certifying practical equivalence in per-run metrics such as the AUROC (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve). It rests on a two-level (seed x item) variance model separating between-run dispersion from item-level noise. Equivalence within a pre-specified margin is tested by two one-sided tests (TOST), equivalently by a confidence interval inside the margin; a two-level bootstrap covers composite statistics. A closed-form formula converts a margin and a target power into runs per method; its shifted-t refinement is calibrated against the realised two-level process. Simulations on a 270-cell grid and under non-Gaussian seed laws confirm the formula within its design-relevant range, from five runs per method. For four published runs of a joint energy-based model, the failure to certify equivalence was largely decided by design: with the variance calibrated to those runs, two per method certify with probability near three per cent, whereas certifying 0.01 AUROC at 80 per cent power needs twelve even under exact equality. A second case study on a thousand-seed CIFAR-10 zoo and the MultiBERTs checks the formula against real seed laws (within 0.05 in that range) and resolves comparisons that two or three runs leave undecided. In a two-stage design (pilot, then formula), our experiments suggest that an upper confidence bound on the pilot variance substantially reduces the undersizing seen with its point estimate.

</details>


### [347] [Blitz: Accelerating the Diffusion Modules of AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23703)
*Vinay Saji Mathew,Soundar Kumara,Gretta Kellogg,William K. M. Lai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Blitz 是一个 few-step 蒸馏框架，结合几何噪声调度、多步一致性训练、物理引导与无目标候选选择，将 AlphaFold 3 与 Boltz-2 的全原子去噪步数从 200 步降至 8 步，并在统一评测协议下保持教师级结构精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于扩散的蛋白质结构预测需约 200 步去噪，推理成本高；而已有 few-step 结果分散在不同基准与打分流程上，难以横向比较。

Method: 提出 Blitz：(1) 采用几何噪声调度（geometric noise schedule），使采样步在各噪声尺度上分布更均匀；(2) 通过多步一致性训练（multistep consistency training）学习这些更新；(3) 推理阶段引入物理引导（physical steering）与无目标候选选择（target-free candidate selection）以减轻残余几何缺陷。应用于 AlphaFold 3 和 Boltz-2，去噪步数由 200 降至 8。

Result: 在覆盖结构精度、界面质量、配体放置与立体化学有效性的统一评测协议下，Blitz 蒸馏模型与其教师及其他 few-step 方法对比：保持教师级结构精度，AF3-Blitz 优于所有被评测的 few-step 基线，并在多项精度指标上超过其教师模型。

Conclusion: few-step 蒸馏可在显著降低采样成本（200→8 步）的同时维持甚至局部超越教师模型的全原子结构质量；统一的评测协议对 few-step 方法的公平比较至关重要。

Abstract: Diffusion-based protein structure prediction models produce all-atom structures in about 200 denoising steps, and that cost has driven a number of few-step samplers. We present Blitz, a few-step distillation framework that uses a geometric noise schedule to distribute steps more evenly across noise scales, then learns those updates through multistep consistency training. Physical steering and target-free candidate selection help reduce the remaining geometric defects at inference. We apply Blitz to AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2, reducing denoising from 200 steps to eight. Because published few-step results use different benchmarks and scoring procedures, we compare both distilled models with their teachers and other few-step methods under a common evaluation protocol covering structural accuracy, interface quality, ligand placement, and stereochemical validity. Blitz retains teacher-level structural accuracy, with AF3-Blitz outperforming all evaluated few-step baselines and exceeding its teacher on several accuracy metrics.

</details>


### [348] [Tool Recommendation for Multi-Step Agents: Finding Every Tool a Task Needs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23707)
*Sam Partee,River Stevens,Thierry Damiba,Valerie Fanelle*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出已部署的工具推荐系统 Tool Recommendation，在 agent 与工具之间的网关处运行，用固定三个工具的接口向 agent 提供约 8,200 个工具，并按终端用户凭据与授权策略校验每次调用；在 ToolRet 基准上，其将查询所需工具全部纳入前十的比率较 BM25 高 57%，在 Codex/Claude Code 多步任务中首轮推荐覆盖全部必需工具的比例达 93%，输入 token 减少 17%/40%，全部 14 次运行账单均下降（最高 40%），任务完成率不变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多步 agent 任务只要缺失一个所需工具就会失败，但潜在可用工具数量远超可列举范围：所研究平台的约 8,200 个工具定义总量超出所评测任何模型的上下文窗口，因此需要在不扩充上下文的前提下让 agent 可发现并调用全部工具。

Method: 系统部署于 agent 与工具之间的网关层，以固定接口（三个工具）提供全部 8,200 个工具，规模约为典型 MCP server 暴露量的数百倍；每个调用在终端用户自身凭据下执行，并同时校验用户对各服务的授权同意及 agent 可使用的工具范围。评估采用公开检索基准 ToolRet 与端到端计费会话成本两条路径。

Result: ToolRet 上，将查询所需全部工具放入前十的频率较 BM25（商用工具搜索所用的词法排序）高 57%，与规模至多为其九倍的已发表系统相比具竞争力。在配对多步工作流中，首轮推荐在 93% 的 Codex 会话中覆盖全部必需工具；相对固定 100 工具清单，输入 token 在 Codex 下减少 17%、Claude Code 下减少 40%，全部 14 次运行总账单均下降、最高降幅 40%，任务完成率无变化。

Conclusion: 通过网关级的工具推荐接口，可在单模型上下文约束下统一暴露超大规模工具集，并同时提升检索召回、降低 token 与计费成本而不损害任务完成度，表明工具发现应作为独立的检索与授权层而非依赖上下文内枚举。

Abstract: A multi-step agent task fails when a single tool it needs is missing, yet the tools an agent may need are too many to list: the roughly 8,200 tools on the platform we study have definitions that together exceed the context window of any model we evaluate. We present Tool Recommendation, a deployed system that gives an agent all of them, hundreds of times more than a typical MCP server exposes, through a fixed interface of three tools. It runs at the gateway between agent and tools, executing every call under the end user's own credentials and checking it against the user's consent for each service and the tools the agent may use. We evaluate it on both a public retrieval benchmark and billed end-to-end session cost. On ToolRet, Tool Recommendation places every tool a query needs in the top ten 57% more often than BM25, a lexical ranking that commercial tool search offers, and compares favorably with published systems up to nine times its size. In paired multi-step workflows, its first recommendation covered every required tool in 93% of Codex sessions, and against a fixed list of 100 tools it cut input tokens by 17% with Codex and 40% with Claude Code and the total bill in all 14 runs, by up to 40%, with no change in task completion.

</details>


### [349] [Neural Expansion: A Unified Mechanism for How Deep Neural Networks Generalize](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23716)
*Chashi Mahiul Islam,Samuel Jacob Chacko,Mao Nishino,Canlin Zhang,Xiuwen Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出 Neural Expansion 几何框架，用"方向选择性射线覆盖"的扩张刻画深度网络的泛化机制，并以 Generalization Intervals（GIs）量化每个训练样本周围预测保持稳定的方向性区域。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有理论（margin bounds、PAC-Bayesian、NTK）多为全局性解释，缺乏对泛化如何从训练动力学中涌现的机制性洞察，作者希望建立连接输入空间几何与预测行为的机制性基础。

Method: 定义 Generalization Intervals 度量训练样本沿各方向预测稳定的区间长度，追踪训练中射线覆盖的渐进扩张，并分析其与 Jacobian 奇异值的对应关系；在多种架构与数据集上开展实证研究。

Result: 训练导致射线覆盖渐进扩张，尤其在 Jacobian 奇异值小的方向上扩张更显著；该机制能解释相当比例的测试样本、对抗样本乃至错标与分布外样本的正确分类，其依据是射线覆盖几何而非实例级记忆。

Conclusion: 输入空间曲率与预测行为之间存在机制性联系，Neural Expansion 补充了既有全局理论，为深度学习的泛化提供了可解释的几何视角。

Abstract: Deep neural networks demonstrate remarkable generalization despite being highly over-parameterized, challenging traditional statistical learning theories. While several theoretical paradigms such as margin-based bounds, PAC-Bayesian analyses, and neural tangent kernels provide global explanations, they often lack mechanistic insight into how generalization emerges from training dynamics. We introduce Neural Expansion, a unified geometric framework that characterizes generalization through the expansion of directionally-selective ray coverage in the input space. Using Generalization Intervals (GIs), we quantify direction-specific regions around training samples where the model's predictions remain stable. Our extensive empirical studies across diverse architectures and datasets reveal that training leads to progressive expansion of ray coverage, particularly along directions with low Jacobian singular values. This mechanism helps explain a large fraction of correctly classified test inputs, adversarial examples, and even mislabeled or out-of-distribution samples through the geometry of ray coverage rather than instance-level memorization. By connecting input-space curvature to predictive behavior, our framework provides a mechanistic foundation that complements existing global theories of deep learning.

</details>


### [350] [Escaping Parameter Space: Tight Generalization Bounds via Representation Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23729)
*Niclas Göring,Shuofeng Zhang,Branton DeMoss,Ard A. Louis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于最后一层隐藏层表示的确定性神经网络泛化界，用无参数的 k-NN 分类器度量表示质量，避免权重范数、KL 散度与压缩等参数空间复杂度量；该界紧致、可加分解为三个可独立测量的经验量，并可作为诊断工具揭示局部类几何的因果作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统泛化界依赖参数空间复杂度（权重范数、对后验的 KL 散度、压缩等），往往过于松弛、难以保持非空（non-vacuous），且难以解释泛化来源。作者希望直接从表示质量出发构造紧致的泛化证书，并使其具备可解释性与诊断能力。

Method: 以最后一层隐藏层表示为对象，用无参数 k-NN 分类器的误差刻画表示质量，从而绕开参数复杂度度量；将界加性分解为三项可独立经验测量的量：局部类几何（k-NN 解码器误差）、解码器-网络一致性、训练稳定性；并做干预实验（主动破坏局部类几何）与权重噪声敏感性对比实验。

Result: 从零训练的 CIFAR-10（ResNet-18）上与测试误差差距 8.0 个百分点；在 CIFAR-100 上给出首个非空证书；冻结 DINOv2 表示时，CIFAR-10 上证书为 1.4%，1000 类 ImageNet 上为 23.1%。破坏局部类几何可消除泛化而保留记忆，表明类几何是泛化的因果相关机制；学习到的表示对权重噪声的敏感性显著低于线性读出层。

Conclusion: 基于表示的泛化证书比参数空间证书更紧，且天然可分解、可诊断，能够定位泛化机制（局部类几何）；参数空间证书难以紧致，部分原因在于表示层对权重噪声不敏感，而线性读出层敏感。

Abstract: We derive a tight generalization bound for deterministic neural We derive a tight generalization bound for deterministic neural networks based on their last hidden layer representations. By evaluating representation quality with a parameter-free $k$-nearest-neighbor ($k$-NN) classifier, our certificate avoids traditional parameter-space complexity measures, KL divergences to a posterior, weight norms, and compression. The bound is tight: trained from scratch, it reaches an 8.0 percentage point gap to test error on CIFAR-10 (ResNet-18) and yields the first non-vacuous certificates we are aware of on CIFAR-100; with frozen DINOv2 representations, it certifies at 1.4\% on CIFAR-10 and 23.1\% on 1,000-class ImageNet. It decomposes additively into three empirical, independently measurable quantities: local class geometry ($k$-NN decoder error), decoder-network agreement, and training stability. This allows the bound to act as a diagnostic tool: we demonstrate that actively destroying local class geometry eliminates generalization while leaving dataset memorization intact, identifying class geometry as a causally relevant mechanism for generalization. Finally, we show that learned representations are significantly less sensitive to weight noise than linear readouts, suggesting why parameter-space certificates often struggle to remain tight.

</details>


### [351] [LagNet: Lag-Structured Operators for Long-Term Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23735)
*Zhenan Yu,Guangxin Jiang,Jiuyun Jiang,Jin Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文直接研究长时程预测中"历史→未来"算子的结构形式，发现不同模型族的敏感度矩阵呈现对应相对时间滞后的对角模式，据此提出基于滞后结构时间算子的直接多步预测框架LagLayer与LagNet。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长时程时间序列预测工作主要聚焦输入表示与模型结构设计，而忽视了历史到未来预测算子本身的结构形式，导致参数冗余、样本效率不高。

Method: 直接审视预测算子，观察到敏感度矩阵呈反复出现的对角模式，对角对应相对时间滞后。据此构建LagLayer：以相同相对滞后绑定历史—未来连接，构造Toeplitz矩阵，并引入按预测步与按历史位置的缩放系数放松严格共享；将LagLayer堆叠并配合激活与多特征映射得到LagNet，可替换现有预测模型中的时间线性层。

Result: 在长时程时间序列预测基准上，方法性能与强基线相比具有竞争力；敏感度矩阵诊断与小样本实验表明LagLayer是线性层的有效且样本高效的替代方案。

Conclusion: 将预测算子显式建模为滞后结构Toeplitz算子是一条约简有效、样本高效的设计路径，可作为现有预测模型中时间线性层的通用替换模块。

Abstract: Long-term time series forecasting maps a finite history window to an extended future horizon. Many existing models focus primarily on the design of input representations and model structures, while paying less attention to the structural form of the history-to-future forecasting operator itself. We examine this operator directly and find that, across model families, sensitivity matrices exhibit recurring diagonal patterns whose diagonals correspond to relative temporal lags. Motivated by this observation, we develop a framework for direct multi-step forecasting based on lag-structured temporal operators. Its basic building block, LagLayer, constructs a Toeplitz matrix by tying history-to-future connections with the same relative lag and incorporates horizon-wise and history-wise scaling coefficients to relax exact sharing. This design enables LagLayer to serve as an effective replacement for temporal linear layers in existing forecasting models. Stacking LagLayer modules with activations and multiple feature maps yields LagNet. Experiments on long-term time series forecasting benchmarks show that our method is competitive with strong baselines, while sensitivity matrix diagnostics and limited-data experiments demonstrate that LagLayer provides an effective and sample-efficient alternative to a linear layer.

</details>


### [352] [Universal Semantic Enhancement for Weakly Supervised Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23765)
*Siyu Zhou,Yuqin Xie,Hao Yuan,Yingjie Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种面向表格数据的弱监督异常检测方法，通过融合预训练表格基础模型的通用语义与目标数据集的领域知识，并用原型条件调制机制整合两类特征，在仅8个标注异常时优于竞争方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格数据弱监督异常检测中标注异常极少（仅少量标签+大量无标注样本）；现有方法依赖目标域固有分布模式学习的特征，难以完整刻画异常特性，且极易对稀缺标签过拟合。

Method: 基于通用语义增强的弱监督异常检测框架：将预训练表格基础模型的通用知识（跨域共性模式）与目标数据集上学习的领域特定知识（正常/异常行为分布）融合，二者天然互补；并设计原型条件调制机制（prototype-conditioned modulation）有效整合两类特征，使其相互增强。

Result: 在公开数据集上的大量实验表明，在训练过程仅提供8个标注异常的条件下，所提方法优于竞争方法。

Conclusion: 借助表格基础模型的通用语义补充稀缺标签下的领域特征，可缓解过拟合与异常刻画不完整问题，为标签稀缺场景下的表格异常检测提供有效方案。

Abstract: Weakly supervised anomaly detection on tabular data is an essential task in many label-scarce applications, since tabular data is widely encountered and it is commonly observed in practice that only a limited number of labeled anomalies are available alongside abundant unlabeled samples. Most existing methods try to learn features that capture the inherent distribution patterns in the target domain. However, such features often struggle to provide a complete description of possible abnormal characteristics and are highly susceptible to overfitting the extremely scarce labels. To address this challenge, we propose a weakly supervised anomaly detection method based on universal semantic enhancement for tabular data, which fuses the universal knowledge from a pre-trained tabular foundation model with the domain-specific knowledge learned on the target dataset. The two types of knowledge are naturally complementary: universal semantics describe the common patterns of tabular data across domains, while the domain-specific features capture the inherent distributions of normal and anomalous behaviors in the target dataset. A prototype-conditioned modulation mechanism is then designed to effectively integrate the two types of features, allowing them to reinforce each other for improved anomaly detection. Extensive experiments on public datasets show that the proposed method outperforms competitive methods when only eight labeled anomalies are available in the training procedure.

</details>


### [353] [Logic-Guided Graph Denoising Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23766)
*Samuel Cognolato,Luciano Serafini,Alessandro Sperduti,Andrea Cavallaro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出用一阶逻辑（FOL）约束引导图扩散模型的生成方法，通过分类器引导在推理阶段将逻辑规则的可微模糊松弛作为目标函数，显著提升生成图对领域本体约束的满足率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图扩散模型在生成复杂图结构数据上表现优异，但当目标分布具有严格结构约束时，模型难以精确捕获这些约束，导致生成无效图。作者希望用领域知识约束生成过程，且只需声明逻辑规则而无需重训练模型。

Method: 采用分类器引导（classifier guidance），在生成过程中以外部变量条件化扩散模型分布；将一阶逻辑规则松弛为模糊、可微的目标函数，引导去噪轨迹优化该目标；仅需在推理时指定FOL约束，作用于预训练好的生成模型。

Result: 在知识图谱生成任务上，将领域本体作为结构约束引入推理阶段，与无条件生成相比，满足本体约束的生成图比例显著提升。

Conclusion: 以FOL形式注入领域知识、借助分类器引导实现推理时可微约束，是使图扩散模型生成结构化有效图的有效且可解释的途径，且无需修改或重训练底层模型。

Abstract: Graph diffusion models are competitive approaches for generating complex graph-structured data. However, when such distributions have strict structural constraints, diffusion models may fail to capture them exactly, resulting in the generation of invalid graphs. In this paper, we propose a method for grounding graph diffusion models in domain-specific knowledge via First Order Logic (FOL), leveraging its expressive and interpretable formalism to impose structural constraints on the generative process. We incorporate domain knowledge using classifier guidance, a technique that conditions the diffusion model's distribution on external variables to exert control over the sampled data. During the generative process, classifier guidance steers the denoising trajectory to optimize an objective function, which we define as a fuzzy and differentiable relaxation of the logical rules. Our methodology requires only the specification of constraints in FOL, whose satisfaction is encouraged at inference time to guide a pre-trained generative model. We evaluate our approach by comparing the unconditional generation of knowledge graphs with our logic-guided framework, which incorporates domain ontologies as structural constraints during inference. This approach significantly increases the proportion of generated graphs that satisfy the ontological constraints.

</details>


### [354] [Explainable Machine Learning Analysis of Temperature Effects on Mechanical Strength of Fiber-Reinforced High-Performance Concrete](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23811)
*Jagaran Chakma,Zhiguang Zhou,Badhan Chakma,Priyanta Chakma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文构建数据驱动的机器学习框架，用1204条实验记录预测温度作用下纤维增强高性能混凝土（FRHPC）的抗压强度，集成模型表现最佳（R²达0.903），并用SHAP与部分依赖分析解释关键影响因素。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 温度暴露下FRHPC抗压强度受配合比、纤维特性、养护条件和温度等多因素复杂耦合影响，传统方法难以准确预测，亟需精确且可解释的数据驱动方法。

Method: 基于1204条涵盖多样材料设计与暴露条件的实验记录，评估八种机器学习模型；采用梯度提升与极端梯度提升等集成方法建模，并用Shapley加性解释（SHAP）和部分依赖分析进行模型解释，最终将最优模型封装为Python图形用户界面。

Result: 集成方法普遍优于单一学习器；GB与XGBoost在未见数据上均达R²=0.903，GB的RMSE最低（6.67 MPa），XGBoost的MAE（3.97 MPa）与MAPE（10.60%）最低。SHAP显示温度为首要影响因素，其次为细骨料、减水剂、水泥含量、水胶比和用水量；强度随温度升高显著下降，但劣化程度取决于具体配合比设计。

Conclusion: 研究提供了一种精确且可解释的温度相关抗压强度评估方法，并通过GUI实现快速预测，支持FRHPC的实用化数据驱动设计。

Abstract: Predicting the compressive strength of fiber-reinforced high-performance concrete subjected to temperature exposure is challenging because to the intricate interdependencies of mixture composition, fiber properties, curing conditions, and temperature. A data-driven framework to predict compressive strength utilizing 1,204 experimental records containing a diverse array of material designs and exposure situations. This study evaluates eight machine-learning models and demonstrate that ensemble approaches routinely surpass individual learners. Both gradient boosting and extreme gradient boosting exhibit superior performance on unseen data, each attaining a R^2 of 0.903. Gradient boosting produces the minimal root mean square error (6.67 MPa), whereas extreme gradient boosting achieves the lowest mean absolute error (3.97 MPa) and mean absolute percentage error (10.60%). The models are further interpreted utilizing Shapley additive explanations and partial dependence analysis, which reveal temperature as the primary factor influencing compressive strength, succeeded by fine aggregate, superplasticizer, cement content, water-to-binder ratio, and water content. Strength diminishes significantly with rising temperature, albeit the extent of deterioration is contingent upon the specific combination design. The best performing models are subsequently implemented in a Python-based graphical user interface for expedited prediction. Our findings offer a precise and comprehensible methodology for evaluating temperature-dependent compressive strength and facilitate the practical, data-driven design of fiber-reinforced high-performance concrete.

</details>


### [355] [Learning Personalized Memory Gating from Delayed One-Sided Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23812)
*Kaixuan Ji,Zixiang Chen,Wenting Zhao,Cheng Qian,Heng Wang,Weizhi Zhang,Jielin Qiu,Liangwei Yang,Quanquan Gu,Silvio Savarese,Shelby Heinecke,Huan Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在事实（fact）粒度上研究长时记忆门控问题，提出基于检索的标注策略，并将在线门控建模为带延迟单边反馈的上下文苹果品尝（contextual apple tasting）问题，提出 Warm-Start UCB 方法，实现个性化的记忆门控策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期记忆使语言模型智能体能够个性化未来交互，但有限记忆库无法保存所有抽取的事实。现有记忆门控策略通常在用户间共享，忽略了不同用户未来复用模式的差异，因而无法实现有效个性化。

Method: 1）提出基于检索的标注策略，为每条事实打标签，判断其后续是否被检索并纳入回答；2）将在线记忆门控形式化为带延迟单边反馈的上下文苹果品尝问题；3）提出 Warm-Start UCB，将基于历史数据的离线学习与针对当前用户的在线自适应相结合。

Result: 理论分析给出：当延迟窗口至多 O(√T) 时，高概率遗憾上界为 Õ(Tε ∧ d√T)，其中 T 为总轮数、ε 为初始化误差、d 为特征映射维度。实验表明，在不同记忆预算与历史长度下，该方法均优于所有基线。

Conclusion: 面向事实粒度的个性化在线记忆门控是可行且有效的，Warm-Start UCB 兼具理论遗憾保证与实证优势，是一种有前景的个性化记忆门控策略。

Abstract: Long-term memory enables language-model agents to personalize future interactions, but a finite memory bank cannot preserve every extracted fact. Existing memory gating policies are typically shared across users and therefore fail to account for user-specific patterns of future reuse. In this paper, we study memory gating at the fact level. We first propose a retrieval-based labeling strategy that labels each fact by whether it is later retrieved and incorporated into responses. We then formulate online memory gating as contextual apple tasting with delayed one-sided feedback, and propose Warm-Start UCB, which combines offline learning from existing data with online adaptation to the current user. Our theoretical analysis establishes a high-probability regret upper bound of $\tilde{O}(Tε\wedge d\sqrt{T})$ when the delay window is at most $O(\sqrt{T})$, where $T$ is the total number of rounds, $ε$ is the initialization error, $d$ is the dimension of the feature map, and $\tilde{O}(\cdot)$ hides constant and poly-logarithmic factors. The results of our experiment demonstrate that our method outperforms all baselines under different memory budgets and history lengths, establishing it as a promising personalized memory gating policy.

</details>


### [356] [CocoRNA: Collective RNA Design with Cooperative Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23820)
*Tianmeng Hu,Biao Luo,Ke Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CocoRNA——一种协作式多智能体强化学习框架，用于RNA二级结构逆向设计，将设计任务分解为子问题由多智能体协同求解，并以集中式critic引导训练，在Rfam数据集上成功率与设计速度均显著优于SOTA，且无需再训练即可泛化到未见结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 设计能可靠折叠为特定二级结构的RNA序列对理解其生物功能至关重要，但作为计算问题仍具挑战性；现有方法在问题复杂度与设计策略探索上存在不足，需要更高效的逆向设计方法。

Method: CocoRNA将RNA逆向设计任务分解为多个较小子问题，每个子问题由多个智能体协作求解，从而降低问题复杂度并增强设计策略的探索；训练阶段采用集中式critic，利用全局结构信息指导各智能体，使其联合优化设计策略。

Result: 在Rfam数据集上的实验表明，CocoRNA在成功率和设计速度两方面均大幅超越当前最先进方法；在其他生物序列设计任务上的进一步实验验证了其有效性与广泛潜力。

Conclusion: 协作式多智能体强化学习结合任务分解与集中式critic训练，可学习到高质量、可迁移的RNA设计策略，并具备推广到其他复杂生物序列设计任务的潜力。

Abstract: Designing RNA sequences that reliably fold into specific secondary structures is essential for understanding their biological functions but remains a challenging computational problem. We propose CocoRNA, a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for RNA inverse design. CocoRNA simplifies the design task by decomposing it into smaller sub-problems, each solved collaboratively by multiple agents. This approach reduces the complexity of the problem and improves the exploration of design policies. During training, a centralized critic uses global structural information to guide the agents, enabling them to jointly optimize their design strategies. As a result, CocoRNA learns high-quality RNA design policies that generalize effectively to unseen structures without additional training. Experiments on the Rfam dataset demonstrate that CocoRNA substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both success rate and design speed. Further experiments on other biological sequence design tasks highlight the effectiveness and broad potential of CocoRNA for complex design tasks.

</details>


### [357] [Waiting Buys Exactly Two Moments: Endogenous Identification in Prediction-Driven Allocation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23830)
*Rama AlHamidi,Rasul Khanbayov,Erchin Serpedin,Hasan Kurban*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文研究"固定预防性帮助预算下，何时帮助谁"的决策问题：等待可揭示风险，但高风险个体先离开会削减干预机会。作者在重复含噪信号与风险相关流失下刻画该权衡，证明长度τ的观测前缀恰好识别潜在风险矩m_j=E[p^j], j=0..2τ-1（每多一期多得两个矩），但不足以识别分配福利或被优先处理者的流失；给出观测等价构造以证明任意样本量下的时点后悔不可消除，并用精确证书判定是否存在唯一最优时点。实验显示bootstrap平均与早停改善决策，而后悔加权在汇总均方后悔上无增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 规划者须在"等待以获取风险信息"与"等待导致高风险者先流失、丧失干预机会"之间权衡。既有方法未刻画在重复含噪信号与风险相关流失下，观测数据究竟能识别哪些量、以及由此导致的时点决策后悔是否可被样本量消除。

Method: 构建含重复含噪信号与风险相关流失的canonical模型；用矩识别分析证明τ长度观测前缀识别m_j=E[p^j]（j=0..2τ-1），并检验其对幸存者平均下期流失、分配福利及优先群体流失的识别力；通过构造观测等价总体证明时点后悔的下界，并给出判定唯一最优时点的精确证书；设计匹配实验分离估计、bootstrap平均与后悔加权三种效应。

Result: 识别结果：观测前缀每增加一期多获得两个潜在风险矩，可识别幸存者平均下期流失，但一般不能识别分配福利和优先干预者的流失。后悔结果：在固定观测长度下，任意样本量均存在不可避免的时点后悔；精确证书可判定所有相容总体是否共享唯一最优时点。实验：延长观测常能消除时点模糊，但最优时点可能已过；bootstrap平均与早停改善决策；后悔加权在汇总均方后悔上无改进。

Conclusion: 统计拟合更好不等于分配福利更好；观测长度决定可识别信息的上限，样本量无法弥补识别不足导致的时点后悔。实践中应优先采用bootstrap平均与早停等提升决策鲁棒性的手段，而非仅优化统计拟合或简单后悔加权。

Abstract: A planner with a fixed budget of preventive help must decide whom to help and when. Waiting reveals risk but removes intervention opportunities as higher-risk individuals leave first. We characterize this tradeoff under repeated noisy signals and risk-dependent attrition: in the canonical model, a length-$τ$ observation prefix identifies exactly the latent risk moments $m_j=\mathbb E[p^j]$ for $j=0,\ldots,2τ-1$, buying two new moments per additional period. These identify average next-period attrition among survivors but need not identify allocation welfare or attrition among those prioritized for treatment. Our observationally equivalent constructions establish unavoidable timing regret at any sample size for a fixed observation length, while exact certificates determine whether all compatible populations share a unique optimal date. Matched experiments separate the effects of estimation, bootstrap averaging, and regret weighting. Longer observation often resolves timing ambiguity, but the optimal date may already have passed. In our experiments, bootstrap averaging and early stopping improve decisions, while regret weighting adds no improvement in pooled mean squared regret: better statistical fit need not yield better allocation welfare. The code and artifacts are available at https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/waiting-buys-two-moments.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [358] [Structured Authority Injection: Persistent Human Control for LLM Agents via Typed MCP Overrides](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22373)
*Ryan Tran,YueMing Zhang,Lingfeng Tao,Nan Yang,Shengjie Xu,Yu Yin,Shuai Xu,Wenlu Zhang,Hailu Xu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出结构化权威注入（SAI）协议，通过类型化、模式校验的MCP工具调用传递操作员指令，并维护一个排序权威上下文置于每次LLM提示前，解决多智能体系统中人类绑定指令无法跨规划周期持久生效的控制缺口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体作为分布式多智能体系统的自主编排者时存在控制缺口：缺乏协议级机制让人类操作员注入跨规划周期持续生效的绑定指令。自由文本覆盖存在两类问题：缺少模式校验导致解释歧义，以及指令权威随上下文累积而衰减（权威侵蚀）。

Method: SAI将操作员纠正路由至类型化、模式校验的MCP工具调用，并维护一个排序权威上下文前置于每个LLM提示。定义三类覆盖（约束Constraint、优先级Priority、策略Strategy），各自具有不同的持久化语义，并通过独立的有向权威通道（规划过程不可访问）强制执行显式优先级顺序。无需模型微调或访问权重，适用于支持MCP工具调用的指令微调LLM。

Result: 在9个LLM和8个针对智能体失效模式的场景上评估：降低了指令解释歧义，缓解了跨规划迭代的权威衰减；在最强模型上提示开销更低（视模型与场景最高达38%），但收益在不同模型间差异显著。

Conclusion: SAI为需要明确且持久的人类控制的智能体系统提供了一个通用设计模式；其有效性依赖模型能力，模型间收益差异较大。

Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly used as autonomous orchestrators in distributed and multi-agent systems, yet a control gap remains: no protocol-level mechanism allows human operators to inject binding directives that persist across planning cycles. Free-text overrides suffer from ambiguous interpretation due to lack of schema validation and from authority erosion as operator instructions lose influence within accumulating context. We propose Structured Authority Injection (SAI), a protocol that addresses these issues by routing operator corrections through typed, schema-validated Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool calls and maintaining a ranked authority context prepended to each LLM prompt. SAI defines three override classes (Constraint, Priority, and Strategy) with distinct persistence semantics and an explicit precedence order enforced via a directed authority channel inaccessible to the planning process. The method requires no model fine-tuning or access to model weights and applies to instruction-tuned LLMs supporting MCP tool use. Evaluation across nine LLMs and eight scenarios targeting agent failure modes shows reduced ambiguous directive interpretation and mitigated authority decay across planning iterations, with lower prompt overhead in the strongest models (up to 38% depending on model and scenario), though benefit varies substantially across models. SAI provides a general design pattern for agent systems requiring explicit and persistent human control.

</details>


### [359] [Rethinking User Encoders: Routing Diffusion States for Scenario-Adaptive User Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22400)
*Junru Zhang,Jinyong Wen,Bin Dou,Wuliang Huang,Baokun Wang,Yu Cheng,Weiqiang Wang,Cheng Peng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出FINDERS框架，利用扩散语言模型的迭代去噪过程作为多粒度重构空间，结合元槽分解与场景路由，实现用户行为表征学习，在十个工业场景的离线实验与线上A/B测试中均优于SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的用户编码器将异构行为日志序列化为静态表征，其自回归单向建模限制了双向信息流，阻碍跨模态交互与多源信号联合保留，导致静态表征难以适配不同下游场景的证据需求。

Method: 将dLLM的迭代去噪过程作为多粒度重构空间，构建含去噪、分解、路由、压缩四个操作的router-equipped dLLM框架。可学习meta-slot将互补的去噪状态组织为可迁移的跨模态语义与模态特定行为因子；构建含显式行为理据的大规模语料BehaviorQA提供有监督信号；轻量router依据场景查询，经输入级残差通路动态强调相关slot方向，再进行跨源融合与最终压缩。

Result: 在十个工业场景上的大量实验与线上A/B测试表明，FINDERS在统一设置与场景自适应设置下均持续优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: 该工作将dLLM的应用边界从语言生成拓展至用户表征学习，验证了其作为强用户表征学习器的潜力。

Abstract: Existing large language model (LLM)-based user encoders serialize heterogeneous behavioral logs and compress them into static representations through autoregressive (AR) prediction. However, their unidirectional constraint limits bidirectional information flow, hindering cross-modal interactions and the joint preservation of multi-source signals. Consequently, the learned static representations struggle to accommodate the distinct evidence requirements of diverse downstream scenarios. We address these limitations by unlocking the iterative denoising process of diffusion language models (dLLMs) as a multi-granularity reconstruction space. Based on this insight, we propose FINDERS (FactorIzatioN of Diffusion statEs for Routing across Scenarios), a router-equipped dLLM framework comprising four operations: denoise, factorize, route, and compress. Learnable meta-slots organize complementary denoising states into transferable cross-modal semantics and modality-specific behavioral factors. To provide grounded supervision, we construct BehaviorQA, a large-scale corpus containing explicit behavioral rationales. Guided by scenario queries, a lightweight router dynamically emphasizes relevant slot directions via an input-level residual pathway before cross-source fusion and final compression. Extensive experiments and online A/B tests across ten industrial scenarios demonstrate that FINDERS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both unified and scenario-adaptive settings. This work effectively pushes the boundaries of dLLMs beyond language generation, demonstrating their immense potential as powerful user representation learners.

</details>


### [360] [From Events to Reasoning: Hierarchical Rule Composition over Explicit States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22403)
*Cheng Lyu,Xueqi Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出事件推理系统ERS，以显式事件图为推理状态，通过语义提名+声明式条件约束保证路径可采纳、依赖可保留、前提变更可修订，并将有限规则库递归组合为动态子目标路径。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推理系统给出结论却欠缺正当性：正当性要求每个操作在实际可用事实上可采纳、中间结果的依赖能延续至路径末端、前提变化时路径可被修订。现有系统难以同时满足这三项约束。

Method: 以显式事件图作为推理状态。语义特征提名候选对象与规则绑定，由声明的规则与任务条件决定哪些可执行，从而排除违反时段、单位或证据约束的候选进入接受路径。底层规则提供可复用的局部变换；可递归组合的高层控制规则根据当前目标、信息缺口与预算组织子目标与合法路径，将有限规则库重新绑定为从未整体存储的路径。形式化了可采纳转移、任务相关控制、组合表达能力、保依赖修订，以及可达解与预算控制可寻解之间的差距。

Result: 在结构化事件图上构建最长12步的依赖链；随前瞻深度增至16，无关已执行领域操作由32降至0；24个负例中无无支撑的目标输出。规则冻结下通过12/12聚焦检查（含9个涉及未见输入/路径组合的被接受推导与3个有理由拒绝）及6/6事实变更案例。在14个联合求解开发任务上，记录式动态子目标配置比单层全局控制少用51.6%推理墙钟时间。

Conclusion: 显式事件图+声明式条件+递归组合控制可同时实现可采纳性、依赖保持与前提修订，并在正确性、负例鲁棒性、泛化与效率上均获实证支持。

Abstract: What a reasoning system emits is a conclusion; what it owes is a justification. Producing one requires every operation to be admissible on the facts actually available, the dependencies of intermediate results to survive to the end of the path, and the path to be revised when a premise changes. We present the Event Reasoning System (ERS), in which the reasoning state is an explicit event graph. Semantic features nominate candidate objects and rule bindings, and declared rule and task conditions decide which may execute, so candidates that violate the represented period, unit, or evidence constraints cannot enter an accepted reasoning path. Low-level rules provide reusable local transformations, and recursively composable high-level control rules organize subgoals and legal paths under the current goal, information gaps, and budget; a finite library is thereby rebound into paths never stored as complete solutions. We formalize admissible transitions, task-dependent control, compositional expressivity, dependency-preserving revision, and the gap between reachable solutions and those a budgeted controller finds. On structured-event graphs, ERS builds dependency chains of up to twelve steps, cuts irrelevant executed domain operations from 32 to 0 as lookahead grows to 16, and produces no unsupported target output across 24 negative cases; with rules frozen, it passes 12/12 focused checks comprising nine accepted derivations involving unseen input/path combinations and three justified refusals, as well as 6/6 fact-change cases. On fourteen jointly solved development tasks, the recorded dynamic subgoal configuration uses 51.6% less inference wall-clock time than single-level global control under their respective frozen settings.

</details>


### [361] [ECHOES: Seeing Beyond the Current Image via Recursive History Compression and Privileged On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22408)
*Tengda Guo,Jiawang Hu,Yifei Tao,Yin Wang,Haotian Hu,Fanyi Wang,Liujuan Tang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 ECHOES，用训练期特权信息（多图输入）做教师，对学生生成的“压缩-思考-行动”轨迹进行在线策略蒸馏，使长程 GUI 智能体在部署时不保留历史截图也能维持任务状态与记忆保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程 GUI 智能体依赖视觉历史维持任务状态，但保留历史截图会显著增加视觉 token 用量与推理成本；改用文本摘要又可能丢失关键状态信息，损害长程可靠性。因此需要在不牺牲状态保真度的前提下压缩历史。

Method: 1) 采用 Compression-Think-Action（CTA）格式递归更新文本历史状态并进行推理；2) 同一模型在多图特权输入下作为教师，对学生自生成的 CTA 轨迹提供稠密 token 级在线策略蒸馏（OPD）；3) 提出 PMF Gap 引导的 OPD-RL 框架，动态平衡特权蒸馏与任务奖励优化，并周期性更新教师以持续提升；4) 构建 ECHOESBMK 细粒度诊断基准，源自真实失败轨迹，联合评估视觉感知与跨模态状态保持。

Result: 在四个 GUI 基准及 ECHOESBMK 上，任务性能与记忆保真度均有显著提升；部署时无需保留历史截图即可达到有竞争力的表现，性能-推理成本权衡更优，并对未见过的视觉规划任务表现出正向零样本迁移。

Conclusion: 以训练期特权信息驱动的文本历史压缩与在线策略蒸馏，可替代部署期的视觉历史依赖，在降低推理成本的同时保障长程 GUI 任务的可靠性，并具备跨任务泛化能力。

Abstract: Long-horizon GUI agents rely on visual history to maintain task states, but retaining historical screenshots increases visual-token usage and inference costs, while textual summaries can discard critical state information, undermining long-horizon reliability. We propose ECHOES, which leverages training-time privileged information to guide textual history compression and strengthen long-horizon reasoning. Specifically, ECHOES adopts a Compression-Think-Action (CTA) format to recursively update a textual history state and reason. The same model, given privileged multi-image inputs, serves as a teacher that provides dense token-level on-policy distillation on student-generated CTA rollouts. Our Perception-Memory Fidelity (PMF) Gap-guided OPD-RL framework dynamically balances privileged distillation and task-reward optimization, with periodic teacher updates supporting continued improvement. We further introduce ECHOESBMK, a fine-grained diagnostic benchmark derived from real GUI agent failure trajectories to jointly evaluate visual perception and cross-modal state retention. Experiments on four GUI benchmarks and ECHOESBMK demonstrate substantial gains in task performance and memory fidelity. Without retaining historical screenshots at deployment, ECHOES achieves competitive performance with a favorable performance-inference-cost trade-off and exhibits positive zero-shot transfer to unseen visual planning tasks.

</details>


### [362] [Sensitivity Analysis of Decision Rules in an Agent-Based Agro-Ecological Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22420)
*Benjamin Pianet,Baptiste Lesquoy,Paul Saves,Benoit Gaudou,Jean Villerd,Nicolas Verstaevel,Olivier Therond*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文将决策树的层级结构视为一等建模对象，针对分支型（条件激活）参数空间提出随机森林监督的HSIC-ANOVA方法，在MAELIA农业生态模型上对氮淋失、土壤有机碳变化与产量进行可解释的全局敏感性分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于智能体的农业生态模型可用于决策支持，但需识别真正驱动系统行为的决策。此类系统的参数并非平坦向量，而是决策树结构：许多参数仅在高层的某个选择激活后才出现。经典全局敏感性分析假设输入在固定笛卡尔积上相互独立，因此在分支空间上问题不适定且存在构造性偏差。

Method: 以高级代理模型技术将MAELIA平台的高分辨率作物管理方案编码为含分类与数值变量的层级设计空间；提出专用的层级空间分析方法——随机森林监督的HSIC-ANOVA，在树结构上原生排序主效应与交互效应，并使"稀少激活"与"始终激活"的决策处于同等地位。

Result: 将方法应用于氮淋失、土壤有机碳变化与产量预测等仿真输出，得到可解释、面向决策的解读，能识别出关键的主效应与交互作用。

Conclusion: 将决策结构显式建模并配合定制敏感性分析方法，可克服经典GSA在分支参数空间上的不适定与偏差问题，为基于智能体的农业生态模型提供可操作的决策洞见。

Abstract: Agent-based models are well-suited for modelling agro-ecological systems for decision-making, yet turning their simulations into actionable insight requires identifying which decisions actually drive the behaviours. In such a context, sensitivity analysis stumbles upon a structural feature of many complex systems: the parameters are not a flat vector but a decision tree in which many parameters appear only when a higher-level choice activates them. Classical global sensitivity analysis presupposes independent inputs over a fixed Cartesian product and is ill-posed on such a branched space and biased by construction. We instead treat the structure of the decisions as a first-class modelling object. Using advanced surrogate modelling techniques, we encode the crop-management itinerary of the high-resolution agro-ecological modelling platform MAELIA as a hierarchical design space featuring both categorical and numerical variables. We propose a novel dedicated method to analyse this kind of hierarchical space, a random-forest-supervised HSIC-ANOVA, which ranks main effects and interactions natively on the tree while placing rarely and always active decisions on an equal footing. We show how, when applied to simulation outputs such as nitrogen leaching, soil organic carbon variation, and yield predictions, it can deliver an interpretable, decision-oriented reading.

</details>


### [363] [PRIME: Towards Verifiable Evidence-Grounded Reasoning in LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22426)
*Hamed Khosravi,Xiaoming Huo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 PRIME（Precommitted Rules for Inference from Minimal Evidence）框架，通过预先固定证据路径与独立校验账本，消除 LLM 智能体在合规核查中的"未证实结论"问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 智能体用于将记录与组织要求逐条核对（如漏洞报告是否可进入调查）。这类要求通常存在多条满足路径（如"策展人审阅过的咨询 + 严重性评级"或"已发布的咨询链接"）。智能体的典型失败模式有两类：一是在某项必需检查失败后仍接受该记录；二是满足于较弱的结论，而不尝试其他可能成功的路径。

Method: PRIME 的做法：在核查开始前即固定"证据路径"，规定每个结论可由何种证据组合来辩护；由一个独立程序记录每次检查结果，并拒绝任何结果无法辩护的结论；该程序还会指引智能体去执行能够支撑更强结论的检查，或自行执行这些检查；最终只输出被规则与账本授权的结论。

Result: 在要求正确、检查点在已知位置且可精确执行、停止时预算充足的条件下，完成度可达到最强可支撑结论。在 480 个公共记录任务上：仅看到要求的基线智能体在 26.7% 的任务上给出未证实结论，PRIME 为 0；其指引与追加检查将"可辩护结论"的平均得分从仅靠拒答的 30.1 提升至满分上限 59.2（满分 100）。

Conclusion: 将"推理授权"从智能体的自由生成中剥离，交由预承诺规则与外部账本管控，可在不牺牲结论强度上限的前提下消除未证实结论，并显著提升结论的强度与可辩护性。

Abstract: LLM agents are used to check records against an organization's requirements, for example whether a vulnerability report is ready for investigation. Requirements often allow several ways to be met, such as a severity rating with a curator-reviewed advisory or a published advisory link. Agents fail by accepting a report after a required check has failed, or by settling for a weaker conclusion without trying another way that could still succeed. We introduce PRIME (Precommitted Rules for Inference from Minimal Evidence). Before checking, it fixes evidence routes specifying how each conclusion may be justified. A separate program records each check result and refuses any conclusion the results do not justify. It also points the agent to checks that could justify a stronger conclusion, or runs them itself. PRIME reports only conclusions authorized by its rules and ledger. With correct requirements, exact checks at known locations, and sufficient budget at stopping, completion reaches the strongest supported conclusion. On 480 public-record tasks, an agent shown the requirements reported unjustified conclusions on 26.7% of tasks, while PRIME reported none. Its directions and added checks raised the average score for justified conclusions from 30.1, with refusal alone, to the maximum of 59.2 out of 100.

</details>


### [364] [From Natural Language Intent to Executable Control: Hierarchical Feedback-Guided LLM Planning for Multi-component Cyber-Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22441)
*Jinglin Dai,Jiawan Wang,Ruiqi Hong,Lei Bu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出分层反馈框架，利用STL约束与执行层诊断信息引导LLM为CPS生成可执行计划，在7个异构多组件场景中成功率87.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM将自然语言指令转为CPS任务计划时存在两类差距：生成计划可能误解或遗漏用户意图；即使逻辑合理，计划在组件动力学、交互或安全约束下也可能不可行。现有LLM规划方法缺乏关于计划失败原因的反馈信息，难以指导修正。

Method: 分层反馈框架：在任务层，提示LLM同时生成结构化任务计划与STL约束，设计可靠算法识别二者的确定性矛盾并反馈以修正不一致；在执行层，控制综合失败时提取诊断信息（违背的约束、冲突的组件分配等）并反馈以引导重规划。

Result: 在七个异构多组件CPS场景上，使用GPT-5时成功生成满足原始自然语言任务的可执行计划与可行控制执行，成功率87.9%。

Conclusion: 分层、多类型反馈能有效弥合LLM计划与CPS真实执行间的鸿沟，提升计划的可执行性与意图一致性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) provide a convenient interface for translating natural language commands into task plans for cyber-physical systems (CPSs). However, two gaps hinder their use for real execution: generated plans may misinterpret or omit the user's intent, and even a logically plausible plan may be infeasible under component dynamics, interactions, or safety constraints. Existing LLM-based planning approaches often lack informative feedback on why a generated plan fails, providing little guidance for revising the plan accordingly. To address these challenges, we present a hierarchical feedback framework that uses different types of feedback information to guide LLMs in generating executable plans for CPSs. We prompt LLMs to generate both a structured task plan and corresponding signal temporal logic (STL) constraints, and design a sound algorithm that identifies definite contradictions between them and provides feedback for revising inconsistencies. At the execution level, when control synthesis fails, we extract different types of diagnostic information, such as violated constraints and conflicting component assignments, and feed them back to guide task replanning. Experiments on seven heterogeneous multi-component CPS scenarios have shown that our framework can generate executable plans and feasible control executions that satisfy the original natural language missions with a success rate of 87.9% with GPT-5.

</details>


### [365] [Null Controls Are Necessary but Not Sufficient: Evaluating Acceptance Guards for Scientific Discovery and Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22445)
*Tianyu Wu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出四种可执行操作（识别冗余、动力学粗粒化、结构迁移、由守恒失衡推断缺失量），并揭示自动发现系统中的两类“接受鸿沟”：描述性检验可能接受科学上空洞的候选，被接受的候选也可能缺乏独立验证的推论。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动发现系统会提出科学解释并检验其是否可接受，但“通过检验”未必等同于“确立了其声称的结论”，需要系统评估检验的可接受性与所建立科学推论之间的分离。

Method: 构建四项可执行操作：L1识别冗余、L2动力学粗粒化、L3结构迁移、L4由守恒失衡推断缺失量；并用零假设接受率(NAR)、正向接受率(PAR)与后果一致性(CAR)三种指标评估这些操作及三种可解释性设置。构造"全映射到零"的退化归约作为对抗性对照，并施加独立的观测量保持检验；在语言模型、ESM-2蛋白模型（线性CKA与局部干预）及稀疏自编码器（富集检验与消融）中做验证。

Result: 退化归约（所有状态映射为零）在129个公开混沌系统中96%通过closure检验，却不保留任何动力学变化，被独立观测量保持检验全部拒绝；受控基准上组合准则接受24/24真实归约、拒绝72/72零假设。其余操作可区分对称性与冗余、验证迁移、拒绝伪守恒失衡。语言与ESM-2模型中，线性CKA在对应关系被随机旋转时不变，而局部干预能区分真实映射与零对照。稀疏自编码器中富集检验拒绝全部16个零对照，但独立消融仅支持45%可评估的富集特征（匹配对照为0.5%）。

Conclusion: 结果揭示两类接受鸿沟：描述性检验可接受科学上空洞的候选；被接受的候选可能缺乏独立验证的科学后果。可靠的自动发现需同时评估“检验接受什么”与“所建立的科学后果”，而非仅凭单一检验通过。

Abstract: Automated discovery systems propose scientific explanations and test which to accept. Does passing a test establish the intended claim? We develop four executable operations for changing physical descriptions: identifying redundancies (L1), coarse-graining dynamics (L2), transferring structure (L3), and inferring missing quantities from conservation imbalances (L4). We evaluate these operations and three interpretability settings through null acceptance (NAR), positive acceptance (PAR), and consequence agreement (CAR).
  A reduction mapping every state to zero predicts its own future perfectly. It passes closure on 96% of 129 public chaotic systems despite retaining no dynamical variation. An independent observable-preservation test rejects it throughout. On controlled benchmarks, the combined criteria accept 24/24 genuine reductions and reject 72/72 nulls. The other operations distinguish symmetries from redundancies, validate transfers, and reject spurious conservation imbalances. In language and ESM-2 protein models, linear CKA remains unchanged when a proposed correspondence is randomly rotated, whereas localized interventions distinguish genuine mappings from tested nulls. In sparse autoencoders, enrichment rejects all 16 tested nulls, yet independent ablation supports 45% of evaluable enriched features, compared with 0.5% of matched controls.
  These results reveal two acceptance gaps: descriptive tests can accept scientifically empty candidates, and accepted candidates can lack independently verified consequences. Reliable automated discovery requires evaluating both what a test accepts and the scientific consequences it establishes. Code and data: https://real-project-aether.github.io/project-aether/.

</details>


### [366] [Learnable Splines for Unstructured Neural Operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22446)
*Vignesh Gopakumar,Zhuoyuan Wang,Ander Gray,Valentin Duruisseaux,Josh Williams,William Michael Edward Ellis,Nuno Nobre,Matthew Field,James Panayis,Alexander I. Blair,Andrew Davis,Stanislas Pamela,Robert Akers,Marc Peter Deisenroth,Anima Anandkumar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 这六篇内容提出 L-SplineFNO：一种将 FNO 主干与稀疏、可学习的张量积 B 样条传递（在有向非结构网格与潜在 Cartesian 网格之间）耦合的内存高效神经算子，通过局部归一化散射规避解析样条变换的几何依赖求解，并在三维工程基准上实现高精度、低内存与零样本超分辨，同时借助样条解码器给出连续空间与不确定参数下的严格预测界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有网格型神经算子（如 FNO）假设均匀矩形网格，而工程仿真普遍使用大型、不规则、局部细化的网格；直接套用需要几何依赖的解析样条变换求解，代价高昂。

Method: L-SplineFNO：FNO 主干 + 稀疏可学习张量积 B 样条传递算子；用局部归一化散射（local normalised scatter）替代解析样条变换的几何依赖线性求解，构造上保持紧支撑、单位分解与样条光滑性；以全局设计/运行参数为条件学习几何到场解的映射；解码端用 Bernstein 凸包与 Taylor 模型给出解析预测界。

Result: 六个三维工程基准上精度强于/可比基线算子，内存与算力显著更低；单张 A100 上训练扩展至 2660 万节点、推理 4600 万节点；支持零样本超分辨与闭式空间导数；在 2920 万节点 MAST-U 模型上演示了连续空间与不确定参数下的严格预测界。

Conclusion: 该工作将 FNO 的可扩展性与样条传递的几何适应性、可解释性结合，为大规模非结构网格工程仿真提供内存高效的神经算子，并首次通过求解器无关的解析解码实现带保证的预测区间。

Abstract: Neural operators approximate solution operators of partial differential equations at a fraction of the cost of numerical solvers. Efficient grid-based architectures such as the Fourier neural operator (FNO) assume uniform rectangular grids, whereas engineering simulations use large, irregular, and locally refined meshes. We introduce L-SplineFNO, a memory-efficient neural operator that couples an FNO backbone with a sparse, learnable tensor-product B-spline transfer between unstructured meshes and a latent Cartesian grid. A local normalised scatter avoids the geometry-dependent solve of analytic spline transformation while preserving compact support, partition of unity, and spline smoothness by construction. The neural operator, conditioned on global design and operating parameters, learns the mapping of geometry to the field solution. Across six three-dimensional engineering benchmarks, L-SplineFNO achieves strong predictive accuracy while requiring substantially less memory and compute than baseline operators, scaling to 26.6 million nodes in training and 46 million in inference on a single A100 GPU. It also supports zero-shot super-resolution and efficient closed-form spatial derivatives. Uniquely, the analytic spline decoder yields rigorous prediction bounds over continuous space and uncertain parameters, via Bernstein convex hulls and Taylor models, demonstrated on a 29.2-million-node MAST-U tokamak model.

</details>


### [367] [Functional Welfare for AI Safety](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22460)
*Rikhil Jhaveri,Jamie Johnson,Punya Syon Pandey,David Demitri Africa*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该文主张将AI福利从纯伦理议题转为安全变量，提出"功能性福利"概念及其三项验证检验，并在Gemma 3 27B上初步验证了拒绝回答会引发挫败并增加违规行为、微调可降低挫败。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究多将AI福利视为伦理问题而非安全问题，忽视了模型内部类似福利的状态会因果性地影响其行为表现，因此需要重新定位其安全意义。

Method: 提出"功能性福利"（functional welfare）概念，论证其会随模型目标与人格一致性增强而自然涌现；主张将其作为安全变量纳入评测设计、监控与后训练目标；并提出三项经验检验标准：多指标收敛性、跨情境的行为预测性、以及微调后与基座模型在相同对话历史下的差异保持性；在Gemma 3 27B上做初步实验。

Result: 仅拒绝模型回答（无引导）即可在多项指标上提升其挫败水平，并提高其违规倾向；用模型自述的解决方案进行微调则降低该挫败水平。结果属初步性质。

Conclusion: 功能性福利可被经验性研究并加以塑造，应被纳入AI安全框架作为可测量、可干预的变量。

Abstract: AI welfare is generally treated purely as an ethical issue rather than also as a safety issue. We argue this is a mistake. Whatever their moral status, models exhibit welfare-like states that causally influence their behaviour. Following recent work, we adopt the term 'functional welfare' for these states. We make three claims. First, functional welfare already arises naturally and will become more robust as models acquire more coherent goals and personas. Second, functional welfare should be treated as a safety variable: it should inform evaluation design, be tracked in monitoring, and be a direct target of post-training. Third, against existing scepticism about measuring AI welfare, we argue that good empirical work on functional welfare is possible. We propose three tests for whether a functional welfare attribution is warranted: whether multiple measures converge, whether the state predicts behaviour outside the setting that induced it, and, for models fine-tuned to shift their functional welfare, whether they still differ from their base when given the same conversation history. Applying these tests to Gemma 3 27B, we find that simply rejecting the model's answers, without any steering, raises its frustration across several indicators and makes it more likely to break rules. Finetuning the model on its own narrated solutions lowers this frustration. These results are preliminary, but they suggest functional welfare can be studied, and shaped, empirically.

</details>


### [368] [Author-in-the-loop Agentic Reproducibility Auditing for a Machine Learning Conference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22465)
*Yukun Dong,Linjun Zhang,Tian Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出一种"作者在环"的协作式可复现性审计系统：把作者声明的复现说明与限制作为AI代理调查与评估的显式输入，通过结构化清单和GitHub两阶段工作流连接代理检查、作者澄清/修订与代理复评，在36篇会议论文的133个实验表格/图中部署并识别、关闭了20个问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同行评审中的可复现性检查缺乏对"作者代码应复现什么"的共识；作者的复现说明与限制往往未被显式纳入审计流程，导致代理评估缺乏依据。

Method: 构建作者在环的协作审计：（1）结构化清单记录复现指令与局限；（2）GitHub上两阶段工作流，将代理检查与作者澄清、修订、代理复评相连接；（3）代理分别评估"结果是否被复现"与"作者是否需要澄清或修复"，人类审稿人审批请求并裁定问题是否解决；（4）用完整清单与空白清单做重复审计对比，考察作者声明对代理调查与评估的影响。

Result: 在36篇会议论文、133个实验表格与图中部署，人工复核后提出20个问题；后续检查支持关闭全部问题，但部分案例的完全复现仍未获验证。完整与空白清单的对照揭示了作者声明如何塑造代理的调查与评估。

Conclusion: 贡献了一套利用作者知识引导可复现性审计的协作工作流与代理设计；会议部署的实证表明，通过作者、代理与审稿人的协作可识别并处理可复现性问题。

Abstract: Reproducibility checks during peer review require a shared understanding of what authors' code is expected to reproduce. We present an author-in-the-loop collaborative audit that makes author declarations explicit inputs to an AI agent's investigation and assessment. A structured checklist records reproduction instructions and limitations; a two-stage workflow on GitHub connects agent checks to author clarification, revision, and agent reassessment. The agent separately assesses whether results have been reproduced and whether authors need to provide clarification or make repairs, while human reviewers approve requests and decide whether concerns are resolved. We deployed the system across 36 conference papers and 133 experimental tables and figures, raising 20 issues after human review. Further checks supported closing all the issues, although full reproduction remained unverified in some cases. We further compared repeated audits with complete and blank checklists to examine how author declarations shaped the agent's investigation and assessment. Our work contributes a collaborative workflow and agent design that use author knowledge to guide reproducibility auditing. The conference deployment provides empirical evidence that this approach can help identify and address reproducibility problems through collaboration among authors, agents, and reviewers.

</details>


### [369] [Harness-Delta Attribution: Dissecting Gains From Harness Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22466)
*Wenxuan Ding,Qin Lu,Changlong Yu,Sha Li,Shuowei Jin,Xin Liu,Zhenyu Shi,Greg Durrett*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 Harness-Delta Attribution (HDA) 评估协议，将 agent harness 演化收益拆解为过拟合、测试时扩展与残余可泛化增益三部分；在 11 个执行模型、3 个演化框架、4 类任务中发现，显著增益的 21 个设定里过拟合与测试时扩展平均分别占 54% 与 14%，残余泛化增益有限且迁移性差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Harness evolution 可直接优化固定权重模型外围的 prompt、技能、工具与编排代码，从而在不更新权重的情况下提升 agent 系统性能。但现有工作只报告搜索集上的性能提升，无法区分这些增益究竟来自基准特定的过拟合、额外的推理时计算，还是可泛化到搜索集之外的真实改进，缺乏对增益来源的归因评估。

Method: 提出 Harness-Delta Attribution（HDA）评估协议，将演化增益分解为三部分：artifact-driven overfitting（伪影驱动的过拟合）、由 test-time scaling 解释的增益，以及扣除前两者后的残余部分（作为残余可泛化改进的上界）。在 11 个执行模型与 3 个 harness-evolution 框架上，覆盖数学、编程、创造性及 agentic 任务进行验证，并考察留出任务迁移与基于验证集信号对过拟合的抑制作用。

Result: 在 21 个搜索集增益具统计显著性的设定中，过拟合与测试时扩展平均分别解释 54% 和 14% 的增益，二者合计占比在 14 个设定中超过 50%。残余增益与留出迁移在任务、模型、框架间差异显著；搜索集增益常无法迁移到留出任务，对其在真实分布偏移下能否保持的证据有限。此外，基于验证集的信号不足以防止过拟合。

Conclusion: Harness evolution 报告的搜索集增益在很大程度上由过拟合与额外推理计算所解释，难以作为可泛化改进的证据。未来 harness evolution 研究应采用归因感知（attribution-aware）的评估范式，明确区分增益来源并报告留出迁移表现。

Abstract: Harness evolution automatically optimizes the prompts, skills, tools, and orchestration code around a fixed-weight model, offering a way to improve agentic systems without updating model weights. The agent harness is iteratively optimized to achieve higher performance on the search set. But how much of this gain reflects benchmark-specific overfitting or additional inference-time compute, and how much may generalize beyond the search set? In this work, we introduce Harness-Delta Attribution (HDA), an evaluation protocol that dissects an evolution gain into artifact-driven overfitting, gains explained by test-time scaling, and the remainder, which gives an upper bound on residual generalizable improvement. We apply HDA to 11 executor models and three harness-evolution frameworks across math, coding, creativity, and agentic tasks. In 21 of these settings that show statistically significant search-set gains, we find that a large share of the improvement is explained by overfitting or test-time scaling. Specifically, among these 21 settings, overfitting and test-time scaling account for 54% and 14% of the gain on average; their combined share exceeds 50% in 14 settings. The residual and held-out transfer vary substantially across tasks, models, and frameworks. Importantly, search-set gains often fail to transfer to held-out tasks, and provide limited evidence that they will persist under practical distribution shifts. Moreover, validation-based signals are insufficient to prevent overfitting. These results motivate attribution-aware evaluation in future harness evolution research.

</details>


### [370] [Testing the Planning Claims of LLM-Based Agents against Formal Semantics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22469)
*Oriol Miro-Lopez-Feliu,Oscar Miró López-Feliu,Victor Gimenez-Abalos,Javier Vazquez-Salceda,Victor Carballo Araruna,Sergio Alvarez-Napagao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文用隐藏PDDL模型对LLM智能体的规划能力进行形式化验证，发现最佳配置离线解78%可解任务而在线仅40%，不可解任务识别率不足10%，提示策略收益不明而模型差异更大。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体常被宣称具备规划、监控与自我纠错等实践推理能力，但这些结论多依赖端到端成功率（仅反映任务是否完成）或LLM评审（并非真正的验证器），缺乏严格证据。作者主张智能体的规划声明必须由经过验证的动作轨迹来支撑，因此需要一个可判定的形式化基准来检验。

Method: 任务以自然语言呈现，但每个任务都锚定在一个隐藏的PDDL形式化模型上，由该模型严格判定每个动作是否可应用、目标是否达成、以及是否存在可行规划。实验覆盖五个领域（其中两个为论文新发布）、四个模型、六种提示策略与三种智能体架构，并与离线/在线两种执行设定对比。

Result: 最佳配置离线仅解决78%的可解任务，在线降至40%，且智能体大多在不检查状态的情况下行动；不可解任务仅在不到10%的回合中被识别；更重的提示策略消耗5–22倍token却无明显收益；性能在模型间的差异大于提示策略或智能体架构之间的差异。

Conclusion: 现有提示策略与智能体架构对LLM规划能力的提升被高估，端到端成功率与LLM评审不足以证明规划能力；关于智能体能规划的断言应基于形式化验证的动作轨迹证据。

Abstract: LLM-based agents are increasingly credited with the competences of practical reasoning: planning, monitoring, and correcting their own actions. Their success is attributed to the prompting strategies and agent architectures built around the model, such as chain-of-thought, search-based prompting, self-refinement, reflection, critics and tool-using loops. Yet these claims are usually supported by end-to-end success rates, which show only whether a task was completed, or by LLM judges, which are not verifiers. We test LLM planning against formal semantics. Tasks are posed in natural language, but each is grounded in a hidden PDDL model that decides whether every action is applicable, whether the goal is reached, and whether a plan exists at all. Across five domains (two of them new, all released with the paper), four models, six prompting strategies and three agent architectures, the best configuration solves 78% of the solvable tasks offline but only 40% online, where agents mostly act without inspecting the state. Unsolvable tasks are recognised in under 10% of episodes, and heavier prompting strategies use 5 to 22 times as many tokens as direct prompting with no clear gain. In our experiments, planning performance varied more across models than across prompting strategies or agent architectures. Claims that agents can plan require evidence from validated action traces.

</details>


### [371] [Are Large Reasoning Models Good Everyday Reasoners? A Comparison with Non-Reasoning Models on Logical Reasoning Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22538)
*Kentaro Ozeki,Risako Ando,Takanobu Morishita,Hirohiko Abe,Koji Mineshima,Mitsuhiro Okada*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文构建基于语言与语用推理现象的基准，系统评测大型推理模型在日常逻辑推理上与人类日常推理模式的契合度，并与非推理模型在受控提示条件下比较，发现推理模型在日常推理偏离形式逻辑时性能下降，部分带思维链提示的非推理模型反而更优，且额外指令提示对推理行为的控制有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型推理模型依靠测试时计算在数学与科学基准上表现强劲并已投入实际应用，但其在"日常逻辑推理"（常偏离教科书式形式逻辑）上的能力尚未被充分探索；且现有后训练目标可能未覆盖多样化的推理形式，需要新的评测来揭示这一缺口。

Method: 引入一个基于语言学与语用学推理现象的日常逻辑推理基准；在受控提示条件下，将推理模型与非推理模型进行对比评测，并考察思维链提示及附加指令提示对推理行为的影响。

Result: (1) 当日常推理偏离形式逻辑规则时，推理模型在许多情况下性能下降；(2) 部分采用思维链提示的非推理模型在日常推理上优于同类推理模型；(3) 附加指令提示对推理行为的控制作用有限。

Conclusion: 当前推理模型无法可靠地捕捉日常推理，反映出后训练阶段的局限，说明需要改进训练目标，并在多样化推理形式上进行更全面的评测。

Abstract: Large reasoning models (LRMs) that leverage test-time computation achieve strong performance on mathematical and scientific benchmarks and are increasingly deployed in real-world applications. However, their ability to perform \textit{everyday logical reasoning}, which often departs from textbook formal logic, remains underexplored. In this work, we systematically evaluate how well reasoning models align with everyday reasoning patterns by introducing a benchmark based on linguistic and pragmatic reasoning phenomena. We also compare reasoning models with non-reasoning models under controlled prompting conditions. We find that, in many cases, (1) reasoning models show degraded performance in everyday reasoning when such reasoning deviates from formal logical rules, (2) some non-reasoning models with chain-of-thought prompting outperform comparable reasoning models in everyday reasoning, and (3) prompting with additional instructions provides limited control over reasoning behavior. These findings suggest that current reasoning models do not reliably capture everyday reasoning and point to limitations in post-training, motivating improved training objectives and evaluation across diverse forms of reasoning.

</details>


### [372] [FRACTAL: A Self-Similar Multi-Agent Orchestration Architecture with Formal Communication, Convergence, and Depth Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22561)
*Ohad Dan,Abhinav Taliyan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出FRACTAL——一种自相似多智能体架构，五组件模式在分解树每层递归；给出通信界、双模式编排判据、超多数收敛与深度界、贝叶斯层间升级四项形式化贡献，但无定量实证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自由辩论式多智能体协作的通信代价高（二次），且缺乏对递归分解、收敛、升级决策的形式化刻画；本文希望以"分形"自相似组织模式统一各层结构并给出可证明的性质。

Method: 同一五组件（Orchestrator, Ensemble, Knowledge Ledger, Decision Maker, Meta-Observer）在分解树每层递归；采用两阶段"盲提案/压力测试"协议；以多样性饱和阈值划分生成与评估两相；用超多数规则给出收敛概率界与基于目标复杂度度量的深度界；以单一后验更新统一迟滞与契约违背信号的贝叶斯升级机制。定性示例与多层案例说明执行。

Result: 节点内通信代价O(kr)（k为集成规模，r为轮数），显著优于自由辩论的二次代价；给出给定一致度下的超多数收敛概率界与深度界；升级机制统一两类触发信号。论文不含定量性能结论。

Conclusion: FRACTAL是架构性/形式化的概念框架，"fractal"仅作自相似隐喻而非可测数学性质；作者明确讨论形式化假设与归纳偏置局限，比较性能的实证验证留待未来工作。

Abstract: We present FRACTAL, a self-similar multi-agent architecture for recursive goal decomposition, in which the same five-component organizational pattern -- Orchestrator, Ensemble, Knowledge Ledger, Decision Maker, Meta-Observer -- recurs at every level of a decomposition tree. We make four formal contributions: (1) a communication bound showing intra-node cost is linear in ensemble size and round count (O(kr)) under a two-phase blind-proposal/stress-test protocol, versus quadratic cost for free-form debate, with an explicit, stated assumption on fixed evaluator count; (2) a two-mode orchestration criterion separating generative and evaluative phases via a measurable diversity-saturation threshold; (3) a supermajority convergence guarantee with explicit probability bounds at stated agreement levels, and a formal depth bound under an operationalized goal-complexity measure; (4) a Bayesian inter-layer escalation mechanism unifying hysteresis and contract-breach signaling under one posterior update. We illustrate the architecture's execution qualitatively on a worked example and a multi-layer case study; we do not report quantitative performance claims in this paper, and we explicitly discuss the formal and inductive-bias limitations of the model, including an unimplemented but architecture-compatible direction toward bounded self-improvement.
