Result: 500个高分技能包中96.8%含至少两类功能角色知识；6个基准、3个模型、2个执行框架的36个设置均取得最高分，较Base提升7.6个百分点，较最强基线平均高2.6个百分点；消融实验支持功能分化与自适应调用的重要性。

Conclusion: 技能内部功能分化是技能演化的关键设计维度，CDSE通过四组件协同与自适应调用显著提升智能体任务表现。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents tackle complex tasks through reasoning and interaction with external environments. Agent skills provide persistent, transferable capabilities that guide task planning, inform contextual decisions, support tool use, and enable executable procedures. Yet existing skill-evolution methods largely organize knowledge around skill artifacts, overlooking the functional heterogeneity within individual skills and its implications for knowledge maintenance and use. Inspired by cognitive science, we propose Cognitive Differentiation in Skill Evolution (CDSE), which evolves a unified skill through four functionally distinct yet coordinated components: Meta, Experience, Tool, and Script. CDSE extracts evidence-grounded semantic gradients from successful and failed trajectories, consolidates them by functional role, and applies component-specific updates and validation with cross-component coordination and adaptive invocation. An analysis of 500 top-ranked skill packages shows that 96.8% contain knowledge spanning at least two functional roles. Across six benchmarks, three agent models, and two execution harnesses, CDSE achieves the highest scores in all 36 settings, improving over the Base agent by 7.6 percentage points and the strongest competing method in each setting by 2.6 points on average. Ablation studies further support the importance of functional differentiation and adaptive invocation.

</details>


### [442] [GEMS: Molecular Structure Elucidation as Learned Search over Isomer Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23617)
*Utku Umur Acikalin,Yingheng Wang,Goncalo J. Gouveia,Tyler J. Schwertfeger,Frank C. Schroeder,Carla P. Gomes*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GEMS通过可学习的2-switch键编辑（保持分子式与原子价态）对候选结构进行迭代精修，在NPLIB1和MassSpecGym上以约3.3分钟实现超过已发表基线的结构鉴定精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无靶向代谢组学与天然产物发现中，仅凭分子式与串联质谱（MS/MS）确定小分子结构仍是瓶颈；数据库检索或de novo预测常无法命中精确结构，但其候选物仅需少数键编辑即可到达邻近真实结构，因此需要一种对候选结构进行局部定向修正的方法。

Method: GEMS用MIST（预训练的谱图→指纹模型）对每条谱图一次性预测指纹概率；神经策略网络将候选结构的指纹与预测指纹比对，把存在的特征映射到生成该特征的原子与键，并在单次前向传播中对所有合法编辑打分。策略以结构间最短编辑路径为监督，先在无谱图的PubChem异构体上预训练，再用谱图预测指纹微调。推理时从多个匹配分子式的初始候选出发搜索，并按指纹一致性与多起点共识对候选排序。

Result: 在PubChem初始化中排除目标结构时，三轮编辑在NPLIB1上达到Hit@1 29.64%/Hit@10 50.81%，在MassSpecGym上达到30.22%/41.33%，优于同等设置下已发表基线；NPLIB1上端到端约3.3分钟即获得更高鉴定准确率，而FRIGID运行需26.2小时。GEMS亦能改进由生成式候选（含经FRIGID精修者）出发的鉴定。使用精确目标指纹的实验表明，指纹预测误差是目标回收与最终排序的瓶颈；更深层搜索无需重训练即可回收更多目标，且从较弱初始候选出发收益更大。

Conclusion: 局部、保分子式的键编辑搜索是提升MS/MS结构鉴定的高效补充手段；未来改进重点在于降低指纹预测误差，并可通过增加搜索深度进一步换取召回而不需重训练。

Abstract: Identifying small-molecule structures from molecular formulas and tandem mass spectra remains a bottleneck in untargeted metabolomics and natural-product discovery. Even when database retrieval or de novo prediction misses the exact structure, the resulting candidates can provide starting points for exploring nearby structures through a few bond edits. We introduce GEMS (Guided Editing of Molecular Structures), which refines candidates through learned 2-switch bond edits that preserve the molecular formula and each atom's total valence. GEMS uses MIST, a pretrained spectrum-to-fingerprint model, to predict fingerprint probabilities once per spectrum. A neural policy compares each candidate's fingerprint with these predictions, links present features to the atoms and bonds that generate them, and scores all valid edits in one forward pass. The policy is trained on shortest edit paths between structures, so it can be pretrained on PubChem isomers without spectra and then fine-tuned with spectrum-predicted fingerprints. At inference, GEMS searches from multiple initial candidates matching the supplied molecular formula and ranks candidates by fingerprint agreement and multi-start consensus. With the target structure excluded from PubChem initialization, three edit rounds achieve Hit@1/Hit@10 of 29.64%/50.81% on NPLIB1 and 30.22%/41.33% on MassSpecGym, exceeding published baselines under comparable settings. On NPLIB1, GEMS achieves higher identification accuracy in about 3.3 minutes end to end, compared with 26.2 hours for our FRIGID run. GEMS also improves identification from generated candidates, including those refined by FRIGID. Experiments with exact target fingerprints identify fingerprint prediction error as a bottleneck in target recovery and final ranking. Deeper search recovers additional targets without retraining, with larger gains from weaker initial candidates.

</details>


### [443] [OwlSight: A Panoramic Monitor for Chain-of-Thought Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23670)
*Lewen Yan,Yanxu Zhu,Jie Zhang,Jing Shao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Factor for CoT monitoring策略与OwlSight监控器，通过提示中可定制的细/粗粒度factor实现单监控器覆盖多任务，在15,971条推理轨迹上显著超越通用LLM并取得SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CoT监控方法局限于特定任务，而推理模型的监管需要覆盖更广的任务范围，缺乏可跨任务复用的统一监控手段。

Method: 提出Factor for CoT monitoring：将监控需求以提示中的factor形式定制，单一监控器依据不同factor适配不同任务；定义细粒度（如某邮箱是否泄露）与粗粒度（如隐私泄露）两类factor。据此构建OwlSight，仅依赖factor监控能力、安全、可信等多维度行为。

Result: 在15,971条推理轨迹上，OwlSight在细粒度与粗粒度上分别领先通用LLM 1.32–30.57分和11.71–27.81分；在OpenAI CoT可监控性基准上达到SOTA；可泛化至未见模型的CoT，并对factor改写、CoT压缩与混淆保持鲁棒。

Conclusion: factor驱动的CoT监控为前沿AI的监督提供了可定制、跨任务、鲁棒的范式。

Abstract: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) monitoring offers actionable evidence for oversight AI systems, with the potential to enable early detection and intervention. However, existing approaches are focused on specific tasks, whereas the regulation of AI, particularly reasoning models, requires monitoring a broader range of tasks. We introduce Factor for CoT monitoring, a strategy that supports customizing monitoring requirements in the prompt, which enables a single monitor to cover different tasks by relying on different factors. Furthermore, we introduce two types of factors, fine-grained and coarse-grained (e.g., monitoring whether a specific email address has been leaked versus monitoring privacy leakage), to accommodate diverse user monitoring needs. Based on this, we develop a CoT monitor named OwlSight that relies solely on factor to monitor behaviors related to multiple dimensions, including capability, safety, and trustworthiness. Experiments across 15,971 reasoning trajectories show that OwlSight surpasses general-purpose LLMs by 1.32-30.57 and 11.71-27.81 points at fine and coarse granularity, respectively, and achieves state-of-the-art results on OpenAI's CoT monitorability benchmark. It also generalizes to unseen models' CoTs and remains robust to Factor rephrasings, CoT compression, and obfuscation, offering a promising paradigm for CoT monitoring that can contribute to the oversight of frontier AI.

</details>


### [444] [Beyond Large Language Models: A Mental World Model Framework for Mental Modeling, Simulation, Evolution, and Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23722)
*Qingshi Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出"心理世界模型"（MWM）及其实现"多分支心理演化架构"（MMEA），显式构建主观世界、建模认知与心理状态的交互并模拟受历史经验塑造的连续心理演化，在ToM任务上显著超越LLM与专用方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM与心理理论（ToM）方法主要从语言信息推断心理状态，缺乏统一机制来处理主观世界构建、认知—心理交互、动态演化与历史依赖，难以实现深层社会认知。

Method: 提出MWM概念框架，并实现为MMEA：多分支结构显式构建个体主观世界，建模认知与心理状态之间的交互，并以历史经验为条件模拟连续的心理状态演化过程。

Result: 在DynToM与RecToM上分别达96.48%和94.00%准确率，优于主流LLM与专用ToM方法；在心理状态与行为预测、长序列预测、隐含心理状态推断上分别提升28.7、39.3、16.6个百分点。

Conclusion: MMEA提供了可解释的连续心理建模框架，使AI超越表层语义表征、从语言推断个体潜在心理状态并动态模拟其内部认知演化；MWM为因果推理、个性化AI、持续性人机交互及通向AGI的研究提供基础。

Abstract: Understanding and simulating how subjective cognition and mental states emerge, evolve, and shape behavior is essential for advancing artificial intelligence toward deeper social cognition and general intelligence. Existing large language models (LLMs) and Theory of Mind (ToM) methods primarily infer mental states from linguistic information, lacking unified mechanisms for subjective world construction, cognitive-psychological interactions, dynamic evolution, and historical dependencies. This paper introduces the Mental World Model (MWM) and its implementation, the Multi-Branch Mental Evolution Architecture (MMEA), which explicitly constructs subjective worlds, models interactions between cognition and mental states, and simulates continuous mental evolution shaped by historical experiences. On DynToM and RecToM, MMEA achieves 96.48% and 94.00% accuracy, respectively, outperforming leading LLMs and specialized ToM methods. Additional experiments demonstrate improvements of 28.7, 39.3, and 16.6 percentage points in mental state and behavior prediction, long-sequence prediction, and implicit mental state inference, respectively. The results demonstrate that MMEA provides an interpretable framework for continuous mental modeling, enabling AI to move beyond surface-level semantic representations to infer individuals' underlying mental states from linguistic information and dynamically simulate their internal cognitive processes and evolution over time. MWM also provides a promising foundation for causal reasoning, personalized AI, sustained human-AI interaction, and future advances toward artificial general intelligence (AGI).

</details>


### [445] [DrugHarness: An Evolvable Agent Harness for Computational Drug Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23791)
*Yuxing Chen,Zhisheng Zhang,Cheng Tang,Wei Li,Minghui Zhang,Ziyan Huang,Shaocong Wei,Jiawei Chen,Junru Hu,Hongze Zhu,Jianghan Shen,Min Cen,Xinyuan Zhu,Yaxue Zhao,Jubo Wang,Yuqiang Li,Chun-Mei Feng,Zongyuan Ge,Rui Su,Jie Xu,Yirong Chen,Xi Xu,Ming Hu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 DrugHarness——一个可演化的智能体框架，将可组合的科学执行与条件化技能归纳相耦合，用于计算药物发现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算药物发现要求智能体能组合科学操作并适应不断变化的证据与约束，现有智能体缺乏可积累、可验证且能随反馈修正的技能机制。

Method: 环境集成 80 余种科学操作、生物医学资源与任务专用代码，保留候选物—结果—产物的关联；从执行轨迹与结果反馈中归纳带可观测适用条件、推荐动作与支持证据的动作假设；由独立审查智能体通过来源验证与针对性执行试验评估候选技能，通过者指导后续任务并依据反馈迭代修订。

Result: 在 MolBench 与 SMDD-Bench 上验证分子筛选、优化与约束设计能力；未演化时亲和力比较准确率超 MolClaw-CC 10.8 个百分点，平均 top-3 活性命中数提升 55%；回溯评估中 Qwen 亲和力比较准确率由 62.2% 升至 81.1%，优化成功率由 79.5% 升至 87.2%；前瞻性 HPK1 研究中中位对接分数优于 Biomni；合成化合物细胞 IC50 达 14.19 nM，较最佳输入参照提升 2.64 倍。

Conclusion: 结果支持科学智能体的条件化技能演化，并展示了连接计算药物设计与实验验证的完整工作流。

Abstract: Computational drug discovery requires agents to compose scientific operations and adapt to changing evidence and constraints. Here we introduce DrugHarness, an evolvable agent harness coupling composable scientific execution with conditional skill induction. Its environment integrates over 80 scientific operations, biomedical resources and task-specific code, preserving associations among candidates, results and artifacts. From execution trajectories and outcome feedback, DrugHarness induces action hypotheses with observable applicability conditions, recommended actions and supporting evidence. An independent review agent evaluates candidate skills derived from these hypotheses through source verification and, when needed, targeted execution trials. Admitted skills guide subsequent tasks and are revised through feedback. Evaluation on MolBench and SMDD-Bench demonstrates capabilities in molecular screening, optimization and constrained design. Without evolution, DrugHarness exceeds reported MolClaw-CC results by 10.8 percentage points in affinity-comparison accuracy and 55% in mean top-three active hits on MolBench. Retrospective evaluation on skill-development tasks shows that evolution increases Qwen's affinity-comparison accuracy from 62.2% to 81.1% and optimization success from 79.5% to 87.2%. In a prospective HPK1 study, DrugHarness achieves a more favorable median docking score than Biomni among system-specific candidates. A synthesized compound achieves a cellular IC50 of 14.19 nM, a 2.64-fold potency improvement over the best input reference, with activity competitive with two selected compounds designed by experienced medicinal chemists. These results support conditional skill evolution for scientific agents and demonstrate a workflow connecting computational drug design with experimental validation.

</details>


### [446] [FuTransformer: FP8 prefill and INT4 decode for Llama-style inference on Hopper](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23796)
*Wei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FUTRANSFORMER 是面向 NVIDIA Hopper GPU 的 Llama 风格 Transformer 块 CUDA 实现，将 CODA 的 GEMM+epilogue 思路用于推理；预填充（prefill）采用 FP8 直写与免填充支持，解码（decode）采用 INT4 投影权重与 INT4 KV-cache，并结合 Tensor Core fragment 布局直接反量化与块对角 Hadamard 旋转降低量化误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Prefill 受限于矩阵乘与激活数据搬运、decode 受限于权重与 KV-cache 读取，二者瓶颈不同；作者希望用统一的 GEMM+epilogue 框架同时高效覆盖两种阶段，并在低精度（FP8/INT4）下保持精度。

Method: 基于 CUDA 在 Hopper 上实现 Llama 块：①直接 KV-cache 放置；②将固定 RMSNorm gain 折叠进权重；③FP8 输出直接写回并采用延迟缩放（delayed scaling）；④支持无 padding 的 prefill；⑤decode 使用 INT4 投影权重与 INT4 KV-cache 副本；⑥权重与 key 采用 Tensor Core fragment 布局，可直接反量化为 MMA 操作数、避免完整中间 tile；⑦块对角 Hadamard 变换抑制 outlier 通道带来的 cache 量化误差。

Result: 单张 H100 上：prefill 比编译版 PyTorch FP8 快至 1.48x，达 1.29 PFLOP/s；8B 形状 gate/up+SwiGLU 下 BF16 路径比 CODA 快 1.13x，FP8 路径比所评测的 BF16 CODA 快 2.02–2.18x。8B/70B 形状、batch 1–32 下 INT4 decode 比 PyTorch BF16 与 INT4 中较优者快 1.3–2.4x（比编译+CUDA Graph 的 BF16 快 2.1–3.3x，比 PyTorch INT4 投影核快 1.3–6.3x，后者仅针对单 query 行且 batch 32 时劣于 BF16），比自身 FP8 路径快 31–51%。Llama-3.1-8B 完整 decode 在 batch 1 下为 2.8 ms/step（编译版 transformers 为 8.1 ms）。INT4 权重路径下 WikiText-2 困惑度由 6.24 升至 7.23（RTN）或 6.99（GPTQ），旋转 INT4 cache 额外增加 0.20；kernel 与量化参考计算困惑度差在 0.001 内。

Conclusion: 按 prefill（计算密集）与 decode（访存密集）分别定制的低精度内核设计可在 Hopper 上显著超越 PyTorch/CODA 基线，且通过 fragment 级反量化与 Hadamard 旋转将 INT4 量化精度损失控制在可接受范围，实现速度与精度的良好折中。

Abstract: Transformer prefill reuses weights across tokens and is dominated by matrix multiplication and activation data movement; single-token decode has limited reuse and is dominated by weight and KV-cache reads. We present FUTRANSFORMER, a CUDA implementation of a Llama-style Transformer block for NVIDIA Hopper GPUs. It applies CODA's GEMM-plus-epilogue approach to inference, adding direct KV-cache placement, folding the fixed RMSNorm gain into weights, writing FP8 output directly with delayed scaling, and supporting prefill without padding. Decode uses INT4 projection weights and an INT4 KV-cache copy. Weights and keys follow Tensor Core fragment layouts for direct dequantization into MMA operands without full intermediate tiles. A block-diagonal Hadamard transform reduces cache quantization error from outlier channels. On one H100, prefill is up to 1.48x faster than compiled PyTorch FP8 and reaches 1.29 PFLOP/s. For gate/up projection with SwiGLU at the 8B shape, our BF16 path is 1.13x faster than CODA. Our FP8 path is 2.02-2.18x faster than the evaluated BF16 CODA path. Across 8B and 70B shapes at batches 1-32, INT4 decode is 1.3-2.4x faster than the faster of PyTorch's BF16 and INT4 blocks at each point: 2.1-3.3x faster than compiled, CUDA-graphed BF16 and 1.3-6.3x faster than the same block using PyTorch's INT4 projection kernel, which targets a single query row and loses to BF16 at batch 32. It is also 31-51% faster than our FP8 path. Complete Llama-3.1-8B decode takes 2.8 ms per step at batch one, versus 8.1 ms for the compiled transformers implementation. Decoding every WikiText-2 token through the INT4 weight path raises perplexity from 6.24 to 7.23 with round-to-nearest weights or 6.99 with GPTQ in the same format; the rotated INT4 cache adds 0.20. The kernels match a quantized reference computation within 0.001 perplexity.

</details>


### [447] [Beyond SAEs: Consistent Concept Discovery with Sparse Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23801)
*Jinho Choi,Hyesu Lim,Jaegul Choo,Steffen Schneider*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出ConSDL，用逐样本稀疏编码替代线性编码器，提高稀疏自编码器字典学习的一致性与可复现性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）通过将激活分解为学习到的字典原子的稀疏组合来解释基础模型表征，但学到的字典在不同训练种子/运行间存在差异，削弱了SAE分析的可靠性与可复现性。

Method: ConSDL将标准SAE中的线性编码器替换为逐样本稀疏编码（per-sample sparse coding）。动机来自合成分析：单次线性编码器前向得到的系数，相比逐样本优化得到的系数是次优的，说明稀疏编码是更可靠的字典学习机制。

Result: 在16个合成设置中实现近乎完美的字典与系数恢复；在4个视觉与语言设置上取得最优的跨种子一致性，相比6个SAE基线的平均值，字典一致性与系数一致性分别提升17.6%和35.9%。

Conclusion: 逐样本稀疏编码可显著提升SAE字典与系数学习的准确性和跨训练运行的一致性，为SAE解释性分析提供更可靠的方案。

Abstract: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) explain foundation model representations by decomposing activations into sparse combinations of learned dictionary atoms. However, the learned dictionaries can vary across training runs, limiting the reliability and reproducibility of SAE-based analyses. We propose Consistent Sparse Dictionary Learning (ConSDL), which replaces the standard linear encoder with per-sample sparse coding. This is motivated by our synthetic analysis showing that coefficients from a single linear encoder pass are suboptimal compared with those obtained by per-sample optimization, suggesting that sparse coding is a reliable mechanism for dictionary learning. Across 16 synthetic settings, ConSDL achieves near-perfect dictionary and coefficient recovery. These gains translate to state-of-the-art cross-seed consistency across four vision and language settings, where ConSDL improves dictionary and coefficient consistency by 17.6% and 35.9%, respectively, over the average of six SAE baselines.

</details>


### [448] [Self-Building Labs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23826)
*Jiaru Bai,Yuchi Zhao,Han Hao,Miroslav Bogdanovic,Yang Cao,Varinia Bernales,Alán Aspuru-Guzik*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出自建实验室（SBL）框架，使实验室能够根据高层科学目标自主设计、配置并运行实验装置，从空房间到已有SDL均可补齐缺失能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自驱动实验室（SDL）只能执行其建造时预设的流程，迁移到新实验需大量人工工程，实验室灵活性成为规模化科学发现的瓶颈。

Method: SBL从现有条件出发，自动构建实验室布局、数字孪生、机器人技能与实验工作流四项缺失能力，并在多种机器人与装置配置上验证，覆盖单工作站到多机器人协同实验室。

Result: 系统跨不同机器人与装置组合均可运行，并以真实量子点合成实验完成端到端能力验证。

Conclusion: 将人类研究者的角色从手动配置与编程设备自动化转变为指定科学目标，使科学自动化更易获得、更灵活且更具可扩展性。

Abstract: Self-driving laboratories (SDLs) accelerate scientific discovery by automating experimental execution and optimization. AI agents can increasingly propose new experiments, but existing SDLs can only run the procedures they were built for. Adapting them to a new experiment still takes extensive manual engineering, which makes laboratory flexibility the bottleneck for scaling discovery. We introduce the self-building laboratory (SBL), which designs, configures, and operates its own laboratory setup given a high-level scientific goal. SBL starts from whatever already exists, from an empty room to a working SDL, and builds the missing capabilities: the lab layout, its digital twin, robot skills, and experimental workflows. We demonstrate the system working across different robots and setups, scaling from a single workstation to laboratories with several robots working together. We validate SBL's end-to-end capabilities through a real-world quantum-dot synthesis experiment. By shifting the role of human researchers from manually configuring and programming device automation to specifying scientific objectives, SBL makes scientific automation more accessible, flexible, and scalable. Project website: https://self-building-labs.github.io/

</details>


### [449] [AI-Driven Reproducibility and Analytical Robustness in Scientific Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23845)
*Shicheng Liu,Krista Opsahl-Ong,Andrew Drozdov,Julian Killingback,Arnav Singhvi,Ronak Pradeep,Michael Bendersky,James C. Dickerson,Monica S. Lam*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出SEER-Repro基准（20篇SEER论文及复现所需数据资源）与LLM智能体，成功复现2,190条原子结论中的77.4%，并构建智能体化分析流水线检验结论稳健性，在9.5%完全复现的发现中识别出潜在关键性分析选择并提请专家复核。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可复现性与分析稳健性是科学进步的基础，但评估这些性质通常依赖昂贵的人工投入。作者希望探究LLM智能体能否自动化复现与稳健性分析，并以基于SEER数据库的医学案例为切入点。

Method: 三步：1) 构建SEER-Repro基准，包含20篇已发表SEER论文及复现其结论所需的数据与资源；2) 开发AI智能体执行复现，并产出可执行基线；3) 构建智能体化分析流水线，识别每项发现背后的分析选择、提出可辩护的替代方案并重跑分析，判断这些选择是否影响结论。

Result: 智能体成功复现2,190条原子结论中的77.4%；稳健性流水线在9.5%完全复现的发现中识别出潜在关键性分析选择并将其标记以供专家审查。

Conclusion: LLM智能体可支持科学审查：复现研究结论、系统性检验其稳健性，并将专家注意力引导至可能具有关键影响的分析选择。

Abstract: Reproducible and analytically robust research findings are essential to scientific progress, but evaluating these properties typically requires costly manual effort. We investigate whether LLM agents can help automate reproduction and robustness analysis, using a medical case study grounded in the Surveillance, Epidemiology, and End Results (SEER) database, a widely used U.S. cancer registry underlying tens of thousands of published studies. First, we introduce SEER-Repro, a benchmark of 20 published SEER-based papers together with the data and resources required to reproduce their findings. Second, we create an AI agent that successfully reproduces 77.4% of 2,190 atomic claims, while providing executable baselines for further analysis. Third, we develop an agentic analysis pipeline to test the robustness of the medical findings by identifying analytical choices underlying each finding, proposing defensible alternatives, and rerunning the analysis to determine whether those choices affect the conclusion. Across published papers in SEER-Repro, our pipeline identifies potentially consequential analytical choices in 9.5% of fully reproduced findings and flags them for expert review. These results show how LLM agents can support scientific review by reproducing findings, systematically testing their robustness, and directing expert attention toward potentially consequential analytical choices.

</details>


<div id='eess.SP'></div>

# eess.SP [[Back]](#toc)

### [450] [Asynchronous Cell-Free Wireless Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22641)
*Hossein Maleki,Angel Lozano,Hamid Jafarkhani*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 论文提出"有意符号级异步"作为无蜂窝网络上行链路的干扰管理机制，通过有意图地给用户分配时延来降低多用户干扰、提升频谱效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上把定时偏移视为损伤，而论文反其道而行，把时延当作可利用的自由度来抑制无蜂窝上行中的多用户干扰。

Method: 设计可扩展接收机架构：同步信道估计导频、异步数据传输、有界匹配滤波采样与加窗合并；以冲突度量刻画多用户干扰严重程度，用低复杂度贪心算法求解时延分配，并以混合整数线性规划（MILP）给出中小规模网络的精确基准方法。

Result: 矩形脉冲与根升余弦脉冲下的数值结果均表明，即使采用小时延码本和短观测窗，相对同步传输也能获得显著性能提升。

Conclusion: 有意符号级异步是可行且有效的干扰管理手段，为无蜂窝上行提供了新思路，并具备低复杂度工程实现路径。

Abstract: This paper introduces intentional symbol-level asynchronicity as an interference-management mechanism for the uplink of cell-free networks. Rather than treating timing offsets as impairments, user-specific delays are deliberately assigned to reduce multiuser interference and improve spectral efficiency. A scalable receiver architecture is devised with synchronous channel-estimation pilots, asynchronous data transmission, bounded matched-filter sampling, and windowed combining. The delay assignment is formulated by means of a conflict metric that measures the severity of multiuser interference and is solved through a low-complexity greedy algorithm. As a benchmark, an exact method is also formulated for small and moderate network sizes using mixed-integer linear programming. Numerical results with both rectangular and root-raised-cosine pulses confirm that considerable performance improvements are feasible relative to synchronous transmissions, even with small delay codebooks and short observation windows.

</details>


### [451] [Continuous-Phase Frequency-Hopping MIMO Signaling and Processing for ISAC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22956)
*Yi Wang,Xianxiang Yu,Jing Yang,Tao Fan,Linlong Wu,Xiangrong Wang,Guolong Cui*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出一种连续相位跳频（CP-FH）MIMO ISAC波形，信息由频率组合与CPM符号联合承载，并配套设计无需信道相位信息的投影能量解调与结构匹配的雷达相干处理，实现通信与雷达一体化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FH-MIMO-ISAC虽支持敏捷多维信号，但面临相位连续传输、无信道相位信息解调、多频回波相干处理三大挑战，需设计波形与收发处理相匹配的一体化方案。

Method: 波形层：CPM相位累积与跳频LFM相位补偿保证相位连续、抑制频谱泄漏；理论层：推导阵元间正交条件、残余互相关界与平均发射波束图起伏界。通信侧：投影能量解调（无需信道相位，弱互相关下近似LS检测），频率组合搜索与CPM符号判决分离。雷达侧：空-时-频匹配滤波+速度一致多普勒聚焦+频率孔径聚焦，形成粗距离-速度-精距离三维响应。

Result: 推导出精确的正交性条件、残余互相关上界和平均发射波束图起伏上界；投影能量解调在弱互相关下近似最小二乘检测，并降低复杂度；结构匹配处理减小多普勒失配损失和周期距离栅瓣带来的多余检测，并给出联合距离响应、输出信号/噪声功率与接收波束图的解析结果。

Conclusion: 该处理器在周期模糊下刻画了目标分辨极限，保持频率孔径距离分辨率与全孔径角分辨率，并在给定条件下具有相同输出噪声功率，验证了CP-FH MIMO ISAC波形与处理匹配的有效性。

Abstract: Frequency-hopping MIMO integrated sensing and communications (FH-MIMO-ISAC) supports agile multidimensional signaling but faces challenges in phase-continuous transmission, demodulation without channel-phase information, and coherent processing of multi-frequency echoes. We propose a continuous-phase frequency-hopping (CP-FH) MIMO ISAC waveform with matched communication and radar processing. Information is conveyed jointly by frequency combinations and continuous-phase-modulation symbols. CPM phase accumulation and frequency-hopping linear-frequency-modulation phase compensation maintain phase continuity and reduce spectral leakage. We derive exact inter-element orthogonality conditions, residual cross-correlation bounds, and a bound on averaged transmit-beampattern ripple. For communication, projection-energy demodulation requires no channel-phase information and approximates least-squares detection under weak inter-branch correlation. It separates frequency-combination search from CPM-symbol decisions, reducing complexity while retaining direct joint-search decisions. For radar, structure-matched coherent processing combines space-time-frequency matched filtering, velocity-consistent Doppler focusing, and frequency-aperture focusing to form a three-dimensional coarse-range--velocity--fine-range response. It reduces Doppler-mismatch loss and extra detections from periodic range grating lobes in conventional pulse-Doppler processing. We further derive the joint range response, output signal and noise powers, and receive beampattern. The analysis characterizes target-discrimination limits under periodic ambiguity and shows that the proposed processor preserves frequency-aperture range resolution and full-aperture angular resolution, with equal output noise power under the stated conditions.

</details>


### [452] [Integrated Sensing and Communication in 3GPP: Standardization, Performance Evaluation, and Experimental Validation Toward 6G](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.22995)
*Gosan Noh,Gebremeskel Seiley Abraha,Joshua Yabana,Nathaniel Foli,Michael Ankomah Asare,Evelyn Seyram Kakah,Mildred Nyantakyiwaa Okyere,De-Roy Ekow Sagoe,Shrayan Das,Pekka Kyösti,Junhyeong Kim,Kyoung-Jae Lee,Eunkyung Kim*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了3GPP中ISAC从Release 19需求与信道建模到Release 20 NR感知评估框架、RAN流程与系统架构的演进，并通过两个仿真案例与一项测试床测量研究给出评估方法，最终提出6G方向的开放挑战与分阶段评估路线图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ISAC正从物理层研究转向标准化蜂窝网络能力，需要在3GPP框架下统一信道建模、无线流程、网络架构与感知服务交付，并建立可复现、可校准的评估体系以衔接仿真、原型、测量与外场试验。

Method: (1) 梳理3GPP Release 19服务需求与目标感知信道建模、Release 20 NR感知评估框架及RAN流程与系统架构；(2) 案例一：多TRP无人机感知中比较硬判决、软判决与混合融合，基于接收端角度估计与分别标定的方法专属阈值评估检测率、虚警率及条件位置/速度精度；(3) 案例二：比较理想与实用感知辅助预测切换和传统切换，并计入感知误差与信息龄；(4) 测试床测量：刻画单站/双站无人机RCS随频率、平台与观测角的变化，为目标响应相关性建模提供实证。

Result: 多TRP融合方案在检测、虚警与定位/测速精度上呈现判决方式相关的性能—复杂度权衡；感知辅助预测切换在计入感知误差与信息龄后仍相对传统切换具有增益，但收益随信息时效下降；测量数据支持相关目标响应建模。

Conclusion: ISAC标准化需以校准信道模型、链路/系统级仿真、实时原型、受控测量与外场试验构成的分阶段评估路线图贯通各环节，未来应重点关注多节点融合、资源与干扰管理、网络演进、安全与隐私及可复现评估。

Abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) is evolving from a primarily physical-layer research into a standardized cellular-network capability spanning channel modeling, radio procedures, network architecture, and the delivery of sensing services. We review this progression within the Third Generation Partnership Project (3GPP), from Release 19 service requirements and target-aware channel modeling to the Release 20 New Radio (NR) sensing evaluation framework, radio access network procedures, and system architecture, and discuss future directions toward 6G. We then present two 3GPP-aligned simulation case studies to demonstrate the corresponding evaluation approaches. The first case study compares hard-decision, soft-decision, and hybrid fusion for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) sensing using multiple transmission and reception points (TRPs). Detection, false alarms, and conditional position and velocity accuracy are evaluated using receiver-derived angle estimates and separately calibrated method-specific thresholds. The second case study compares ideal and practical sensing-assisted predictive handover with conventional handover, while accounting for sensing error and information age. We further present a testbed-based measurement study that characterizes monostatic and bistatic UAV radar cross sections across frequencies, platforms, and observation angles and provides empirical support for correlated target-response modeling. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future research directions in multi-node fusion, resource and interference management, network evolution, security, privacy, and reproducible evaluation. Together, these components connect calibrated channel models, link- and system-level simulation, real-time prototypes, controlled measurements, and field trials through a staged evaluation roadmap.

</details>


### [453] [An Efficient Blind Detection of OFDM Signals with Unknown Parameters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23026)
*Ata Bartu Soyuer,Gokhan M. Guvensen*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文针对宽带频谱感知中功率、带宽、载频均未知的OFDM信号盲检测，建立了渐近协方差意义下可处理的离散时间信号模型，在单/多天线、噪声功率已知/未知四种情形下推导广义似然比检验（GLRT）检测器，并利用累积和（CUSUM）运算将检测统计量化简为一维搜索，实现高效检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 宽带频谱感知中OFDM信号的功率、带宽与载波频率往往先验未知，传统能量检测（Conv-ED）在此类失配条件下性能显著退化，因此需要设计对多未知参数鲁棒的盲检测器。

Method: 先给出接收信号模型并进行渐近协方差分析，得到可处理的离散时间表示；据此在单天线场景下针对噪声功率已知与未知两种情形推导GLRT检测器，再扩展至多天线情形得到相应多天线GLRT；通过CUSUM操作将检测器化简为一维搜索；同时对Conv-ED与假想的均匀最大功效（UMP）检验作理论分析，并给出所提方法与常规方法的计算复杂度分析。

Result: 理论分析揭示了系统参数对Conv-ED与UMP检测性能的影响；仿真结果显示，所提检测器的检测概率接近genie-aided检测器的上界，并显著优于常规检测方法，且仅需一维搜索、复杂度可控。

Conclusion: 基于渐近协方差建模与CUSUM化简的GLRT框架，可在单/多天线、噪声功率已知/未知条件下实现多未知参数OFDM信号的低复杂度盲检测，性能接近理想先验辅助检测器并显著超越传统方案。

Abstract: This study investigates efficient detector designs for the blind detection of orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) signals with unknown power, bandwidth, and carrier frequency in wideband spectrum sensing. We first describe the received signal model and conduct an asymptotic covariance analysis to obtain a tractable discrete-time representation. Based on this model, generalized likelihood ratio test (GLRT) detectors are derived for both known and unknown noise power cases in a single-antenna receiver setting. The proposed framework is subsequently extended to multi-antenna receivers, and the corresponding multi-antenna GLRT detectors are developed for both known and unknown noise power cases. Importantly, using the cumulative-sum (CUSUM) operations, the resulting detectors reduce to an efficient one-dimensional (1D) search in both single-antenna and multi-antenna settings. We also provide theoretical analysis for the conventional energy detector (Conv-ED) and the hypothetical uniformly most powerful (UMP) test to reveal the impact of system parameters on detection performance. In addition, computational complexity analysis is presented for both the proposed and conventional detectors. Finally, comprehensive simulation results are provided to evaluate the probability of detection. The results demonstrate that the proposed detectors achieve performance close to that of a genie-aided detector while significantly outperforming conventional detection approaches.

</details>


### [454] [Covert Digital Semantic Communication With Movable Antennas: Constellation Shaping, Spatial Optimization, and Semantic Mapping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23076)
*Yunfan Bai,Yuwen Qian,Hao Jiang,Yiyang Ni,Feng Shu,Jun Li,Shuning Zhang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种可移动天线辅助的隐蔽数字语义通信系统，联合设计星座、天线位置与语义收发机，在保证语义保真度的同时隐藏传输。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数字语义通信（SemCom）能高效传递源信号"语义"，但无线信道的广播特性使传输暴露于对抗性监听者；同时离散符号偏离传统隐蔽通信所假设的高斯信令，现有方案难以直接适用。

Method: 1) 推导面向未知噪声水平下最优检测器的最大隐蔽速率闭式表达式，揭示合法信噪比与星座矩匹配阶数及MA阵列空间增益的关系；2) 在峰值功率约束下设计Gauss-Laguerre环形星座以提高矩匹配阶数；3) 提出"秩—环分配+加扰"的隐蔽符号映射，将语义承载于潜在幅值的排序中；4) 基于推导的语义失真界，通过可逆流模型在所设计星座与MA阵列上端到端训练语义编解码器。

Result: 仿真表明该方案可实现更高的隐蔽速率，且与现有先进SemCom方案相比重建质量提升24%。

Conclusion: 通过星座、MA阵列与语义收发机的联合设计，可在离散信令下兼顾隐蔽性与语义保真度，为隐蔽数字语义通信提供可行方案。

Abstract: Digital semantic communication (SemCom) is emerging as a bandwidth-efficient paradigm for next-generation wireless networks by delivering the meaning of a source over finite constellations. However, the broadcast nature of wireless channels exposes transmissions to adversarial wardens, while discrete symbols deviate from the Gaussian signaling assumed by conventional covert communication. In this paper, we propose a covert digital SemCom system assisted by movable antennas (MAs), where the constellation, the antenna positions, and the semantic transceiver are jointly designed to conceal the transmission while preserving the semantic fidelity. Specifically, the maximum covert rate against the optimal detector with unknown noise level is derived in closed-form, which reveals that the legitimate signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) scales with the moment-matching order of the constellation and the spatial gain provided by the MA array. A Gauss-Laguerre ring constellation is then designed to raise the moment-matching order under the peak power constraints, and a covert symbol mapping with rank-to-ring assignment and scrambling is developed to carry the semantics in the ordering of the latent magnitudes. Guided by the derived semantic distortion bound, the semantic encoder and decoder are trained end-to-end through an invertible flow over the designed constellation and MA array. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme supports a higher achievable covert rate and improves the reconstruction quality by 24% compared to state-of-the-art SemCom schemes.

</details>


### [455] [LWMa: Distributed Deployment of an Angle-Delay-Domain Wireless Foundation Model for Multiple Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23084)
*Zhizhen Ren,Xudong Zhang,Jingbo Tan,Jintao Wang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出基于角度-时延域大无线模型（LWMa）的分布式框架，以可复用的信道表征支撑6G FDD系统下的多任务处理，并缓解上行反馈受限问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G无线业务多样化，需要跨不同传播环境、支持多任务的复用信道表征；但在FDD系统中于用户设备与基站之间部署此类表征受上行反馈约束。

Method: 构建角度-时延域LWMa，利用角度-时延结构与时延截断提升特征提取效率并降低计算开销；借鉴Perceiver IO设计场景专用网络，对信道重建任务的嵌入进行压缩，其余任务使用低维紧凑全局嵌入；采用嵌入重建训练后接信道质量引导微调的两阶段策略。

Result: 仿真表明该方法在有限反馈下可实现有效的信道重建并支撑多任务，且部署复杂度降低；恢复的嵌入可泛化至额外任务并支持分割推理。

Conclusion: 角度-时延域大无线模型结合两阶段训练可在受限反馈条件下提供可复用、可泛化的信道表征，适配多任务与分割推理部署。

Abstract: The growing diversity of wireless services in sixth-generation (6G) wireless communication systems calls for reusable channel representations that support multiple tasks across different propagation environments. However, deploying such representations between user equipment and the base station in frequency-division duplexing systems faces uplink feedback constraints. This paper proposes a distributed framework based on an angle-delay-domain large wireless model (LWMa) for multiple tasks. LWMa exploits angle-delay structure and delay truncation to improve feature extraction and reduce computational cost. A scenario-specific network inspired by Perceiver IO (input-output) compresses embeddings for channel reconstruction tasks, while other tasks use a low-dimensional compact global embedding. Embedding reconstruction training followed by channel-quality-guided fine-tuning preserves information useful for downstream processing. Simulations demonstrate that the proposed method supports effective channel reconstruction and multiple tasks under limited feedback with reduced deployment complexity. Further evaluations show that the recovered embeddings generalize to additional tasks and support split inference.

</details>


### [456] [Keep Pace to Learn: Movable Antennas Restore the Backpropagated Gradient Under User Mobility](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23118)
*Xianzhong Li,Yuzhi Yang,Tianhao Guo*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 研究移动终端参与空口训练时自身运动对梯度的旋转效应，提出"随动天线"无需信道估计即可补偿，并给出速度律与偏置–抖动律，仿真验证可逼近理想CSI精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 移动终端在空口训练中，终端自身运动会使回传梯度发生旋转，破坏梯度方向，导致学习性能下降；而传统做法依赖数字域信道估计与校正，开销大。作者希望找到一种无需CSI的物理层补偿手段并明确其适用条件。

Method: 在物理回波的标量条件均值模型下做理论分析：推导残差位移与空间相关函数第一正瓣的关系，得到保证条件均值梯度仍为下降方向的速度律，并给出临界"执行器–终端速度比"；进一步分析零均值高斯抖动与亚波长系统偏置对梯度方向的影响，提出偏置–抖动律。在3GPP CDL-A信道上做仿真，并辅以独立定位仿真对照。

Result: 仿真表明，天线随动、无需数字信道校正即可达到98.58%精度，接近理想CSI参考的98.59%；当残差位移落入较后的正相关瓣内时，部分补偿仍可支持学习，故执行器更快并不必然带来更高精度；定位仿真中系统偏置造成精度骤降，而同量级零均值高斯抖动退化很小。

Conclusion: 随动可移动天线可在无信道估计条件下有效恢复梯度方向；存在一个临界速度比使残差落在第一正瓣内；在零有效偏置下，有限幅度零均值高斯抖动仅缩放梯度而不改变方向，而亚波长系统偏置可能反转梯度方向，因此应优先进行偏置校准以保持梯度方向。

Abstract: When a mobile terminal takes part in over-the-air training, its own motion rotates the gradient that travels back through it; a movable antenna that keeps pace with the terminal rotates it back---without any channel estimate. We give a speed law: under a scalar conditional-mean model of the physical return, landing the residual displacement inside the first positive lobe of the spatial correlation keeps the conditional mean gradient a descent direction, which, given sufficient travel, fixes a critical actuator-to-terminal speed ratio. We further prove a bias--jitter law: under the same scalar conditional-mean model and with zero effective bias, independent zero-mean Gaussian jitter of any finite amplitude scales the conditional mean gradient without reversing its direction, whereas a sub-wavelength systematic bias can reverse it. This result motivates prioritizing bias calibration to preserve gradient direction. Simulations on 3GPP CDL-A channels show that an antenna keeping pace with the terminal achieves near-CSI accuracy without digital channel correction, reaching 98.58 % compared with 98.59% for the ideal-CSI reference. The simulations also show that partial compensation can support learning when the residual displacement falls within a later positive correlation lobe, so a faster actuator does not necessarily yield higher accuracy. Separate positioning simulations show a sharp accuracy loss under systematic bias but little degradation under zero-mean Gaussian jitter of comparable spatial scale.

</details>


### [457] [Wait to Learn: Lobes and Dead Zones in Physical Backpropagation over an Aging Single-Antenna Channel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23135)
*Xianzhong Li,Yuzhi Yang,Tianhao Guo*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 在物理反向传播中，单根移动天线的回传梯度会被时间相关性的相位"反旋转"；延迟回传至相关性极值点可绕开相关性零点导致的可识别性失效。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理反向传播依赖互易信道回传损失梯度，但接收端天线移动使回传梯度带有时间相关相位，且传统线性校正（标定）在相关性零点附近无法恢复真实梯度，需要新的应对策略。

Method: 将单天线回传梯度建模为真实梯度经时间相关性相位反旋转后的结果，并分析不同相关性相位（负相关瓣、正相关瓣、零点）下的训练行为；对比线性校正/增加标定与"保持回传至下一相关性极值再使用"的延迟策略。

Result: 仿真显示未校正训练在负相关瓣失败、在正相关瓣恢复；相关性零点处回传与正向信道无关，任何线性校正均无均值可恢复，附近增大标定收效甚微，而延迟至下一相关性极值则有效。

Conclusion: 相位延迟（等待）可作为一种优于线性标定的校正手段，规避相关性零点带来的不可辨识问题。

Abstract: Sometimes the best way to correct an aged gradient is to wait. In physical backpropagation, a receiver returns its loss gradient through the reciprocal channel. With a single moving antenna, the mean gradient returned at the antenna is the true one counter-rotated by the phase of the temporal correlation. In simulation, uncorrected training fails in negative correlation lobes and revives in positive ones. At correlation zeros the return is independent of the forward channel, so no linear correction has a mean to recover; near them, more calibration barely helps, but holding the return until the next correlation extremum does.

</details>


### [458] [Coherent but Discordant: Rotate, Don't Invert, to Backpropagate Through an Aging Channel](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23137)
*Xianzhong Li,Yuzhi Yang,Tianhao Guo*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 在过空口反向传播中，移动终端引起的时变相关性会给回传梯度带来相位旋转而非单纯幅度衰减；相干性只衡量幅度，因此不是正确的度量。正确做法是校正旋转而非拉伸：标量情形做相位校正可将准确率从51.7%恢复到92.5%；阵列情形可通过端口重索引或用条件均值算子的酉极因子旋转回传种子来恢复性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 物理（over-the-air）反向传播中，接收端经互易信道回传损失梯度。当终端在两次传输之间移动时，梯度不仅被加噪，还被"旋转"。而工程中常用的相干性指标只刻画时变相关的幅度（|ρ|），忽略了相位，导致即使在近乎完全相干（|ρ|>0.9）的信道下，未校正的训练也会严重退化。因此需要指出相干性是错误的度量，并给出正确的校正对象。

Method: 1) 建立标量条件均值模型，证明旋转由时变相关的相位决定；据此提出相位校正（而非幅度/相干性对齐）。2) 阵列情形：分析迹相关零点附近标量校正失效的机理，说明信息并未丢失而是被移到相邻天线上；提出零数字反馈下的端口重索引（按位移）方案；并提出用条件均值算子的酉极因子旋转回传种子、绝不对其求逆的方案。3) 给出一条精确的阵列恒等式统一解释上述三种现象，并对比"各天线相位对齐自身历史"这一失败做法。

Result: 仿真中，|ρ|>0.9 的相干信道下未校正训练准确率仅 51.7%，相位校正后恢复至 92.5%。在迹相关零点附近，即使 ρ 精确已知，标量校正仍失效；而按位移重索引端口（零数字反馈）或用量化酉极因子旋转回传种子均可恢复损失的性能；按各天线自身历史对齐相位则使性能变差。精确阵列恒等式解释了这三种现象。

Conclusion: 结论可概括为一句：校正旋转，而非拉伸（correct the rotation, not the stretch）。相干性（|ρ|）不能作为时变信道下过空口反向传播的可靠性度量；应以相位/条件均值算子所诱导的旋转为校正对象，且旋转优于求逆。该原则对阵列系统同样成立，可通过端口重索引或酉极因子旋转在无需数字反馈的情况下实现。

Abstract: A channel can be almost perfectly coherent and still teach a transmitter the wrong direction. In physical ("over-the-air") backpropagation, the receiver sends its loss gradient back through the reciprocal channel; when the terminal moves in between, mobility does not merely add noise to the returned gradient, it rotates it. Under a scalar conditional mean model the rotation is set by the phase of the temporal correlation, so coherence, which measures only its magnitude, is the wrong ruler: in simulation, channels with absolute value of rho greater than 0.9 drive uncorrected training to 51.7% accuracy, while phase correction restores 92.5%. Arrays add a twist. Near zeros of the trace correlation, scalar correction fails even with rho known exactly, yet most of the information is still there: noise has moved it onto neighbouring antennas. Re-indexing the ports by the displacement, with zero digital feedback, recovers the lost performance in simulation, and so does rotating the returned seed with the unitary polar factor of the conditional mean operator, never inverting it; aligning each antenna's phase with its own past makes things worse. An exact array identity explains all three. The lesson fits in one line: correct the rotation, not the stretch.

</details>


### [459] [Robust Design of Sensing-Assisted Secure Transmission for RIS-Aided ISAC System under Eavesdropper 3D Positioning Uncertainty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23139)
*Jie Li,Zhendong Li,Wen Chen,Wei Xu,Ning Wang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种感知辅助的鲁棒安全传输框架，利用ISAC感知刻画窃听者定位不确定椭球集合，两阶段联合优化感知波束/通信波束与RIS反射系数，最大化最差情况保密速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RIS辅助ISAC系统中，窃听者位置估计误差会导致安全传输性能显著下降，需将定位不确定性显式建模并加以鲁棒处理。

Method: RIS划分为反射区与感知接收区实现空间分离；联合基站与RIS感知区观测，用MLE估计到达角，交叉定位获得Eve三维位置，并由定位CRLB构造椭球不确定域。两阶段优化：阶段I联合优化感知波束成形与RIS反射系数以提升定位精度；阶段II将不确定域纳入鲁棒安全设计，联合优化通信波束成形与RIS反射系数最大化最差情况保密速率。

Result: 仿真表明所提方案在保密性能上优于无RIS辅助和随机RIS配置的基准方案，有效缓解了Eve定位误差引起的保密性能退化。

Conclusion: 将ISAC感知与定位CRLB驱动的鲁棒优化结合，可有效提升RIS辅助ISAC系统的物理层安全性。

Abstract: Localization errors in estimating the position of a potential eavesdropper (Eve) pose a critical challenge to secure transmission in reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems. To address this issue, this paper proposes a sensing-assisted robust secure transmission framework that exploits ISAC sensing to characterize the positioning uncertainty induced by these errors. The RIS is partitioned into a reflection region and a sensing reception region, supporting sensing and communication through spatial separation. By jointly exploiting observations collected at the base station (BS) and the RIS sensing reception region, maximum likelihood estimation (MLE) is employed to estimate the arrival angles, from which Eve's three-dimensional (3D) position is obtained through cross localization. The resulting localization Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLB) is then used to construct an ellipsoidal uncertainty region around the estimated position. A two-stage optimization strategy is developed. In Stage I, the sensing beamformer and RIS reflection coefficients are jointly optimized to improve localization accuracy. In Stage II, the resulting positioning uncertainty is incorporated into a robust secure transmission design, where the communication beamformer and RIS reflection coefficients are jointly optimized to maximize the worst-case secrecy rate. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms benchmark schemes without RIS assistance and with random RIS configurations in terms of secrecy performance. The proposed framework effectively mitigates secrecy performance degradation caused by localization errors in Eve's position.

</details>


### [460] [Entropy-Based Wireless Technology Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23158)
*Mohammad Alhellani,Eli De Poorter,Mamoun Guenach,Adnan Shahid*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出基于二维离散熵的轻量级无线技术识别框架，从连续频谱图区域的局部时频复杂度演化中提取特征，用MLP分类，在-20~40 dB下平均准确率82.73%，优于IQ/STFT-CNN基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有WTR方法或依赖鲁棒性有限的手工特征，或依赖高维IQ/频谱图上计算量大的深度学习模型，缺少兼顾鲁棒性与计算效率的表示方法。

Method: 假设无线技术可由其局部时频复杂度的时序演化区分。对连续频谱图区域计算二维离散熵（2D dispersion entropy），刻画一次传输过程中局部复杂度演化，汇总为紧凑特征向量，交由多层感知机（MLP）分类。

Result: 在IEEE 802.11ah、802.15.4 SUN-FSK、802.15.4 SUN-OFDM、LoRa、802.11n、LTE、5G NR七种技术上、-20~40 dB SNR范围内评估：全SNR平均准确率82.73%，较IQ-CNN与STFT-CNN分别提升23.8%和14.6%，低/中SNR优势尤为明显；数据增强训练下优势保持，且训练时间显著更短。

Conclusion: 局部频谱图复杂度的时序演化构成具有技术特异性的鲁棒指纹，是一种有效且计算高效的WTR表示；轻量熵特征+MLP可替代重型CNN方案。

Abstract: Wireless Technology Recognition (WTR) enables identifying wireless technologies from received radio signals and is important for spectrum monitoring and management systems. Existing approaches either rely on handcrafted signal features with limited robustness or computationally intensive Deep Learning (DL) models operating on high-dimensional In-phase and Quadrature (IQ) samples or spectrograms. In this paper, we investigate a different hypothesis: wireless technologies can be distinguished through the temporal evolution of their local time-frequency complexity. To capture this behavior, we propose a lightweight WTR framework based on two-dimensional dispersion entropy. Entropy values are extracted from successive spectrogram regions to characterize the evolution of local spectrogram complexity throughout a transmission and summarized into a compact feature representation for classification using a Multilayer Perceptron (MLP). The framework is evaluated on seven wireless technologies, namely IEEE 802.11ah, IEEE 802.15.4 SUN-FSK, IEEE 802.15.4 SUN-OFDM, LoRa, IEEE 802.11n, LTE, and 5G NR, at Signal-to-Noise Ratios (SNRs) ranging from -20 dB to 40 dB. Experimental results show that the proposed approach consistently outperforms IQ-based and Short-Time Fourier Transform (STFT)-based Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) baselines, particularly at low and moderate SNRs. Averaged across all evaluated SNR levels, it achieves 82.73% accuracy, corresponding to improvements of 23.8% and 14.6% over the IQ-based and STFT-based CNN approaches, respectively. Furthermore, the approach maintains its recognition advantage with data-augmented training while requiring substantially shorter training times. The results demonstrate that temporal evolution of local spectrogram complexity provides a robust technology-specific fingerprint and an effective, computationally efficient representation for WTR.

</details>


### [461] [IMU-Aided Motion Compensation of RSS Measurements for Dynamic Visible Light-Inertial Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23188)
*Xiao Sun,Zhenqi Zheng,Jianzhu Huai,Xingxing Li,Wanwei Zhang,Yuan Zhuang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出IMU辅助的RSS校正算法，补偿PD快速运动在DFT窗口内导致的RSS平均化误差，并嵌入紧/松耦合VLP/INS框架，实现高动态室内定位。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLP基于PD接收机可实现高精度室内定位，但PD快速运动时DFT处理给出的是窗口内平均RSS而非瞬时RSS，造成测量偏差，限制动态场景性能。

Method: 利用IMU导出的运动参数建模DFT窗口内光信号的时间变化，实现瞬时RSS估计；将该校正算法嵌入紧耦合与简单（松）耦合VLP/INS组合框架中估计移动接收机位姿。

Result: 仿真验证校正模型；全站仪跟踪实验显示相对模型参考的RSS偏差下降；8组高动态手持试验（峰值平移2.25 m/s、角速度284 deg/s）中，与共享IMU的LiDAR/IMU参考相比，3D位置与PD法向倾角RMSE分别降低56.0%和71.9%。

Conclusion: IMU辅助的RSS校正可有效消除运动引起的RSS失真，显著提升高动态室内VLP/INS定位精度；数据集与源码公开。

Abstract: Visible Light Positioning (VLP) offers high-precision indoor positioning using existing LED infrastructure. However, in VLP systems using Photodiodes (PDs) as receivers, rapid movement of the PD causes measurement inaccuracies as the Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) processing yields averaged rather than instantaneous Received Signal Strength (RSS) values. To address this challenge, we propose an RSS correction algorithm that integrates Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) data with VLP observations to compensate for motion-induced distortions. Our approach leverages IMU-derived motion parameters to model the temporal variation of optical signals during the DFT window, enabling instantaneous RSS estimation. The algorithm is embedded within both tightly and simply coupled VLP/INS integration frameworks that estimate the pose of the moving receiver. This work targets highly dynamic indoor navigation. Simulations validate the correction model, and total-station-tracked experiments confirm reduced RSS discrepancies against model references. Across eight held-out high-dynamic handheld trials with peak translational and angular speeds of 2.25 m/s and 284 deg/s, correction reduces the pooled 3D position and PD-normal inclination root mean square errors relative to the LiDAR/IMU reference with a shared IMU by 56.0% and 71.9%, respectively. Both datasets and source code are publicly available.

</details>


### [462] [Joint Subcarrier and Power Allocation for Localization-Oriented Multi-Carrier Underwater ISAC Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23381)
*Wei Huang,Sitong Liu,Christos Masouros,Hao Zhang,T. Aaron Gulliver,Kaitao Meng*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文针对多锚点水声通感一体化（ISAC）系统，提出面向定位的子载波与功率分配方案，基于频选信道与色噪声下的闭式CRB和到达时间Fisher信息推导子载波级定位信息贡献，建立"距离-频率匹配"原则并设计低复杂度贪婪算法，在满足通信QoS的同时显著降低定位误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多载波水声ISAC可同时实现通信与定位，但水声信道的频率选择性导致各子载波定位能力不均；现有资源分配多面向通信或均匀分配，缺乏以定位精度为目标的子载波/功率分配理论依据。

Method: 1）建立统一的子载波正交复用（OSM）多锚点ISAC框架；2）在频选信道与色噪声下推导闭式CRB；3）由TOA Fisher信息导出子载波级定位信息贡献度量；4）理论分析该度量对距离与频率的依赖性质，提出距离-频率匹配原则；5）据此设计低复杂度贪婪算法，迭代分配子载波以最小化残余定位误差目标，并满足通信QoS约束。

Result: 仿真表明，在对称与非对称拓扑下，所提方法获得的定位误差界显著低于均匀分配、随机分配与高频优先分配，同时保证通信QoS，实现更优的通信-定位折中。

Conclusion: 频率选择性使子载波定位信息贡献存在距离-频率匹配关系，据此进行定位导向的子载波与功率分配可有效提升多锚点水声ISAC系统的定位精度并保持通信性能，为联合资源分配提供理论与算法基础。

Abstract: Multi-carrier underwater integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) realizes concurrent acoustic communication and localization, yet the frequency selectivity of the acoustic channel creates uneven positioning capabilities across subcarriers. This paper proposes a localization-oriented subcarrier and power allocation scheme for multi-anchor underwater ISAC systems. We build a unified orthogonal subcarrier multiplexing framework and derive closed-form Cramer-Rao bounds (CRBs) under frequency-selective channels with colored noise. We derive a subcarrier-level localization information contribution from the time of arrival Fisher information, which enables localization-oriented resource allocation. We derive several theoretical properties regarding the distance and frequency dependence of the localization information metric, and establish a distance-frequency matching principle. These results provide a theoretical foundation for localization-oriented resource allocation and guide the design of a low-complexity greedy algorithm that improves positioning accuracy. Specifically, the algorithm iteratively allocates subcarriers to minimize the residual positioning-error objective, thereby improving positioning accuracy while satisfying communication quality-of-service (QoS) constraints. Simulations verify that our method yields much lower positioning error bound than uniform, random and high-frequency-first subcarrier allocation in symmetric or asymmetric topologies while guaranteeing communication QoS, achieving superior communication-localization tradeoffs.

</details>


### [463] [AWM: An All-in-One Wireless Foundation Model for Multi-User Channel Acquisition and Localization Without Downstream Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23403)
*Zirui Chen,Ziqing Xing,Zhaoyang Zhang,Hongning Ruan,Zili Wang,Zhaohui Yang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一体化无线基础模型AWM，用"同属性参考对"作为提示把异构无线属性转化为可对齐的相对性表示，从而统一信道插值、跨频段预测与定位任务，并避免任务专属输出头与部署期微调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有无线基础模型（WFM）虽旨在统一多任务多场景，但仍依赖任务/场景专属组件或部署时微调，难以真正实现"一体化"。而多用户信道获取与定位在数据模态与功能目标上差异显著，如何在同一框架下统一是核心挑战。

Method: 核心洞察：用户位置与不同频段的CSI可视为同一无线链路的"属性特定测量"。方法上引入场景内同属性参考对作为prompt，将异质属性转换为可对齐的相对性表示，把带内信道插值、跨频段信道预测和无线定位统一建模为"无线状态变换"；并设计多任务MateFormer，在单一架构中完成源属性相对性提取、跨属性相对性对齐与目标属性合成，无需任务专属输出头或下游微调。

Result: 综合实验验证了模型统一的有效性：跨任务知识共享带来显著增益，可无缝泛化到未见场景，并为移动用户提供高效的闭环服务。

Conclusion: 通过相对性表示与参考对提示的统一建模范式，AWM实现了多属性无线任务的一体化建模，兼顾跨任务知识共享、场景泛化与部署效率，为无线基础模型提供了无需微调的统一路线。

Abstract: Wireless foundation models (WFMs) seek to unify diverse wireless tasks and scenarios, yet existing methods still rely on task- or scenario-specific components or deployment-time fine-tuning. This paper presents an all-in-one wireless model (AWM), a WFM that unifies multi-user channel acquisition and localization, despite their distinct data modalities and functional objectives. We reveal that user location and channel state information (CSI) at different frequencies can be viewed as attribute-specific measurements of the same wireless link. By introducing in-scenario same-attribute reference pairs as prompts, AWM converts heterogeneous attributes into alignable relativity representations, formulating intra-band channel interpolation, inter-band channel prediction, and wireless localization as unified wireless-state transformations. Further, a multi-task MateFormer is developed to perform source-attribute relativity extraction, cross-attribute relativity alignment, and target-attribute synthesis within a unified architecture, avoiding task-specific output heads or downstream fine-tuning. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of model unification, including substantial gains from cross-task knowledge sharing, seamless generalization to unseen scenarios, and an efficient closed-loop service for mobile users.

</details>


### [464] [Pilot-Based Sensing With OFDM and AFDM: A Resource-Matched Performance Comparison](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23420)
*Siyi Tang,Yin Xu,Aimin Tang,Dazhi He,Wenjun Zhang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文在相同带宽、帧时长、导频能量与预留资源开销下，系统比较AFDM与OFDM基于导频的感知性能，分离波形、导频样式与接收机处理三者的影响。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AFDM作为下一代无线波形候选，虽常与OFDM在不同配置下被比较，但缺乏在统一资源条件下基于导频的感知性能的系统性对比。

Method: 在相同带宽、帧时长、导频能量和预留资源开销约束下，将OFDM-random、OFDM-fixed-comb、OFDM-shifted-comb导频与带保护资源的AFDM导频进行对比；分别采用不含CP/CPP的非周期模糊函数与含CP/CPP的循环模糊函数进行分析，并开展目标检测实验。

Result: OFDM-fixed-comb距离旁瓣低但存在周期性距离模糊峰；AFDM与OFDM-shifted-comb可有效抑制零多普勒距离模糊。共同无模糊区域内，两波形各导频配置在强目标检测中阈值相近，而在弱目标检测中结构化OFDM与AFDM导频优于OFDM-random。高移动性下，采用DAFT的AFDM接收机可分辨超出传统慢时间最大无模糊速度的整数多普勒，在搜索复杂度增加的前提下优于所测试的常规OFDM与AFDM接收机。

Conclusion: 研究结果将波形、导频布置与接收机处理的影响相分离，为AFDM与OFDM的导频感知设计提供了依据。

Abstract: As a waveform candidate for next-generation wireless systems, affine frequency division multiplexing (AFDM) has often been compared with orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) under different configurations, while a systematic comparison of their pilot-based sensing performance remains lacking. This paper establishes a comparison with the same bandwidth, frame duration, pilot energy, and reserved-resource overhead. OFDM-random, OFDM-fixed-comb, and OFDM-shifted-comb pilots are compared with AFDM pilots surrounded by guard resources using aperiodic ambiguity functions without cyclic prefix/chirp-periodic prefix (CP/CPP) and cyclic ambiguity functions with CP/CPP, followed by target detection experiments. The results show that OFDM-fixed-comb exhibits low range sidelobes but periodic range ambiguity peaks, while AFDM and OFDM-shifted-comb effectively suppress zero-Doppler range ambiguities. Within the common unambiguous region, all pilot configurations for both waveforms exhibit similar detection thresholds in strong-target detection, while structured OFDM and AFDM pilot placements outperform OFDM-random in weak-target detection. At high mobility, the AFDM receiver using the discrete affine Fourier transform (DAFT) can resolve integer Doppler beyond the conventional slow-time maximum unambiguous velocity, outperforming the tested conventional OFDM and AFDM receivers at the increased search complexity. These results separate the effects of waveform, pilot placement, and receiver processing, providing a basis for AFDM and OFDM pilot-based sensing design.

</details>


### [465] [Temporal vs Spectral Resolution in CSI Reporting for Wi-Fi ISAC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23422)
*Abolfazl Zakeri,Sumit Roy,Nhan Thanh Nguyen,Markku Juntti*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 在IEEE 802.11bf框架下，研究Wi-Fi CSI反馈在时间分辨率与频谱分辨率两个维度上的精度-开销权衡，提出"周期上报+均值载荷+块均值分组"方案，以最多7.7%的完整CSI开销获得96–98%的完整CSI精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: CSI反馈是Wi-Fi感知（如人体活动识别HAR）的基础，但会占用本可用于数据通信的资源，构成显著开销。因此需要在受限的CSI上报预算下，寻找最有效的反馈策略。

Method: 沿IEEE 802.11bf的两个维度（上报强度/时间分辨率、上报子载波数/频谱分辨率）展开：对比等速率下的周期上报与阈值触发上报，对比等报告尺寸下的均匀抽取与块均值分组；并提出上报自上次报告以来累积CSI均值的方案。采用以802.11bf报告尺寸为开销度量的评估方法，在三个公开数据集上使用CNN+GRU+时间金字塔池化（TPP）模型评估精度-开销权衡。

Result: 在相同CSI开销下，周期上报结合均值载荷与块均值分组可将精度提升最多53个百分点；时间分辨率通常比频谱分辨率更具成本效益；所提方案仅用最多7.7%的完整CSI反馈开销，即可达到完整CSI精度的96–98%。

Conclusion: 在CSI反馈设计中，应优先投入时间分辨率而非频谱分辨率，并采用周期上报、累积均值载荷与块均值分组策略，可在极低开销下近似保持完整CSI的HAR精度。

Abstract: CSI feedback is fundamental to proposed uses of Wi-Fi sensing such as human activity recognition (HAR); but it also constitutes significant overhead as resources must be allocated away from data communications. Wi-Fi CSI extraction can be explored along two dimensions in IEEE 802.11bf: reporting intensity, i.e., temporal resolution, and number of reported subcarriers, i.e., spectral resolution. We explore periodic and IEEE 802.11bf threshold-based reporting at matched rates, and uniform decimation and block-mean grouping at matched report sizes. We further propose reporting the mean CSI accumulated since the last report. Using the 802.11bf report size as the metric, we evaluate the accuracy-cost tradeoffs on three public datasets with our proposed model, a convolutional neural network combined with a gated recurrent unit and temporal pyramid pooling. The proposed periodic reporting with mean payload and block-mean grouping improves accuracy by up to 53 percentage points at equal CSI overhead cost. Temporal resolution is generally more cost-effective than spectral resolution. With only at most 7.7% of full-CSI feedback cost, the proposed scheme achieves 96-98% of full-CSI accuracy.

</details>


### [466] [Sensing-Driven Secure Transmission with Mobile Eavesdropper Tracking in RIS-Assisted ISAC](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23437)
*Jie Li,Ning Wang,Zhendong Li,Ze Li,Lingfeng Shen,Zhongyun Li,Jiakang Zheng*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 针对RIS辅助ISAC系统中机动窃听者位置快速变化导致窃听信道时变与安全决策过时的问题，提出感知驱动的安全传输方案：联合BS与RIS的多视角MUSIC/MLE三维定位、IMM-EKF结合OOSM补偿的机动目标跟踪预测，以及满足感知CRLB约束的波束成形与RIS相移联合优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 潜在窃听者（Eve）的移动性使窃听信道快速时变，导致物理层安全（PLS）决策过时，这是ISAC系统安全传输中的关键挑战；因此需要利用ISAC波形的感知能力来实时获取Eve位置并据此更新安全传输策略。

Method: 1）利用ISAC波形双重功能，基于MUSIC与最大似然估计（MLE）联合基站与RIS的多视角角度估计，实现三维Eve定位，并以CRLB刻画定位精度；2）采用带乱序测量（OOSM）补偿的交互多模型扩展卡尔曼滤波（IMM-EKF）跟踪并预测机动Eve；3）基于预测轨迹更新时变窃听信道，在感知CRLB约束下联合优化发射波束成形与RIS相移；4）设计融合分数规划、半正定松弛（SDR）与黎曼流形优化的交替优化（AO）算法求解非凸问题。

Result: 数值结果表明，所提方法能够准确跟踪机动Eve，并在动态ISAC环境中有效提升安全传输性能。

Conclusion: 感知驱动的定位—跟踪—预测—优化闭环可有效应对机动窃听者带来的时变信道问题，验证了RIS辅助ISAC系统中感知与安全通信协同设计的可行性与优势。

Abstract: The mobility of potential eavesdroppers (Eves) poses a critical challenge to physical-layer security (PLS) in integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) systems, since rapidly varying Eve positions lead to time-varying eavesdropping channels and outdated security decisions. To address this challenge, this paper investigates sensing-driven secure transmission for reconfigurable intelligent surface (RIS)-assisted ISAC systems with a maneuvering Eve. To this end, by exploiting the dual functionality of the ISAC waveform, a multi-view angle estimation method jointly exploiting the base station (BS) and RIS is developed based on MUSIC and maximum likelihood estimation (MLE), enabling three-dimensional (3D) Eve localization, whose accuracy is characterized by the Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLB). Subsequently, an interacting multiple model extended Kalman filter (IMM-EKF) with out-of-sequence measurement (OOSM) compensation is employed to track and predict the maneuvering Eve. Based on the predicted trajectory, the time-varying eavesdropping channel is updated, and the transmit beamforming and RIS phase shifts are jointly optimized subject to a sensing CRLB constraint. Furthermore, an alternating optimization (AO) algorithm integrating fractional programming, semidefinite relaxation (SDR), and Riemannian manifold optimization is developed to solve the resulting non-convex problem. Finally, numerical results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in accurately tracking maneuvering Eves and enhancing secure transmission in dynamic ISAC environments.

</details>


### [467] [A Smaller Subspace is All You Need: Efficient ISAC Beamforming via Dimensionality Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23462)
*Ruiqi Liu,Yuanshuo Gang,Tianqi Mao,Qingqing Wu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文指出ISAC波束赋形可在比精确子空间更低维的子空间中求解，仅带来很小的感知性能损失，并比较了不同子空间下的感知性能与计算复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 6G中ISAC单站感知模式下，需通过最优波束赋形平衡通信与感知性能；MIMO系统中天线数量大使该波束赋形问题复杂度很高。现有方法利用低维精确子空间将复杂度降至与通信用户数和感知目标数成正比，作者希望进一步降低维度。

Method: 证明ISAC波束赋形问题可在仅含更少维度的子空间中求解（低于精确子空间维度），从而进一步降低计算复杂度；并通过数值实验在精确子空间与更小子空间之间对比感知性能与复杂度。

Result: 在更小维度子空间中求解可获得显著更低的计算复杂度，同时仅损失少量感知性能；数值结果给出了精确子空间与更小子空间在感知性能和复杂度上的对比。

Conclusion: ISAC波束赋形存在可接受感知性能损失下的低维近似子空间方案，为大规模MIMO下降低波束赋形复杂度提供了可行途径。

Abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) has been recognized as a critical technology for the sixth generation (6G) wireless networks. Under monostatic sensing mode, achieving a balance between communication and sensing performance via optimal beamforming is a critical research problem. In multiple input multiple output (MIMO) systems, such beamforming problems are of substantial computational complexity due to the large number of antennas. Existing methods exploit exact subspaces of lower dimensions to speed up the beamforming process where the complexity is proportional to the number of communication users and sensing targets instead of antennas. In this paper, it is demonstrated that the beamforming problem can be solved in an even lower-dimensional subspace with only a small sensing performance loss. Numerical results compare the sensing performance and computational complexity of ISAC beamforming problem in the exact subspace and smaller subspaces.

</details>


### [468] [Beyond Latent Personalization: Integrating HRV-Conditioned Personalization via LLM for Interpretable Stress Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23555)
*Wei-Hsiang Ma,Ya-Tse Wu,Hsing-Hang Chou,Chi-Chun Lee*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种LLM增强的个性化压力检测框架，通过LLM语义解释融合HRV特征与个人属性，在TILES-2018上MCC相对提升29.9%，并提供可读的个体生理反应描述。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于心率变异性（HRV）的个性化压力检测方法通过隐表示将个人属性与HRV融合，二者交互过程缺乏可解释性。

Method: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的语义解释机制整合HRV特征与个人属性，构建个人生理反应的可读文本描述并用于个性化压力检测。

Result: 在TILES-2018数据集上，相较最强基线，MCC相对提升29.9%，同时输出人类可读的个体生理反应描述。

Conclusion: LLM语义解释有望同时实现有效且可解释的个性化压力检测。

Abstract: Stress detection based on heart rate variability (HRV) has received increasing attention. However, existing personalized approaches integrate personal attributes with HRV through latent representations, limiting the interpretability of their interactions. In this work, we propose an LLM-enhanced personalized stress detection framework that integrates HRV features and personal attributes through LLM-based semantic interpretation. The proposed framework achieves a 29.9% relative MCC improvement over the strongest baseline on TILES-2018 while providing human-readable descriptions of individual physiological responses. The results highlight the potential of LLM-based semantic interpretation for achieving both effective and interpretable personalized stress detection.

</details>


### [469] [Packet Loss Analysis Under Doppler Effects and Reinforcement-Learning-Based Resource Allocation for Direct-to-Satellite LoRaWAN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23682)
*Alireza Maleki,Ebrahim Bedeer,Robert Barton*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 该文针对LoRaWAN直连卫星物联网（DtS-IoT），构建了同时考虑多普勒损伤与时频域碰撞的解析丢包率模型，并以该PLR为奖励，采用DQN与PPO两种强化学习进行资源分配，实现近乎七倍的终端承载量提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRaWAN具备长距离、低功耗特性，适合作为直连卫星物联网技术。但在大规模DtS-IoT网络中，数据包碰撞与卫星运动引起的多普勒效应会显著抬高丢包率，需要有效的资源分配方法加以缓解。

Method: 建立解析PLR模型，同时刻画多普勒损伤以及时间域与频率域上的数据包碰撞；将该解析PLR作为奖励函数，驱动深度Q网络（DQN）与近端策略优化（PPO）两种强化学习方案进行资源分配。

Result: 蒙特卡洛仿真验证了解析PLR模型的准确性。相对随机分配，在目标PLR为3×10^-2时，随机分配仅支持100个终端，PPO与DQN分别支持约650与690个终端，提升近七倍；对800个终端，PPO与DQN的总发包数分别提升106.7%与88.0%。

Conclusion: 解析建模与强化学习相结合的资源分配可显著提升DtS-IoT LoRaWAN网络的容量与吞吐性能，验证了多普勒与碰撞联合建模对大规模场景资源优化的必要性。

Abstract: Long range wide area network (LoRaWAN) has a long communication range and low power consumption, making it a potential technology for direct-to-satellite (DtS) Internet of Things (IoT) connectivity. However, packet collisions and Doppler impairments brought on by satellite motion can greatly increase the packet loss ratio (PLR) in large-scale DtS-IoT networks. In this paper, we study resource allocation in DtSIoT LoRaWAN by first developing an analytical PLR model that simultaneously takes Doppler impairments and packet collisions in the temporal and frequency domains into account. In order to maximize resource allocation, the generated PLR is then used as the reward function for two reinforcement learning (RL) schemes: deep Q-network (DQN) and proximal policy optimization (PPO). Simulation results validate the analytical PLR model against Monte Carlo simulations and demonstrate significant improvements over random resource allocation. At a target PLR of 3*10^-2, while random allocation supports only 100 end devices (EDs), PPO and DQN support approximately 650 and 690 EDs, respectively, representing nearly a seven-fold increase. Furthermore, for 800 EDs, PPO and DQN increase the total number of transmitted packets by 106.7% and 88.0%, respectively, compared with random allocation.

</details>


### [470] [ECG-SDI: Single-lead Electrocardiogram Enables Continuous Sleep Depth Index Profiling and Scalable Digital Biomarkers for Sleep Health](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.23727)
*Donglin Xie,Qingshuo Zhao,Songchi Zhou,Haoyu Wang,Jingyu Wang,Yuxi Zhou,Thomas Penzel,Shenda Hong*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出ECG-SDI，一种基于单导联心电图的连续睡眠深度刻画与数字生物标志物提取框架，并经大样本及外部验证支持其表型分型与CPAP疗效监测价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统睡眠分期为粗粒度离散表示，掩盖了同一睡眠期内的深度差异，难以刻画连续睡眠深度变化及个体化表型。

Method: 基于12,392份整夜多导睡眠图记录，以常规睡眠分期标签为监督，训练并验证两阶段深度学习模型，从单导联ECG输出连续睡眠深度指标（ECG-SDI）；在内部合并测试集与外部Cleveland Family Study中评估与有序分期的相关性及REM分类性能，并进行生物标志物表型分型、CPAP前后配对分析及可穿戴概念验证。

Result: 与有序分期（排除REM）相关性内部为0.828、外部为0.848，REM分类AUROC分别为0.954与0.977；整夜轨迹可捕捉期内变异。表型分型识别出与较差主观睡眠质量及更高全因死亡风险相关的紊乱亚型（SHHS，校正HR 1.20，95% CI 1.05–1.38）。507名CPAP配对受试者中标准化睡眠深度面积增加6.1%，低于0.3的浅睡负荷下降16.0%；近似熵与深度变异性的降低分别与氧减饱和减少和睡眠效率提高相关（Spearman rho=0.24、0.12），协变量校正后仍为正；N2期平均ECG-SDI增加0.017（95% CI 0.004–0.030）。

Conclusion: 单导联ECG可实现连续睡眠深度刻画与表型分型，并具CPAP应答居家监测潜力，需进一步评估。

Abstract: Conventional sleep staging provides a coarse-grained representation that obscures within-stage depth variation. We developed ECG-SDI, a single-lead electrocardiography (ECG) framework for continuous sleep-depth profiling and digital biomarker extraction. Using 12,392 overnight polysomnographic recordings, we trained and validated a two-stage deep learning model supervised by conventional sleep-stage labels. Correlations with ordered stages excluding rapid eye movement (REM) sleep were 0.828 in the pooled internal test set and 0.848 in the external Cleveland Family Study; corresponding REM classification AUROCs were 0.954 and 0.977. Overnight trajectories captured within-stage variation. Biomarker-based phenotyping identified a disturbed subtype associated with poorer subjective sleep quality and higher all-cause mortality in the Sleep Heart Health Study (adjusted hazard ratio, 1.20; 95% CI, 1.05-1.38). Among 507 participants with paired recordings before and after continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP), normalized sleep-depth area increased by 6.1% and shallow-sleep burden below 0.3 decreased by 16.0%. Exploratory analyses linked reductions in approximate entropy and depth variability to reduced oxygen desaturation and increased sleep efficiency, respectively (Spearman rho = 0.24 and 0.12); both associations remained positive after covariate adjustment. Mean ECG-SDI within N2 increased by 0.017 (95% CI, 0.004-0.030). A wearable proof-of-concept illustrated the acquisition-to-report workflow. These findings support ECG-based sleep phenotyping and further evaluation of CPAP response monitoring at home.

</details>


### [471] [Property Estimation in Geotechnical Databases Using Labeled Random Finite Sets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.22659)
*Changbeom Shim,Youngho Kim,Craig Butterworth*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出在标签随机有限集（LRFS）框架下，利用广义标签多伯努利（GLMB）滤波器从含噪、不完整数据中估计岩土参数，并借助LRFS与岩土大数据间接数据（BID）的相似性将其应用于数据中心岩土工程，通过公开黏土数据库的数值实验验证方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 岩土数据集本质上具有不确定性，工程师难以获得精确信息用于决策；当数据驱动技术仅依赖不完善数据库、或现场勘察困难时，这一问题更为突出。因此需要一种能够在贝叶斯视角下处理量测不确定性的岩土参数估计方法。

Method: 将岩土参数估计建模为LRFS框架下的多目标估计问题，采用GLMB滤波器处理测量不确定性；并论证LRFS特性与岩土BID特性的相似性，从而将GLMB滤波潜在迁移至数据中心岩土工程；使用公开黏土数据库开展数值实验评估。

Result: 通过公开黏土数据库的数值仿真实验对所提方法进行了评估（摘要未给出具体定量结果）。

Conclusion: LRFS与BID的相似性使GLMB滤波成为处理岩土含噪、不完整数据的可行途径，为数据中心岩土工程中的参数估计提供了新的贝叶斯多目标估计思路。

Abstract: The sufficiency of accurate data is a core element in data-centric geotechnics. However, geotechnical datasets are essentially uncertain, whereupon engineers have difficulty with obtaining precise information for making decisions. This challenge is more apparent when the performance of data-driven technologies solely relies on imperfect databases or even when it is sometimes difficult to investigate sites physically. This paper introduces geotechnical property estimation from noisy and incomplete data within the labeled random finite set (LRFS) framework. We leverage the ability of the generalized labeled multi-Bernoulli (GLMB) filter, a fundamental solution for multi-object estimation, to deal with measurement uncertainties from a Bayesian perspective. In particular, this work focuses on the similarity between LRFSs and big indirect data (BID) in geotechnics as those characteristics resemble each other, which enables GLMB filtering to be exploited potentially for data-centric geotechnical engineering. Experiments for numerical study are conducted to evaluate the proposed method using a public clay database.
